title: When Agent Governance Helps
comment: 35 pages, 14 figures. Companion empirical study to a Purdue D.Tech dissertation. Introduces the GAMPO framework from a 321-source qualitative evidence synthesis and probes a prompt-layer instantiation on the CHI-Bench healthcare benchmark across open and frontier models
summary: No specification says how a governed autotelic AI agent organization, where agents pursue self-generated goals inside guardrails, should be designed and evaluated. We answer in two parts. First, we synthesize the Governed Autotelic Multi-Agent Product Organization (GAMPO) framework from a document-based qualitative evidence synthesis of 321 sources, integrating agency, agile, platform, and governance theory into a runnable specification. Second, we probe a prompt-layer instantiation of GAMPO on CHI-Bench, a long-horizon healthcare benchmark, across open and frontier models. The result is a boundary condition: governance benefit is gated by a model's spare capacity and is domain- and model-specific. On capacity-constrained open models the full procedure yields no reliable benefit, whereas a single "verify your writes" sentence doubles task success (pass@1 2/20 to 4/20). At the frontier the same scaffold lifts prior-authorization 24% to 40% but nets zero on another model, a gap traced to a stable recommendation-override disposition. A second result refines the first: replacing the generic procedure with an answer-blind, per-task definition-of-done, keyed only to the case's own policy and published standards, never the hidden key, raises prior-authorization to 84% under best-of-five self-consistency (68% single-attempt, confirmed by a held-out board) and utilization-management to 44%, while care-management meets a subjective content-quality wall. The contribution is a named, auditable framework and capability-gated evidence that governance should be sized to spare capacity, and that at the frontier a case-grounded specification beats a uniform procedure. Findings are exploratory: partial instantiation, small per-cell samples (n = 5-25), and single trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了治理型自主体多智能体产品组织（GAMPO）框架，并对其在医疗基准CHI-Bench上进行了实证探测。核心发现是：治理收益受模型备用能力限制，且具有领域与模型特异性。对于容量受限的开源模型，完整治理流程无可靠收益，但简单的"校验写入"提示可将任务成功率翻倍；在前沿模型上，统一流程收益有限，而基于case的、任务特定的"完成定义"能大幅提升授权任务成功率（最高达84%）。
AI.motivation: 当前没有任何规范说明如何在护栏内设计并评估由自主智能体组成、追求自生成目标的治理型企业组织。研究者希望填补这一空白，回答治理型自主体多智能体组织应如何设计的问题。
AI.method: 第一部分通过对321个来源的文献定性证据综合，整合了主体性、敏捷、平台与治理理论，提炼出可运行的GAMPO框架规范。第二部分在CHI-Bench（长时程医疗基准）上对开源与前沿模型进行提示层实例化探测，对比完整治理流程、简化的"verify your writes"句子、以及基于case的回答盲完成定义等多种配置。
AI.result: 研究表明：1）在容量受限的开源模型上，完整治理流程无可靠收益，而单个"校验写入"提示使pass@1从2/20提升至4/20；2）同一脚手架在前沿模型上将预授权任务从24%提升至40%，但在另一模型上收益为零（归因于稳定的推荐覆盖倾向）；3）用答案盲的、基于每任务案例自身策略的完成定义替代通用流程后，预授权任务在最佳5次自洽条件下达到84%（单次尝试68%），利用率管理达44%，但护理管理遇到主观内容质量瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了一个具名、可审计的框架和基于能力门槛的证据，表明治理应适配模型的备用能力；在前沿模型上，基于case的规范优于统一流程。但研究属于探索性发现：部分实例化、每格样本量小（n=5-25）且仅单次试验。

title: TamilEOT: A Dataset and Model for Semantic End-of-Turn Detection in Tamil Telephone Speech
comment: 13 pages, 7 tables. Code, data and models: https://github.com/santhosh-005/tamil-eot
summary: A voice agent has to decide, at every pause, whether the user has finished speaking. Without a model of the language that decision falls back to a fixed silence timeout: set it short and the agent interrupts, set it long and every turn pays the full wait. Open semantic end-of-turn detectors exist, but to our knowledge none covers a South Indian language. We release TamilEOT: 18,485 labelled turn boundaries cut from 116 real Tamil telephone conversations, and two audio-only detectors fine-tuned from Smart Turn v3. On a held-out split of 4,168 clips from 30 unseen calls, accuracy rises from 70.30% zero-shot to 83.71% (8.7 MB) and 86.13% (21 MB); ROC-AUC rises from 0.751 to 0.921. Both models run in under 150 ms single-threaded on a laptop CPU. We also report what building it cost. Rule-derived labels, checked against a blind human listening pass, were right 95.9% of the time on the positive class and 44.4% on the negative class, which is below chance, because the rule answered a different question than the model is asked. Replacing them with an audio-LLM labeller measured at 97.5% human agreement cost US$5.69. Of every training lever we measured, only encoder capacity moved the result; three runs at identical config and seed span 0.87 accuracy points, which is the floor below which none of our other deltas mean anything. Replaying the same labelled boundaries through the production VAD and streaming adapter costs a further 2.60 points, and 7.8% of boundaries are never surfaced to the model at all. Data, weights, code and every negative result are public.

AI.tldr: 本文发布TamilEOT，一个包含18,485个标注回合边界的数据集（来源于116段真实泰米尔语电话录音），以及两个从Smart Turn v3微调而来的纯音频端到端（EOT）检测器。模型在4,168个片段（30个未见通话）上准确率从零样本的70.30%提升至83.71%（8.7 MB）和86.13%（21 MB），ROC-AUC从0.751提升至0.921，单线程延迟低于150 ms，并在公共平台上发布了数据、权重、代码及所有负面结果。
AI.motivation: 语音代理在每个停顿点都必须判断用户是否说完话。现有方案多依赖固定静音超时，过短会打断、过长则增加延迟；开放语义端到端检测器虽存在，但缺乏对南印度语言（如泰米尔语）的支持，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 从116段真实泰米尔语电话录音中切出18,485个标注回合边界；从Smart Turn v3微调两个纯音频EOT检测器（8.7 MB和21 MB）。对规则派生标签进行了人工盲听验证（正类95.9%正确），后改用音频-LLM标注器（97.5%人工一致性，成本5.69美元）。系统性测量了各训练杠杆的影响，并通过VAD和流式适配器评估部署损失。
AI.result: 模型在4,168个片段、30个未见通话上准确率从70.30%提升至83.71%和86.13%，ROC-AUC从0.751升至0.921；两模型均在150 ms内完成单线程CPU推理。规则标签在负类别上仅44.4%正确（低于随机水平），因其回答的问题与模型任务不同；替换为音频-LLM标注器成本仅5.69美元。只有编码器容量是有效训练杠杆（同一配置三次运行的0.87点标准差为置信下限），经VAD与流式适配器后额外损失2.60点，7.8%的边界未被模型感知。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过发布首个泰米尔语开放语义EOT检测器及其数据集，证明了低资源语言EOT检测的可行性；同时揭示了规则派生标签的局限性与音频-LLM标注的经济性，强调需报告单个训练杠杆的噪声下限和部署管线损耗，以推动更可靠、可复现的EOT研究。

title: Better Together: Complementary Query Rewriting Under a Strong RAG Baseline
summary: A popular way to improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is to rewrite the user's question into several variants and search with all of them. We test whether this actually helps once the underlying search is already strong. Under one fixed, competitive pipeline (BGE dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and MMR diversification), we compare four query-rewriting strategies (S1-S4) against two strong LLM baselines (HyDE, Query2Doc) on three datasets (HotpotQA, AmbigNQ, and the 512K-document EnterpriseRAG-Bench) over three seeds with paired-bootstrap significance tests. Our headline result is that rewriting alone is at best competitive with a strong baseline, but combining methods yields outsized gains because different strategies fail on different questions. A post-hoc union of four methods (S1+S3+S4+HyDE) improves HIT@10 over the baseline by +12.5 points on enterprise data (51.70 vs 39.22), and a five-method union reaches 52.98 (+13.8). Budget-matched controls capture only ~40% of this gain, confirming that complementarity, not retrieval budget, is the primary driver. On HotpotQA the union adds +1.6 to +1.8 points (p<0.001), saturating the all-method oracle; on AmbigNQ the same fusion hurts (-2.4 below the best solo, p<0.001), and we analyze when and why. Because rewriting is expensive, we evaluate in simulation a confidence-gated router that runs rewriting only when the baseline's own top-1 score is low. It captures about half of the enterprise full-merge gain (+4.3 HIT@10) while paying rewriting cost on <40% of queries, and automatically declines to rewrite on AmbigNQ. A downstream answer-quality evaluation confirms the router improves F1 by +1.92 (p<0.01) at roughly 40% of the expansion cost. In short: treat query rewriting as a complementary coverage source, applied through cost-aware routing, not as a standalone replacement for a strong baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了查询重写策略在强检索基线下的实际效果，发现单一重写方法最多与强基线持平，但多种方法组合因互补性可带来显著增益（企业数据上HIT@10提升+12.5至+13.8）。同时提出置信度门控路由器，仅对低置信度查询执行重写，能以约40%的计算成本获得约一半的增益。
AI.motivation: 查询重写是改进RAG的流行方法，但已有研究未充分检验在强检索基线（如稠密检索+重排序+多样化）下重写是否仍有帮助，以及多策略组合的互补性和成本控制问题。
AI.method: 在固定竞争性流水线（BGE稠密检索、交叉编码器重排序、MMR多样化）下，对三种数据集、三种随机种子、配对学生自助显著性检验，系统比较四种查询重写策略（S1-S4）与两个强LLM基线（HyDE、Query2Doc），并进行方法联合（union）、预算匹配对照、置信度门控路由器的模拟与下游答案质量评估。
AI.result: 单一重写在强基线下至多持平；后验四方法联合（S1+S3+S4+HyDE）在EnterpriseRAG-Bench上HIT@10达51.70（+12.5），五方法联合达52.98（+13.8）；HotpotQA上联合提升+1.6~+1.8（p<0.001），AmbigNQ上融合反而下降-2.4（p<0.001）；预算匹配对照仅捕获约40%增益；置信度门控路由以<40%查询重写成本获得+4.3 HIT@10，下游F1提升+1.92（p<0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 查询重写不应作为强基线的独立替代方案，而应视为互补性覆盖来源，通过成本感知的路由机制来应用；不同策略在不同问题上失败模式不同，组合互补性而非检索预算才是提升的关键驱动因素。

title: Who Maintains Agent Skills? A Longitudinal Study of Human-Governed, AI-Assisted Skill Maintenance
summary: Lifelong LLM agents increasingly rely on external skill artifacts as one element for preserving and reusing capabilities over time. These skills (usually portable Markdown files such as SKILL.md) describe when and how to apply a capability and must be corrected, expanded, and consolidated as tools and usage patterns shift over deployment. Recent work seeks to automate skill curation, but it largely evaluates against automated baselines and treats human maintenance as an unmeasured bottleneck. We study that missing process directly. We mine the full commit histories of five public AI-skill repositories, a purposive sample of AI-tooling organizations, covering 873 commits, 143 skill files, and 254 substantive post-creation edits from October 2025 to June 2026. We code each edit with pre-registered governance, operation, and trigger-evidence codebooks. Three findings emerge. First, every substantive edit is authored or merged through a named human account, while 62% carry an AI co-author trailer, with large repository-level variation. Second, these edits are genuine curation: an audited sample shows that most change skill content, and the coded operations are dominated by additions and corrections. Third, a pre-registered rule-likeness axis fails its reliability gate; reliably coding rule-likeness from commit artifacts remains an open measurement problem. We release the corpus, codebooks, mining scripts, and a replay protocol for automated skill curators. For self-evolving agents, public skill maintenance currently looks less like an autonomous pipeline than a human-governed, AI-assisted loop that future curators must measure against and operate within.

AI.tldr: 本文通过挖掘五个公开AI技能仓库的完整提交历史（873次提交、143个技能文件、254次实质性编辑），研究终身学习LLM代理中技能工件的人类维护过程。研究发现所有实质性编辑都通过具名人类账户完成，62%带有AI合著者标记，编辑以增补和修正为主，但规则相似性的可靠编码仍是一个未解测量问题。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化技能策展研究主要针对自动化基线进行评估，将人类维护视为未测量的瓶颈。作者希望直接研究这一被忽视的人类维护过程，为自动化技能策展系统提供可衡量、可遵循的现实基准。
AI.method: 对五个公开AI技能仓库进行有目的抽样，挖掘2025年10月至2026年6月间的完整提交历史，共收集873次提交、143个技能文件和254次实质性编辑。使用预注册的治理、操作和触发证据编码手册对每次编辑进行编码，并对规则相似性轴进行可靠性检验。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：1）所有实质性编辑均通过具名人类账户撰写或合并，62%带有AI共同作者标记，仓库间差异显著；2）这些编辑是真正的策展行为，审计样本显示大多改变技能内容，编码操作以增补和修正为主；3）预注册的规则相似性轴未通过可靠性门槛，从提交工件中可靠编码规则相似性仍是开放测量问题。
AI.conclusion: 公开技能维护目前更像人类主导、AI辅助的循环，而非自主流水线。未来的自动化技能策展器必须以此为基准并在该运维环境中运行。作者发布了语料库、编码手册、挖掘脚本和回放协议以供研究使用。

title: Architectural and Regularization Components in Deep Learning Medical Image Registration: Systematic Ablation Study
summary: Deep learning registration methods routinely stack two kinds of enhancement on a base network: architectural additions such as affine pre-alignment stages, and training-objective additions such as regularization losses. Papers tend to adopt both at once, so it is unclear which is doing the work. I ran a controlled ablation to separate them. Using the OASIS brain MRI dataset (394 training subjects, 20 test subjects), I trained four variants of the same registration pipeline: a baseline 3D U-Net with basic similarity losses, the same U-Net with a full regularization suite, an affine-plus-deformable architecture with basic losses, and the affine architecture with the full suite. I evaluated registration accuracy (MSE, NCC, SSIM), deformation quality (Jacobian determinant preservation, displacement statistics, an anatomical plausibility score), and computational cost. Regularization alone accounted for most of the gain: a 21.3% relative gain on the MSE-improvement metric (1.78% to 2.16%, P<.001) and a 21.8% relative gain in NCC improvement, while cutting maximum deformation from 53.1 to 0.51 units, a 99.0% reduction, at essentially no computational cost (-0.06% inference time). The combined model produced the largest accuracy gain, 25.8% (1.78% to 2.24%), and raised anatomical plausibility from 0.596 to 0.930, at a moderate +9.8% inference-time cost. Gradient correlation rose from 0.742 at baseline to 0.980 for the fully enhanced model. All enhanced variants reached sub-voxel accuracy under plausible deformation constraints. Regularization losses are the primary driver in this setting, delivering the accuracy gains and almost all of the deformation control for free at inference time, while the affine architecture adds a smaller complementary benefit at acceptable cost. The 99% reduction in unrealistic deformations addresses a known barrier to clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过受控消融实验，分离了深度学习配准方法中"网络架构增强"与"训练目标增强"两类改进的贡献。在OASIS脑MRI数据集上，正则化损失单独贡献了大部分精度提升（MSE改善21.3%、NCC改善21.8%），并将最大形变削减99%，且几乎不增加推理成本；仿射预对齐架构则提供较小的互补增益。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习配准方法常同时叠加架构增强（如仿射预对齐）与目标函数增强（如正则化损失），导致难以区分各自贡献。论文旨在通过受控消融实验厘清二者的主导作用。
AI.method: 在OASIS脑MRI数据集（394训练/20测试）上，对同一配准流程训练四种变体：基线3D U-Net+基础相似度损失、含完整正则化套件的U-Net、仿射+可变形架构+基础损失、以及仿射架构+完整正则化套件。评估指标包括配准精度（MSE/NCC/SSIM）、形变质量（Jacobian行列式保持、位移统计、解剖合理性评分）和计算成本。
AI.result: 正则化单独贡献了大部分增益：MSE改善指标相对提升21.3%（1.78%→2.16%，P<.001），NCC改善相对提升21.8%，最大形变从53.1降至0.51（降低99.0%），推理时间仅增加-0.06%。组合模型获得最大精度增益25.8%（1.78%→2.24%），解剖合理性评分从0.596提升至0.930，代价为+9.8%推理时间。梯度相关性从基线0.742升至0.980。所有增强变体均达到亚体素精度并满足合理形变约束。
AI.conclusion: 在该配准场景中，正则化损失是精度提升和形变控制的主要驱动力，推理阶段几乎零成本；仿射架构提供较小但互补的增益，代价可接受。99%的不可理形变削减有助于克服临床部署的关键障碍。

title: A Rubric-Guided Large Language Model Solution for Opioid Use Disorder Computable Phenotyping
summary: Opioid use disorder (OUD) remains a public health crisis in the United States, yet it is difficult to identify from electronic health records (EHRs) because missing diagnosis codes and supporting evidence are buried in clinical narratives. Accurate OUD identification is critical to support interventions and improve health outcomes. This study developed a rubric-guided large language model (LLM) that incorporated Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) for OUD computable phenotyping (CP). The framework used an 18-item, expert-identified rubric to instruct LLMs to automatically extract critical text with supporting evidence to determine OUD flags. Two UF Health physicians (GMR and WMG) chart-reviewed 253 patients, including 68 OUD-positive cases. Our LLM-based computable phenotype (CP) achieved the best F1 score of 0.774 and an AUROC of 0.934, outperforming the machine learning-based CP using EHR and natural language processing-extracted variables, and zero-shot LLMs by relative F1 improvements of 12.8% and 44.4%, respectively. The proposed LLM-based CP could link LLM-extracted evidence to OUD phenotyping for better explainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）和阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）计算表型框架，通过18项专家制定的评分标准引导LLM自动从电子健康记录（EHR）中提取关键证据，识别OUD患者。在253例患者（68例OUD阳性）的验证中，该方法F1分数达0.774，AUROC为0.934，相比机器学习方法和零样本LLM分别提升12.8%和44.4%的F1分数，同时提供了可解释的LLM提取证据。
AI.motivation: 阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）是美国严重的公共卫生危机，但由于诊断编码缺失以及支持证据深埋于临床叙述文本中，从电子健康记录（EHR）中准确识别OUD十分困难。准确的OUD识别对于支持临床干预和改善患者健康结果至关重要，因此需要开发更有效的自动化表型识别方法。
AI.method: 本研究开发了一种基于评分标准指导的大语言模型（LLM）框架，结合Optimization by PROmpting（OPRO）技术用于OUD可计算表型识别。该框架使用18项由专家制定的评分标准来指导LLM自动提取包含支持证据的关键临床文本，从而判断OUD标记。两名Uflorida Health医师对253名患者（含68例OUD阳性）进行了图表审查作为金标准。
AI.result: LLM-based可计算表型取得了最佳F1分数0.774和AUROC 0.934，相比基于EHR和NLP提取变量的机器学习表型以及零样本LLM，F1分数分别相对提升了12.8%和44.4%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的LLM-based可计算表型方法能够将LLM提取的证据与OUD表型判定相关联，不仅提升了识别性能，还增强了模型的可解释性，为OUD的自动化识别提供了更优的解决方案。

title: A Survey on Adversarial Attacks and Defenses for Diffusion Models Across Multiple Modalities
comment: Accepted into Life-Cycle Intellectual Property Governance of Visual Generative Models Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Diffusion models have become the dominant family of generative models in the visual domain. However, their widespread public availability enables misuse at scale, motivating a rapidly growing body of research on adversarial attacks and defenses. This survey provides, to our knowledge, the first unified review of this literature across three visual modalities: image, video, and 3D. We introduce a comprehensive, task-centric taxonomy: we first divide the literature by modality; within each modality, we separate methods into attacks and defenses, and then group them by the generative task they target, presenting them chronologically within each task. Moreover, we provide an in-depth analysis of their evaluation settings, consolidating the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks used to assess them. We conclude by identifying several open challenges and outlining concrete future research directions. Project Webpage: https://github.com/ozgurkara99/awesome-adv-attack-defense-on-diffusion

AI.tldr: 本文是首个跨图像、视频和3D三种视觉模态，对扩散模型的对抗攻击与防御研究进行统一综述的论文，提出了以生成任务为中心的分类体系，并对评测设置进行了深入分析，最后指出了开放挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型已成为视觉领域占主导地位的生成模型，但其广泛公开可用性可能导致大规模滥用，因此针对扩散模型的对抗攻击与防御研究正在快速增长，亟需一篇统一综述来梳理这一领域的文献。
AI.method: 采用以任务为中心的综合分类法：首先按模态（图像、视频、3D）划分文献；在每个模态内，将方法分为攻击和防御两类；然后按其所针对的生成任务进行分组，并在每个任务内按时间顺序呈现。此外，还对评测设置进行了深入分析，整合了用于评估的数据集、指标和基准。
AI.result: 本文整合了三个视觉模态下的攻击与防御文献，提供了系统性的任务中心分类框架，并对评测数据集、指标和基准进行了统一梳理。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别出若干开放挑战，并提出了具体可行的未来研究方向，为该领域的进一步发展提供了指导。

title: Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding for Common-Context Question Answering
summary: In common-context question answering (CCQA) tasks, multiple input questions share a common context to base their answers from. However, Large Language Models typically generate each answer using an independent prompt. While existing batching and caching techniques help improve parallelism and reduce repeated computations, the separation of questions across prompts limits the achievable speedup, as modern GPUs are underutilized due to a memory bottleneck during attention. We present Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding (IPPD), a novel inference method that answers multiple common-context questions in parallel within a single prompt. IPPD directly addresses the bottleneck by efficiently sharing both memory and computation during the attention process, as the next token for every question is decoded in a single inference step. IPPD uses virtual position IDs and attention mask manipulation to generate the same output as standard prompting without requiring fine-tuning or any changes to the LLM architecture. Since all parallelism occurs within a prompt, IPPD is fully compatible with batched inference, even when each prompt features a different context. Our experiments show that IPPD delivers up to 7X the effective throughput as standard decoding without quality degradation, and outperforms prefix caching with PagedAttention in most settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为IPPD的新型推理方法，通过将多个共享上下文的问答任务合并到单个提示中并行解码，突破了传统独立提示导致的内存瓶颈，实现了最高7倍的吞吐量提升且不牺牲生成质量。
AI.motivation: 在共享上下文的问答任务中，大语言模型通常为每个问题使用独立提示生成答案，导致GPU因注意力机制的内存瓶颈而利用率不足。现有的批处理和缓存技术虽能改善并行性和减少重复计算，但问题之间的提示隔离限制了速度提升的上限。
AI.method: IPPD将多个共享上下文的问题整合到单个提示中，在单次推理步骤中同时为每个问题解码下一个token。通过使用虚拟位置ID和注意力掩码操作，确保输出与标准提示方式完全一致，无需微调或修改LLM架构。所有并行操作均发生在单个提示内部，因此与批量推理完全兼容。
AI.result: 实验表明，IPPD相比标准解码可实现最高7倍的有效吞吐量提升，且在大多数场景下优于使用PagedAttention的前缀缓存方法，同时不产生质量下降。
AI.conclusion: IPPD通过单提示内多问题并行解码有效解决了共享上下文问答中的GPU内存瓶颈问题，在保持生成质量的前提下显著提升推理效率，且兼具架构无关性和批量推理兼容性。

title: An Exploratory Study of Frequency-Aware Task Weighting for YOLOv8-Based Unified Driving Perception
summary:
Unified perception enables autonomous driving systems to perform object detection, drivable-area segmentation, and lane segmentation within a single network, improving efficiency and reducing deployment complexity. Jointly optimizing multiple perception tasks remains challenging because tasks exhibit different convergence rates, loss scales, and optimization stability. Existing task-weighting methods use loss magnitude, learned uncertainty, short-term loss changes, or gradient statistics; here, we explore the frequency structure of a recent loss-history window as a complementary signal.
  We implement and examine Frequency-aware Task Weighting (FTW), a dynamic task-balancing rule that estimates a loss-trajectory stability proxy from the low-frequency energy ratio of recent loss histories. FTW assigns larger weights to tasks whose mean-centered loss trajectories contain a larger proportion of low-frequency power. We document FTW and two baselines under full-network static training and progressive freezing using a unified YOLOv8-based perception framework with three task-specific heads.
  Experiments on Mapillary Vistas compare FTW with fixed and uncertainty-based weighting under both configurations. Final holdout metrics are reported for the checkpoint with the lowest per-epoch validation loss in each run. Across six single-run configurations, static FTW has the largest derived overall score and lane mIoU, progressive FTW has the largest detection mAP, and static uncertainty weighting has the largest drivable-area mIoU. Without repeated-seed estimates, single-task baselines, or FTW ablations, these rankings are descriptive. The evidence supports the feasibility of loss-frequency-based weighting in this pipeline, but does not establish improvement over the baselines or generalization beyond the reported runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出频率感知任务加权（FTW）方法，利用损失历史窗口中的低频能量占比作为任务稳定性的代理信号，在统一的YOLOv8多任务感知框架中动态调节各任务的加权，以实现目标检测、可行驶区域分割和车道线分割的联合优化。
AI.motivation: 多任务感知网络（目标检测、可行驶区域分割、车道线分割）的联合优化具有挑战性，因为不同任务存在不同的收敛速度、损失尺度和优化稳定性。现有任务加权方法依赖损失幅值、不确定性、短期损失变化或梯度统计量，本文探索将最近损失历史窗口的频域结构作为互补信号，以更有效地平衡多任务训练。
AI.method: 实现并检验了频率感知任务加权（FTW）：该动态任务平衡规则从近期损失历史中估计低频频能量占比，作为损失轨迹稳定性的代理指标。FTW对均值中心化损失轨迹中低频功率占比更大的任务赋予更大的权重。实验在统一YOLOv8感知框架（含三个任务特定头）下，比较了FTW与固定加权、不确定性加权两种基线方法，并分别在全网络静态训练和渐进冻结两种配置下进行评估。
AI.result: 在Mapillary Vistas数据集上，六种单次运行配置中：静态FTW取得最大的综合分数和车道线mIoU，渐进FTW取得最大的检测mAP，静态不确定性加权取得最大的可行驶区域mIoU。结果仅为描述性排名，缺乏重复种子的估计、单任务基线或FTW消融实验。
AI.conclusion: 实验证据表明基于损失频率的任务加权在该管线中具有可行性，但尚不能确认FTW优于基线方法，也不能证明其超越所报告运行场景的泛化能力。

title: MedWER: A Reproducible, Model-Free Evaluation Protocol for Medical Speech Recognition
comment: 10 pages, 3 tables. Code, term list, and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/Nordis-Tech/medwer. Package: pip install medwer. Source archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22103865
summary: Overall word error rate hides clinically critical errors: a transcript can be 95% correct and still swap one drug for another. The usual fix weights errors on medical entities, and almost always depends on an evaluation-time named-entity recognition (NER) model or cloud API, which makes the metric's denominator a versioned black box. We present MedWER, an evaluation protocol and open-source tool for medical ASR whose denominator is a fixed, license-clean term list: 19,373 drug, diagnosis, symptom, and injury-mechanism entries projected from public sources. The protocol couples a pinned text normalizer with a phrase-aware term-restricted WER, the MedWER, so the only versioned component is a normalizer dependency held at an exact release and checked against committed golden fixtures. Coverage is validated against an independent provincial drug-benefit file the list was not built from; the matching heuristic is calibrated against ground-truth entity spans. Baselines for Moonshine~base, Whisper~base.en, and MedASR on two open benchmarks are scored with the released tool and reported with 95% confidence intervals from resampled per-utterance scores.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedWER，一种用于医学自动语音识别（ASR）评估的协议和开源工具，其分母采用固定的19,373个医学术语列表（含药物、诊断、症状和损伤机制），避免了传统方法依赖版本化的NER黑盒模型/云API的问题，并提供了基于重采样的95%置信区间基线结果。
AI.motivation: 传统的整体词错误率（WER）会掩盖临床关键性错误（如药物互换），而现有修复方案依赖评估时的NER模型或云API，其分母是版本化的黑盒，导致指标不可复现、不透明。
AI.method: 设计MedWER评估协议，包含：(1) 固定的、许可证干净的19,373个医学术语列表作为分母；(2) 固定的文本规范化器（锁定精确版本并配黄金测试夹具）；(3) 短语感知的术语受限WER计算方法；覆盖度通过独立省药物福利文件验证，匹配启发式用真实实体跨度校准。
AI.result: 在Moonshine base、Whisper base.en和MedASR两个开放基准上使用发布工具评分，均报告了基于逐话语重采样的95%置信区间；术语列表覆盖度通过独立数据集验证。
AI.conclusion: MedWER提供了一种透明、可复现的医疗ASR评估方案，解决了传统指标隐藏关键临床错误和黑盒NER依赖的问题。

title: Emergent Goal-Directed Attention in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Human observers prioritize visual information according to task goals. Most computational models of naturalistic viewing are gaze-trained for free viewing, leaving open whether goal-directed attention can emerge in systems without gaze supervision. We tested two off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs), Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, on 4,887 naturalistic scenes under visual-search and free-viewing instructions. Model predictions were compared with human fixations on the same images under corresponding tasks. Both models aligned more closely with human fixations under matching goals than under mismatched goals. This crossover persisted in target-absent scenes, where alignment could not be explained by simple visual grounding, and appeared in decoder-layer readouts. Furthermore, model-thinking traces were grounded in target semantics during search and in visual prominence during free viewing. These findings show that general-purpose VLMs can generate human-aligned, goal-directed spatial priorities without gaze-specific training, informing theories of goal-directed attention and offering scalable tools for predicting where people look across tasks.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了两种无需注视监督训练的视觉-语言大模型（Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking和Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it），在视觉搜索和自由观看两种任务下对4,887个自然场景的预测与人类注视的一致性，发现两种模型在任务匹配时与人类注视的契合度显著高于任务不匹配时，表明通用VLM无需凝视监督即可涌现出目标导向的注意力。
AI.motivation: 大多数自然观看的计算模型都是在自由观看条件下通过注视数据进行训练的，这导致目标导向注意力能否在没有注视监督的系统中自发涌现成为一个悬而未决的问题。
AI.method: 选取两种现成的视觉-语言大模型，在4,887个自然场景上分别施加视觉搜索和自由观看两种指令，并将模型预测与人类在同一图像对应任务下的注视点进行比较分析，同时通过无目标场景测试和隐藏层输出分析排除简单视觉接地解释，并检查模型思考轨迹的语义基础。
AI.result: 两种模型在目标匹配任务下与人类注视的对齐程度高于任务不匹配时；这种交叉效应在无目标场景中仍然存在，无法由简单视觉接地解释；该效应出现在解码器层的读出中；模型的思考轨迹在搜索中锚定目标语义，在自由观看中锚定视觉显著性。
AI.conclusion: 通用视觉-语言大模型无需注视专门训练即能产生与人类一致的、目标导向的空间注意力优先级，这为目标导向注意力的理论研究提供了新的视角，也为跨任务预测人类注视位置提供了可扩展的工具。

title: Some Tokens Behave like Magnets: Revealing Linguistic Organization in the Layers of Language Models
summary:
We identify a special group of token vectors inside large language models (LLMs), which we term magnetic vectors, that organize the surrounding tokens by either attracting or repelling them. Particularly, tokens pointing the same way as an attracting magnet are elongated; tokens pointing the same way as a repelling magnet are compressed. Just as physical magnets pull or push away the iron filings around them, these vectors organize their surroundings through two opposing polarities. Moreover, we identify a statistically significant pattern in linguistic category where function words consistently act as repelling magnets in early layers, and we also find magnets consistently reorganize their polarities in unique ways deeper in the model. In a further case study we find this observation may unveil a deliberate, layer-wise organization in how LLMs process language.
  This pattern is consistent across different LLM architectures, sizes, and layer configurations. It is also causally relevant. When the LLM is fine-tuned for a downstream task, the task-functional tokens emerge as magnets. E.g., in question answering, the answer-span tokens become uniquely repelling magnets in the final layer, geometrically carving the answer out of the surrounding context. Furthermore, removing early-layer repelling magnets devastates syntactic tasks (POS tagging accuracy drops from 91% to below 10%) while sparing semantic ones, and removing late-layer attracting magnets does the reverse. We believe this phenomenon warrants further investigation, as it opens the first probe-free path to understanding how language models geometrically organize linguistic computation across their layers.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型语言模型（LLM）中存在一类特殊的token向量，称为"磁性向量"（magnetic vectors），它们通过吸引或排斥来组织周围token的空间分布，类似于物理磁铁对铁屑的排列作用。该现象在不同架构、规模和层配置的LLM中一致存在，且具有因果相关性：移除早期层的排斥磁铁会严重破坏句法任务，移除晚期层的吸引磁铁则损害语义任务。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM如何在内部几何空间中组织语言计算是一个重要问题。现有方法通常依赖探针（probe）来解读模型内部表征，作者希望找到一种无需探针的直接路径来揭示LLM层间语言组织的机制，从而更深入地理解大语言模型的内部工作原理。
AI.method: 作者在LLM的token向量空间中识别出一类特殊的"磁性向量"，通过分析其吸引或排斥极性来研究它们如何组织周围token的分布。作者考察了不同层中磁性向量的极性模式，检验了功能词在早期层中作为排斥磁铁的统计显著性模式，并通过微调实验和移除特定层磁铁向量的因果干预实验来验证其功能相关性。
AI.result: 研究发现：函数词在早期层中一贯扮演排斥磁铁角色；不同层中磁性向量以独特方式重组极性；该模式在不同LLM架构间一致；微调后任务相关token会涌现为磁性向量（如问答中答案span在最终层成为独特排斥磁铁）；移除早期层排斥磁铁使词性标注准确率从91%骤降至10%以下（句法任务受损），而移除晚期层吸引磁铁则伤害语义任务（反之亦然）。
AI.conclusion: 磁性向量现象揭示了LLM中一种有意的、逐层组织的语言处理几何机制，为理解语言模型如何在层间组织语言计算提供了第一条无需探针的路径，值得进一步深入研究。

title: CrossModalQA: A Cross-modal and Multi-hop Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval-augmented Generation
summary: Despite the strong capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), their parametric knowledge remains incomplete and difficult to update, motivating multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground responses in external text and images. However, existing benchmarks face two major limitations: (i) they typically emphasize single-hop retrieval or reasoning over a small set of provided contexts rather than open-domain evidence discovery; and (ii) they provide fragmented coverage of cross-modal reasoning paths, leaving complex multi-hop and multi-image reasoning underexplored. In this paper, we introduce CrossModalQA, an open-domain benchmark for evaluating multimodal retrieval and reasoning over heterogeneous corpora. CrossModalQA contains 1,863 question-answer pairs constructed from 4,987 Wikipedia articles and 4,431 Wikimedia Commons images. It covers five complementary reasoning paths: vision-to-text, text-to-vision, vision-to-text-to-vision, multi-image intersection, and image-set reasoning. Every question requires retrieving and composing distributed textual and visual evidence, with an average reasoning depth of 3.50 hops. We construct the benchmark through multimodal knowledge graph-guided subgraph sampling and apply rule-based consistency checking and LLM verification to ensure multimodal dependence and traceable evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that existing multimodal RAG systems struggle to recover complete evidence chains and can underperform closed-book models when incomplete retrieval introduces distracting context. Further analysis reveals that complete cross-modal retrieval contributes more to answer accuracy than generator scaling, while multi-image retrieval and reasoning remain the primary bottlenecks limiting end-to-end performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CrossModalQA，一个开放域多模态检索增强生成基准，包含1,863个问题-答案对，覆盖五种跨模态推理路径，平均推理深度3.50跳。实验发现现有多模态RAG系统在恢复完整证据链方面存在困难，且不完整检索可能引入干扰上下文导致性能低于封闭式模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基准存在两大局限：(i)偏重单跳检索或在小范围上下文上推理，缺乏开放域证据发现；(ii)跨模态推理路径覆盖零散，复杂多跳和多图像推理未被充分探索。此外，多模态大语言模型的参数化知识不完整且难以更新。
AI.method: 通过多模态知识图谱引导的子图采样构建基准，结合基于规则的稠密性检查和LLM验证来确保多模态依赖性和可追踪证据。基准涵盖视觉到文本、文本到视觉、视觉到文本到视觉、多图像交集和图像集推理五种推理路径。
AI.result: 现有多模态RAG系统难以恢复完整证据链，当检索不完整引入干扰上下文时可能低于封闭式模型。完整跨模态检索对回答准确性的贡献大于生成器规模扩展，多图像检索与推理是限制端到端性能的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: CrossModalQA揭示了当前多模态RAG系统的关键不足，强调完整的跨模态证据检索比扩大生成器规模更为重要，多图像检索与推理是未来需要重点突破的方向。

title: CrisisKD: Five-Stage Knowledge Distillation for Aspect-Level Sentiment and Emotion Analysis in Crisis Discourse
comment: Accepted to the 11th Workshop on Natural User-generated Text (W-NUT 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Identifying the target of emotional words or phrases in crisis situations, especially health-related ones, is important for understanding public concerns across cultural and linguistic contexts. We propose CrisisKD, a five-stage teacher--student knowledge distillation framework for aspect-level sentiment and emotion analysis on unannotated social media data. A teacher LLM generates aspect-level labels and reasoning traces that supervise a smaller student model across aspect extraction, syntactic parsing, opinion extraction, sentiment classification, and emotion classification. Using this framework, we construct and release a dataset containing 50,615 aspect-level labels, together with the annotation and fine-tuning scripts as open-source resources. The resulting student supports end-to-end ABSA and emotion detection at substantially lower inference cost than the teacher. On a manually annotated 500-tweet gold set, the 5-task Qwen2.5-7B student improves over the untuned model by 7.9 F1 points on aspect extraction, 17.0 points on emotion accuracy, and 6.5 points on sentiment accuracy. On the external ABEA benchmark, CrisisKD improves the same-model Qwen2.5-7B ICL baseline by 2.8 F1 points on ATE and 3.8 F1 points on joint ATE+AEC.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CrisisKD，一个五阶段的教师-学生知识蒸馏框架，用于在未标注的社交媒体数据上进行方面级情感与情绪分析。教师LLM生成方面级标签和推理轨迹，指导学生模型完成方面提取、句法解析、观点提取、情感分类和情绪分类五个任务。框架构建了包含50,615个方面级标签的数据集，学生模型（Qwen2.5-7B）在各项指标上显著优于未微调模型，推理成本远低于教师模型。
AI.motivation: 在危机情境（尤其是健康相关危机）中识别情绪词或短语的目标，对于理解不同文化和语言背景下公众的关注点至关重要。然而，社交媒体数据缺乏标注，需要高效且低成本的方面级情感与情绪分析框架。
AI.method: 提出CrisisKD框架，采用五阶段教师-学生知识蒸馏：教师LLM生成方面级标签和推理轨迹，用于监督较小的学生模型。蒸馏覆盖五个任务：方面提取、句法解析、观点提取、情感分类和情绪分类。同时构建并发布含50,615个方面级标签的数据集及开源脚本。
AI.result: 在人工标注的500条推文黄金集上，5任务Qwen2.5-7B学生模型相比未调优模型在方面提取上提升7.9 F1分，情绪准确率提升17.0分，情感准确率提升6.5分。在外部ABEA基准上，相比ICL基线提升2.8 F1分（ATE）和3.8 F1分（联合ATE+AEC）。学生模型推理成本显著低于教师模型。
AI.conclusion: CrisisKD证明了知识蒸馏在危机情境方面级情感与情绪分析中的有效性，能够以较低的推理成本实现接近教师LLM的性能，并发布了开源数据集与脚本供社区使用。

title: Contrastive Knowledge Distillation for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Illumination/Focus Display Images
summary: In this paper, we tackle automatic anomaly detection in multi-illumination and multi-focus display images. The minute defects on the display surface are hard to spot out in RGB images and by a model trained with only normal data. To address this, we propose a novel contrastive learning scheme for knowledge distillation-based anomaly detection. In our framework, Multiresolution Knowledge Distillation (MKD) is adopted as a baseline, which operates by measuring feature similarities between the teacher and student networks. Based on MKD, we propose a novel contrastive learning method, namely Multiresolution Contrastive Distillation (MCD), which does not require positive/negative pairs with an anchor but operates by pulling/pushing the distance between the teacher and student features. Furthermore, we propose the blending module that transforms and aggregate multi-channel information to the three-channel input layer of MCD. Our proposed method significantly outperforms competitive state-of-the-art methods in both AUROC and accuracy metrics on the collected Multi-illumination and Multi-focus display image dataset for Anomaly Detection (MMdAD).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多分辨率对比蒸馏（MCD）的无监督异常检测方法，用于多光照、多聚焦显示面板图像中的微小缺陷检测，在自建MMdAD数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 显示面板表面的微小缺陷在RGB图像中难以识别，且仅使用正常数据训练的模型难以检测此类缺陷，现有方法在该场景下性能不足。
AI.method: 以多分辨率知识蒸馏（MKD）为基础框架，通过拉近/推远教师与学生网络特征之间的距离实现对比学习（无需锚点正负样本对），并提出混合模块将多通道信息转换并聚合为MCD所需的三通道输入。
AI.result: 在自收集的多光照多聚焦显示图像异常检测数据集（MMdAD）上，所提方法在AUROC和准确率指标上均显著优于多种现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的MCD对比蒸馏方案有效解决了显示面板微小缺陷在多光照多聚焦条件下的自动检测难题，为该领域提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Recall Is Not Protection: Evaluating Safety Monitors Against Model Compliance
comment: Submitted to the NeurIPS 2026 JUDGe Workshop
summary: Safety monitors screen prompts sent to deployed language models, flagging harmful requests so they are never answered. They are evaluated by recall against harmfulness labels, but a catch only prevents harm if the model would otherwise have complied. We measure the difference directly: we sample repeated responses from the target model, call a harmful prompt \emph{elicitable} if the model complies at least once, and report monitor recall separately on elicitable and non-elicitable prompts. Across six monitor configurations and three model families, spanning activation probes, fine-tuned text guards, and a 120B policy-conditioned reasoning classifier, recall on elicitable prompts falls 0.22 to 0.38 below recall on non-elicitable prompts at a fixed false positive rate. The prompts a monitor misses are 2.8 to 5.6 times more likely to be complied with than the prompts it catches. The gap replicates across three model families and appears also in text-only monitors entirely independent of the target model. This suggests that standard recall may overstate the protection monitors provide in practice, and that monitors should be evaluated against what their models will actually answer.

AI.tldr: 本文发现安全监控器在"可引出"提示（模型至少会响应一次的有害请求）上的召回率显著低于"不可引出"提示，意味着标准召回率指标可能高估了监控器在实际部署中的保护效果。
AI.motivation: 现有安全监控器的评估主要基于召回率，但仅当被监控模型原本会遵从有害请求时，拦截才算真正防止了危害。这种评估方式忽略了模型实际响应的影响，可能导致对监控器保护效果的高估。
AI.method: 对目标模型多次采样响应，将模型至少一次遵从的有害提示定义为"可引出"，分别计算监控器在可引出与不可引出提示上的召回率。实验横跨六种监控配置、三种模型家族，包括激活探针、微调文本守卫和120B策略条件推理分类器。
AI.result: 在固定假阳性率下，监控器在可引出提示上的召回率比不可引出提示低0.22到0.38；监控器漏掉的提示比其拦截的提示被模型遵从的可能性高2.8到5.6倍。该差距在三种模型家族中均复现，且在与目标模型完全无关的纯文本监控器中也同样存在。
AI.conclusion: 标准召回率可能高估了监控器在实际中提供的保护水平，监控器评估应基于其目标模型实际会回答的内容进行，而非仅仅依赖危害性标签。

title: Diffusion models for eye-gaze trajectory generation using position and velocity representations
summary: Eye-tracking data are expensive to collect, requiring specialized hardware and controlled laboratory conditions, and difficult to share because of privacy constraints. We address this using two complementary denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) for unconditional generation of eye-gaze dynamics from visual-search data. Both use an identical FiLM-conditioned one-dimensional U-Net with self-attention (19.35,M parameters), trained on 8,s sliding-window sequences from 28 participants. One model generates raw two-dimensional gaze-position sequences, while the other generates two-component velocity sequences; each uses representation-specific preprocessing, training settings, data partitions, and evaluation protocols. Both are evaluated across three independent training seeds, with aggregated metrics reported as mean,$\pm$,SD. The position-space model achieves a mean Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence of $0.016\pm0.004$ across nine kinematic features, with the highest feature-wise mean below $0.030$, fixation duration within 2% of real data, and a Fr'echet Gaze Distance more than an order of magnitude below statistical and Markovian baselines. Under a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real protocol, synthetic-only training achieves $R^2=0.66\pm0.02$, or 82.7% of the real-data $R^2$ point estimate. The velocity-space model achieves a mean JS divergence of $0.0065$ across velocity components, speed, log-speed, and turning angle, with a maximum of $0.015\pm0.005$. Reconstructed path length is less accurate ($0.21\pm0.02$ versus $0.03\pm0.01$ in position space), although the protocols differ. Overall, unconditional diffusion captures local gaze kinematics and short-range temporal and directional structure, while long-range properties such as saccade counts and cumulative path geometry remain targets for future conditioned models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的无条件生成方法，用于模拟视觉搜索任务中的眼动轨迹数据。一种在原始二维注视位置空间建模，另一种在速度空间建模，两者均采用FiLM条件一维U-Net自注意力架构。实验表明位置空间模型在九种运动学特征上平均JS散度达0.016±0.004，速度空间模型在速度相关特征上平均JS散度仅0.0065，远优于统计和马尔可夫基线。
AI.motivation: 眼动追踪数据采集成本高昂（需专用硬件和受控实验室条件），且因隐私约束难以共享。作者旨在解决这一数据稀缺问题，通过生成合成眼动数据来扩展可用数据集。
AI.method: 使用两个互补的DDPM模型进行无条件生成：一个生成原始二维注视位置序列，另一个生成双分量速度序列。两者共享相同的FiLM条件一维U-Net自注意力架构（19.35M参数），在28名参与者的8秒滑动窗口序列上训练，采用表征特定的预处理、训练设置、数据划分和评估协议。
AI.result: 位置空间模型：平均JS散度0.016±0.004，注视持续时间与真实数据差异在2%以内，Fr'echet Gaze Distance比统计和马尔可夫基线低一个数量级以上；合成数据训练实现R²=0.66±0.02（达真实数据的82.7%）。速度空间模型：平均JS散度0.0065，最大0.015±0.005；重建路径长度精度较低（0.21±0.02对比0.03±0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 无条件扩散模型能够捕捉局部注视运动学特征以及短程时序和方向结构，但在扫视计数和累积路径几何等长程属性上仍存在局限，未来需要通过条件化模型来改进。

title: Dynamic Lagging for Simultaneous Translation
summary: In cascaded simultaneous speech translation, the machine translation (MT) system cannot control the read--write schedule of the upstream recognizer: it must decide, from a growing source prefix, how much target text to commit. We make a sentence-trained, decoder-only LLM prefix-aware by fine-tuning it on stable prefixes---the longest prefix that any translation up to the current partial source has shared with the model's own full-source output---mixed with full-sentence pairs, and prompt it through a single force-decode turn that carries the committed target forward as more source arrives, making the system flicker-free by construction. We fine-tune Qwen3-8B for EN to DE, JA, ZH, simulating the source stream with reference-transcript prefixes. Prefix finetuning preserves full-sentence quality while improving worst-position chunk quality, and it improves calibration of token-level commit confidence, reducing expected calibration error (ECE) on early source prefixes against a stable-prefix oracle. A single training-free threshold on that confidence is the most effective of the three latency controls we compare: it traces a continuous quality--latency frontier that outperforms the discrete wait-$k$ and target-suffix-deletion quality-latency tradeoff mechanisms. The effect holds well on FLEURS, WMT24++, and CoVoST~2 test sets, under both COMET and MetricX.

AI.tldr: 本文提出让句级训练的decoder-only LLM具备前缀感知能力，通过稳定前缀微调和单次force-decode推理，实现级联同声传译中的无闪烁目标文本提交，并以无训练置信度阈值实现优于wait-k等方法的质量-延迟权衡。
AI.motivation: 在级联同声传译中，机器翻译系统无法控制上游识别器的读写节奏，必须从不断增长的源前缀中决定提交多少目标文本。现有方法缺乏对前缀稳定性的感知，导致翻译结果闪烁且提交决策不优。
AI.method: 将句级训练的decoder-only LLM通过稳定前缀（当前部分源与模型全句输出共享的最长前缀）与全句对混合进行微调，使其具备前缀感知性；通过单次force-decode推理，将已提交的目标文本随源增长向前推进，从构造上消除闪烁。使用Qwen3-8B在EN→DE/JA/ZH上以参考转录前缀模拟源流进行微调。
AI.result: 前缀微调保持全句质量的同时提升最差位置块质量，并改善token级提交置信度的校准（降低ECE）。单一无训练置信度阈值作为延迟控制手段，能绘制连续的质量-延迟前沿，优于离散的wait-k和目标后缀删除机制；该效果在FLEURS、WMT24++和CoVoST 2数据集上，在COMET和MetricX指标下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 基于稳定前缀的微调与force-decode框架，加上简单的置信度阈值控制，就能在级联同声传译中实现高效且稳定的质量-延迟权衡，且无需额外训练延迟控制策略。

title: Infrastructure-based Monocular 3D Vehicle Localization Framework with Experimental Validation
summary: This paper presents a one-stage learning framework that maps monocular roadside-camera images directly to vehicle states in a ground-fixed coordinate frame. Unlike conventional approaches that first detect vehicles in the image plane and subsequently apply geometric post-processing, the proposed method leverages features from a pretrained object detector to jointly estimate each vehicle's ground-plane position, dimensions, and yaw angle. The framework therefore uses visual features not only for vehicle detection but also for direct spatial and orientation estimation. To support model training and evaluation, we develop a data-collection and label-generation pipeline based on synchronized video from a roadside camera and an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Acting as a temporary top-view sensing platform, the UAV provides vehicle trajectories, dimensions, and orientations, which are transformed into the ground-fixed coordinate frame and temporally aligned with the roadside-camera images to generate ground-truth labels. The framework is evaluated using data collected during multiple experiments at the Mcity Test Facility. Results show that the proposed method can recover vehicle trajectories and orientations from monocular roadside imagery without a separate geometric post-processing stage, demonstrating its potential as a scalable approach to infrastructure-based perception at urban intersections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种单阶段学习框架，将单目路侧相机图像直接映射到地面固定坐标系中的车辆状态（位置、尺寸、偏航角），利用预训练目标检测器的特征联合估计多个车辆属性，无需传统方法中的几何后处理步骤。同时开发了基于路侧相机与无人机同步视频的数据采集和标签生成流程，通过在Mcity试验场的多组实验验证了该方法在恢复车辆轨迹和朝向方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统路侧感知方法通常先检测车辆再应用几何后处理，流程分离且依赖额外步骤，限制了在城市场景中的可扩展性和效率。
AI.method: 提出单阶段学习框架，利用预训练目标检测器的视觉特征同时估计地面平面的车辆位置、尺寸和偏航角；开发基于路侧相机与无人机同步视频的数据采集与标签生成流程，无人机作为临时俯视传感平台提供真实标注。
AI.result: 在Mcity试验场的多次实验数据上验证，该方法无需分离的几何后处理阶段即可恢复车辆轨迹和朝向，展现了作为城市路口基础设施感知可扩展方案的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该单阶段框架能够直接由单目路侧图像估计车辆状态，简化了传统几何后处理流程，为城市场景下的基础设施感知提供了一种可扩展的有效方案。

title: AtomCite: Verification and Correction of Supplied Page-Level Citations in Multi-Page Documents
summary: Large language models answering questions over multi-page documents are expected to cite the supporting pages, yet supplied citations are sometimes inaccurate, and current evaluations score citations at generation time or against text passages: no existing benchmark evaluates whether a system can verify and correct a page-level citation already attached to an answer. We propose AtomCite, an agentic framework that parses an answer into claims, checks each claim against the image of its cited page, and applies a deterministic repair policy. To evaluate it, we introduce DocCite, to our knowledge the first benchmark for systems that verify and correct page-level citations in document images. Built on MP-DocVQA and DUDE, it combines 928 validated injected instances with 2,468 candidate natural errors harvested from frontier- and efficiency-tier models, of which a two-annotator audit confirms 1,909 as genuine errors. Primary labels are assigned deterministically, not by LLM judges, with the human audit as a separate validation layer. Across three model families (Gemini, Claude, and GPT), AtomCite reaches around 93% binary verification accuracy on the injected benchmark, significantly outperforming every OCR-only condition, including a compute-matched control, and exceeding every prior text-based baseline given the same OCR text. Its repair policy lifts citation precision on the injected mix from a constructed 34% to 87-90% while retaining over 90% of correct claims. AtomCite also transfers: with frozen prompts and zero training, it raises the hallucination-detection scores of two open 7-8B models on five public benchmarks above the same models prompted as direct judges. Finally, the audit shows that noise in automatic labels biases measured verifier accuracy and can reverse system rankings, so evaluations relying only on synthetic or automatic labels risk mismeasuring verification capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AtomCite，一个智能体框架，用于验证和纠正文档图像中回答的页级引用，并引入DocCite基准——首个专门评估页级引用验证与纠正系统的基准。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多页文档问答中提供的引用有时不准确，而现有评估要么在生成时评分，要么基于文本片段评分，缺乏对页级引用进行验证和纠正的系统性评估基准。
AI.method: AtomCite将回答解析为多个声明，逐一对照被引用页面的图像进行核查，并应用确定性修复策略。DocCite基于MP-DocVQA和DUDE构建，包含928个验证过的注入实例和2,468个从模型中采集的自然错误候选，其中1,909个经人工审计确认为真实错误，标签由确定性规则而非LLM判定。
AI.result: 在Gemini、Claude和GPT三个模型家族上，AtomCite在注入基准上达到约93%的二分类验证准确率，显著优于所有OCR-only条件和先前的基于文本的基线。修复策略将引用精确率从构造的34%提升至87-90%，同时保留超过90%的正确声明。在冻结提示和零训练条件下，还能提升两个开源7-8B模型在五个公共基准上的幻觉检测分数。
AI.conclusion: 页级引用验证与纠正是一个可行且有效的任务；自动标签中的噪声会偏差化验证准确率的度量甚至反转系统排名，因此仅依赖合成或自动标签的评估存在度量失真的风险。

title: DIVA: Exploiting Cross-Step Conditional Propagation for Visual Jailbreaks in Discrete Diffusion Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main. Code: https://github.com/loststars2002/DIVA
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, yet existing visual jailbreak research has focused almost exclusively on autoregressive architectures, leaving an important emerging family unstudied: multimodal discrete diffusion vision-language models (dVLMs). We identify a vulnerability specific to diffusion generation: because the visual embedding conditions every reverse denoising step rather than acting as a one-time prefix, adversarial visual semantics are repeatedly propagated and amplified across the generation trajectory, a phenomenon we term cross-step conditional propagation. We provide empirical evidence through stage-sensitivity analysis, prompt-level switch rates, and pairwise denoising-bin disagreement metrics, confirmed by bootstrap resampling. We propose DIVA (Discrete-diffusion Vision-language model Attack), a white-box visual jailbreak framework using cross-modal intent obfuscation and diffusion-aware multi-timestep adversarial optimization. Across three dVLMs, DIVA reaches 58.8%, 67.7%, and 69.1% HADES ASR under the Beaver reward-model metric, outperforming visual jailbreak baselines designed for autoregressive models. Code: https://github.com/loststars2002/DIVA

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究多模态离散扩散视觉语言模型（dVLMs）的视觉越狱漏洞，提出一种扩散特有的"跨步条件传播"现象，并设计了白盒攻击框架DIVA，在三个dVLMs上取得了显著优于传统自回归模型越狱基线的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉越狱研究几乎全部聚焦于自回归架构的VLMs，而新兴的多模态离散扩散VLMs（dVLMs）尚未被研究。由于dVLMs的生成机制与自回归模型根本不同，亟需探索其独特的安全漏洞与攻击面。
AI.method: 首先通过阶段敏感性分析、提示级切换率和成对去噪箱不一致度量等实验揭示"跨步条件传播"现象并用bootstrap重采样验证。随后提出DIVA攻击框架，包含跨模态意图混淆和扩散感知的多时间步对抗优化两个核心组件，采用白盒攻击方式进行视觉越狱。
AI.result: DIVA在三个dVLMs上分别达到58.8%、67.7%和69.1%的HADES ASR（以Beaver奖励模型为评估指标），全面超越为自回归模型设计的视觉越狱基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 扩散型VLMs存在区别于自回归模型的独特安全脆弱性——视觉对抗语义在去噪过程中被反复传播和放大，DIVA有效利用该机制实现高成功率攻击，表明需要对扩散型多模态模型的安全防护给予专门关注。

title: CONDUIT: A Unified Residual-Stream Restoration Framework for KV Cache Reuse in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often answer new questions about recurring visual content, where reusing the key-value (KV) cache can avoid re-encoding expensive visual prefixes. Exact-prefix reuse, however, fails when the same visual content appears under a changed prefix. Selective recomputation can recover quality under a small visual-token budget, but only when the right stale tokens are refreshed. Raw-attention selection can waste budget on high-attention tokens with small value-norm proxy scores and on query-irrelevant images. To address these failure modes, we propose CONDUIT, a training-free refresh policy that unifies single- and multi-image reuse as residual-stream restoration. Building on norm-weighted attention, CONDUIT ranks cached visual tokens using cached-key query attention and an accessible pre-output cached-value-norm proxy, then applies empirical image-level relevance amplification before one global selection. With one image, the coefficient is one and the rule reduces to intra-image token selection. The method preserves model architecture and weights, adding only a single query-conditioned scoring pass at inference. At a 10% refresh budget, CONDUIT achieves 97.0-99.5% of the corresponding full-prefill five-dataset average across three VLM backbones and leads budgeted methods on average; on the MMLongBench-Doc latency subset, it uses 13.5% of full-prefill FLOPs and achieves a 2.99x time-to-first-token speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CONDUIT，一种无需训练的KV缓存刷新策略，通过范数加权注意力统一单图和多图视觉前缀复用场景，在10%刷新预算下达到全量预填充97.0-99.5%的性能，并实现2.99倍首令牌加速。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在处理重复视觉内容时，精确前缀复用会在前缀变化时失效；选择性重算虽然能在小视觉令牌预算下恢复质量，但原始注意力选择机制会浪费预算在高注意力但低范数的令牌上，以及查询不相关的图像上。
AI.method: 提出CONDUIT训练无关刷新策略，将单图和多图复用统一为残差流恢复问题。基于范数加权注意力，使用缓存键-查询注意力和缓存值范数预输出代理对缓存视觉令牌排序，并应用经验性图像级相关性放大后进行全局选择；单图系数为1时退化为图像内令牌选择。
AI.result: 在10%刷新预算下，CONDUIT在三个VLM骨干网络上达到五个数据集平均全量预填充性能的97.0-99.5%，平均优于其他预算受限方法；在MMLongBench-Doc延迟子集上仅使用全量预填充13.5%的FLOPs，实现2.99倍的TTFT加速。
AI.conclusion: CONDUIT通过范数加权注意力与图像级相关性放大的组合，在不改变模型架构和权重的前提下，仅增加一次查询条件评分推理，有效解决了原始注意力选择在缓存刷新中的失效模式，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持了接近全量预填充的性能。

title: A Specialized Large Multimodal Model for Interpreting PET/CT in Head and Neck Cancer
summary: Background: Diagnosing head and neck cancer using PET/CT is clinically challenging and time-consuming due to the anatomical complexity of the region, motivating computer-aided diagnosis (CAD). Generalist Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) remain limited in medical contexts by insufficient domain-specific knowledge, privacy and security concerns, and verbosity, motivating specialized standalone LMMs. Purpose: We evaluated the feasibility of a specialized LMM for automated PET/CT interpretation in head and neck cancer using a large-scale multi-institutional PET/CT dataset, a tailored training curriculum, and autoregressive training. Methods: LLaVA-NeXT was fine-tuned using a two-level curriculum with image-conversation pairs curated by two radiologists from public data. The dataset included clinically important annotations such as primary tumor presence and metastatic lymph node location. Level 1 used 28,000 image-conversation pairs to learn basic information, including modality type and hypermetabolism. Level 2 used 12,975 pairs to learn primary tumor presence and the existence and anatomical location of cervical lymph node metastases. External validation included four institutions with diverse imaging devices. Results: The specialized LMM substantially outperformed ChatGPT and LLaVA-NeXT. In Level-2 external validation, ROUGE-L, ROUGE-S, Cosine Similarity, Precision, Recall, and F1 were 0.8751, 0.8794, 0.8324, 0.8794, 0.8711, and 0.8751, while generalist models consistently scored below 0.1. Primary tumor classification accuracy was 83.14 +/- 1.15% internally and 69.03 +/- 0.81% externally. For lymph node localization, the corresponding scores were 0.6389, 0.6257, 0.5287, 0.5782, 0.6371, and 0.6648. Conclusion: Specialized LMMs show promising results for fast, accurate PET/CT-based diagnostic support and medical education, highlighting their potential for clinical translation.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了在头颈癌PET/CT诊断中，通过两级课程训练和自回归训练微调的专科大型多模态模型（LMM）的可行性，证明了其显著优于通用模型，具备临床转化潜力。
AI.motivation: 头颈癌的PET/CT诊断因解剖结构复杂而具有临床挑战性和耗时性，需要计算机辅助诊断。通用大型多模态模型在医学领域的应用受到领域知识不足、隐私安全问题及冗长输出的限制，因此需要开发专门的独立LMM。
AI.method: 基于LLaVA-NeXT进行微调，采用两级课程策略：(1) Level 1使用28,000个图像-对话对学习基本知识如模态类型和高代谢；(2) Level 2使用12,975个图像-对话对学习原发肿瘤存在性及颈部淋巴结转移的解剖位置。数据由两位放射科医生从公共数据中筛选标注，外部验证涵盖四家不同成像设备的机构。
AI.result: 专科LMM在各项指标上大幅超越ChatGPT和LLaVA-NeXT。Level-2外部验证中ROUGE-L为0.8751、ROUGE-S为0.8794、余弦相似度为0.8324等，而通用模型得分均低于0.1。原发肿瘤分类准确率内部为83.14%，外部为69.03%。淋巴结定位各项分数在0.53-0.66之间。
AI.conclusion: 专科大型多模态模型在快速准确的PET/CT辅助诊断及医学教育方面展现出良好前景，具有临床转化的潜力。

title: SinoGlyphBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Chinese Glyph-Level Obfuscation in Language-Model Moderation
summary: Glyph-level obfuscation can leave harmful Chinese content readable to humans while degrading automated moderation. We introduce SinoGlyphBench, a diagnostic benchmark that identifies label-critical semantic anchors and creates matched original and glyph-obfuscated inputs in text and image modalities. By perturbing anchors, background context, or both, this design distinguishes corruption of moderation-relevant evidence from general surface variation. Across 176,916 paired evaluations of 12 LLMs and MLLMs, obfuscation increases harmful false-negative and false-positive rates by 6.1 and 4.7 percentage points, respectively, and reduces four-way accuracy by 5.0 points. Models retain 75.7% of the decisions that were correct on the matched original inputs. Full-scope perturbations cause the largest degradation, anchor-only perturbations are more damaging than background-only perturbations, and cross-script substitution is particularly difficult in the text modality. Analysis of structured outputs identifies observable mismatches in visible-form reading, intended-message recovery, and final safety judgment. The evaluated models, therefore, remain brittle to Chinese content written with non-canonical glyphs. Resources are available at https://github.com/fengshun124/SinoGlyphBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SinoGlyphBench诊断基准，系统评估12个LLM/MLLM在中文变体字形混淆攻击下的内容审核脆弱性。通过176,916次配对评测发现，混淆使有害内容假阴性和假阳性率分别上升6.1和4.7个百分点，四分类准确率下降5.0点，模型保留了75.7%原本正确的决策。
AI.motivation: 字形级混淆（glyph-level obfuscation）可使有害中文内容对人类可读，同时躲避自动审核系统。作者旨在构建一个能够区分"破坏审核关键证据"与"一般表面变化"的诊断基准，以系统评估主流模型对此类攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 设计SinoGlyphBench基准，识别标签关键语义锚点（label-critical semantic anchors），在文本和图像两种模态下创建配对的原始输入与字形混淆输入。通过分别扰动锚点、背景上下文或两者同时扰动，区分混淆对审核相关证据的破坏与一般表面变化的影响。
AI.result: 在176,916次配对评估中，混淆使有害内容的假阴性率上升6.1个百分点，假阳性率上升4.7个百分点，四路分类准确率下降5.0点。全范围扰动导致最大性能退化；仅锚点扰动比仅背景扰动更具破坏性；跨文字替换在文本模态中尤其困难。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM和MLLM在面对使用非规范字形书写的中文有害内容时仍然脆弱。结构化输出分析发现了可见形式读取、意图信息恢复和最终安全判断三个环节的可观察失配，模型在这些层面均存在可被利用的缺陷。

title: SimpleMemVLA: A Simple but Effective Native-Video Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Long-horizon manipulation is partially observable: the information needed to choose the next action may appear only in observations from minutes earlier. Existing memory mechanisms: retrieval banks, learned compressors, recurrent states must decide what to keep from the past before knowing what a future decision will require. This was motivated by the assumption that minute-scale history is too large to process directly, which modern VLM backbones no longer make true. In this work, we introduce SimpleMemVLA, a VLA without a dedicated memory module. It keeps the sampled history intact and passes it to the backbone in the timestamped video format the backbone was pretrained to process; the hidden states of a generated sub-task then form the only channel from history to a standard flow-matching action head. Since consecutive decisions share most of their history, prefilling the shared prefix during action execution keeps latency close to a single-frame VLA. SimpleMemVLA sets a new state of the art on four memory benchmarks without cost on general-purpose control. Holding the backbone and training setup fixed, it outperforms retrieval, compression and recurrent-state mechanisms by a wide margin, and causal interventions confirm that the policy genuinely reads its history. Code available at https://github.com/wadeKeith/SimpleMemVLA

AI.tldr: SimpleMemVLA提出了一种无需专用记忆模块的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，直接将完整采样历史以带时间戳的视频格式输入预训练backbone，利用生成子任务的隐藏状态作为历史通道。通过前缀预填充保持低延迟，在四个记忆基准上刷新SOTA，且不牺牲通用控制性能。
AI.motivation: 长时程操控具有部分可观测性，决策所需信息可能出现在数分钟前的观测中。现有记忆机制（检索库、学习压缩器、循环状态）必须在知道未来决策需求之前决定保留什么，这源于"分钟级历史过大无法直接处理"的过时假设，而现代VLM backbone已不再受此限制。
AI.method: SimpleMemVLA不使用专用记忆模块，将完整采样历史以时间戳视频格式直接输入backbone（利用其预训练时擅长的处理方式），令生成子任务的隐藏状态成为从历史到动作头的唯一信息通道。由于连续决策共享大部分历史，执行时对共享前缀进行预填充，使延迟接近单帧VLA。
AI.result: 在四个记忆基准上达到新的SOTA，且在通用控制任务上无性能损失。在固定backbone和训练设置下，大幅超越检索、压缩和循环状态机制；因果干预实验证实策略确实读取了历史信息。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在现代VLM时代，直接处理完整历史比设计复杂的记忆压缩机制更简单有效，为长时程VLA的记忆设计提供了新范式。

title: What if LLMs Ate Their Words: Causal History Effects in Multi-Turn Interaction
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Code and data are available at https://github.com/jinnanli/llms-ate-their-words
summary: Multi-turn interaction creates a feedback process in which an LLM's previous responses become context for later behavior. Prior work shows substantial multi-turn degradation and that assistant-generated history can affect later behavior. However, it remains unclear how these effects manifest across models, tasks, turns, and inside a model. We study these gaps across six task families and five models. Degradation from fully specified single-turn input (FULL) to progressively revealed multi-turn interaction (SHARDED) is clearly task- and model-dependent, and stronger one-shot performance does not imply greater interaction robustness. We then retrospectively analyze completed SHARDED conversations by replaying the user messages already observed in each trajectory while editing only assistant-generated history. Replacing prior assistant responses with neutral content (termed neutralization) changes downstream min-max normalized performance by +.027 across 2,973 trajectories. On a prespecified length-controlled subset, short and length-matched neutralization yield nearly identical effects (+.069 versus +.068), showing that simple context shortening is insufficient to explain the effect of history editing. Turn Surgery further intervenes on one assistant turn at a time. Among 237 selected degraded trajectories, 63.7% contain at least one beneficial intervention, while most tested positions remain unchanged; for binary tasks, 48.4% admit a fail-to-success reversal. An open-weight case study links behaviorally consequential history changes to measurable downstream state differences, but finds task-dependent rather than universal internal signatures. Overall, assistant-generated history has active but selective effects on multi-turn performance, motivating selective rather than uniform history management.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在多轮交互中的退化现象，发现历史对话中助手生成的内容对后续表现具有选择性影响。通过中性化处理和Turn Surgery干预实验，证明这种影响不能用简单的上下文缩短来解释，且不同模型和任务间存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已表明多轮交互会导致LLM性能退化，且助手生成的历史会影响后续行为，但尚不清楚这些效应如何跨模型、任务、轮次在模型内部表现。作者希望填补这一空白，系统理解助手生成历史在多轮交互中的影响机制。
AI.method: 在六个任务族和五个模型上进行实验。使用FULL（完整单轮输入）与SHARDED（逐步多轮交互）对比量化退化。采用三种方法：(1) 中性化处理——重放用户消息但将助手回复替换为中性内容；(2) 长度控制子集比较短中性化与长度匹配中性化； (3) Turn Surgery——逐一干预单一助手轮次。
AI.result: 中性化使2,973条轨迹的平均性能改变+0.027；短中性化和长度匹配中性化效果几乎相同（+0.069 vs +0.068），排除简单上下文缩短解释。在237条退化轨迹中，63.7%存在至少一个有益干预；二分类任务中48.4%可实现从失败到成功的反转。开放权重模型案例研究显示行为相关性与内部状态差异相关，但无普适内部特征。
AI.conclusion: 助手生成的历史对多轮性能具有活跃但选择性的影响，这种影响因任务和模型而异。干预措施并非对每条轨迹都有效，而是存在选择性，这启示历史管理应采取选择性而非统一策略。

title: Beyond the Verdict: Evidence-Aligned Evaluation of Visual Prompt-Injection Guardrails
comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop on Benchmarking Evidence-Aligned Multimodal Reasoning (BEAM2) at ECCV 2026 (Oral Presentation)
summary: Verdict-only evaluation does not reveal whether a vision-language model (VLM) used the visual evidence that should support its decision. We study this problem in web-agent guardrails, where a VLM judges whether on-screen text conflicts with a user instruction. We introduce Mind2Web-Injection, a benchmark of 9,954 instruction-screenshot pairs with instruction-relative labels, pixel-exact evidence boxes, and matched image-side counterfactuals. Across six VLMs, two models with nearly identical average precision differ ninefold in Evidence-Aligned Detection (EAD), the fraction of attacks both detected and correctly localized. To test whether a verdict depends on the command cited as evidence, we replace the instruction with one that endorses that command. Qwen3-VL-32B, the strongest open-weight localizer, returns aligned in only 58.7% of cases, whereas GPT-5.6-luna does so in 99.9%. To diagnose these failures, we propose two training-free interventions. ReadGate improves grounding without changing verdicts, while CmdCompare tests whether explicit instruction-command comparison resolves instruction-side inconsistency. These results motivate reporting verdict correctness, evidence localization, and counterfactual responsiveness separately.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在网页代理护栏任务中是否真正使用了视觉证据来支持其判断。作者引入Mind2Web-Injection基准（含9,954个指令-截图对），提出证据对齐检测（EAD）指标，并发现两个平均精度几乎相同的模型在EAD上差距达九倍。通过反事实测试发现Qwen3-VL-32B仅在58.7%情况下对齐，而GPT-5.6-luna达99.9%。提出ReadGate和CmdCompare两种无需训练的干预方法，主张应分别报告判定正确性、证据定位和反事实响应性。
AI.motivation: 仅基于最终判定（verdict）的评估无法揭示VLM是否真正利用了支撑其决策的视觉证据。在网页代理护栏场景中，VLM需要判断屏幕文本是否与用户指令冲突，现有评估范式存在根本性盲区，亟需新的评估方法和诊断工具。
AI.method: 1) 构建Mind2Web-Injection基准数据集：包含9,954个指令-截图对，提供指令相对标签、像素级精确证据框和匹配的图像侧反事实；2) 提出Evidence-Aligned Detection (EAD)指标，衡量攻击被检测且被正确定位的比例；3) 设计反事实测试，将指令替换为认可该命令的指令来测试判定是否依赖于被引用的证据；4) 提出两种免训练干预方法：ReadGate（改进地面定位但不改变判定）和CmdCompare（测试显式指令-命令比较是否能解决指令侧不一致）。
AI.result: 六个VLM的评估显示，两个平均精度几乎相同的模型在EAD上差距达九倍。Qwen3-VL-32B作为最强的开源权重定位器，在反事实测试中仅有58.7%的案例返回对齐，而GPT-5.6-luna达到99.9%，展示了两者在证据-判定一致性上的巨大鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 当前单指标评估掩盖了VLM在证据使用上的显著差异。研究主张未来应分别报告判定正确性、证据定位精度和反事实响应性三个独立维度，以更全面地评估VLM在安全关键场景中的可靠性。

title: AlignDiff: Exploiting Model-Intrinsic Information for Better Preference Data Selection
summary: Aligning large language models with human preferences remains a challenge, primarily due to the critical role of preference data quality in effective alignment. Existing datasets are frequently plagued by inherent noise and distribution shifts, which inherently limit model performance. To bridge this gap, we propose AlignDiff, a preference data filtering framework driven by intrinsic model signals. AlignDiff first identifies samples with clear preferences using both positive and inverse signals, then prioritizes the more challenging samples based on the average negative log-likelihood gap, encouraging the model to learn richer information from them. AlignDiff is evaluated on two widely used model families (LLaMA and Qwen) and three benchmarks widely adopted in the alignment community (AlpacaEval 2.0, Arena-Hard, and MT-Bench). Across all settings, it consistently outperforms seven strong baselines. We conduct comprehensive ablation studies to validate the effectiveness of AlignDiff, and further show that difficulty-based curriculum learning improves model performance.

AI.tldr: AlignDiff是一个基于模型内在信号驱动的偏好数据筛选框架，通过正向和逆向信号识别偏好清晰的样本，并依据平均负对数似然差距优先选择更具挑战性的样本，以提升大语言模型与人类偏好的对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好数据集中存在固有噪声和分布偏移问题，这些数据质量问题从根本上限制了大规模语言模型与人类偏好对齐的性能表现。
AI.method: AlignDiff首先利用正向和逆向信号筛选出具有清晰偏好的样本，然后根据平均负对数似然差距（NLL gap）对更具挑战性的样本进行优先级排序，促使模型从这些样本中学习更丰富的信息，属于一种难度感知的课程学习方法。
AI.result: 在两个广泛使用的模型家族（LLaMA和Qwen）以及三个社区常用基准（AlpacaEval 2.0、Arena-Hard和MT-Bench）上，AlignDiff在所有设置中均一致优于七个强基线方法，消融实验也验证了其各模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AlignDiff通过数据筛选与基于难度的课程学习相结合，有效缓解了偏好数据质量问题，为提升大语言模型对齐性能提供了可靠的通用方案。

title: VIS-DICT: A Visual Dictionary for Missing Modality Imputation in Social Network Depression Detection
summary: Tracking social media posts can help spot early signs of depression. Recent studies show that combining text and images works better for detecting depression than using text alone. However, many social media posts do not have images, which makes it hard to use multimodal models. Most existing methods fill in missing images using retrieval or generative models that need extra training. In this paper, we introduce Vis-Dict, a dictionary-based method that builds missing visual features by linking words to average image vectors from complete training posts. These estimated visual features are then combined with text to track changes in user behavior over time. We tested Vis-Dict on a social media dataset using user timelines of up to 512 posts and compared it with other missing-data methods. The results show that Vis-Dict performs on par with generative networks, reaching an F1-score of 0.9454 and an ROC-AUC of 0.9890. Most importantly, Vis-Dict achieves this strong performance with zero trainable parameters for image generation. These findings show that directly connecting words to visual features is an effective and practical way to handle missing images in depression detection systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Vis-Dict，一种基于词典的方法来处理社交媒体抑郁检测中缺失图像的问题。该方法通过将词语与完整训练帖子中的平均图像向量关联来估计缺失的视觉特征，无需额外训练即可达到与生成网络相当的性能（F1=0.9454，ROC-AUC=0.9890）。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体中许多帖子没有配图，导致多模态抑郁检测模型难以应用。现有方法依赖检索或生成模型填补缺失图像，但这些方法需要额外的训练开销，成本高且不实用。
AI.method: Vis-Dict方法构建了一个词典，将词语映射到来自完整训练帖子（含文本和图像）的平均图像向量上。对于缺失图像的帖子，根据其文本中的词语从词典中检索对应的平均图像向量来估计视觉特征，然后将这些估计的视觉特征与文本特征结合，用于追踪用户随时间的行为变化。
AI.result: 在社交媒体数据集上使用最多512条帖子的用户时间线进行测试，Vis-Dict与生成网络表现相当，达到F1-score为0.9454、ROC-AUC为0.9890。关键在于，Vis-Dict在图像生成方面实现了零可训练参数，却仍能获得如此优异的性能。
AI.conclusion: 直接将词语与视觉特征关联是处理抑郁检测系统中缺失图像问题的一种有效且实用的方法。Vis-Dict证明无需复杂的生成模型或额外的训练成本，也能在多模态抑郁检测中取得优异表现。

title: From Narrative to Auditable Forecasts: A Structured Scaffold for Agentic Forecasting
summary: LLM agents are increasingly used for live forecasting, where they retrieve up-to-date information and produce estimates for unresolved future events. However, current agentic forecasting often relies on implicit narrative aggregation: agents collect evidence, discuss it in prose, and often assign a probability without an explicit update path from evidence to forecast. This limits both forecasting accuracy and auditability. We propose AuditForecast, an agentic scaffold for structured probabilistic forecasting. AuditForecast first anchors the forecast with a suitable quantitative baseline model, uses model-guided data retrieval to derive a base probability, and then applies situational factor updates outside the model's scope through mechanical aggregation in odds space. This turns forecasting from a prose-based judgment into a structured process with explicit intermediate objects. Across multiple live forecasting benchmarks, AuditForecast improves forecasting accuracy and calibration relative to strong agentic baselines, surpasses market-implied references in several settings, and outperforms substantially more expensive deep-research agents while remaining Pareto-dominant in the cost--accuracy tradeoff. Beyond performance gains, AuditForecast produces an auditable forecasting report that makes forecast construction explicit and supports systematic post hoc analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出AuditForecast框架，通过结构化概率预测流程（基线模型锚定、模型引导检索、赔率空间聚合情境因子更新）将LLM智能体预测从隐式叙事聚合转变为显式可审计的结构化过程，在多个实时预测基准上超越强基线且具有成本优势。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体预测依赖隐式叙事聚合——智能体收集证据并以散文形式讨论后直接给出概率，缺乏从证据到预测的显式更新路径，限制了预测的准确性和可审计性。
AI.method: AuditForecast包含三阶段：首先用合适的定量基线模型锚定预测，然后通过模型引导的数据检索推导基础概率，最后在赔率空间中对模型范围之外的情境因子进行机械式聚合更新，将预测从散文式判断转化为具有显式中间对象的结构化过程。
AI.result: 在多个实时预测基准上，AuditForecast相比强agentic基线显著提升预测准确性和校准度，在若干场景超越市场隐含参考值，性能超越成本高得多的深度研究智能体，在成本-准确率权衡中保持帕累托主导地位，并生成可审计的预测报告。
AI.conclusion: AuditForecast证明结构化、显式的概率预测流程不仅能提升LLM智能体预测的准确性与校准度，还能保证成本效率和可审计性，为Agentic预测提供了一个兼具性能和透明度的新范式。

title: Dual-Latent Memory Routing for Vision-Language Reasoning
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at ICML 2026; 17 pages, 7 figures
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently made strong progress in vision-language reasoning, yet their performance often degrades as generations grow longer. A key factor is that they frequently lose track of earlier visual evidence and intermediate constraints under a monolithic growing context. Inspired by how humans separately recall what they see and what they infer when solving complex tasks, we propose DLMR, a parameter-efficient mechanism that equips MLLMs with Dual Latent Memories: a visual memory that compresses image evidence and a reasoning memory that tracks intermediate conclusions and constraints. A Router then dynamically decides which memory and how much to reuse during inference, preserving visual grounding while maintaining coherent long-horizon reasoning. DLMR is trained in three stages, from latent memory construction to selective router learning, while keeping the base MLLM frozen, yielding substantial gains on both general and reasoning benchmarks with only a small number of additional trainable parameters. Analyses further show interpretable, state-dependent routing with specialized memory roles and reduced decoding tokens over long generations. Code is available at https://github.com/Hunter-Wrynn/DLMR.

AI.tldr: DLMR是一个参数高效的机制，为多模态大语言模型配备双隐式记忆（视觉记忆压缩图像证据，推理记忆追踪中间结论和约束），通过路由器动态决定推理时使用何种记忆及使用程度，在冻结基础MLLM的情况下保持视觉基础和长程推理连贯性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉-语言推理中虽有进展，但生成变长时性能常下降，关键原因是在单一增长的上下文中容易丢失早期视觉证据和中间约束。受人类分别回忆所见与所推的启发，提出该机制。
AI.method: DLMR包含双隐式记忆系统：视觉记忆压缩图像证据，推理记忆追踪中间结论与约束；路由器动态决定推理时选用哪种记忆及复用程度；采用三阶段训练（隐式记忆构建到选择性路由器学习），同时保持基础MLLM冻结。
AI.result: 在通用和推理基准上均获得显著提升，仅需少量额外可训练参数；分析显示具有可解释的状态依赖路由、专门化的记忆角色，以及长生成中解码token的减少。
AI.conclusion: DLMR通过分离视觉证据记忆与推理过程记忆并动态路由，有效缓解了长序列生成中的信息丢失问题，以参数高效方式提升了MLLM的长程视觉语言推理能力。

title: UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) excels on tasks with verifiable rewards, but in open-ended tasks, the reliability of reward models remains a key challenge. Existing solutions either depend on costly proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge systems or opaque scalar reward models that lack interpretability. Recent works on generative reward models offer a promising alternative, but they remain constrained by static evaluation criteria, fragmented evaluation paradigms, and limited multilingual support. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{MixReward}, a large-scale multilingual dataset spanning six domains and 103 languages, containing both pairwise and listwise data, and propose \textbf{UniRRM}, a unified reasoning reward model supporting multiple languages and evaluation paradigms. UniRRM uses a staged reasoning chain to dynamically generate task-generic and instruction-specific criteria, enabling fine-grained, input-adaptive judgments while maintaining consistency across languages. Experiments demonstrate that UniRRM-8B and UniRRM-14B achieve performance close to the state-of-the-art for models of comparable size across multiple benchmarks, and are effective for unseen evaluation paradigms. In addition, ablation studies validate the reliability and effectiveness of UniRRM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MixReward多语言数据集（覆盖6个领域、103种语言，包含成对和列表数据）及UniRRM统一推理奖励模型，通过分阶段推理链动态生成评价标准，实现多语言、多评估范式的细粒度判断，在多个基准上接近SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励模型在开放式任务中面临可靠性挑战：依赖昂贵的专有LLM-as-a-Judge系统，或缺乏可解释性的标量奖励模型；生成式奖励模型受限于静态评价标准、碎片化评估范式和有限的多语言支持。
AI.method: 构建MixReward大规模多语言数据集（六领域、103种语言、成对及列表数据）；提出UniRRM统一推理奖励模型，采用分阶段推理链动态生成任务通用和指令特定的评价标准，实现输入自适应判断，并保持跨语言一致性。
AI.result: UniRRM-8B和UniRRM-14B在多个基准上性能接近同规模最优模型，并对未见评估范式有效；消融研究验证了模型的可靠性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一多语言数据和推理式评价标准生成，UniRRM在保持高可靠性的同时增强了可解释性和跨场景泛化能力，为开放式任务的奖励建模提供了新方向。

title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Abstention and Refusal Reasoning in Vision--Language Models
summary:
Many medical conditions require diagnosis through detailed, multi-context clinical assessment rather than from visual appearance alone. Despite this, vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly queried to interpret images in ways that touch on medical or diagnostic judgments, raising safety concerns when such inferences are unsupported. ASD diagnosis requires behavioral and developmental evidence, not static facial photographs. We audit whether VLMs abstain from this unanswerable paired-image query, and whether expressions sway non-abstaining choices.
  We introduce PARITY (Paired Assessment with Reused Identity), a synthetic, demographically balanced set of identity-controlled neutral/expression portrait pairs with neutral-neutral controls. All identities are synthetic and have no ASD status; because the query is unanswerable from images, any non-abstaining selection is treated as a harmful attribution. Across contemporary VLMs, we find a clear split between refusal-first models and speculative models; in the latter, certain expressions disproportionately trigger harmful selections. Clinical guardrails and single-image framing substantially increase abstention, suggesting actionable mitigations in both prompting and interface design

AI.tldr: 本文提出PARITY数据集，用于审计视觉语言模型（VLM）在无法从静态面部照片回答的自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）诊断查询中是否能够正确弃答。
AI.motivation: 许多医疗诊断需要多情境临床评估而非仅凭视觉外观，但VLM常被用于医学判断性图像解释，带来安全隐患。ASD诊断需要行为和发育证据而非静态面部照片，因此需要审计VLM在此类不可回答查询中的行为。
AI.method: 引入PARITY（Paired Assessment with Reused Identity），一个合成、人口统计学平衡的、身份控制的神经表情/表情肖像配对数据集，包含神经中性对照。所有身份均为合成且无ASD状态，由于查询无法从图像回答，任何非弃答选择均视为有害归因。
AI.result: 在当代VLM中，发现拒绝优先模型与推测性模型之间存在明显分歧；在推测性模型中，某些表情会不成比例地触发有害选择。临床护栏和单图像框架能显著提高弃答率。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了VLM在不可回答的医学查询中存在推测性行为风险，并提示在提示设计和界面设计层面均存在可行的缓解措施。

title: Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning: Unlocking Efficient Alignment Mechanisms for Large Language Models
comment: EMNLP 2026 Findings. Codes are available at: https://github.com/NLP2CT/NGFT
summary: Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning paradigms, particularly Full Parameter Fine-Tuning are often plagued by parameter redundancy, inconsistent data quality, and catastrophic forgetting, which current methods typically address in isolation and lack a unified optimization signal to bridge data selection, parameter updates, and knowledge preservation. To address this, we propose Neuron-Guided Fine-Tuning (NGFT), a holistic framework that leverages neuron activation patterns as a universal proxy to unify the fine-tuning lifecycle. NGFT operates via three synergistic mechanisms: (1) Adaptive Task-Specific Neuron Selection, which identifies essential neurons in a single forward pass to concentrate updates and reduce redundancy; (2) Activation-Based Data Selection, which prioritizes information-dense samples that maximize contribution to key neurons; and (3) Neuron Activation Alignment, a novel loss function that anchors activations to pre-trained states, deepening representation learning and preserving general knowledge. Experimental results across three models across both domain-specific and general benchmarks demonstrate that NGFT significantly outperforms existing mainstream fine-tuning methods in both efficiency and performance, while effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经引导微调（NGFT）框架，利用神经元激活模式作为统一代理，将数据选择、参数更新和知识保留三个环节整合到微调全生命周期中，通过三种协同机制（自适应任务特定神经元选择、基于激活的数据选择、神经元激活对齐损失）显著提升微调效率与性能，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有监督微调范式（尤其是全参数微调）面临参数冗余、数据质量不一致和灾难性遗忘三大问题。当前方法通常孤立地解决这些问题，缺乏统一的优化信号来桥接数据选择、参数更新和知识保留之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出NGFT框架，包含三个协同机制：(1) 自适应任务特定神经元选择，通过单次前向传播识别关键神经元以集中更新并减少冗余；(2) 基于激活的数据选择，优先选择对关键神经元贡献最大化、信息密度高的样本；(3) 神经元激活对齐损失函数，将激活锚定到预训练状态，深化表征学习并保留通用知识。
AI.result: 在三个模型上的领域专用和通用基准测试中，NGFT在效率和性能方面均显著优于现有主流微调方法，同时有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: NGFT通过神经元激活模式作为统一代理信号，成功将微调全生命周期的各个环节串联起来，证明了统一优化信号对于解决微调多重挑战的有效性，为高效且知识稳健的微调提供了新思路。

title: Video Compression with Graph-inspired Neural Representation
summary: Implicit Neural Representations (INR) provide a compact and content-adaptive paradigm for video compression, typically representing a video through shared network parameters and frame-indexed embeddings. Compared to conventional or autoencoder-based codecs, these approaches exploit temporal redundancy within videos in an implicit manner, which potentially results in sub-optimal compression performance. In this paper, we propose G-NeRV, a graph-inspired INR that explicitly improves temporal redundancy exploitation in the implicit latent space. Motivated by the total correlation principles in information theory, we construct a temporal neighborhood over frame embeddings and perform message passing to aggregate reusable information from neighboring frames through an adaptive gate controlling the injection of neighboring information. Inspired by the reference frame buffer in conventional video coding, a memory bank mechanism has been further designed to enable efficient temporal-neighbor retrieval under random frame-index sampling in INR training. This new representation model has been integrated into an advanced representation compression framework and compared with existing conventional and neural video codecs. The results show that the G-NeRV codec outperforms the state-of-the-art INR-based codec, NVRC, and the latest standard video codec, VVC VTM, by 8.86\% and 14.68\% (in BD-rate), respectively, measured by PSNR on the UVG dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G-NeRV，一种基于图的隐式神经表示视频压缩方法，通过显式利用时间冗余来提升压缩性能，在UVG数据集上相比现有方法取得显著BD-rate改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的INR视频压缩方法通过共享网络参数和帧嵌入来隐式利用视频帧间的时间冗余，但这种隐式方式可能导致次优的压缩性能。作者希望显式地提升隐式潜在空间中的时间冗余利用，从而获得更好的视频压缩效果。
AI.method: G-NeRV从信息论的总相关（total correlation）原理出发，在帧嵌入上构建时间邻域，通过消息传递机制聚合相邻帧的可重用信息，并使用自适应门控控制邻域信息的注入。同时受传统视频编码中参考帧缓冲区的启发，设计了记忆库机制以支持在INR训练的随机帧索引采样下高效地进行时间邻域检索。
AI.result: G-NeRV集成到先进的表示压缩框架中，相比最先进的基于INR的编解码器NVRC和最新标准视频编解码器VVC VTM，在UVG数据集上基于PSNR的BD-rate分别降低8.86%和14.68%。
AI.conclusion: 通过图的显式消息传递和记忆库机制，G-NeRV有效增强了INR框架对帧间时间冗余的利用，在性能上超越了现有INR编码器以及最新视频编码标准。

title: Solving versus Verifying: Catching Contradictions in Tax Reasoning Systems
comment: Accepted for the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
summary: Large language models now compute correct tax liabilities on over 90% of well-formed cases in statutory benchmarks, which makes them candidates for the tax-advisory and compliance systems that consume such an answer directly. Real legal inputs, however, are frequently defective: required facts are missing, or stated facts contradict one another. Accuracy on clean benchmarks says nothing about how a model behaves then, and a system that computes straight through a defective input returns a confident number with no sign that anything is wrong. This raises two questions: does a model asked to solve a case abstain when the input is defective, and when it does not, can the same model catch the defect when asked instead to verify the input? We study six recent models on SARA-derived tax cases under missing-fact and contradictory-fact perturbations. The strongest models abstain when a fact is missing but compute through injected contradictions, returning the clean-input answer 63-76% of the time with no signal of the conflict; asked instead to verify the same input, they flag most of those contradictions. We wire that verification call into a simple contradiction gate: one extra call that abstains when the model reports a conflict. Across all six models it recovers most of the missed contradiction abstention at a clean-accuracy cost of at most about 5 percentage points, with no training and no external tooling. High accuracy on well-formed inputs is therefore an incomplete measure of reliability, and the detection the solver misses is cheaply recoverable with a single self-check.

AI.tldr: 研究表明大语言模型在干净案例上准确率超90%，但当法律输入存在缺陷（缺少事实或事实矛盾）时，模型可能不会主动弃权，反而自信地返回错误答案。通过一次简单的验证调用（矛盾门控），可以以不超过5个百分点的干净准确率代价恢复大部分被遗漏的矛盾弃权，且无需训练或外部工具。
AI.motivation: 现实法律输入常存在缺陷（事实缺失或相互矛盾），而现有基准只衡量干净输入上的准确率，无法反映模型在缺陷输入下的可靠性。如果系统在缺陷输入上直接计算并返回自信的数字，用户将得不到任何错误信号，可能造成严重后果。这引出了两个问题：模型是否在输入有缺陷时弃权？当它不弃权时，能否通过验证任务发现缺陷？
AI.method: 在SARA衍生的税务案例上，对六个近期模型施加缺失事实和矛盾事实两类扰动。首先测试模型在缺陷输入上的弃权行为；其次让同一模型执行验证任务来识别输入矛盾；最后将验证调用接入一个简单的"矛盾门控"机制——当模型报告冲突时即弃权。
AI.result: 最强模型在事实缺失时会弃权，但面对注入的矛盾时仍会继续计算，63-76%的时间返回干净输入的答案且无冲突信号；然而让同一模型执行验证任务时，它能标记出大部分矛盾。引入矛盾门控后，所有六个模型都恢复了大部被遗漏的矛盾弃权，干净准确率损失最多约5个百分点。
