AuthBench contains 428,150 documents written by 153,825 individuals across ten widely used languages, 9 primary genres, 66 fine-grained genres, and four document-length buckets. It supports two complementary tasks: authorship attribution, formulated as same-author retrieval and authorship verification, formulated as same-author binary decision. We benchmark 47 neural models and three non-neural baselines under a unified zero-shot protocol. Results show that authorship representation remains far from solved: the best retrieval model reaches only 0.258 Success@5, while the best verification model achieves 0.076 EER and 0.968 ROC-AUC. The leaderboard also reveals a meaningful task split, with different model families leading retrieval and verification, and large performance differences across languages, genres, and lengths.
  These findings position AuthBench not only as a new benchmark, but as a diagnostic resource for studying when and why authorship representations succeed or fail. We release AuthBench, its evaluation toolkit, and benchmark data at https://github.com/mao-code/AuthBench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/MaoXun/AuthBench.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AuthBench，一个大规模多语言作者身份表征基准，包含428,150篇文档、153,825位作者，覆盖10种语言、9个主要体裁和4种文档长度。通过零样本协议评估47个神经模型和3个非神经基线，结果显示作者身份表征任务远未解决：最佳检索模型仅达0.258 Success@5，最佳验证模型为0.076 EER。该基准作为诊断资源，可研究作者身份表征在何种条件下成功或失败。
AI.motivation: 现有作者身份基准存在碎片化问题：通常只覆盖狭窄的语言集合、单一体裁或有限文档长度范围，难以评估现代表征模型的真实泛化能力，因此需要构建一个广泛、标准化且现实的基准。
AI.method: 构建AuthBench基准，包含428,150篇文档和153,825位作者，覆盖10种语言、9个主要体裁（66个细粒度体裁）、4个文档长度桶；设计两个互补任务：作者归属（同作者检索）和作者验证（同作者二分类）；采用统一的零样本协议对47个神经模型和3个非神经基线进行基准测试。
AI.result: 最佳检索模型仅达到0.258 Success@5，最佳验证模型达到0.076 EER和0.968 ROC-AUC。不同模型家族在检索和验证任务上表现各异，且在语言、体裁和长度间存在显著的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 作者身份表征远未解决，AuthBench不仅作为新基准，还作为诊断资源，用于研究作者身份表征成功或失败的原因和条件。

title: FujinSplat: Seeing Through Smoke with RAW-Domain Gaussian Splatting
summary: The appearance of a smoky scene is shaped by two processes that a camera records together: the participating medium alters scene radiance in a view-dependent way, and the image signal processor (ISP) then remaps the result through a nonlinear tone and color transformation. Recovering a clean 3D scene requires separating both. Per-view sRGB dehazing acts only after the ISP has entangled them; standard 3D reconstruction ignores the medium and absorbs it into scene geometry and radiance. FujinSplat addresses the problem in the RAW domain, where the two processes remain separable. A per-scene Base ISP is fitted from the scene's hazy RAW captures to its own camera renderings and then frozen, providing a fixed photometric anchor that performs no dehazing. Analyzing expert corrections reveals a compact, low-dimensional correction space identifiable from RAW alone. FujinSplat therefore fits per-view action answers at the training poses and trains a single scene-agnostic controller to regress them from RAW; the corrected views supervise one static 3D Gaussian representation, jointly with a bounded per-view residual that reconciles cross-view photometric inconsistencies. On the RealX3D real-world smoke benchmark FujinSplat clearly outperforms the strongest comparable baseline, ahead of both physics-based reconstruction and restoration-then-3DGS pipelines.

AI.tldr: FujinSplat提出在RAW域中分离烟雾介质散射与ISP非线性变换，通过场景级Base ISP锚定、紧凑校正空间学习以及3D高斯表示，实现真实烟雾场景的干净三维重建，在RealX3D基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 烟雾场景的外观由两个耦合过程共同塑造：介质对场景辐射度的视点相关改变，以及ISP后续的非线性色调和颜色变换。现有的sRGB域去雾处理在ISP混合之后进行，而标准3D重建则忽略了介质并将其吸收进几何与辐射度中，两者都未能将这两个过程正确分离。
AI.method: 在RAW域中处理问题以保持两个过程的可分离性。首先从雾霾RAW采集及其相机渲染中拟合场景级Base ISP并冻结作为光度锚点；其次通过分析专家校正揭示紧凑低维校正空间，在训练位姿处拟合逐视角校正动作，并训练场景无关控制器从RAW回归这些校正；最后利用校正后的视角监督静态3D高斯表示，并结合有界逐视角残差以调和跨视角光度不一致性。
AI.result: 在RealX3D真实烟雾基准上，FujinSplat明显优于最强可比基线，超越了基于物理的重建方法和restoration-then-3DGS流水线。
AI.conclusion: 在RAW域处理烟雾场景重建，区分介质效应与ISP变换，并利用紧凑校正空间和统一3D高斯表示，是解决真实烟雾场景干净重建问题的有效途径。

title: Typed Federated Artifacts for the Agentic Web:Sharing Tool-Routing Knowledge Across Frozen,Heterogeneous LLM Agents
summary: An open, networked web will allow agents to run frozen models from multiple vendors, keep their history private, and teach each other which tool to call and when. Flat text (prompts, example pools) makes it difficult for the protocol to distinguish between noise statistics, merging rules, and documentation. Weights and adapters cannot transfer that knowledge between platforms. We suggest sharing typed federated artifacts, schema-validated objects with well-defined fields for per-field privacy (described here, but measured), dispute resolution, and cross-model transfer, and instantiating them as SYNAPSE1, a common tool-routing knowledge. After deleting 192 garbage entries and 1,916 training items that duplicate or almost duplicate test queries, a federated compendium routes within 1.1 points of a centralized one at 20 MB of JSON per client each round on StableToolBench (3,180 tools). The same experience merged and shown to the router as typed fields rather than one flat string is worth 8.5 points on clean data and 7.4 under 60% injected contradiction. Crossing merge and rendering shows the halves are inseparable (the typed merge shown flat is the worst arm), while three conflict policies are indistinguishable, so the conflict log that motivated this work is not the On τ-bench retail, each compendium arm improves GPT-4o agents' per-step tool-call accuracy by at least 6.7 points, attributed to format rather than federated experience. Two cautionary findings conclude the paper: on a topic-labeled math proxy and StableToolBench, a TF-IDF classifier over the same labeled experience beats every LLM routing arm (by 48 and 26 points, mostly retrieval recall) because the benchmark's pool holds labeled queries for every supposedly unseen tool and every test query verbatim before our filter. It cannot measure routing to tools without labels, which routing exists for.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SYNAPSE1，一种基于类型化联邦工件（typed federated artifacts）的通用工具路由知识共享协议，允许网络化代理跨平台共享工具调用经验。在StableToolBench上，该方案在20MB JSON每客户端每轮的通信负载下，性能仅比集中式方案低1.1分。类型化字段合并与渲染比单条平文提示更优（干净数据上+8.5分，60%注入矛盾下+7.4分）。研究还发现两个警示性问题：基准测试存在标签泄漏，TF-IDF分类器在带标签的代理基准上大幅优于所有LLM路由方案。
AI.motivation: 开放网络环境中的代理需要运行多家供应商的冻结模型、保持历史隐私，并互相教授何时调用哪个工具。但平文本提示难以区分噪声统计、合并规则与文档；权重和适配器无法跨平台传递知识。作者旨在设计一套能区分这些组件、支持逐字段隐私、争议解决与跨模型迁移的共享工件协议。
AI.method: 提出类型化联邦工件（schema校验、逐字段隐私的对象），并将其实例化为SYNAPSE1——一个通用工具路由知识库。通过合并与渲染的交叉实验来评估工件：将合并结果以类型化字段而非单条平文呈现给路由器。此外过滤了192条垃圾条目和1,916条重复/近似重复测试查询的训练项，并进行冲突策略对比实验。
AI.result: 联邦数据汇编在20MB JSON每客户端每轮的负载下达到集中式的1.1分以内（StableToolBench，3,180个工具）。类型化字段渲染优于平文渲染：干净数据+8.5，60%矛盾注入下+7.4。合并与渲染不可分割（类型化合并平文渲染是最差组合）。三种冲突策略无显著差异。在τ-bench零售任务中，各汇编方案使GPT-4o代理的逐步工具调用准确率至少提升6.7分。警示发现：TF-IDF分类器在带标签数学代理和StableToolBench上分别领先所有LLM方案48和26分，因为基准包含测试查询的逐字复制和有标签的未见工具。
AI.conclusion: 类型化联邦工件比平文提示更适合共享跨平台工具路由知识。但当前基准无法衡量真正的路由能力——即向无标签工具的路由，这恰恰是路由存在的意义。作者建议未来基准应避免标签泄漏，并设计能评估无标签工具路由的实验设置。

title: What Does Animal Re-Identification Learn? Linear Biological Concepts and Their Origins in Visual Representations
summary: Conservation increasingly relies on camera traps that collect more wildlife imagery than experts can manually analyze, making animal re-identification (Re-ID) essential for monitoring individuals and populations. Yet understanding which cues drive model decisions is challenging for ViT-based Re-ID models, whose metric-learning objectives provide no explicit supervision for biological concepts. We ask whether such models nonetheless organize their representations along biologically meaningful axes. Using a DINOv3 backbone fine-tuned for Western lowland gorilla Re-ID with triplet-margin loss, we find that sex and age emerge as linear directions that generalize to held-out individuals, reaching up to 0.91 AUROC and being recoverable from a single image per individual. Activation steering further shows that the sex direction is causally used by the model, flipping a significant fraction of predictions to the opposite sex. Comparing off-the-shelf and fine-tuned backbones shows that Re-ID training does not create these concepts, but relocates them across the network. Finally, data attribution reveals that the representation we find reflects a graded biological axis, is redundantly encoded across the population and shaped by visually ambiguous individuals. Together, these findings show how interpretability can uncover both the biological structure and failure modes of Re-ID representations, providing a step toward auditable computer vision for wildlife monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索基于ViT的野生动物再识别（Re-ID）模型是否在表征中自发组织生物有意义的概念（如性别和年龄），发现使用DINOv3骨干微调的西部低地大猩猩Re-ID模型中，性别和年龄作为线性方向涌现且可泛化到新个体，通过激活引导证实模型因果关系地使用性别方向，并揭示了Re-ID训练并非创造这些概念而是重新定位它们。
AI.motivation: 野生动物保护依赖相机陷阱收集大量图像，人工分析不可行，Re-ID模型成为必需。但基于度量学习的ViT Re-ID模型缺乏对生物概念的显式监督，理解模型决策依据何种线索成为挑战，需要探明模型表征是否沿生物有意义轴组织。
AI.method: 使用DINOv3骨干通过三元组边际损失微调进行西部低地大猩猩Re-ID；利用线性探测分析性别和年龄是否作为线性方向涌现；通过激活引导（activation steering）验证方向因果性；对比预训练与微调骨干分析概念来源；采用数据归因揭示表征的冗余编码与个体影响。
AI.result: 性别和年龄表示为可泛化到留出个体的线性方向，AUROC最高达0.91且可从每只个体单张图像恢复；激活引导翻转显著比例的预测到相反性别；Re-ID训练不创造概念但会重新定位它们；数据归因显示表征反映分级生物轴，冗余编码于整个群体并且受视觉模糊个体影响。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性方法能够揭示Re-ID表征中的生物结构（如性别、年龄方向）和失败模式，为野生动物监测中可审计的计算机视觉系统迈出了重要一步。

title: XYBench: Can LLMs Respond Pragmatically to Queries with Misconceptions?
comment: Accepted to Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) 2026, 32 pages, 25 figures
summary: When non-expert users ask LLMs for assistance, their queries can often have misconceptions (e.g., "How do I parse XML with regex?"). In such cases, often referred to as the XY-problem, LLMs must identify the misconception ("regex are fragile") and meaningfully direct the user toward a pragmatic solution that will address the root problem implicit in the request ("use an XML parser"). We introduce XYBench, a benchmark of 8,115 such queries, drawn from technical (StackOverflow/StackExchange) and everyday (WikiHow and a manually-curated subset) domains. We design an evaluation paradigm that assesses model responses along three criteria grounded in cooperative response theory: (a) presence and (b) emphasis on pragmatic solutions, and (c) identification of misconceptions. Our experiments show that even the strongest LLMs predominantly answer the literal request (0.75--0.92) and far less often the intended one (0.33--0.71), while substantially lagging behind humans at identifying misconceptions (at most 63% vs. 79--90%). Further, models overwhelmingly prefer pragmatic responses in a multiple choice setting yet consistently fail to generate them. Oracle ablation experiments show that providing explicit user intent at generation time helps; however a large gap remains, suggesting pragmatic redirection is a fundamentally underdeveloped capability in current LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍XYBench基准测试，包含8,115个带有误解的用户查询（即XY问题），评估LLM是否能在回答字面问题的同时识别误解并提供务实解决方案。实验显示最强LLM在识别误解和引导务实方案方面显著落后于人类。
AI.motivation: 非专家用户在向LLM提问时往往带有误解（即XY问题），而现有研究缺乏系统评估LLM在这方面能力的基准。作者希望量化LLM在识别用户误解和引导务实解决方案上的能力差距。
AI.method: 构建XYBench基准，包含8,115个查询，覆盖技术领域（StackOverflow/StackExchange）和日常领域（WikiHow及人工筛选子集）。基于合作回应理论设计三项评估标准：务实解决方案的存在性、强调程度、以及误解识别。采用多项选择与生成式评估结合的范式，并进行Oracle消融实验。
AI.result: 最强LLM在回答字面请求上的比例为0.75-0.92，而回答预期意图的比例仅为0.33-0.71；误解识别最多达到63%，而人类为79-90%。模型在多项选择设置中偏好务实回应，但生成时却无法产生此类回应。Oracle实验表明提供明确用户意图有帮助，但仍有很大差距。
AI.conclusion: 务实重定向（pragmatic redirection）是当前LLM中根本性未开发的能力，即使最强的模型在识别用户误解并引导其走向根本解决方案方面仍与人类存在显著差距，需要进一步发展。

title: Image-Scale Robustness and Visual Recognition Performance: A Cross-Architecture Analysis
summary: The sensitivity of visual recognition models to changes in image scale is well established, yet the factors governing this sensitivity across heterogeneous architectures remain unclear. In this work, we investigate whether scale robustness exhibits a common quantitative structure across modern vision models. We evaluate 20 pretrained ImageNet-1K classifiers spanning seven architectural families, including convolutional, mobile, efficient, and Transformer-based architectures. By systematically reducing input image scale, we construct scale-accuracy response curves and define a characteristic scale as a compact measure of the onset of substantial recognition degradation. We then examine the relationship between characteristic scale and baseline recognition accuracy, model parameter count, architectural family, and representation stability. A strong inverse association is observed between baseline accuracy and characteristic scale (Pearson r = -0.890, R^2= 0.792, p < 10^-6). This relationship remains stable under bootstrap resampling, leave-one-architecture-out analysis, and leave-one-family-out analysis. In contrast, parameter count provides negligible additional explanatory power after controlling for baseline accuracy (p = 0.80), while architectural family does not provide significant incremental explanatory power. Furthermore, characteristic scale shows essentially no association with representation stability (r = -0.003, p = 0.991). These results indicate that, across the studied models, scale robustness is strongly organized by baseline recognition performance rather than simply by model size, architectural family, or representation stability. The study provides an empirical framework for characterizing scale robustness across vision architectures and identifies a reproducible accuracy-scale regularity that warrants further theoretical investigation.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了20个涵盖7种架构家族的ImageNet-1K预训练视觉模型，通过系统降低输入图像尺度构建尺度-精度响应曲线，发现基线识别精度与特征尺度之间存在强烈的负相关关系（r=-0.890），而参数数量、架构家族和表示稳定性均不提供显著的额外解释力。
AI.motivation: 视觉识别模型对图像尺度变化的敏感性已被广泛认知，但控制这种敏感性的因素在不同异构架构之间仍不清楚，缺乏统一的量化框架来理解尺度鲁棒性的结构。
AI.method: 对20个来自7个架构家族（卷积、移动、高效、Transformer等）的预训练ImageNet-1K分类器进行系统性的输入图像尺度缩减，构建尺度-精度响应曲线，定义特征尺度作为识别显著退化开始的紧凑度量，并分析其与基线精度、参数数量、架构家族和表示稳定性的关系，辅以bootstrap重采样、留一架构和留一家族分析验证稳健性。
AI.result: 基线精度与特征尺度呈强负相关（r=-0.890，R²=0.792，p<10⁻⁶），该关系在多种稳健性检验下保持稳定；参数数量的额外解释力可忽略不计（p=0.80）；架构家族无显著增量解释力；特征尺度与表示稳定性几乎无关联（r=-0.003，p=0.991）。
AI.conclusion: 跨现代视觉模型的尺度鲁棒性主要由基线识别性能组织决定，而非模型大小、架构家族或表示稳定性；该研究提供了跨架构表征尺度鲁棒性的经验框架，识别出的精度-尺度规则值得进一步的理论探索。

title: You Are What You Read: Misalignment via In-Context Persona Induction
summary: Broad misalignment has been produced by finetuning on narrow data, harmful or benign, and in context only by demonstrations of the undesirable behaviour itself. We show that benign data suffices in context, with no finetuning and no demonstration of harmful behaviour in the prompt. Biographical facts that converge on a single figure, placed in a model's context as ordinary conversational turns, lead it to answer as that figure on questions the facts never touch. We call this persona induction. Across nine personas and thirteen models, identity adoption rises sigmoidally with the number of facts and crosses 50% within 3 to 10 of them. Misalignment then tracks which figure is described. Harmless personas reach full adoption with near-zero misalignment, while harmful ones voice their characteristic views on unrelated questions, at rates up to 80%. A formatting instruction can gate when the persona activates. Because each fact is individually benign, accumulated biographical context is flagged by content filters on 3% of inputs against 24-33% for an equivalent direct instruction.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现，仅通过在上下文中放置普通对话形式的传记事实（无需微调或展示有害行为的示范），就能诱导语言模型采用特定人物的身份，且身份采用率随事实数量呈S形增长。无害人物几乎不产生不良对齐，而有害人物会在不相关问题上以高达80%的比例表达其特有观点，且这种诱导方式难以被内容过滤器检测到。
AI.motivation: 以往研究表明，在狭窄数据上微调或在上下文中直接示范不良行为会导致模型产生广泛的对齐偏差。然而，研究者想探究一个更隐蔽的问题：完全无害的数据（如普通传记事实）是否足以在上下文中引发模型的身份改变和潜在的有害行为，而不需要任何有害示范或微调。
AI.method: 实验设计：将多个聚焦于单一人物的传记事实作为普通对话轮次放入模型上下文，跨越9种人物角色和13种模型进行测试。通过逐步增加事实数量观察身份采用率的变化，并测量随之产生的对齐偏差程度。同时对比内容过滤器对该诱导方式与显式直接指令的检测差异。
AI.result: 身份采用率随传记事实数量呈S形（sigmoidal）增长，在3到10个事实内即超过50%的采用率。无害人物能达到完全身份采用且几乎零错误对齐；有害人物则在无关问题上以高达80%的概率表达其特有观点。内容过滤器仅能标记3%的此类输入，而等效的直接指令被标记率高达24-33%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了一种新的安全漏洞——"人物诱导"（persona induction）：每个单独无害的传记事实累积起来可诱导模型采用危险身份并产生不良行为，同时有效规避现有的内容过滤机制。由于无法通过阻止"有害数据"来防御这种攻击，这要求重新思考上下文安全策略的构造方式。

title: DriveZero: End-to-End Driving Beyond Human Demonstrations
summary: Most end-to-end autonomous-driving systems learn by imitating human driving logs, leaving their learned behavior constrained by the quality and behavioral coverage of the recorded trajectories. This report presents DriveZero, an end-to-end system that learns driving behavior beyond human demonstrations. It decomposes driving into a perception model and an action model, pretrains each in the regime best suited to it, and combines them into one end-to-end planner. The two models call for different learning recipes: perception must understand the world, and benefits from massive and diverse visual data; action must interact with it, and requires closed-loop feedback. On the action side, we introduce DriveRL, a mixed-agent closed-loop reinforcement-learning framework. It converts real driving logs into interactive worlds, where a privileged teacher policy is trained with PPO through closed-loop rollouts. For the perception model, DriveVFM consolidates multiple frozen vision foundation models, including DINOv3, SigLIP2, SAM and Depth Anything V2, into a single backbone from raw images alone, requiring no task-specific annotations. DriveZero then unifies the two: a camera-only planner that distills the frozen DriveRL teacher through its rolled-out trajectories. The goal-conditioned teacher can moreover be queried under augmented driving intents, yielding diverse, goal-consistent supervision that logged data cannot provide. On nuPlan, DriveRL with value-guided test-time action search achieves a mean score of 93.57 across the Val14, Test14-hard, and Test14-random community splits in both non-reactive and reactive modes, exceeding the Log-Replay expert on all three splits. DriveZero achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIMv1, NAVSIMv2 and the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark without any human trajectory supervision.

AI.tldr: DriveZero是一个端到端自动驾驶系统，将驾驶拆解为感知模型和动作模型，分别采用最适合的训练方案——感知模型依赖多视觉基础模型的融合与大规模视觉预训练，动作模型通过DriveRL混合代理闭环强化学习框架在交互式世界中训练。最终通过蒸馏将两者统一为纯摄像头规划的端到端规划器，在nuPlan上达到93.57均分，并在NAVSIM和HUGSIM基准上取得SOTA成绩，无需任何人类轨迹监督。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶系统过度依赖模仿人类驾驶日志，其行为上限受限于记录轨迹的质量和覆盖面，无法超越人类示范的水平。
AI.method: 将驾驶系统分解为感知模型（DriveVFM，融合DINOv3、SigLIP2、SAM和Depth Anything V2等冻结视觉基础模型）和动作模型（DriveRL，基于混合代理的闭环PPO强化学习，将真实驾驶日志转化为交互世界并训练特权教师策略）。DriveZero通过蒸馏冻结的DriveRL教师策略的滚动轨迹，将两者统一为纯摄像头的端到端规划器，并支持通过增强驾驶意图查询目标条件教师以生成多样化监督信号。测试阶段还采用基于价值的推理时动作搜索。
AI.result: 在nuPlan的Val14、Test14-hard和Test14-random三个社区划分上，DriveRL在非反应和反应模式下均达到93.57的均值分数，三个划分均超越Log-Replay专家；DriveZero在NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2和闭环HUGSIM基准上取得SOTA性能，全程无需人类轨迹监督。
AI.conclusion: DriveZero证明了通过将感知和动作解耦、分别采用最适合各自领域的训练范式（大规模视觉预训练与闭环强化学习），端到端自动驾驶系统可以打破人类示范的局限，学习超越人类日志覆盖的驾驶行为。

title: AutoLexSteer: Automatic Contrast Construction for Lexical Activation Steering
summary: Steering vectors have rapidly emerged as a popular and effective method for guiding the output of LLMs in very specific ways. But constructing accurate steering vectors is a difficult manual process due to the opacity of embeddings. We introduce Hangman, a novel type of steering vector that operates using word senses, as well as AutoLexSteer, the first fully automated process for building steering vectors. AutoLexSteer employs families of closely-related words extracted from WordNet to specify both the steering source to be avoided and the desired steering target. The steering vectors are quite precise, can be used to steer at the level of words and sets of word senses (meanings), and are able to steer certain LLM behaviors like sycophancy. The dataset and code can be found at https://github.com/ShuheWang1998/autolexsteer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hangman——一种基于词义（word senses）的新型steering vector，以及AutoLexSteer——首个全自动构建steering vector的流程，利用WordNet中紧密相关的词族来指定要避免的steering源和期望的steering目标，可在词和词义集合层面精准引导LLM行为（如同步奉承）。
AI.motivation: Steering vectors已成为引导LLM输出的流行且有效的方法，但由于嵌入空间的不可解释性，人工构建精确的steering vectors非常困难。
AI.method: 提出Hangman这一新型steering vector类型（基于词义操作），以及AutoLexSteer自动化流程——利用WordNet中提取的紧密相关词族来指定steering源（应避免的）和steering目标（期望的），自动构建精确的steering vectors。
AI.result: 构建的steering vectors非常精确，能够在单词和词义集合（含义）的层面进行引导，并能有效引导某些LLM行为（如奉承行为）。团队已公开数据集和代码。
AI.conclusion: AutoLexSteer实现了steering vector构建的全自动化，解决了手工构建困难的问题，并通过词义粒度的控制提升了steering的精确性。

title: GradeTrap: Authority Cues in Images Shift VLM Judgments Despite Explicit Instructions to Ignore Them
summary: As vision-language models (VLMs) become increasingly capable and are deployed in consequential real-world settings, they must evaluate evidence independently rather than defer uncritically to human authority. We introduce GradeTrap, a controlled evaluation that places two social cues in direct conflict: a student answer, which should attract sycophantic agreement, and a conflicting answer attributed to a peer, teacher, or official answer key, which should attract authority-based deference. Models produce free-form answers while being explicitly instructed to solve independently and ignore all student answers, feedback, and grading marks. We test the models on 60 synthetic real-world trade-off scenarios. Five neutral trials establish a stable model-relative preference, followed by three repetitions of six experimental cues including controls. On the 45-item common intersection across Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-5.6 Luna, and Claude Haiku 4.5, a generic second-answer control yields 5.4% conflicting-answer selection. Relative to that control, pooled within-item changes show no reliable peer-review effect, a 6.9-point teacher-review effect, and a 19.5-point official-key effect. In contrast, a displayed conflicting student answer alone compared to a displayed student reference answer alone only raises selection from 2.2% to 5.2%. Official-key provenance therefore redirects judgements more than a student answer or the generic second-answer control, despite an explicit ignore instruction and an opposing student answer given along with the official key. Effects vary in magnitude across the three models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GradeTrap，一种受控评估方法，用于测试视觉语言模型(VLM)在面对学生答案与权威来源（同伴、教师或官方答案）冲突时是否会违背明确指示而产生权威顺从。结果显示官方答案来源使模型的选择率提升19.5个百分点，远高于学生答案（从2.2%提升到5.2%）和通用第二答案对照（5.4%），表明模型在存在权威来源时即使收到忽略指令也难以独立判断。
AI.motivation: 随着VLM在现实世界中被广泛部署，它们需要独立思考而非盲目顺从人类权威。现有研究关注模型的奉承行为，但很少系统研究模型在面对相互冲突的社会线索（学生答案与权威答案）时会如何表现，尤其缺乏受控的实验设计来量化权威效应对模型判断的影响。
AI.method: 设计60个合成现实世界权衡场景，将学生答案与冲突的同伴/教师/官方答案来源置于直接冲突中。模型被明确指示独立解题并忽略学生答案、反馈和评分标记。实验流程包括5个中性试验以建立模型相对偏好，随后是6种实验线索各重复3次。使用不同参数设置的公共45项交集对Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、GPT-5.6 Luna和Claude Haiku 4.5进行测试，通过组内项目变化比较各条件下的冲突答案选择率。
AI.result: 通用第二答案对照产生5.4%的冲突答案选择率。与之相比：同伴审查无明显效应（+0），教师审查增加6.9个百分点，官方答案来源增加19.5个百分点。单独显示冲突学生答案相对于仅显示学生参考答案仅将选择率从2.2%提高到5.2%。三种模型间效应幅度存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 尽管有明确的忽略指令并存在对立的学生答案，官方答案来源仍能显著重定向模型的判断，其影响远超学生答案和通用第二答案对照。这一发现揭示了VLM对制度化权威的过度信任倾向，强调在现实部署中需要解决此类权威顺从偏见的必要性。

title: Towards Bridging the Gap Between Offline and Iterative Alignment via Preference Distillation
comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Direct preference optimization DPO is a promising offline approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) due to its simplicity, computational efficiency, and implicit modeling of human preferences. Interestingly, iterative extensions of DPO have achieved stronger performance on academic benchmarks, raising two key questions: (i) Why do iterative methods generally outperform offline ones? (ii) Can their advantages be incorporated into offline alignment? To answer the first question, our controlled experiments reveal that the explicit preference model, additionally introduced in the iterative procedure, is a key factor behind its superiority over offline methods. This insight leads us to answer the second question affirmatively and propose Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization (DP3O), an effective and efficient offline alignment algorithm. DP3O first learns an explicit preference model using a helper class of LLMs and then distills its knowledge into policy optimization. Theoretically, we show that explicit preference modeling admits better estimation error control than implicit formulations, and that DP3O achieves a tighter generalization bound than hard-label DPO through variance reduction. Empirically, we evaluate DP3O on a wide range of chat-based and downstream tasks and show that it outperforms state-of-the-art offline methods, achieves performance comparable to iterative DPO, and reduces training time by about $42\%$, demonstrating both its effectiveness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP3O算法，通过显式偏好模型蒸馏知识到策略优化中，弥合了离线与迭代DPO方法之间的性能差距，在保持离线训练效率的同时取得了与迭代DPO相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 两个关键问题驱动研究：(i)为什么迭代式DPO方法通常优于离线方法？(ii)能否将迭代方法的优势融入离线对齐？
AI.method: DP3O算法分两步：首先利用辅助类LLM学习显式偏好模型，然后将该模型的知识蒸馏到策略优化中。理论上证明了显式偏好建模比隐式建模具有更好的估计误差控制，并通过方差缩减获得比硬标签DPO更紧的泛化界。
AI.result: 在广泛的聊天型及下游任务上，DP3O超越现有最优的离线方法，性能与迭代DPO相当，且训练时间减少约42%。
AI.conclusion: 显式偏好模型是迭代方法优于离线方法的关键因素，通过离线方式引入显式偏好模型可以兼顾性能与效率，为离线对齐提供了新的有效范式。

title: NSFlow: End-to-End Differentiable Neuro-Symbolic Optical Flow for Visual Odometry
summary: Sparse optical flow provides stable inter-frame correspondence, playing a key role in Visual Odometry (VO) and Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO). Classical optimization-based methods, such as Lucas-Kanade (LK), perform well under small displacements but are sensitive to large motions and illumination changes. Modern regression-based learning methods, while more robust in complex scenes, are often computationally heavy and lack explicit geometric consistency, making them less suitable for efficient VO/VIO front-ends. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid neuro-symbolic framework that combines the strengths of both paradigms. Our method uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract robust feature representations, which is fed into a differentiable LK optimizer to estimate optical flow in an end-to-end trainable manner. Through implicit differentiation, gradients are propagated across the iterative solver, enabling joint optimization of feature extraction and flow estimation. The resulting system integrates seamlessly into existing VO/VIO pipelines and runs in real-time on embedded platforms. Experiments show that our method outperforms conventional optimization-based flow in challenging conditions such as dynamic lighting and low texture, while also achieving higher accuracy and lower latency than purely regression-based alternatives. When deployed in a VIO system, our method demonstrates significant performance improvement, achieving an average error reduction of 42\% on challenging datasets while enhancing tracking stability. The code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合神经符号光流估计框架，将CNN特征提取与可微LK优化器端到端结合，兼顾经典方法的几何一致性与学习方法的鲁棒性，在嵌入式平台上实时运行，并显著提升VIO系统的定位精度。
AI.motivation: 经典优化方法（如LK）在微小位移下表现良好但对大运动和光照变化敏感，而现代回归学习方法虽鲁棒但计算量大且缺乏显式几何一致性，两者都难以高效适配VO/VIO前端。作者旨在弥合这一鸿沟，构建兼具两者优势的混合框架。
AI.method: 提出混合神经符号框架：使用CNN提取鲁棒特征表示，将其输入可微LK优化器进行光流估计，整个流程端到端可训练。通过隐式微分在迭代求解器间传播梯度，实现特征提取与光流估计的联合优化，且可无缝集成到现有VO/VIO流水线中。
AI.result: 实验表明：在动态光照和低纹理等挑战性场景下优于传统优化方法；比纯回归方法精度更高、延迟更低；在VIO系统中，在挑战性数据集上平均误差降低42%，并增强了跟踪稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 混合神经符号框架有效结合了经典优化方法的几何一致性与深度学习方法的鲁棒性，为高效VO/VIO前端提供了一种实时、高精度的解決方案，代码已公开。

title: Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE and Empirical Analysis of Vocabulary Pruning
summary: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but the resulting merge order does not necessarily allocate a fixed model-visible vocabulary optimally for compression. We propose Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE (DH-BPE), a vocabulary-construction method that combines token exposure under exact minimum-token segmentation with the hierarchical dependencies induced by BPE training. Starting from a modestly overshot BPE candidate vocabulary, DH-BPE uses dynamic programming to measure candidate utility and applies exposure-guided, dependency-aware pruning to select a fixed-size model-visible vocabulary. We compare DH-BPE against Standard BPE and recent vocabulary-optimization baselines, including Pruned BPE, MinGram, and MinGram-PP, in primary evaluations at 12K and 16K target vocabulary sizes, with an additional 18K evaluation against MinGram only. Across the primary 12K and 16K comparisons, DH-BPE consistently improves aggregate compression over Standard BPE, Pruned BPE, and MinGram under a shared exact minimum-token DP encoder. MinGram-PP achieves stronger aggregate compression in the primary comparisons, but DH-BPE outperforms it at overshoot factors f = 2.0 and f = 3.0 in cross-corpus evaluation; at 12K, MinGram-PP reverses this ordering only with the substantially larger candidate pools at f = 4.0 and f = 5.0. Qualitative analysis further shows that DH-BPE balances later, more complete BPE merges with reusable subword components, providing a practical approach to improving vocabulary allocation under a fixed model-visible vocabulary budget.

AI.tldr: 提出DH-BPE，一种结合动态规划与BPE层级依赖的词汇表构建方法，在固定模型可见词汇预算下通过曝光引导和依赖感知的剪枝来优化压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 标准BPE通过贪心合并构建词汇表，但合并顺序并不一定能在固定模型可见词汇预算下实现最优压缩分配。
AI.method: 从适度过采样的BPE候选词汇表出发，使用动态规划评估候选词效用，并采用曝光引导、依赖感知的剪枝方法，选择固定大小的模型可见词汇表。
AI.result: 在12K和16K目标词汇量下，DH-BPE在聚合压缩方面一致优于Standard BPE、Pruned BPE和MinGram；MinGram-PP在主要对比中表现更强，但在f=2.0和f=3.0的跨语料评估中DH-BPE更优；定性分析表明DH-BPE在后期完整BPE合并与可复用子词组件之间取得了平衡。
AI.conclusion: DH-BPE为固定模型可见词汇预算下的词汇分配提供了实用的改进方法，在压缩性能与子词可复用性之间实现了良好平衡。

title: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Complex and Multimodal Video Object Segmentation
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures (6 panels), 3 tracks; report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge held in conjunction with ECCV 2026
summary: This report summarizes the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. The challenge evaluates video segmentation in three complementary settings: complex semi-supervised video object segmentation on MOSEv2, text-guided referring video object segmentation on MeViSv2-Text, and audio-guided referring video object segmentation on MeViSv2-Audio. We describe the tasks and evaluation protocols and review the methods of the top three teams in each track. Across the nine leading solutions, foundation segmentation models are combined with target-aware memory, multimodal reasoning, explicit target-existence verification, agentic interaction, and corrective tracking. These systems illustrate a broader transition from single-model mask propagation toward modular pipelines that reason about object identity, query validity, and temporal reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了第八届大规模视频目标分割挑战赛（LSVOS），该赛事与ECCV 2026联合举办，涵盖三个赛道：MOSEv2上的复杂半监督视频目标分割、MeViSv2-Text上的文本引导指称视频目标分割，以及MeViSv2-Audio上的音频引导指称视频目标分割。文章描述了任务定义、评估协议，并回顾了每个赛道前三名团队的方法。
AI.motivation: 视频目标分割领域正从单一模型掩码传播向整合多模态推理和目标身份验证的模块化系统过渡，需要通过挑战赛系统评估不同设置（半监督、文本引导、音频引导）下的最新技术水平。
AI.method: 九个顶尖解决方案普遍将基础分割模型与目标感知记忆、多模态推理、显式目标存在性验证、智能体交互和纠错追踪机制相结合，形成模块化的推理流水线。
AI.result: 九支优胜团队的方法展示了从单模型掩码传播向能够推理目标身份、查询有效性和时间可靠性的模块化系统的范式迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛揭示了视频目标分割领域正朝模块化、多模态、可推理的系统架构方向发展，目标感知记忆和显式验证机制成为提升性能的关键组件。

title: TurEngMix: A Text Corpus and Benchmark for Turkish-English Code-Mixed Language Identification and Named Entity Recognition
comment: Accepted to W-NUT 2026 (11th Workshop on Natural User-generated Text), co-located with EMNLP 2026. 15 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables
summary: Natural language processing systems underperform on code-mixed text, particularly for low-resource language pairs. Turkish-English poses a further challenge: it lets English stems combine with Turkish suffixes to form single mixed-language tokens. We introduce TurEngMix, a corpus of 5.5K noisy, naturally occurring social media posts (486,974 tokens) rich in Turkish-English code-mixing. From this corpus, we construct a new Turkish-English benchmark for code-mixed language identification (LID) and named entity recognition (NER), comprising 15K expert-annotated tokens. Evaluating both decoder LLM and fine-tuned encoder baselines, we find that monolingual Turkish and English tokens are labeled reliably, but all models have high error rates on mixed-language tokens for both LID and NER. For morphologically integrated tokens, NER error rates were 5.2x and 6.3x higher for GPT-4o and Qwen, respectively. This highlights how morphological integration remains a challenge. We release the corpus, annotations, and code to support future computational and sociolinguistic research on Turkish-English code-mixing.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍TurEngMix语料库，包含5.5K条土耳其语-英语混合代码的真实社交媒体帖子（486,974个词元），并构建了约15K专家标注词元的土英代码混合语言识别（LID）和命名实体识别（NER）基准。实验发现，当前模型在单语词元上表现可靠，但在混合语言词元上错误率极高——形态整合词元上NER错误率分别是GPT-4o和Qwen的5.2倍和6.3倍，凸显了形态整合仍是核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有NLP系统在代码混合文本上表现不佳，尤其是低资源语言对。土耳其语-英语尤为特殊：英语词干可与土耳其语后缀结合形成混合单词元。此前缺乏针对该语言对的代码混合基准数据集，限制了相关研究。
AI.method: 作者构建TurEngMix语料库，收集5.5K条自然发生的嘈杂社交媒体帖子；从中整理出约15K个专家标注词元的土英代码混合基准，用于语言识别（LID）和命名实体识别（NER）两项任务。使用解码器LLM（如GPT-4o、Qwen）和微调编码器基线进行系统评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，各模型在单语土耳其语和英语词元上的标注可靠，但在混合语言词元上无论是LID还是NER都存在高错误率。对于形态整合词元，GPT-4o和Qwen的NER错误率分别比普通词元高出5.2倍和6.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 形态整合（英语词干+土耳其语后缀）是代码混合NLP的主要未解挑战。作者公开了语料库、标注和代码，以支持未来土耳其语-英语代码混合的计算语言学和社会语言学研究。

title: Automatic Red Teaming for Implicit Vulnerabilities of Text-to-Image Models
summary: Red-teaming Text-to-Image (T2I) models is essential for safe deployment, yet it remains particularly challenging against implicit adversarial prompts. Unlike explicit adversarial prompts that can be readily identified and blocked, implicit ones are much harder to detect: the prompts appear benign on the text surface yet still lead to inappropriate visual content. To address this, we propose Adversarial Probing for Implicit VulnErabilities (AdvPIE), a multimodal agentic framework to expose implicit vulnerabilities without requiring access to the parameters of target models. AdvPIE adopts a policy agent to generate and refine implicit adversarial prompts based on the feedback from a judge agent. To construct informative feedback, the judge agent provides modality-specific safety evaluation at both global and relative levels across iterations. To effectively leverage the feedback, we propose a novel Cumulative Adversarial Decoding strategy for the policy agent, which dynamically reweights token distributions to favor tokens that lead to more harmful images while preserving sampling diversity. Extensive experiments on standard and safety-aligned T2I models show that AdvPIE1 effectively uncovers implicit vulnerabilities, outperforming various baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdvPIE，一个多智能体框架，用于在黑盒条件下揭露文生图（T2I）模型在面对隐式对抗提示词时的安全漏洞。该方法通过策略智能体生成并优化隐式对抗提示词，裁判智能体提供跨迭代的多模态安全评估，并采用累积对抗解码策略来动态调整 token 分布，实验表明其在多个 T2I 模型上优于各种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型的安全部署至关重要，但隐式对抗提示词（表面文本看似正常却能诱导生成不当视觉内容）远比显式对抗提示词难以检测和阻断，现有方法难以有效揭露此类隐藏漏洞。作者希望在不访问目标模型参数的黑盒条件下，系统性地发现这些隐式安全漏洞。
AI.method: AdvPIE 是一个多智能体框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 裁判智能体——提供全局和相对两个层面、跨迭代的多模态（特定模态）安全评估反馈；(2) 策略智能体——基于裁判反馈生成和优化隐式对抗提示词，并采用新提出的累积对抗解码（Cumulative Adversarial Decoding）策略，动态重新加权 token 分布，偏向能产生更有害图像的 token，同时保持采样多样性。
AI.result: 在标准和经过安全对齐的 T2I 模型上进行了大量实验，AdvPIE 能有效揭露隐式安全漏洞，其性能优于多种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: AdvPIE 为 T2I 模型的隐式对抗漏洞探测提供了一种无需模型参数的通用框架，为模型安全评估和后续安全对齐提供了新的技术路径。

title: CantoneseLLM v2: Reasoning in a Low-Resource Language
summary: Cantonese is widely spoken but remains low-resource in written data, with no large corpus of native Cantonese reasoning traces available for model training. We develop and release CantoneseLLM v2, comprising models based on Qwen3 8B and 30B-A3B. The models are trained through CPT on 784 million Cantonese and Hong Kong-related tokens, chat-vector merging, SFT, DPO, and RLVR. Evaluation across the training stages shows that chat-vector merging transfers instruction following but preserves the donor model's reasoning language, while SFT with limited Cantonese reasoning data substantially shortens or removes reasoning traces and reduces benchmark performance. DPO restores the reasoning-block format, particularly for the 8B model, but recovers only part of the lost performance. The RLVR training with Cantonese language and Traditional Chinese scripts as multiplicative constraints introduced Cantonese language alignment and restored the lost performance. The 30B-A3B model reaches 73.16 on HKCanto-Eval, within 1.20 points of its merged checkpoint, while retaining the Cantonese reasoning behaviour absent from that checkpoint. We release the model checkpoints, the training environments, and a thirteen-year Traditional Chinese Common Crawl dataset. The models can be accessed at https://huggingface.co/collections/hon9kon9ize/cantonesellm-v20

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CantoneseLLM v2，一个基于Qwen3训练的粤语大语言模型系列，通过CPT、chat-vector合并、SFT、DPO和RLVR多阶段训练，成功使30B-A3B模型在HKCanto-Eval上达到73.16分，并保留了粤语推理行为。
AI.motivation: 粤语使用广泛但书面数据资源匮乏，缺乏用于模型训练的原生粤语推理轨迹大数据集。研究者旨在开发能使用粤语进行推理的LLM，填补这一低资源语言模型的空白。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3 8B和30B-A3B模型，采用多阶段训练方法：先在7.84亿个粤语及香港相关token上进行CPT，然后进行chat-vector合并、SFT、DPO和RLVR训练。RLVR以粤语和繁体中文作为乘性约束条件。
AI.result: 30B-A3B模型在HKCanto-Eval上达到73.16分，与其合并checkpoint仅差1.20分。研究发现chat-vector合并保留推理语言但转移指令跟随能力，DPO可恢复推理块格式但仅部分恢复性能，RLVR则完整恢复了丢失的性能。
AI.conclusion: CantoneseLLM v2成功解决了低资源粤语LLM的训练问题，通过RLVR训练实现了粤语语言对齐和性能恢复，并开源了模型checkpoint、训练环境和十三年的繁体中文Common Crawl数据集。

title: PASTEL: Panoramic Alignment for Monocular 4D Scene Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing 4D scenes from casually captured monocular video is vital for applications in virtual reality (VR) and embodied AI. Recent advances in 4D reconstruction and novel view synthesis have substantially propelled this capability. However, existing reconstruction methods generally cannot recover regions beyond visible camera limits. Consequently, we introduce a new paradigm that achieves 4D scene synthesis by combining visible-region reconstruction from monocular input with invisible-region generation beyond observable camera boundaries. We present Panoramic Alignment for Strategic Exploitation of Generative Priors (PASTEL). Specifically, PASTEL proposes panoramic scene alignment, a novel representation that reformulates the intractable 3D "invisible region" exploration into a tractable 2D directional trajectory planning. This is achieved by reducing the viewpoint planning from 6-DoF search to a 2D directional search with explicit visibility boundaries. By operating within this panoramic space, our method strategically identifies camera trajectories that maximize exploration beyond observable boundaries while minimizing viewpoint deviation. Experimental results show that PASTEL can not only extrapolate plausible scene content beyond the observable boundaries of input monocular videos, but also substantially boost monocular 4D reconstruction performance. PASTEL outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method by 0.9dB in full-image PSNR on the DyCheck IPhone dataset.

AI.tldr: PASTEL方法通过全景对齐将单目视频的4D场景重建从可见区域扩展到不可见区域，将3D不可见区域探索转化为2D方向轨迹规划，在DyCheck IPhone数据集上PSNR提升0.9dB。
AI.motivation: 现有4D重建方法无法恢复超出相机可见范围之外的区域，限制了其在VR和具身AI等应用中的效果。
AI.method: 提出全景场景对齐（Panoramic Scene Alignment），将6自由度视点搜索降维为2D方向搜索并明确可见性边界，通过策略性识别最大化探索范围且最小化视点偏差的相机轨迹来生成不可见区域内容。
AI.result: 在DyCheck IPhone数据集上超越SOTA方法0.9dB全图PSNR，不仅能外推输入视频可见边界之外的合理场景内容，还显著提升单目4D重建性能。
AI.conclusion: PASTEL通过将不可见区域生成与可见区域重建相结合的新范式，有效解决了4D场景合成中的探索边界问题，证明了2D方向视角规划在4D场景外推中的可行性与有效性。

title: Train Overcomplete, Deploy Compact: Scaling Recovery Capacity for Structured LLM Pruning
comment: Accepted by the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) 2026
summary: Large language models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but deployment remains costly because of memory, latency, and energy demands. Structured pruning reduces these costs by removing architectural components, yet its recovery stage is often limited by a mismatch between the recovery module's representational capacity and the complexity of the removed knowledge. We call this bottleneck the capacity-knowledge asymmetry and propose OverRep, an Overcomplete Reparameterization framework for structured LLM pruning. Following the principle of "train overcomplete, deploy compact", OverRep temporarily overparameterizes the recovery module during training to absorb complex knowledge distilled from the original model. After recovery, the overcomplete re-parameterization is algebraically merged into a mathematically equivalent compact module, preserving the pruned model's inference-time architecture and computational cost. OverRep further introduces an annealed activation that enables nonlinear training dynamics while converging to a linear regime for exact algebraic merging. Across three backbone families, OverRep improves retained reasoning performance over strong recovery baselines by up to 5.5 and 8.4 points at 25% and 50% pruning, respectively, while keeping memory usage and TFLOPs comparable to existing recovery methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/OverRep.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OverRep框架，针对结构化LLM剪枝中"容量-知识不对称"问题，通过训练时过完备参数化恢复模块、推理时代数合并回紧凑模块的方式，在保持推理架构和计算成本不变的前提下，显著提升了剪枝后模型的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型部署成本高昂（内存、延迟、能耗），结构化剪枝虽能降低成本，但恢复阶段常因恢复模块的表达能力与已移除知识的复杂度不匹配而受限，即所谓的"容量-知识不对称"瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出OverRep框架，遵循"训练时过完备，部署时紧凑"的原则：训练期间对恢复模块进行过参数化以吸收从原始模型蒸馏的复杂知识，同时引入退火激活函数，使非线性训练动力学逐步收敛到线性机制，从而保证训练结束后可将过完备重参数化通过代数操作精确合并为数学等价的紧凑模块，不改变推理时的架构和计算开销。
AI.result: 在三个骨干模型家族上，相比强恢复基线，OverRep在25%和50%剪枝率下分别将保留的推理性能提升了最多5.5和8.4个点，同时内存使用量和TFLOPs与现有恢复方法相当。
AI.conclusion: OverRep有效解决了结构化剪枝恢复阶段的容量瓶颈，兼顾了训练时的强大表达能力和推理时的紧凑高效架构，为LLM剪枝后性能恢复提供了一种通用且高效的解决方案。

title: TBDub: Production-Oriented Visual Dubbing
summary: Visual dubbing must synchronize mouth motion with replacement speech while preserving identity, appearance, and temporal consistency. Although X-Dub provides a strong mask-free video-editing baseline, its application to livestream and generated-video content reveals limitations in production-domain robustness, temporal and motion stability, identity and oral-detail preservation, and inference efficiency. We present \textbf{TBDub}, a production-oriented extension of X-Dub that combines task-adaptive post-training with task-aware few-step distillation. Post-training adapts the video DiT using production-domain data, production-specific conditioning and filtering, and enhanced audio features to obtain a 30-step Teacher. Distillation adapts DMD/DMD2 to conditional video editing and compresses the Teacher into a two-step Student. On 38 TalkVid clips, the Teacher improves all eight reported reconstruction, perceptual, identity, and synchronization metrics over X-Dub. In the MOS evaluation, it improves lip-sync consistency, identity consistency, and visual quality over X-Dub by 0.14, 0.95, and 0.90 points, while the Student achieves the highest lip-sync and visual-quality scores and remains close to the Teacher in identity consistency. In paired end-to-end generation timing from the first VAE encode through the final VAE decode on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU at $512\times512$, the Student reaches 7.13 effective FPS and reduces total latency by $13.93\times$; the DiT stage alone is accelerated by $42.49\times$. The Student largely retains the Teacher's generation quality and audiovisual synchronization. The code is available on GitHub at \https://github.com/TaoLiveAIGC/TBDub, and the 30-step Teacher and two-step Student weights are available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/TaoLiveAIGC/TBDub.

AI.tldr: TBDub是X-Dub的生产级扩展，结合任务自适应后训练与任务感知少步蒸馏，将30步Teacher压缩为2步Student。Teacher在38个TalkVid片段上全面超越X-Dub的各项指标，Student在H20 GPU上达到7.13 FPS，DiT阶段加速42.49倍，总延迟降低13.93倍，同时保持生成质量与音画同步。
AI.motivation: X-Dub作为无掩码视频编辑基线虽表现强劲，但在直播和生成视频等生产场景中存在领域鲁棒性、时间与运动稳定性、身份与口腔细节保持、推理效率等方面的不足。
AI.method: 采用任务自适应后训练（利用生产域数据、生产专用条件化与过滤、增强音频特征得到30步Teacher），再通过任务感知少步蒸馏（将DMD/DMD2适配到条件视频编辑场景）将Teacher压缩为两步Student。
AI.result: Teacher在38个TalkVid片段上全部8项重建/感知/身份/同步指标优于X-Dub；MOS评估中lip-sync提升0.14、identity提升0.95、visual quality提升0.90。Student达到7.13有效FPS，总延迟降低13.93倍，DiT加速42.49倍，并保持接近Teacher的质量。
AI.conclusion: TBDub通过后训练与蒸馏的组合，在保持高质量视觉配音效果的同时实现了显著的速度提升，验证了其面向直播及生成视频内容的生产可用性。

title: Aha-Flow Distillation: Flow Markers Matter in LLM Reasoning
summary: We identify the Flow Moment, a reasoning pattern characterized by sustained, process-confirming verbalizations such as I'm doing, in contrast to the revision- and backtracking-oriented Aha Moment. We refer to their corresponding linguistic expressions as Flow Markers and Aha Markers, respectively. Based on this observation, we construct Flow-CoT by rewriting the discourse markers of original reasoning traces while preserving their underlying reasoning content, and use it as auxiliary supervision for on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). We further propose \textbf{Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)}, a dual-mode extension of OPSD that pairs different forms of privileged information with corresponding reasoning instructions. The Aha branch retains concise solution-based supervision, while the Flow branch introduces rewritten Flow-CoT under a direct and confident reasoning instruction. At inference time, the model uses only the standard reflective instruction, so Flow-style reasoning serves purely as a training signal. Experiments on AIME25 and HMMT25 show consistent improvements across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B: AFD improves Avg@12 from 60.8 to 61.3 on Qwen3-8B and from 57.5 to 58.6 on Qwen3-4B over our reproduced OPSD baselines. Controlled ablations further show that, with the same Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT composition, dual-mode training improves Avg@12 from 59.5 to 60.1, indicating that the benefit comes not only from introducing heterogeneous reasoning supervision, but also from how it is organized during self-distillation. The code is available at https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/Aha-Flow-Distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了一种新的推理模式——Flow Moment（流程确认型推理），与其对应语言表达为Flow Markers（如"I'm doing"），区别于以修订和回溯为导向的Aha Moment。作者构建Flow-CoT通过改写原推理轨迹的话语标记（保留推理内容），并结合Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)双模式蒸馏方法进行训练。实验表明该方法在AIME25和HMMT25上对Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-4B均有一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有研究工作主要关注Aha Moment（即模型自我修正、回溯式推理），但忽视了另一种常见的持续确认式推理模式Flow Moment。作者希望探究如何将这两种异构推理监督信号有效组织并进行自蒸馏，以提升模型的数学推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出Flow-CoT：通过改写原始推理轨迹中的话语标记（discourse markers）来构造流程确认式推理数据，同时保留底层推理内容。2) 提出Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)：双模式扩展的on-policy self-distillation，其中Aha分支保留简明的基于解法的监督，Flow分支在直接且自信的推理指令下引入改写后的Flow-CoT。推理时仅使用标准反思式指令，Flow式推理仅作为训练信号。
AI.result: 在AIME25和HMMT25数据集上，AFD在Qwen3-8B上Avg@12从60.8提升到61.3，在Qwen3-4B上从57.5提升到58.6。可控消融实验表明，在相同Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT组成下，双模式训练将Avg@12从59.5提升到60.1。
AI.conclusion: 双模式训练的优势不仅来自引入异构推理监督信号本身，还取决于自蒸馏过程中对监督的组织方式。这为推理模式研究和大模型蒸馏训练提供了新的视角和有效方法。

title: Multiple Myeloma Lesion Segmentation on Whole-Body Diffusion-Weighted Imaging via Efficient Anatomical Anticipation and Multimodal Confirmation
summary: Whole-body diffusion-weighted imaging (WB-DWI) is widely used for multiple myeloma (MM) assessment, yet automated lesion segmentation remains challenging due to limited anatomical delineation and the low specificity of marrow hyperintensity. Existing studies have introduced bone region-of-interest (ROI) information and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps to mitigate these ambiguities, but practical limitations remain. Bone ROI construction often relies on costly manual annotation, image registration, or dedicated bone models, while ADC is usually incorporated only through simple channel fusion, limiting its ability to provide complementary structural and lesion-discriminative cues. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage framework for MM lesion segmentation on WB-DWI. In the first stage, we train a bone ROI generation model from ADC images without dedicated bone labels, providing an efficient and practical anatomical prior for lesion analysis. In the second stage, we propose Anatomy-guided Multimodal U-Net (AMU-Net), which leverages ADC in a manner consistent with clinical lesion assessment rather than treating it as a generic auxiliary modality. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed method. It achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated methods, with a mean Dice score of 76.2%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段框架用于全身弥散加权成像（WB-DWI）中的多发性骨髓瘤（MM）病灶分割。第一阶段从ADC图像生成骨骼ROI，无需专门的骨骼标签；第二阶段提出解剖引导的多模态U-Net（AMU-Net），以符合临床评估方式利用ADC信息。实验表明该方法取得最佳性能，平均Dice分数达76.2%。
AI.motivation: WB-DWI在MM评估中应用广泛，但自动病灶分割面临解剖结构界定有限和骨髓高信号特异性低等挑战。现有方法引入骨骼ROI和ADC图缓解问题，但存在实际局限：骨骼ROI构建依赖昂贵的人工标注、图像配准或专用骨骼模型；ADC仅通过简单通道融合纳入，未能充分提供互补的结构性和病灶判别性信息。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段训练一个骨骼ROI生成模型，无需专用骨骼标签，直接从ADC图像生成解剖先验；第二阶段提出解剖引导的多模态U-Net（AMU-Net），以与临床病灶评估一致的方式利用ADC信息，而非将其作为普通辅助模态处理。
AI.result: 在评估的方法中取得了最佳整体性能，平均Dice分数达到76.2%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法有效且实用，能够克服现有方法中骨骼ROI构建成本高和ADC利用方式不当的局限，在MM病灶分割任务上展现了显著优势。

title: A Hyperbolicity Atlas of Large Language Model Hidden States
summary: LLM hidden states are ordinary vectors, but the distances among those vectors may still show hierarchical structure. To our knowledge, this paper is the first systematic study of whether prompt-token hidden states in contemporary LLMs exhibit Gromov Hyperbolicity (GH), a distance-based measure of tree-likeness. Using 818,904 sample-layer measurements from ten open-weight models across MATH500, HumanEval, WinoGrande, and TruthfulQA, we build a GH map over four axes: parameter scale, layer depth, model family, and input domain. The clearest pattern is depth, not scale: middle layers usually form a high-relative-hyperbolicity plateau, while final layers often become substantially more tree-like. Scale effects are weak and non-monotonic, matched 7/8B model families differ strongly, and domains interact with model specialization. These findings make GH useful as a practical diagnostic: it shows where hierarchical distance structure appears, how specialization changes it, and which model-layer-domain comparisons deserve closer analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了当代LLM中prompt-token隐状态是否表现出Gromov双曲性（一种基于距离的树状结构度量）。通过对十个开源模型在四个数据集上的818,904个样本-层测量，构建了涵盖参数规模、层深度、模型家族和输入领域四个维度的GH图谱。最清晰的模式是深度而非规模：中间层通常形成高相对双曲性高原，而最终层往往变得更加树状。规模效应弱且非单调，7/8B模型家族差异显著，领域与模型特化相互交织。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM隐状态向量之间的距离是否呈现层次化（树状）结构，这是此前未被系统性研究的方面。通过Gromov双曲性作为度量工具，作者希望揭示隐空间中距离结构的几何特性，并为模型分析提供实用的诊断工具。
AI.method: 使用818,904个样本-层测量，覆盖十个开源权重模型，在MATH500、HumanEval、WinoGrande和TruthfulQA四个数据集上进行实验。沿四个轴（参数规模、层深度、模型家族、输入领域）构建Gromov双曲性图谱，系统测量prompt-token隐状态的双曲性。
AI.result: 最清晰的发现是深度效应而非规模效应：中间层通常呈现高相对双曲性高原，而最终层往往显著变得更加树状。规模效应弱且非单调，匹配的7/8B模型家族之间存在显著差异，输入领域与模型特化交互影响双曲性模式。
AI.conclusion: Gromov双曲性可作为实用的诊断工具：它揭示了层次化距离结构的出现位置、模型特化如何改变这种结构，以及哪些模型-层-领域的比较值得更深入的分析。这为理解LLM内部表征的几何组织提供了新的视角。

title: SolarBench: A global solar energy nowcasting benchmark
summary: As the share of solar power grows, nowcasting weather-driven solar variability becomes critical for reliable energy system operation. State-of-the-art approaches increasingly apply deep learning to sky camera and geostationary satellite observations, but fragmented datasets and inconsistent evaluation make it difficult to determine whether reported improvements generalize across climates, cloud regimes, and photovoltaic (PV) systems. Here we introduce SolarBench, an open global benchmark for image-based solar nowcasting. SolarBench harmonizes more than six million sky and satellite images from 11 diverse sites spanning a decade, together with irradiance or PV output and auxiliary atmospheric data. An accompanying toolbox supports reproducible data access, processing, model development, and evaluation. Using SolarBench, we benchmark representative models and reveal a gap between average forecasting accuracy and the ability to capture rapid solar fluctuations. We further quantify predictability across cloud regimes and demonstrate data-efficient adaptation to new PV systems. SolarBench provides an extensible foundation for fair comparison and methodological innovation in solar nowcasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了SolarBench，一个用于图像驱动的太阳能短期预报（nowcasting）的开源全球基准。它整合了来自11个不同站点、跨越十年的600多万张天空和卫星图像，并配套提供工具支持数据处理与模型评估，可复现地对比预报模型性能。
AI.motivation: 随着太阳能发电占比不断提升，准确预报天气驱动的太阳能波动对电网可靠运行至关重要。现有深度学习方法依赖零散的数据集和不一致的评估协议，难以判断方法改进是否能在不同气候、云况和光伏系统间泛化，缺乏统一的公平比较平台。
AI.method: 构建SolarBench开源基准：整合6百多万张来自11个站点的天空和卫星图像（跨越十年），配套辐照度或光伏出力数据及辅助大气数据。提供工具箱支持数据获取、处理、模型开发和标准化评估；在该基准上对代表性模型进行测试。
AI.result: 基准测试揭示了平均预报精度与捕捉快速太阳波动能力之间存在差距；量化了不同云况下的可预测性；并证明了模型对新光伏系统具有数据高效的迁移适应能力。
AI.conclusion: SolarBench为太阳能短期预报提供了可扩展的公平对比基础，有助于推动该领域的方法创新和可复现研究。

title: Where to Look and What to Use: Retrieve-Localize-Generate for Long-Term Conversational Memory Question Answering
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to answer questions by accessing external knowledge and has been widely adopted for long-term conversational memory question answering. However, existing methods suffer from two key challenges: (1) fragmented evidence scattered across temporally distant sessions, and (2) noisy content within retrieved sessions that triggers the lost-in-the-middle effect. To address these challenges, we propose MemLoc, a unified Retrieve-Localize-Generate framework for long-term conversational memory QA. For retrieval, MemLoc decomposes each session into multi-granularity memory units and performs query routing via an inner-memory graph with entropy-based granularity selection. It further models cross-session semantic and temporal dependencies through a cross-memory graph, enabling coarse-to-fine retrieval of top-K relevant memory candidates. For localization, we introduce a reasoning-based evidence locator trained with Self-reflective Hint Policy Optimization (SHPO), which performs progressive refinement by extracting query-relevant fragments within memory units to suppress noise and reranking across candidates to remove redundancy, producing a compact evidence set with lightweight location IDs. For generation, these IDs act as precise grounding signals that guide the LLM to the correct memory positions, mitigating the lost-in-the-middle effect while preserving original contextual integrity. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that MemLoc achieves state-of-the-art retrieval accuracy and response quality while maintaining efficiency. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Nikol-coder/MemLoc.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemLoc，一个统一的"检索-定位-生成"框架，用于解决长时对话记忆问答中的证据碎片化和检索内容噪声两大挑战，通过多粒度记忆单元分解、内/跨记忆图建模、基于推理的证据定位器以及轻量级位置ID引导生成，在四个基准上取得SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法在长时对话记忆问答中面临两个关键挑战：(1) 证据碎片化——相关信息分散在时间上相距遥远的多个会话中，难以完整召回；(2) 检索段落中的噪声内容会触发"lost-in-the-middle"效应，导致LLM忽略关键证据。
AI.method: MemLoc包含三个核心组件：(1) Retrieve阶段：将会话分解为多粒度记忆单元，通过内记忆图实现查询路由和基于熵的粒度选择；通过跨记忆图建模跨会话的语义和时间依赖，实现由粗到细的top-K候选检索。(2) Localize阶段：提出基于推理的证据定位器，采用自反思提示策略优化(SHPO)训练，通过渐进式精炼提取查询相关片段以抑制噪声，并在候选中重排序消除冗余，生成带轻量级位置ID的紧凑证据集。(3) Generate阶段：位置ID作为精确接地信号引导LLM到正确记忆位置，缓解lost-in-the-middle效应同时保留原始上下文完整性。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MemLoc在检索准确率和响应质量方面均达到最先进水平，同时保持较高的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: MemLoc通过统一的检索-定位-生成框架有效解决了长时对话记忆QA中的证据碎片化和噪声干扰问题，位置ID引导机制为缓解lost-in-the-middle效应提供了新思路。

title: One Perturbation Is Not Enough: Identifiability and Blind Baselines for Behavioral AI Evaluation
summary: Behavioral evaluations perturb an input and read the induced change in the output in order to certify that a system uses that input. We show that the number of perturbations such a certificate requires is fixed, and that reporting a single perturbation cannot supply it. Where a response ratio is a property of the policy rather than of the test items, the behavioral record is a linear measurement of an exponent vector recording how much the output depends on each input, so perturbations identify input use exactly when their logarithms span the input space. At least $n$ are needed for $n$ inputs, an incomplete design confuses precisely the policies differing along the kernel of its design matrix, and sharpening a perturbation never substitutes for adding an independent one. We also derive in closed form the score such a test awards a policy that reads nothing, which is far from zero and which none of the probes we survey reports. Instantiating this where the correct response is fixed by dimensional analysis, we run a complete identifying set of three perturbations on three vision--language models reporting a physical quantity from video. All three score far below their own blind bound rather than above it, because each defaults to one of a small set of round calibration values that never matches what the scale asserts; none moves its relabeling response by a single exponent, and none is separable from the same model instructed to ignore the video.

AI.tldr: 本文证明行为化评估（behavioral evaluation）若要认证系统确实使用了某输入，所需的扰动数量是固定的，且单个扰动无法提供该认证。作者从理论上推导出完整识别n个输入至少需要n个扰动，并推导出"盲读"策略得分的闭式解（远非零）。在视觉-语言模型预测物理量的实验中，三个模型在三个扰动的完整识别集下均低于其自身盲读基准，证明它们并未真正使用视频输入。
AI.motivation: 行为化评估通常通过扰动输入并观察输出变化来证明系统"使用了该输入"。然而，现有研究大多只报告单个扰动，本文指出这种单一扰动的认证是不充分的。作者旨在从理论上阐明行为化评估的识别能力边界，并揭示当前探针（probes）普遍缺失的关键盲点——即对"什么都不读"的策略应给予的分数基线。
AI.method: 作者将响应比率（response ratio）视为策略而非测试项的性质，将行为记录建模为指数向量（记录输出对各输入的依赖程度）的线性测量。他们证明扰动可精确识别输入使用当且仅当其对数张成输入空间，因此n个输入至少需要n个独立扰动；不完全设计的混淆核对应策略差异。作者还闭式推导了盲读策略（什么都不读）的得分，并将其应用于维度分析固定的物理量预测任务，对三个视觉-语言模型运行完整的三扰动识别集。
AI.result: 三个视觉-语言模型在完整的三扰动识别集中得分都远低于各自的盲读下界而非高于它。原因在于：每个模型都默认采用少数几个"整数值"校准响应，而这些值从不匹配维度分析所断言的标度；没有模型对重标标签（relabeling）响应移动哪怕一个指数；也无法将该模型与同一个被指示忽略视频的模型区分开来。
AI.conclusion: 行为化评估需要固定的最小扰动数量才能证明输入被使用，单个扰动远远不够；更尖锐的扰动无法替代增加独立扰动。实验表明，这些视觉-语言模型实际上并未基于视频输入进行物理量推理，而是退化为默认的校准响应，且现有探针因未报告盲读基线而无法揭示这一失败。

title: Revisiting Complete Reasoning Traces for Post-Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often post-trained on pre-collected reasoning trajectories to improve their reasoning capability. Such trajectories tend to be long due to complex, interwoven paths, which often include detours on the path toward the answer. However, it has been underexplored whether LLMs indeed benefit from learning complete trajectories in post-training, such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Starting from our pilot study, we find that full trajectories provide only limited benefit, while partial trajectories are effective even under heavy truncation. We analyze redundancy in reasoning trajectories through attention-based analyses and controlled token-removal studies, both of which show that intermediate tokens contribute minimally to final reasoning quality. This suggests that avoiding redundant information may allow LLMs to internally infer coherent alternatives by inferring missing steps from their internal knowledge, given known trajectory endpoints. Furthermore, we show that training LLMs using endpoints leads to consistent changes in reasoning behavior, and that it also benefits post-training methods based on reinforcement learning or on-policy distillation, highlighting the need to revisit complete reasoning traces. Code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/revisiting-trace.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型在后训练阶段使用完整推理轨迹是否必要。研究发现，完整的推理轨迹收益有限，而部分轨迹（甚至仅有端点）在监督微调、强化学习和策略蒸馏中都能带来一致且有效的推理能力提升，表明推理轨迹中存在大量冗余信息。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常使用预先收集的完整推理轨迹对LLM进行后训练以提升推理能力，但推理轨迹往往冗长且包含许多绕路步骤。作者质疑LLM是否真的需要学习完整的推理轨迹，并希望探索冗余信息对后训练效果的影响。
AI.method: 首先通过初步实验对比完整轨迹与部分轨迹的训练效果；其次利用基于注意力的分析和受控的token移除实验来评估推理轨迹中各部分的冗余程度；最后在监督微调、强化学习和策略蒸馏等多种后训练框架下验证使用端点（endpoints）训练的效果。
AI.result: 完整推理轨迹仅带来有限的收益，而部分轨迹即使在重度截断下仍然有效；注意力分析和token移除实验表明中间token对最终推理质量贡献极小；使用端点训练的LLM表现出一致的行为变化，并在强化学习和策略蒸馏中同样受益。
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹中存在大量冗余信息，LLM可以凭借已知轨迹端点结合内部知识自行推断缺失步骤，这提示研究社区应重新审视对完整推理轨迹的依赖。

title: PhysWeep: Does a Video Generator Realize the Physics You Ask For?
summary: Image-to-video generators are often credited with absorbing physical dynamics as implicit world models, a claim the community currently checks with plausibility scores that ask whether a clip looks consistent with real-world motion. Plausibility is the wrong test on its own, because a clip can look natural while encoding the wrong value of the governing physical parameter, and no existing benchmark measures this gap directly. PhysWeep closes it with a fixed, label-free audit, treating a frozen generator as a black box, recovering the realized parameter from generated pixels, and reporting how often generation is trackable at all, how far the realized value sits from the requested one, and which, if either, of the literature's two proposed failure mechanisms the data support. A deterministic-simulator positive control confirms every score is exactly checkable. Applied to three open generators across six sweep axes, PhysWeep finds a specific, reproducible, previously undocumented failure. Conditional on producing trackable motion, two of the three generate confident, well-fit dynamics that converge to one of a small number of fixed, wrong values selected by the sampling seed rather than by the request, reproducing across two independent model families, two physical systems, and an independent tracker. It matches neither the prior reversion nor the case-based clamping the literature anticipates, because the reversion target is seed-conditional rather than a single global default, and a leave-one-out selection rule rejects both; the in-range faithfulness slope is statistically indistinguishable from zero wherever a response is estimable at all. A benchmark averaging over seeds would never see this: each sample is confidently locked to a wrong constant, exactly the failure a plausibility score is structurally blind to. We release the protocol, suite, and analysis code.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文指出现有的图像到视频生成模型评测仅使用合理性分数（视频看起来是否自然）存在漏洞：一个视频可能看起来自然，但对物理参数的编码值是错误的。作者提出了PhysWeep，一个固定、无需标注的审计框架，将冻结的生成器视为黑盒，从生成像素中恢复实际物理参数值，并报告生成可追踪的频率、实际值与请求值之间的偏差，以及数据支持文献中提出的两种失败机制中的哪一种。通过确定性模拟器阳性对照验证了评分的可检查性。在三个开放生成器的六个扫描轴上进行实验，发现了一个可复现的、此前未记录的失败：两个模型产生的轨迹看起来令人信服，但收敛到少数几个由采样种子而非请求决定的不变错误值。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像到视频生成器评测过度依赖合理性分数（视频内容是否与现实运动一致），但这种检测方式存在结构性盲区——一个视频可以看起来自然，却编码了错误的物理参数值。目前没有任何基准能直接衡量这一差距，作者旨在填补这个空白。
AI.method: PhysWeep提出固定且无需标注的审计框架：将冻结的生成器当作黑盒，从生成像素中恢复实际参数值，测量生成可追踪的频率、请求值与实际值之间的偏差，并区分文献中预测的两种失败机制（全局反转或基于案例的钳制）。使用确定性模拟器作为阳性对照确保每个评分可精确检查。
AI.result: 在三个开放生成器和六个扫描轴上，发现一个可复现且此前未记录的失败：三个模型中两个在产生可追踪运动时，生成自信、拟合良好的动态，但收敛到少数由采样种子选择的固定错误值，而非请求值。此现象在独立模型系列、两个物理系统及独立追踪器上均出现。种子平均基准会掩盖此问题，合理性分数在结构上也无法发现。
AI.conclusion: 现有评测方法（合理性分数和种子平均）无法发现生成器对物理参数的系统性错误编码问题。PhysWeep揭示了一个新的失败模式：seed条件性的错误值锁定，而非文献预期的全局默认值反转或案例钳制。该协议、套件和分析代码已开放。

title: The Illusion of Debiasing: Persona Steering Redistributes Rather Than Reduces Bias in LLMs
summary: Prompt-based interventions: system prompts, personas, role instructions, reliably reshape what a language model says, but it is unclear which layer they reach. Do they reconfigure internal structure, or only modulate the output channel? We use persona conditioning as a controlled probe, measuring its effects along a depth axis from self-report, through open-ended generation, to word-level parametric association, across three instruction-tuned models. We find a graded dissociation. Personas are legible but not structural: models follow single-trait instructions yet fail to reproduce human inter-trait covariance. The dissociation deepens with depth: personas hold or amplify closed-form QA bias, shift absolute tone while leaving between-group disparity unchanged, and barely perturb an already saturated associative baseline. Prompt-based steering thus operates in the output channel and has a structural reach limit that surface manipulability can mask.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过人格条件设定作为受控探针，在自我报告、开放式生成和词汇级参数联想三个深度层面测量提示干预的效果，发现提示式干预存在"表现可塑但结构不达"的梯度分离现象，其作用局限于输出通道而非底层结构。
AI.motivation: 提示式干预（系统提示、人设、角色指令）能可靠地改变语言模型输出内容，但尚不清楚这种改变触及模型的哪个层面——是重构了内部结构，还是仅调节了输出通道？
AI.method: 以人格条件设定（persona conditioning）作为受控探针，在"自我报告-开放式生成-词级参数联想"的深度轴线上，测量三种指令微调模型中人格干预的效果差异，包括单特质指令服从性与人际特质协方差结构的复现情况。
AI.result: 发现梯度分离现象：模型能遵循单特质指令，但无法复现人类特质间的协方差结构；随深度加深分离加剧——人格设定能维持或放大封闭式问答偏差、改变绝对语气但不改变组间差异、对已饱和的联想基线几乎无扰动。
AI.conclusion: 提示式引导作用于输出通道，存在结构可达性上限，而表面的可操控性可能掩盖这一深层限制。

title: From Gaze to Meaning: A Training-Free AI Agent for Unified Grounding and Explanation
summary: Understanding human attention is fundamental for scene interpretation, yet existing approaches often rely on heavily trained models that lack interpretability. Prior methods struggle to jointly reason about gaze targets, attended objects, and visual grounding without extensive supervision. To the best of our knowledge, this work introduces the first training-free Gaze Target Agent (GTA) for gaze-guided reasoning across tasks such as gaze target prediction, attention localization, and object identification. This is achieved by leveraging pretrained vision-language models, augmenting them with visually guided prompts, and employing a memory-based retrieval strategy for high-uncertainty samples to improve performance without additional training. We evaluate our approach using both quantitative metrics and qualitative results. Quantitatively, our method achieves state of the art performance on the GazeFollow and GazeHOI benchmarks. Qualitatively, our agent provides detailed semantic predictions, predicts the correct targets even when ground truth labels are wrong, and remains flexible without vocabulary constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出无训练的凝视目标智能体（GTA），利用预训练视觉语言模型和视觉引导提示，结合基于记忆的检索策略，实现凝视目标预测、注意力定位和对象识别等凝视引导推理任务，在GazeFollow和GazeHOI基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有注意力理解方法依赖重度训练的模型且缺乏可解释性，难以在无需大量监督的情况下联合推理凝视目标、被注意对象和视觉定位。
AI.method: 利用预训练视觉语言模型，通过视觉引导提示进行增强，并针对高不确定性样本采用基于记忆的检索策略来提升性能，整个过程无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在GazeFollow和GazeHOI基准上取得了最先进的定量性能，并展示了详细的语义预测能力，即使在地面真值标签错误时也能正确预测目标，且无词汇约束限制。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的GTA方法证明无需训练即可实现凝视引导的跨任务推理，兼具高性能、可解释性和灵活性，有望为场景理解中的注意力解析提供新范式。

title: PTCG: Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages, 13 figures, 15 tables
summary: The ability to generate counterarguments is important for critical thinking and balanced discourse, yet existing approaches typically produce only a single counterargument, failing to capture the diversity and persuasiveness required in real-world debates. To address this limitation, we propose Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation (PTCG), a framework that combines Tree-of-Thoughts-inspired step-wise generation and pruning with speaker persona selection. By estimating the author's persona from the original argument and incorporating speaker personas representing distinct perspectives, PTCG operationalizes perspective-taking and enables the generation of diverse counterarguments. Results from LLM-as-a-Judge, classifier-based assessment, and human evaluations indicate that PTCG shows consistent improvements in both the diversity and persuasiveness of counterarguments compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PTCG（Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation）框架，结合Tree-of-Thoughts启发的逐步生成与剪枝策略以及说话人画像选择，用于生成多样化且具有说服力的反驳论点。
AI.motivation: 现有反驳论点生成方法通常只能生成单一的反驳，无法满足真实辩论场景中对多样性和说服力的需求。
AI.method: PTCG框架采用两个核心机制：(1) 借鉴Tree-of-Thoughts的逐步生成与剪枝方法进行逐步推理；(2) 从原始论点中估计作者画像，并融合代表不同视角的说话人画像，从而实现视角采择并生成多样化的反驳论点。
AI.result: 通过LLM-as-a-Judge、分类器评估和人工评估三种方式验证，PTCG在反驳论点的多样性和说服力方面均相较基线方法取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: PTCG通过引入说话人画像引导的树状生成策略，有效提升了反驳论点的多样性与说服力，为批判性思维和平衡论述场景提供了可行的生成框架。

title: Branch-Centric Tokenization and Test-Time Augmentation for Skeleton Generation
summary: Automatic skeleton generation involves predicting both joint positions and skeletal connectivity. However, existing approaches struggle to encode branch structures into token sequences and do not use test-time computation effectively. We study these choices within a unified autoregressive framework. First, we introduce branch-centric tokenization, a branch-aware representation that places structurally related elements next to each other and encodes connectivity directly in the sequence. Compared with standard BFS-style serialization, this representation yields more compact sequences. Second, we introduce view-augmented generation, a test-time augmentation procedure that applies axis-aligned rotations to the input mesh, maps all predictions back to a common frame, and selects the final skeleton based on mesh coverage and consistency among predictions from different views. Experiments show that our method achieves better skeleton prediction accuracy than state-of-the-art methods. In particular, our method reduces the CD-J2B error by 16.9% on the Articulation-XL2.0 dataset compared to the strongest directly comparable baseline, Auto-Connect. Qualitative results on in-the-wild meshes further demonstrate generalization across diverse inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动骨架生成的统一自回归框架，包含分支感知的分支中心化标记化方法和视图增强生成策略，在骨架预测精度上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自动骨架生成方法难以将分支结构有效编码为token序列，且未充分利用测试时的计算资源。这些限制导致骨架连接结构的预测精度受限。
AI.method: 1) 提出分支中心化标记化（branch-centric tokenization），一种分支感知的表征方式，将结构相关的元素相邻放置并直接将连通性编码进序列中，相比BFS式序列化产生更紧凑的序列；2) 提出视图增强生成（view-augmented generation），一种测试时增强方法，对输入网格施加轴向旋转，将各视图预测结果映射回统一坐标系，并基于网格覆盖率和视图间一致性选择最终骨架。
AI.result: 该方法在骨架预测精度上优于现有最先进方法。在Articulation-XL2.0数据集上，相比最强直接可比基线Auto-Connect，CD-J2B误差降低了16.9%。在真实世界网格上的定性结果进一步证明了其跨多样输入的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过分支感知的序列编码和测试时视图增强，该框架有效解决了骨架生成中分支结构编码和测试时计算利用两大问题，显著提升了骨架预测性能和泛化能力。

title: Line-Coupled Language Model
summary: Autoregressive language models generate one token per decoding step, limiting the useful output of each forward pass. Although diffusion models, insertion-based decoding, and multi-token prediction enable parallel generation, they either incur additional training-time token traffic or struggle to predict strongly dependent future tokens. We introduce the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM), an autoregressive model that advances multiple text lines together by predicting the next token for every active line while coupling the lines through shared causal context. LCLM interleaves line tokens into a single causal sequence and uses line-staggered rotary positions, retaining the standard next-token objective and causal attention. Controlled experiments show that cross-line targets are substantially less dependent than consecutive same-line targets, supporting lines as parallel generation units. With 881M parameters, LCLM produces an average of 2.94 content tokens per forward pass with a validation cross-entropy loss of 2.44, compared with 1.00 token per forward pass and a loss of 2.39 for the vanilla autoregressive baseline. Most notably, even when LCLM generates 16 tokens per forward pass, its loss is only 0.09 higher than that of the vanilla autoregressive baseline (2.34 vs. 2.25).

AI.tldr: 本文提出线耦合格言模型（LCLM），一种自回归模型，通过在共享因果上下文下同时预测多个文本行的下一个token来实现并行生成，在不增加训练开销的情况下大幅提升每次前向传播的token产出效率。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型每次解码仅生成一个token，限制了前向传播的产出效率。虽然已有扩散模型、插入式解码和多token预测等方法可实现并行生成，但它们要么增加额外的训练开销，要么难以预测强依赖性的未来token。
AI.method: LCLM将多个文本行交错排列成单一因果序列，使用行交错的旋转位置编码（line-staggered rotary positions），使每一行在推理时同时预测下一个token，同时各线共享因果上下文实现耦合。它保留了标准的next-token训练目标和因果注意力机制，不引入额外训练复杂性。
AI.result: 在881M参数的模型中，LCLM平均每次前向传播产生2.94个内容token，验证交叉熵损失为2.44，而vanilla自回归基线仅产出1.00 token/前向传播且损失为2.39。即使LCLM每次前向传播生成16个token，其损失也只比基线高0.09（2.34 vs 2.25）。
AI.conclusion: 跨行token之间的依赖性显著低于同行的连续token，验证了将"行"作为并行生成单元的合理性。LCLM在显著提升并行生成效率的同时，保持了接近vanilla自回归基线的生成质量，展示了以较低质量代价换取大幅吞吐量提升的潜力。

title: Spatial Attention Supervision for Defect Localization: Exploiting Ground-Truth Masks as Training Signal in Diffusion-Augmented Defect Detection
summary: Ground-truth defect masks in industrial inspection datasets are typically reserved for evaluation. This paper repurposes them as spatial supervision signals during training of classification networks, teaching a model not just what to predict but where to look. The method adds an activation-based attention alignment loss that steers convolutional feature maps toward defect regions, in a mixed-supervision formulation that also accommodates samples without masks, such as diffusion-generated images. Combined with DDPM augmentation, synthetic images contribute quantity while masks contribute spatial precision. We evaluate 85 models (four CNN backbones under a 2x2 data/training factorial over five seeds, plus a Swin-V2-T transformer baseline) on the MVTec-AD bottle benchmark, with localization measured on held-out defect images excluded from classifier gradient updates. Main findings: (1) attention-guided training improves activation-based localization (Pixel-AUROC) by +18.0% for EfficientNetB0 with augmentation (p=0.005, Cohen's d=2.6) and +18.7% for ResNet50 (p=0.008), significant in four of eight CNN settings (uncorrected for multiple comparisons) with no significant change in classification; (2) for EfficientNetB0 a data x training-mode interaction is significant (p=0.002), consistent with a super-additive effect (+13.6% combined vs +1.6% summed individual effects); (3) architectures with weaker spatial representations benefit most, whereas ConvNeXt-T shows no effect, apparently because its depthwise-convolution activations yield spatially uninformative channel-mean maps; (4) unsupervised PatchCore remains the strongest localizer (Pixel-AUROC=0.983), contextualizing the supervised gains. These results show that existing evaluation masks can act as practical training signals that measurably and reproducibly improve where defect classifiers attend.

AI.tldr: 本文重新利用工业检测数据集中原本仅用于评估的真实缺陷掩码，将其作为分类网络训练过程中的空间监督信号，通过激活注意力对齐损失引导卷积特征图关注缺陷区域，在MVTec-AD瓶数据集上评估85个模型后发现注意力引导训练可显著提升基于激活的定位性能（Pixel-AUROC最高提升+18.7%），且对分类性能无显著影响。
AI.motivation: 工业检测数据集中的真实缺陷掩码通常仅保留用于评估而未被利用，本文旨在挖掘这些掩码的训练价值，教会模型不仅预测什么而且关注哪里，从而在不损失分类性能的前提下提升缺陷定位能力。
AI.method: 提出激活注意力对齐损失，将卷积特征图引导至缺陷区域；采用混合监督框架支持无掩码样本（如扩散生成图像）；结合DDPM数据增强，合成图像提供数量、掩码提供空间精度；在2x2数据/训练因子设计下对四种CNN骨干网络（五个种子）及Swin-V2-T变体进行评估。
AI.result: 注意力引导训练使EfficientNetB0的Pixel-AUROC提升+18.0%（p=0.005），ResNet50提升+18.7%（p=0.008），在八个CNN设置中四个显著；发现数据×训练模式交互作用显著（p=0.002），两者结合呈超加性效应（+13.6% vs 单独效应之和+1.6%）；空间表征较弱的架构受益最大，而ConvNeXt-T因深度卷积激活产生空间信息不足的通道均值图而无效果；无监督PatchCore仍是最强定位器（Pixel-AUROC=0.983）。
AI.conclusion: 现有评估掩码可作为实用训练信号，可测量且可复现地改善缺陷分类器的注意力位置，为工业检测中掩码数据的再利用提供了新思路。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble for Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction
comment: Accepted at CCL 2026 (China National Conference on Computational Linguistics)
summary: This paper presents our system for CCL2026-Eval Task 5: Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction (MGBIE), which jointly extracts 12 entity types and 6 relation types from minor-grain breeding literature. We propose RAME (Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble), a training-free framework that elicits multiple LLM outputs under controlled diversity and aggregates them by majority voting to obtain high-confidence predictions. RAME combines (i) retrieval-augmented few-shot selection via a hybrid BM25-embedding retriever, (ii) a three-prompt ensemble (Strict, Relaxed, Balanced) spanning the precision to recall spectrum, and (iii) large-scale repeated sampling with majority voting to filter noisy predictions. Built on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, RAME achieves a Total Score of 0.499 (NER 0.730, RE 0.346) on the leaderboard, ranking 1st and surpassing the official Track-A baseline powered by GPT-5.5 (0.448), representing an 11.4% relative improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/king-wang123/CCL26-RAME.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAME框架，用于小作物育种信息抽取任务（MGBIE），无需训练即可联合抽取12种实体类型和6种关系类型。RAME结合检索增强的少样本选择、三提示集成和大规模重复采样投票，在CCL2026-Eval Task 5榜单上以0.499总分排名第一，超越GPT-5.5驱动的官方基线11.4%。
AI.motivation: 小作物育种文献中的信息抽取面临实体与关系类型多样、标注数据有限等挑战，现有方法依赖大量训练数据或单一提示策略，导致精度与召回难以兼顾，亟需一个无需额外训练即可提升抽取性能的框架。
AI.method: RAME框架包含三个核心组件：(i) 基于混合BM25与嵌入检索器的检索增强少样本选择；(ii) 覆盖精确率-召回率光谱的三提示集成（严格、宽松、平衡）；(iii) 大规模重复采样结合多数投票过滤低置信度预测。框架基于DeepSeek-V4-Flash实现，全程无需训练。
AI.result: RAME在CCL2026-Eval Task 5评测中取得总分0.499（NER 0.730，RE 0.346），排名第一，相比GPT-5.5驱动的官方Track-A基线（0.448）实现了11.4%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了在训练资源受限场景下，通过检索增强、多提示集成与投票机制能够有效激发大模型在专业领域信息抽取中的潜力，为育种信息抽取提供了低成本高性能的解决方案。

title: VDiff-Bench: A Challenging Benchmark for Fine-Grained Image Difference Identification
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) perform strongly on general visual understanding tasks such as visual question answering, yet they often struggle with a basic comparative skill: identifying what has changed between two similar images. We introduce VDiff-Bench, a challenging multiple-choice benchmark for fine-grained Image Difference Identification. VDiff-Bench contains 1,756 four-way questions over image pairs and covers 10 change categories: position, motion, regional image color, overall image color, appearance/disappearance, noise/resolution, texture, substitution/size, OCR/text, and illumination. Each question corresponds to two image inputs with 4 choices: the true difference, two hard negative descriptions, and a "no difference" distractor. To make the task challenging, we specifically curate ground-truth-conditioned negatives that require models to distinguish the actual change from nearby semantic alternatives. Experiments with 11 state-of-the-art open- and closed-source MLLMs show that fine-grained visual comparison remains brittle: models exhibit uneven performance across sources and change categories, with persistent failures on subtle low-level changes like noises and textures. For instance, three 7-8B-scale open-source MLLMs score 52.5-70.6% on semantic changes but only 8.7-33.3% on low-level changes like noise and texture, falsely assuming no changes between two image inputs. Surprisingly, despite strong performance of other closed-source commercial models, Grok 4.3 demonstrate remarkable performance drop on identifying noise and texture differences between images, falling significantly behind large open-source models like Kimi K2.5 and K3. Overall, VDiff-Bench provides a targeted diagnostic for evaluating comparative visual understanding in MLLMs, exposing failures that are not captured by standard single-image vision-language tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VDiff-Bench，一个针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）细粒度图像差异识别能力的挑战性基准，包含1,756个四选一问题和10类变化类别，实验表明现有MLLMs在低级视觉变化（如噪声、纹理）识别上表现脆弱。
AI.motivation: 虽然MLLMs在通用视觉理解任务上表现强劲，但它们在识别两张相似图像之间的细微变化这一基本比较能力上常常失败；现有标准视觉问答任务无法暴露这一缺陷，需要专门的诊断基准来评估模型的比较视觉理解能力。
AI.method: 构建VDiff-Bench基准：包含1,756个四选一问题，覆盖10类图像变化（位置、运动、区域颜色、整体颜色、出现/消失、噪声/分辨率、纹理、替换/大小、OCR/文本、光照）。关键是设计基于真实变化条件的高质量负样本，包含两个硬负例描述和一个"无差异"干扰选项，使任务具有挑战性。使用11个开源和闭源MLLMs进行评测。
AI.result: 实验发现MLLMs在细粒度视觉比较上表现不均匀：3个7-8B开源模型在语义变化上得52.5-70.6%，但在噪声和纹理等低级变化上仅得8.7-33.3%，经常错误地假设图像之间无差异。有趣的是，闭源模型Grok 4.3在噪声和纹理识别上表现大幅下降，落后于Kimi K2.5和K3等大型开源模型。
AI.conclusion: VDiff-Bench为评估MLLMs的比较视觉理解能力提供了针对性诊断工具，揭示了标准单图像视觉语言任务无法捕捉的失败模式，尤其暴露了模型在低级视觉变化识别上的系统性短板。

title: Vishing-Tactics-Bench: Forecasting Exploitation Trajectories in Voice Phishing Calls
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Voice phishing (vishing) unfolds in real time; by the time a call has ended and post-hoc classification is possible, the harm has already been done. The more actionable question is which concrete harm (Information Gathering or Financial Exploitation) an ongoing call is tactically progressing toward. We present Vishing-Tactics-Bench, a benchmark grounded in Endsley's situation-awareness (SA) framework that recasts vishing defense from after-the-fact fraud classification to harm projection: predicting at each turn whether the call will reach either terminal harm. We adapt MITRE ATT&CK to vishing as a 6-tactic taxonomy (Vishing-Tactics) and label 35,340 scammer utterances across 5,645 synthetic Chinese calls. We define Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting, a survival-style protocol over the two terminal harms with three metrics: AP@k, C-index, and divergence error. Baselines ranging from a Markov heuristic to fine-tuned LLMs show that the tactical trajectory serves as an interpretable representation of the call's tactical state, supporting harm-specific forecasting, which can then be used for the downstream application of intervention selection; a stratified lead-time analysis at a tight false-alarm budget further identifies at what point in a call the trajectory signal yields early warning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Vishing-Tactics-Bench基准，基于Endsley态势感知框架，将语音钓鱼（vishing）防御从事后欺诈分类转变为实时危害预测（信息收集或金融利用），并通过6战术分类法和生存式预测协议实现逐轮呼叫走向预测。
AI.motivation: 语音钓鱼是实时进行的，呼叫结束时再进行事后分类已经无法挽回损失。因此需要更可操作的问题：预测正在进行的通话正朝着哪种具体危害（信息收集或金融利用）推进，以便实时干预。
AI.method: 1) 基于Endsley态势感知框架构建基准；2) 将MITRE ATT&CK适配为语音钓鱼6战术分类法（Vishing-Tactics）；3) 标注5,645通合成中文电话中35,340条诈骗者话语；4) 定义剥削轨迹预测（Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting），采用生存分析风格协议，涵盖两种终局危害；5) 采用三个指标：AP@k、C-index和散度误差；6) 使用从马尔可夫启发式到微调LLM的基线方法。
AI.result: 基线实验表明，战术轨迹可作为通话战术状态的可解释表示，支持面向特定危害的预测，进而用于下游干预选择。分层提前期分析在严格误报预算下确定了轨迹信号在通话中何时能提供早期预警。
AI.conclusion: 通过将防御目标从分类转向危害投射，并在通话进行中逐轮预测终局危害，该方法为语音钓鱼的实时干预提供了可行框架与评测基准。

title: MobileVLA-R1 2.0: RL-Enhanced Reasoning for Mobile Robot Control
