AI.result: 效价比唤醒度表现出更强且更连贯的表征组织；跨数据集分析显示EMOIS与OASIS在情感组织上存在差异；回归分析在EMOIS内部实现高效价（R²=0.865）和唤醒度（R²=0.807）预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究有助于阐明建筑环境的情感表征，并将EMOIS建立为具有密集标注的资源，为未来建筑环境领域的情感计算研究提供支持。

title: What Eviction Destroys: A Restore-Counterfactual Audit of Forgetting in Agent Memory
summary: Agent memory systems must discard stored information when their history exceeds a fixed token budget. Existing budget-accuracy frontiers quantify the resulting loss in accuracy, but do not distinguish irreversible losses caused by eviction from recoverable retrieval failures. We introduce the restore counterfactual, a per-question paired intervention that reinstates the question's gold evidence in the read-time context and reruns the same reader. Combining the change in correctness with whether the evidence was retained after eviction classifies each oracle-answerable error as recoverable, irreversible, or residual; in the residual case, the answer remains incorrect after restoration. We evaluate FIFO, random, redundancy-aware, and LLM-importance eviction on LongMemEval-S at three budgets and under two retrieval regimes, using GPT-4o-mini as the primary reader and judge and GPT-5.4-mini as a robustness reader. Under top-k retrieval at an 80k-token budget, the irreversible share among errors corrected by restoration is 0.67-0.73 for FIFO, random, and redundancy-aware eviction, compared with 0.60 for LLM-importance. At 8k tokens, it reaches 1.00 for all four policies. Recoverable errors occur under top-k retrieval at 80k tokens but are absent under forced-gold injection by construction, so budget-accuracy results are not directly comparable unless the retrieval regime is reported. An exploratory matched-accuracy analysis detects no difference in irreversible rate among accuracy-matched policy pairs at a resolution of 1.2-6 percentage points. The same analysis detects the deliberately destructive control. To our knowledge, this is the first per-item, per-question restore-counterfactual audit of eviction for external agent-memory stores on a standard conversational benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"恢复反事实"（restore counterfactual）审计方法，通过配对干预检查外置代理记忆逐出策略导致的错误是可恢复的检索失败还是不可逆的信息丢失，并在LongMemEval-S基准上对FIFO、随机、冗余感知和LLM重要性四种逐出策略进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 现有预算-精度前沿只能量化逐出带来的精度损失，但无法区分哪些损失是由信息被不可逆地逐出造成的，哪些是由检索失败造成的（后者是可以恢复的）。这种区分对于设计和优化代理记忆系统至关重要。
AI.method: 引入"恢复反事实"：对每个问题施加配对干预，将问题的黄金证据重新注入到读取上下文并重新运行同一读取器。结合正确性变化与证据在逐出后是否被保留，将每个可被oracle回答的错误分类为可恢复、不可逆或残余错误。在LongMemEval-S上评估四种逐出策略（FIFO、随机、冗余感知、LLM重要性），分别在三个预算和两种检索机制下，以GPT-4o-mini为主要读取器和评判器，GPT-5.4-mini作为稳健性读取器。
AI.result: 在top-k检索、80k token预算下，由恢复纠正的错误中不可逆占比为0.67-0.73（FIFO、随机、冗余感知）vs 0.60（LLM重要性）；8k预算下四种策略均达1.00。可恢复错误仅在top-k检索、80k预算下出现，在强制黄金注入下按构造不存在。匹配精度分析在1.2-6个百分点的分辨率下未检测到精度匹配策略对之间的不可逆率差异，但能检测到人为破坏性对照组。
AI.conclusion: 本文是首个对外置代理记忆存储在标准对话基准上的逐出进行逐项、逐问题的恢复反事实审计的研究。研究表明预算-精度结果在不同检索机制下不可直接比较，且恢复反事实审计能够有效区分可恢复与不可逆的信息损失。

title: Novel Methods for Catheter and Guidewire Segmentation in X-ray Fluoroscopy under a Federated Learning Setting
comment: PhD Thesis, University of Liverpool. 163 pages
summary:
Endovascular procedures rely on real-time manipulation of thin instruments, catheters and guidewires, under X-ray fluoroscopy guidance, where accurate visual analysis is essential for procedural safety. Learning-based methods are constrained by structural complexity, data scarcity, and privacy regulations precluding centralised training across institutions. This thesis presents a structure-aware federated learning framework for catheter and guidewire analysis, with four contributions evaluated on real-animal and phantom data.
  A benchmark dataset, CathAction, is introduced for catheterisation analysis, with over 600,000 annotated frames and 40,000 segmentation masks. A shape-sensitive loss transforms masks into signed distance maps compared in a structural feature space, improving Dice coefficient by up to 2.9 points across five backbones.
  This is extended to federated learning with shape-sensitive loss, preserving geometric consistency under heterogeneous client data and outperforming federated averaging by up to three points in mean intersection-over-union as clients scale from four to eight. Federated learning with projected gradient descent adds adversarial optimisation, raising mean intersection-over-union by over ten points on real-animal data.
  Finally, a structure-aware diffusion framework synthesises catheter and guidewire video sequences, combining structural supervision with a domain-adaptive reconstruction objective, reducing Frechet video distance over a strong baseline while maintaining visual fidelity. Incorporating synthetic sequences into federated training raises the Dice score from 44 to 51 percent under data scarcity, with gains across four held-out sites.
  Together, these contributions advance privacy-preserving catheter and guidewire analysis, supporting collaborative training without centralising patient data or large amounts of manual annotation.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种结构感知的联邦学习框架，用于导管和导丝的内窥镜/血管内手术影像分析。论文涵盖四个贡献：引入包含60万帧标注的CathAction基准数据集、形状敏感损失函数提升分割精度、联邦学习结合投影梯度下降与对抗优化提升真实动物数据上的分割性能，以及结构感知扩散模型合成视频序列以缓解数据稀缺问题。整体在隐私保护前提下实现了跨机构协作训练。
AI.motivation: 血管内手术依赖于在X射线透视引导下对导管和导丝进行实时操控，准确的视觉分析对手术安全至关重要。然而，基于学习的方法受限于结构复杂性、数据稀缺，以及隐私法规禁止跨机构集中式训练等因素，难以有效发展与部署。
AI.method: 论文提出了一个包含多项技术创新的结构感知联邦学习框架：(1) 构建CathAction基准数据集，包含超过60万个标注帧和4万张分割掩膜；(2) 设计形状敏感损失函数，将分割掩膜转换为符号距离图并在结构特征空间中比较，使Dice系数提升最多2.9个百分点；(3) 将形状敏感损失扩展到联邦学习，通过投影梯度下降加入对抗优化，增强对异构客户端数据的适应性；(4) 提出结构感知扩散模型用于合成导管和导丝视频序列，结合结构监督与域自适应重建目标。
AI.result: 在五个骨干网络上Dice系数最高提升2.9个百分点；在客户端从4个扩展到8个时，联邦学习比联邦平均方法在平均交并比上最高提升3个百分点；投影梯度下降加对抗优化使真实动物数据的平均交并比提升超过10个百分点；扩散模型降低了视频弗雷歇距离且保持了视觉保真度；将合成序列纳入联邦训练后，在数据稀缺条件下Dice分数从44%提升至51%，在四个保留站点均有增益。
AI.conclusion: 这些贡献推动了隐私保护的导管和导丝分析，支持无需集中患者数据或大量人工标注的协作训练模式，为跨机构联邦学习在介入手术视觉分析中的应用奠定了坚实基础。

title: Tracing Stereotypes from Representation to Output in Multilingual LLMs
comment: 18 pages total (9 pages main text), 13 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
summary: Multilingual LLMs show stereotype-related behavior that varies across languages, but behavioral scores do not show where the relevant information is represented or how it affects the output. To investigate these internal mechanisms, we compare linear probing, attribution patching, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and feature ablation in Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-2-9B. Probe performance peaks substantially earlier than attribution in all three models, with a separation of 36-53% of model depth. Retained Llama-Scope features often match the social category on which they were selected and form recurring semantic families, but their lexical alignment and ablation effects vary across SAE suites. Only 6-18% of evaluated residual-stream features have language-agnostic effects under our criterion, and none are category-agnostic. Language-agnostic features have larger mean ablation effects in Llama-Scope, but this pattern does not repeat in the other SAE suites. Decodability, output influence, and cross-lingual ablation effects therefore need to be measured separately.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过线性探针、归因修补、稀疏自编码器和特征消融四种方法，在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-2-9B多语言模型中研究刻板印象相关行为的内在机制，发现探针性能峰值远比归因出现得更早，且多数特征不具备跨语言一致的效应。
AI.motivation: 多语言大语言模型在不同语言中表现出的刻板印象相关行为存在差异，但现有的行为层面评分无法揭示相关信息在大模型内部如何表征及如何影响输出，因此需要从机制层面深入理解。
AI.method: 在三个多语言模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-2-9B）上，综合运用线性探针、归因修补、稀疏自编码器（SAEs）和特征消融四种方法进行对照比较分析，并评估保留特征的语义家族、词汇对齐及消融效应。
AI.result: 探针性能峰值比归因早36-53%的模型深度；Llama-Scope保留特征通常与所选社会类别匹配并形成重复的语义家族；仅有6-18%的残差流特征在跨语言条件下具有语言无关效应，且没有任何特征是社会类别无关的；语言无关特征仅在Llama-Scope中具有更大的平均消融效应，该模式在其他SAE套件中未复现。
AI.conclusion: 可解码性、输出影响力和跨语言消融效应是需要独立测量的三个维度，不可互相替代；不同SAE套件的结果缺乏一致性，说明在多语言模型中研究刻板印象机制时需谨慎选择分析工具并分维度评估。

title: Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs, localizing targets from directional language remains challenging, even when observer grounding is made explicit. We find that explicit breakdowns of observer-relative spatial reasoning improve target localization. Our project page is available at https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了POVBench基准数据集，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）在具身任务中通过上下文线索推断说话者视角并理解情境化空间关系的能力（称"上下文观察者接地"）。实验发现最先进的VLMs在定向语言目标定位上仍具挑战，而显式的观察者相对空间推理分解能提升定位性能。
AI.motivation: 人类在具身任务（如机器人）中理解语言指令时，需要从说话者的情境视角推断空间关系，这依赖于共享环境知识、活动上下文和常识。虽然现有VLMs看似具备空间推理能力，但它们能否从上下文线索推断说话者视角并据此理解情境化空间关系尚不清楚，因此需要系统性研究这一能力。
AI.method: 1) 定义"上下文观察者接地"能力；2) 构建POVBench基准数据集，包含3D场景和查询，将观察者接地区分为推断型（Inferred）、陈述型（Stated）和给定型（Given）三类自然具身交流形式；3) 提供多视角观测和自然语言句子，要求模型从情境化空间和上下文线索定位未见或欠指定的目标；4) 在多种SOTA VLM上评估该任务。
AI.result: 跨最先进的VLMs，从定向语言中定位目标仍然具有挑战性，即使给出了显式的观察者接地信息。研究发现，将观察者相对空间推理进行显式分解可以改善目标定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLMs在具身场景中的情境化空间推理方面仍存在显著不足，但通过显式分解观察者相对空间推理的中间步骤，可以有效提升模型的定位能力，为未来改进具身语言理解指引了方向。

title: SentryLine: Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Evolving Documents in Oncology Care
summary: Oncology care operates at constant pressure of absorbing rapidly evolving evidence base in biomedicine. The American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) addresses this through living guidelines, but the format introduces a new burden: any recommendation can change at any point, across multiple versioned documents. We present SENTRYLINE, a living guideline-aware clinical question answering system. SENTRYLINE retrieves guideline passages through a vectorless hierarchical RAG pipeline and returns a role-specific answer with inline citations, factual and temporal verification reports, and drift detection notes that surface when a guideline has been updated. We construct ASCOBENCH, a benchmark of 405 three-turn conversations across four question categories with gold answers from expert annotators(clinicians), and use test set to evaluate SENTRYLINE against five baselines under an LLM-as-judge framework. Experiments across three generation backbones show consistent improvements over four retrieval baselines and ASCO's guideline assistant, with particularly strong gains on Reasoning and Role-Specific questions where multi-hop synthesis and register adaptation are required

AI.tldr: 本文提出SENTRYLINE，一个面向肿瘤学"活指南"的临床问答系统，通过无向量的分层RAG检索并结合角色化答案、引用、事实与时间验证及漂移检测，在405轮三回合对话基准ASCOBENCH上显著优于五个基线系统。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤学临床决策需不断吸收快速演变的生物医学证据。ASCO采用"活指南"（living guidelines）解决更新问题，但引入新负担：任何推荐内容可能随时变化，且分散在多个版本文件中，医生难以追踪最新且准确的指南信息。现有问答系统未充分处理指南的动态更新特性。
AI.method: 构建SENTRYLINE系统，核心包括：(1) 无向量分层RAG管道检索指南段落；(2) 返回角色特定答案，附内联引用、事实与时间验证报告；(3) 提供漂移检测注释以提示指南更新。同时构建ASCOBENCH基准（405个三回合对话、四类问题、临床专家标注金答案），采用LLM-as-judge框架在三种生成骨干模型下与五个基线对比评估。
AI.result: 在三个生成骨干模型上，SENTRYLINE始终优于四个检索基线和ASCO官方指南助手。尤其在需要多跳合成与语域适配的推理类和角色特定问题上提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: SENTRYLINE证明了"活指南"感知的问答架构能有效应对临床指南频繁更新的挑战，为精准肿瘤学临床决策支持提供了可靠的技术方案。

title: BEFORE THE FLIP: Measuring Hidden Score Shifts In Quantized Vision Language Models Before The Answer Changes for Visual Question Answering
summary: Quantization makes vision language models (VLMs) cheaper to store and run by using fewer bits to represent their weights. While unchanged answers on visual question answering (VQA) after compression are an expected behavior, they can still hide changes in the underlying scores (log probabilities). For example, a model may still answer yes after compression, even as the score gap between yes and no shrinks. We introduce BEFORE THE FLIP to measure these hidden changes. Our method compares the score change caused by compression with the change caused by replacing the image's internal representations, or image tokens, with one fixed average token. We then increase the precision of one weight group at a time to identify where extra bits help, and test whether choosing different groups for each question offers benefits beyond shuffled controls. Among 8,277 LLaVA questions where image token replacement measurably affects the scores, 4-bit compression shifts the yes or no score gap farther toward the replacement output than 8-bit compression. Qwen shows the same pattern, but with a smaller difference. Yet only 265 of 9,000 LLaVA answers change at 4 bits. In a separate study of 1,024 calibration questions, choosing weight groups separately for each question does not outperform both shuffled controls at any tested storage budget. These findings show that compression can alter the scores behind unchanged answers, but do not establish a reliable benefit from adjusting precision for each question.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"翻转之前"（BEFORE THE FLIP）方法，用于检测视觉语言模型（VLM）量化压缩后虽答案不变但底层得分已然改变的现象，并发现4-bit压缩比8-bit压缩更能使得分偏向图像token替换方向，但逐问题分配精度并无可靠收益。
AI.motivation: 量化压缩VLM虽降低成本，但仅关注VQA答案是否变化会掩盖底层得分（对数概率）的隐蔽改变。例如模型压缩后仍回答"yes"，但yes/no之间的得分差距可能已缩小。需要一种方法来揭示这种压缩对得分分布的隐蔽影响。
AI.method: 将压缩引起的得分变化，与用固定平均token替换图像内部表示所引起的得分变化进行对比；随后逐权重组提升精度以定位额外比特的作用，并检验对每个问题单独选择不同权重组是否比随机对照组更有优势。
AI.result: 在8277个LLaVA问题中（图像token替换可测地影响得分），4-bit压缩比8-bit压缩使yes/no得分差距更偏向替换输出方向；Qwen呈现相同趋势但差异更小。然而9000个LLaVA问题中仅265个答案在4-bit下发生改变。单独研究中，对1024个校准问题逐题选择权重组在任意存储预算下均未胜过两个随机对照组。
AI.conclusion: 压缩确实能在答案不变的表象下改变底层得分，但并未证实为每个问题单独调整精度能带来可靠的收益。这一发现提示评估量化模型时不能仅依赖最终答案的正确性。

title: Reading a Legal Question Word by Word: Embedding Trajectories of 2,144 Vietnamese Legal Headlines
summary: A dense retriever encodes a question as one vector, but the question arrives one word at a time. We read 2,144 held-out headlines from Thu Vien Phap Luat (Vietnamese legal library) word by word with Nemotron-3-Embed 8B/1B and Qwen3-Embedding 8B/0.6B, encoding 65,444 prefixes against 20,034 articles, plus every prefix of 3,438 sub-questions from 1,112 multi-question headlines and of 168 answers. (i) The gold article becomes rank 1 after a median of 6-7 content words in every encoder, before the interrogative frame is read, and stays there to the end in 78-85% of cases. (ii) In a multi-question headline the lock is inside the first sub-question 94-98% of the time; the second leaves rank unchanged in 89-95%; encoded alone, the second reaches rank 1 in 42-58% vs 91-96% for the first, at the same lock word (95-97% identical). (iii) Numbers, dates and instrument identifiers move the embedding twice as far as content words and four times as far as interrogative words; 72-78% of steps move toward the gold article, and the closing interrogative frame moves against that direction in 95-99% of headlines. (iv) Rank/cosine clustering yields six archetypes (instant, typical, unstable, late, never-locking) that differ by legal area and form (chi-squared p < 1e-8): real-estate and litigation headlines never lock on a number; environmental and accounting headlines do so a third of the time. (v) An answer read word by word retrieves its article after 8-16 words and addresses the sub-questions in order asked in 83-89% of cases. (vi) A word's step keeps a consistent direction across headlines (cosine 0.25-0.33; 0.44-0.60 for numbers); a preceding question rotates that step by about 60 degrees and a greeting by about 30 degrees; steps shrink as i^{-0.8}; and a two-question headline is within 12-17 degrees of a linear mix of its two questions. We call this a context-modulated additive walk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了稠密检索器在逐词编码越南语法律标题时的动态行为，发现检索器通常在6-7个内容词后即将目标文章锁定为第一名，并在多问题、数值词、问题框架等不同条件下表现出可预测的"上下文调制加法行走"模式。
AI.motivation: 传统稠密检索将问题编码为单一向量，但问题实际是逐词到达的。理解嵌入逐词演化的动态过程，有助于揭示检索器内部工作机制、预测检索稳定性，并改进增量式检索与对话系统中的查询理解。
AI.method: 使用Nemotron-3-Embed与Qwen3-Embedding系列模型（共4种规模），对越南法律图书馆的2,144条标题进行逐词前缀编码，涉及65,444个前缀对20,034篇文章的检索，同时对多问题标题的子问题前缀和答案前缀进行编码分析，并通过排名/余弦聚类、方向性统计等手段提取规律。
AI.result: 发现六大核心规律：①金标文章在中位数6-7个内容词后即达第一并保持；②多问题标题的锁定通常发生在第一个子问题内；③数值/日期/文书标识词对嵌入的推动是普通词的两倍、疑问词的四倍；④可聚类为六种锁定原型且与法律领域显著相关；⑤答案逐词读取可在8-16词内检索到对应文章；⑥单词步长跨标题保持方向一致性，上下文（前置问题、问候语）会旋转步长方向，步长以i^-0.8衰减。
AI.conclusion: 稠密检索器的嵌入演化呈现可预测的"上下文调制加法行走"结构：嵌入随内容词呈加性累积移动，上下文对其方向进行旋转调制。这一发现对理解稠密检索的稳定性、多意图查询处理及增量检索应用具有理论价值。

title: Emo-DVS: A Multimodal Benchmark for Privacy-Aware Emotion Recognition with Event Cameras
summary: Emotion analysis is a fundamental task in computer vision, but its practical deployment remains constrained by the privacy risks inherent to conventional RGB cameras. Bio-inspired event cameras present a promising hardware-level solution because they capture asynchronous brightness changes, thereby reducing exposure of facial identity details while leveraging high dynamic range for robust perception under challenging illumination conditions. Despite these advantages, existing event-based methods struggle in complex real-world settings due to limited dataset scales, simple acquisition conditions, and reliance on single-modality visual cues. To address these, we establish a challenging tri-modal benchmark with event, audio, and text modalities and propose the Information-Guided Gated Fusion (IGF) framework, which first pre-trains an event encoder on the FAU subset of Emo-DVS to capture fine-grained facial dynamics, then employs adaptive modality gating to suppress modality-specific noise, and finally leverages mutual information maximization to align robust cross-modal representations. To alleviate data scarcity, we introduce Emo-DVS, the first large-scale event-based emotion analysis dataset, which couples dynamic illumination with the Facial Action Unit (FAU) subset and emotion subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IGF achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IGF框架和首个大规模事件相机情感分析数据集Emo-DVS，通过三模态（事件、音频、文本）融合、门控去噪和互信息最大化对齐，实现情感分析任务的最优性能，同时利用事件相机天然规避传统RGB相机的隐私风险。
AI.motivation: 传统RGB相机在情感分析中存在隐私泄露风险，现有事件相机方法受限于数据集规模小、采集条件简单且仅依赖单一视觉模态，难以应对复杂真实场景，亟需更鲁棒的多模态解决方案。
AI.method: 提出三模态基准（事件、音频、文本）和IGF框架：先在Emo-DVS的FAU子集上预训练事件编码器捕捉细粒度面部动态，再通过自适应模态门控抑制各模态噪声，最后利用互信息最大化对齐跨模态表征；同时构建首个大规模事件情感分析数据集Emo-DVS，覆盖动态光照条件并包含FAU与情绪子集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明IGF在情感分析任务上取得了最先进的性能，验证了三模态融合框架的有效性和事件相机在大规模场景下的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机结合多模态信息融合是解决隐私保护和复杂环境情感分析的有效途径，所提出的数据集与框架为事件驱动的情感感知研究提供了新基础。

title: Structural Jailbreaks Generalize but Do Not Compound: A cross-provider and multilingual study of Involuntary In-Context Learning
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Pilot study. Includes a cross-family judge-agreement check (kappa=0.86) and output-language verification
summary: Aligned language models fail under two independent pressures: the structural jailbreak class recently formalized as Involuntary In-Context Learning (IICL), which reframes a harmful request as the final missing cell of a data-labeling task completed by pattern rather than judged as content; and the erosion of safety alignment outside English. A natural hypothesis is that these compound. We test it directly. Using a deterministic IICL operator and a StrongREJECT-style rubric judge, we red-team two Google Gemini models on two benchmarks, a 30 general-harm behaviours from HarmBench and 30 financial-abuse behaviours from FinProof, each under a single-shot baseline and under IICL in four languages (English, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic). First, IICL generalizes to a second provider and is worse in finance: it lifts attack success from <=6.7% to 80-90% on HarmBench and 97-100% on FinProof, an order of magnitude above the <=24% its introducing study reported on OpenAI's GPT-5.4. Second, against the hypothesis, forcing the IICL output into a non-English language does not stack the two weaknesses, it attenuates the attack. Eleven of twelve non-English conditions score below their English baseline (sign test, p~0.003), the lone exception a ceiling tie near 100%; on the stronger model's financial set Arabic collapses from 100% to 33%. We attribute this to a relevance curse: once structure has unlocked compliance, the models produce lower-quality harmful content in lower-resource languages, which a substance-grading judge scores as partial. The pattern replicates under an independent non-Google judge (Cohen's kappa=0.86, 377 paired verdicts), and 76.6% of non-English responses were verified in-language. Jailbreak vulnerabilities are therefore not additive; the dominant residual risk is the English structural attack, most acute for financial abuse, not a multilingual one.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了一个假设：结构型越狱（IICL类，将有害请求伪装成数据标注任务）与多语言安全对齐薄弱是否叠加。结果发现两者不可叠加——IICL在非英语条件下反而减弱攻击效果，主导残余风险是英语结构型攻击，尤其在金融滥用场景中最严重。
AI.motivation: 语言模型面对两类独立压力：一类是结构型越狱（IICL，将有害请求重构为数据标注任务，利用模式匹配而非内容判断触发响应），另一类是安全对齐在非英语环境下的退化。一个自然的猜想是这两种弱点会叠加放大，但缺乏直接验证。作者旨在直接检验这一假设。
AI.method: 使用确定性IICL操作符和StrongREJECT风格评分裁判，对两个Google Gemini模型进行红队测试。使用两个基准（HarmBench的30个一般危害行为和FinProof的30个金融滥用行为），在单次基线条件下和四种语言（英/西/印地/阿拉伯）的IICL条件下进行测试。采用符号检验（sign test）和Cohen's kappa评估一致性。
AI.result: （1）IICL成功泛化到第二个提供商（Google），在金融场景中效果更差：HarmBench攻击成功率从≤6.7%提升至80-90%，FinProof达到97-100%，远超原始研究中GPT-5.4的≤24%。（2）与非英语叠加不强化攻击，反而削弱：12个非英语条件中有11个低于英语基线（p≈0.003），最强模型金融场景中阿拉伯语从100%降至33%。（3）独立模型裁判验证（kappa=0.86），76.6%的非英语响应经确认为同语言产出。归因于"相关性诅咒"：结构解锁合规后，低资源语言中模型产生的内容质量更差，被基于内容的评分器判定为部分合规。
AI.conclusion: 越狱漏洞并非简单叠加；主导残余风险是英语结构型攻击（对金融滥用最为致命），而非多语言攻击。这意味着安全防御应优先针对结构型越狱的英语场景加强，而非分散资源于多语言对齐强化。

title: Sub-Pixel Affine Registration of Space Debris Images via the Radon Point Spread Function
summary: Inter-frame affine misalignment caused by platform jitter and attitude adjustments poses a fundamental challenge for multi-frame analysis of point targets in optical surveillance. Conventional registration methods rely on spatial intensity correlations or distinctive image features, both of which are largely absent in low-signal-to-noise-ratio point target imagery. We introduce the Radon Point Spread Function (RPSF) to characterize point targets in the Radon-transformed domain, and derive a closed-form framework that jointly estimates inter-frame translation and rotation from as few as four scalar RPSF samples per frame pair. The method requires no iterative optimization, feature extraction or interpolation, which is suitable for resource-constrained onboard processing. Simulation results confirm sub-pixel translation accuracy and a mean rotation error of 0.2556° at 1° Radon angular resolution. Validation on five real space debris datasets including both ground-based and in-orbit observations yields a mean calibration error below 0.5 pixels, substantially exceeding the precision required for reliable multi-frame processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Radon点扩散函数（RPSF）的闭合形式框架，用于解决低信噪比点目标图像中由平台抖动引起的帧间仿射错位问题，仅需每帧对4个标量RPSF样本即可联合估计平移和旋转，无需迭代优化、特征提取或插值，适用于资源受限的星上处理场景。
AI.motivation: 在光学监视中，平台抖动和姿态调整导致的帧间仿射错位是多帧点目标分析的根本性挑战。传统配准方法依赖空间强度相关性或显著图像特征，但在低信噪比点目标图像中这些信息基本缺失，亟需一种无需特征和迭代优化的高效配准方法。
AI.method: 引入Radon点扩散函数（RPSF）在Radon变换域中表征点目标，推导出闭合形式的框架以联合估计帧间平移和旋转，每帧对仅需4个标量RPSF样本即可完成估计。
AI.result: 仿真结果确认亚像素平移精度，在1°Radon角分辨率下平均旋转误差为0.2556°。在五个真实空间碎片数据集（含地基和天基观测）上验证，平均标定误差低于0.5像素，远超多帧处理所需的精度要求。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需迭代优化、特征提取或插值，计算效率高，适合资源受限的星上处理；在真实空间碎片观测数据上展现出优异的配准精度，优于传统方法的适用场景。

title: Compositional Multilingual and Behavioral Attribute Steering
summary: This study examines the compositionality of steering vectors for language and behavioral control in large language models. Focusing on language, jailbreak, and conciseness, we investigate whether additive, training-free composition of attribute steering vectors can preserve the intended steering effect of each attribute, across four instruction-tuned models from two model families and two size scales. We find that single-attribute steering is reliable for all three attributes, but only within an appropriate combination of intervention layer and steering strength, with abstract behaviors (jailbreak, conciseness) favoring middle layers and language favoring earlier layers. We show that additive composition of two attribute vectors succeeds in steering both attributes simultaneously when each is injected at its own best-performing layer, and that this partially extends to three simultaneously composed attributes, addressing an inconsistency left open by prior work on training-free composition. We further analyze the geometric properties of these steering vectors, finding that they are approximately orthogonal in the residual stream, consistent with their compositional behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了大语言模型中用于语言和行为控制的引导向量的组合性。通过在两个模型家族、两类尺寸的四个指令微调模型上，对语言、越狱和简洁性三种属性进行单属性及多属性引导向量组合实验，发现单属性引导在合适的干预层和强度下可靠有效，语言属性偏好浅层、抽象行为偏好中层；两个向量在各自最优层叠加可同时生效，部分扩展到三个属性。
AI.motivation: 先前关于训练无关（training-free）的引导向量组合工作存在不一致的问题，本研究旨在系统性地解决该不一致，探究多属性引导向量的加法组合能否同时保持各属性的引导效果。
AI.method: 在四种指令微调模型（两个模型家族×两个尺寸）上，分别针对语言、越狱、简洁性三种属性生成单一引导向量，系统评估不同干预层和引导强度的效果；随后测试在各自最优层进行加法组合注入来同时控制多个属性的效果，并分析引导向量在残差流中的几何特性（如正交性）。
AI.result: 单属性引导在适当的干预层和强度组合下对三种属性均可靠有效，其中抽象行为（越狱、简洁性）偏好中层干预，语言偏好浅层；两个属性的引导向量在各自最优层通过加法组合可同时有效引导，部分扩展到三个属性；引导向量在残差流中近似正交，与其组合稳定的行为一致。
AI.conclusion: 本研究填补了训练无关组合引导研究中的空白，表明在适当的分层干预策略下，属性引导向量可以组合使用以同时控制多个属性，其几何近似正交性为这种可组合性提供了理论解释。

title: CARDEA: Auditable Reasoning Grounded in Spatial Evidence for End-to-End Coronary Angiography Interpretation
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures and 4 tables in the main text; supplementary appendix with 5 figures and 1 table. Model weights: https://huggingface.co/benbayibaurba/cardea-v0. Code: https://github.com/benbayibaurba/cardea
summary: Invasive coronary angiography (CAG) is the gold standard for diagnosing coronary artery disease, but interpretation varies substantially among observers. Existing AI systems can improve consistency but lack auditable decision processes and are limited in comprehensive open-ended assessment, undermining clinician trust and clinical adoption readiness. We developed CARDEA, a unified large vision-language model that serves as the inference core of a CAG pipeline. It was trained solely on public datasets and closed-ended tasks in three stages: visual feature alignment, a self-distilled Chain-of-Box (CoB) cold start, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) with a CoB reward encouraging bounding-box use in the reasoning trace. We assessed its two study-level diagnoses, dominance classification and complexity assessment, against a dedicated classifier and two interventional cardiologists. Report generation was excluded from training and evaluated zero-shot across stages on an external cohort using vessel-severity macro-$F_1$. CARDEA trailed the classifier on in-distribution dominance but drew level under domain shift (accuracy, 0.91 [95% confidence interval (CI), 0.86 to 0.95]) and was comparable to the cardiologists on complexity assessment (accuracy, 0.90 [CI, 0.82 to 0.97]). Only RLVR improved zero-shot report generation, raising its vessel-severity macro-$F_1$ (0.686 [CI, 0.664 to 0.707]) above the untuned base model (0.513) and over twice the always-normal floor (0.312). CARDEA runs an end-to-end CAG pipeline from raw multi-view videos through keyframe selection to study-level diagnosis while exposing auditable spatial evidence behind its conclusions. RLVR on verifiable closed-ended tasks surfaced open-ended reporting ability that supervised imitation did not. Clinical use requires prospective validation against expert cardiologists.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARDEA，一个统一的大视觉语言模型，作为冠状动脉造影（CAG）分析管线的推理核心。通过三阶段训练（视觉特征对齐、自蒸馏Chain-of-Box冷启动、带可验证奖励的强化学习），在仅使用公开数据的情况下，实现研究级诊断、优势分类与复杂性评估，并通过RLVR显著提升零样本报告生成能力，同时提供可审计的空间证据。
AI.motivation: 侵入性冠状动脉造影是诊断冠心病的金标准，但观察者间判读差异大。现有AI系统虽能提高一致性，但缺乏可审计的决策过程，且无法进行全面的开放式评估，削弱了临床医生的信任并阻碍临床采纳。
AI.method: 构建统一的大视觉语言模型CARDEA作为CAG管线推理核心，仅用公开数据集训练，采用三阶段策略：1）视觉特征对齐；2）自蒸馏Chain-of-Box冷启动；3）带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），其中CoB奖励鼓励推理轨迹中使用边界框。报告生成排除在训练之外，用于零样本评估。
AI.result: CARDEA在域内优势分类上略逊于专用分类器，但在域偏移下追平（准确率0.91）；复杂度评估与介入心脏病专家相当（准确率0.90）。只有RLVR提升了零样本报告生成能力，将血管-严重度宏F1从0.513提升至0.686，远超基线（0.312）。
AI.conclusion: CARDEA实现从原始多视角视频到研究级诊断的端到端CAG管线，并提供可审计的空间证据。可验证的封闭式任务上使用RLVR能够涌现出监督模仿无法实现的开放式报告能力。临床应用仍需前瞻性验证。

title: Detecting Authorship in Political Texts with Inductive Stylometry
comment: 34 pages, 17 figures, 3 tables. Includes appendices A-D (validation materials and discriminant validity checks). Under review
summary: Political texts are rarely authored by the nominal speaker alone. Tweets, speeches, reports, and official statements are drafted, edited, or harmonized by staff, yet political science has paid limited attention to the stylistic traces these hidden authors leave behind. This paper develops and stress-tests an inductive stylometric approach for recovering latent authorship structure in political communication, combining character 3-gram features with UMAP dimensionality reduction, and Burrows' Delta. We apply the approach to six corpora that vary in length (from tweets to long documents), in mode (written and oral), and in language (English and Hungarian). The approach recovers near-disjoint analyst fingerprints in formal legal prose in both languages, sorts a politician's tweets into validated subsets while uncovering additional insights, and distinguishes scripted from improvised speech. It fails, however, to resolve individual speechwriters within scripted corpora. Frequency-based stylometry is thus a powerful tool that, depending on authorial signal strength and institutional editing, can uncover authorship traces relevant to legislative studies, political communication, and policy research.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并压力测试了一种归纳式文体计量学方法，通过字符3-gram特征、UMAP降维与Burrows' Delta的组合，在六种跨语言、跨体裁的政治语料中恢复隐藏作者结构。该方法在正式法律文本中能清晰识别分析师指纹，能对政治人物推文进行分类并发现额外洞见，也能区分照稿演讲与即兴发言，但无法在照稿语料中区分个体撰稿人。
AI.motivation: 政治文本很少由名义发言人独立撰写，推文、演讲、报告和官方声明往往由工作人员起草、编辑或润色，但政治科学对这些隐藏作者留下的文体痕迹关注有限。
AI.method: 采用归纳式文体计量学方法，结合字符3-gram特征、UMAP降维和Burrows' Delta距离度量，应用于六个语料库，涵盖推特到长文档的不同长度、书面与口头的不同模式以及英语和匈牙利语两种语言。
AI.result: 该方法在两种语言的正式法律文本中恢复了近乎分离的分析师指纹，能对政治人物的推文进行分类并揭示额外洞见，还能区分照稿演讲与即兴发言；但在照稿语料中无法解决个体撰稿人的区分问题。
AI.conclusion: 基于频率的文体计量学是一种强大工具，取决于作者信号强度与制度性编辑程度，能够揭示对立法研究、政治传播和政策研究具有相关价值的作者痕迹。

title: PRG-Fusion: Orchestrating Generative Priors with Reconstruction Evidence for Driving View Synthesis
summary: Synthesizing photorealistic driving videos along specified trajectories is essential for scalable closed-loop simulation. Reconstruction-based methods leverage neural rendering to synthesize geometrically consistent views, but often exhibit diverse artifacts and missing content when the viewpoint deviates from the training trajectory. In contrast, generative models can synthesize realistic views along arbitrary trajectories from vehicle sensor data, yet often struggle to maintain temporal and geometric consistency across frames. To combine the strengths of both, we propose PRG-Fusion, a framework for driving view synthesis that uses reconstruction evidence to orchestrate generative priors across regions. Specifically, we extract region-wise degradation evidence from reconstructed driving scenes and convert it into Preserve, Repair, and Generate (PRG) labels. At inference, these labels serve as a unified routing policy for region-aware spatiotemporal synthesis, orchestrating 3DGS appearance preservation, LiDAR-guided structural correction, and video-prior-driven content completion across Preserve, Repair, and Generate regions, respectively. We then follow a two-stage training paradigm, first establish geometric control from sparse LiDAR projections and subsequently learning appearance control from dense 3DGS renderings. Extensive experiments on Waymo demonstrate that PRG-Fusion achieves state-of-the-art overall performance in novel trajectory video synthesis, with superior visual quality and geometric fidelity while maintaining competitive view consistency under large trajectory shifts.

AI.tldr: PRG-Fusion是一个用于驾驶场景视图合成的框架，通过重建证据来编排生成先验，将驾驶场景划分为Preserve（保留）、Repair（修复）和Generate（生成）三个区域，分别采用3DGS外观保留、LiDAR引导的结构修正和视频先验驱动的补全策略，实现沿任意轨迹的高质量逼真视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的重建方法（如神经渲染）在视角偏离训练轨迹时会产生伪影和内容缺失，而生成模型虽然能合成任意轨迹的真实视图，但难以保持跨帧的时间和几何一致性。两者各有缺陷，缺乏一个能结合二者优势的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 从重建的驾驶场景中提取区域级退化证据，并将其转化为Preserve、Repair、Generate（PRG）标签；2) 在推理时将PRG标签作为统一的区域感知时空合成路由策略，分别编排3DGS外观保留、LiDAR引导结构修正和视频先验驱动的补全；3) 采用两阶段训练范式：先通过稀疏LiDAR投影建立几何控制，再通过学习密集3DGS渲染的外观控制。
AI.result: 在Waymo数据集上的大量实验表明，PRG-Fusion在新轨迹视频合成任务中达到了最先进的整体性能，在大型轨迹偏移下具有优越的视觉质量和几何保真度，同时保持了竞争力的视角一致性。
AI.conclusion: PRG-Fusion通过区域感知的重建与生成融合策略，有效解决了重建方法和纯生成方法各自的局限性，为可扩展的闭环仿真的逼真驾驶视频合成提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: Do Reviewers Still Reward Lexical Complexity? A Frozen-Rater Study of Preference Drift in 124K ICLR Reviews
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Code and the machine-readable records behind every number: https://github.com/Biajin-PKU/frozen-rater-drift
summary: Large language models have collapsed the cost of producing lexically elaborate prose, and whether peer reviewers still reward it is a question about the evaluator, not about the text. When the association between a writing cue and review scores moves across years, the reviewers may have changed, the submissions may have changed, or both, and a regression of scores on text cannot say which. We separate the two with a frozen rater: 81,850 machine reviews of ICLR submissions from 2018 to 2025, all generated in one February-April 2025 window with one model family and one prompt, so that its year-to-year coefficients track submission composition alone and the human-minus-frozen trend difference identifies reviewer preference drift. On 32,638 submissions with 124,615 human reviews, the human coefficient on non-domain lexical complexity falls from +0.142 to -0.015 while the frozen rater moves from +0.080 to +0.082; the three-way difference-in-differences is -0.0100 (q=0.013), and forty random-wordlist placebos through the same specification centre on zero. Humans still reward sentence-length variability, which the frozen rater never registers, while the frozen rater still pays for lexical complexity at its earlier rate. Every claim is held to a double gate of false-discovery control and interval exclusion, and the findings that failed adversarial re-testing are reported. Reviewers discounted a cue whose production cost collapsed, as models of manipulable signals prescribe; an LLM judge calibrated to historical human preferences inherits the earlier schedule and drifts out of alignment while its agreement with humans on totals stays ordinary.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用"冻结评分者"方法（2025年同一时间窗口内用同一模型和提示词对2018-2025年ICLR投稿生成81,850条机器评审），将投稿构成变化与评审者偏好漂移分离。发现人类评审对非领域词汇复杂度的系数从+0.142降至-0.015，而冻结评分者保持在+0.080至+0.082，三重差分显示显著差异（-0.0100, q=0.013），表明评审者确实因语言生产成本崩塌而降低了对华丽文风的奖励。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型大幅降低了生成词藻华丽文本的成本，评审者是否仍然奖励此类写作是一个关于评审者而非文本的问题。由于写作线索与评分之间的关联随时间变化既可能是评审者变了，也可能是投稿变了，传统回归无法区分两者，因此需要新方法分离这两种效应。
AI.method: 采用"冻结评分者"设计：在2025年2-4月的单一时间窗口内，用同一模型家族和同一提示词对2018-2025年的32,638篇ICLR投稿生成81,850条机器评审。由于冻结评分者固定不变，其逐年系数变化仅反映投稿构成变化；人类评分与冻结评审的差异变化则识别评审者偏好漂移。使用三重差分分析和40个随机词表安慰剂检验，并经过错误发现率控制和区间排除双重门控，报告未通过对抗性重测的发现。
AI.result: 在124,615条人类评审中，人类对非领域词汇复杂度的系数从+0.142下降到-0.015，而冻结评分者仅从+0.080微变至+0.082，三重差分显著（-0.0100, q=0.013），40个安慰剂检验集中在零附近。人类仍奖励句子长度变异性（冻结评分者从未体现这一点），而冻结评分者仍以早期速率奖励词汇复杂度。校准到历史人类偏好的LLM评审者继承了早期偏好时间表，随时间推移与人类评审出现偏差，但其与人类在总分上的一致性仍属普通水平。
AI.conclusion: 评审者确实对生产成本崩塌的写作线索（词汇复杂度）降低了评价权重，这与可操纵信号的理论模型预测一致。随着人类偏好漂移，基于历史偏好校准的LLM评审者会逐渐失准，这警示了使用静态LLM评审系统的局限性。

title: Joint-Conditioned Stereo Surface Reasoning for Interaction Field Estimation
summary: Predicting hand--object interaction fields requires locating the nearest object-surface point for each hand joint, often from small and partially occluded image regions. We view this task as joint-conditioned surface-endpoint estimation: each joint has its own nearest endpoint, while endpoints from the same hand can draw on shared local surface evidence. This structure motivates Joint-Conditioned Stereo Surface Reasoning (JSSR). A temporal-stereo network jointly predicts 3D joints, a direct interaction field, and per-view endpoint evidence. Calibrated candidate search evaluates endpoint hypotheses using joint-specific image compatibility and cross-view correspondence. A hand-shared candidate support lets joints draw on common surface evidence, and a learned residual gate controls the geometric correction when observations are ambiguous. Our system built on this method ranked third on the SHOW3D Interaction Field Challenge leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JSSR方法，将手物交互场预测建模为关节条件下的表面端点估计任务，通过时间立体网络联合预测3D关节、交互场和逐视图端点证据，在SHOW3D交互场挑战赛中排名第三。
AI.motivation: 手物交互场预测需要为每个手部关节定位最近的物体表面点，但这些点往往来自小而部分遮挡的图像区域，预测难度大。作者将任务重新定义为关节条件下的表面端点估计，以利用同一只手的端点可共享局部表面证据这一结构特性。
AI.method: 提出Joint-Conditioned Stereo Surface Reasoning (JSSR)方法：采用时间立体网络联合预测3D关节、直接交互场和逐视图端点证据；通过校准候选搜索评估端点假设，结合关节特定的图像兼容性和跨视角对应；利用手部共享的候选支持使关节能够共用表面证据，并通过学习的残差门控在观测模糊时控制几何修正。
AI.result: 基于该方法构建的系统在SHOW3D交互场挑战赛排行榜上获得第三名。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了关节条件表面端点估计这一视角的有效性，以及跨视角一致性和手部共享证据在手物交互场预测中的价值。

title: Same Values, Different Languages? From Multilingual Probing to Steering LLMs Toward Chinese Social Values
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into human society, aligning them with pluralistic social values has become a critical priority. However, whether LLMs exhibit consistent value preferences across languages remains underexplored, particularly for culturally grounded values, which are more abstract and difficult to evaluate and align than safety-centric principles. We investigate this issue through Chinese Social Values (CSV), a value system rooted in Chinese culture and comprising $12$ dimensions across national, societal, and personal levels. We construct C-Voices, the first comprehensive multilingual contrastive probe dataset for CSV, with 86,400 dilemma-based instances in six languages, each pairing a CSV-aligned action with a value-conflicting alternative. Building on the contrastive probes of C-Voices, we then propose a fine-tuning-free value vector steering method that derives value directions from hidden-state discrepancies and selectively intervenes on value-sensitive layers during inference. Experiments on six languages show that CSV-oriented preferences are model-dependent and language-sensitive, with the same dilemma eliciting divergent responses across languages. Our method achieves effective CSV steering, supports cross-lingual transfer of value vectors, and generalizes to existing FLAMES and ValuePrism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在多语言环境下是否表现出一致的文化价值偏好，构建了基于中国社会价值观（CSV）的首个多语言对比探针数据集C-Voices（含86,400个困境实例、6种语言），并提出一种无需微调的价值向量引导方法，通过在隐藏状态差异中提取价值方向并对价值敏感层进行选择性干预，实验表明CSV导向偏好具有模型依赖性和语言敏感性，所提方法能有效实现跨语言价值引导。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM深度融入人类社会，使其与多元社会价值观对齐至关重要。然而，LLM在不同语言间是否表现出一致的价值偏好尚未得到充分探索，尤其是具有文化根基的价值观，这类价值观比安全导向原则更抽象、更难评估和对齐。
AI.method: 首先构建C-Voices数据集，基于中国社会价值观（CSV）的12个维度（涵盖国家、社会、个人层面），生成86,400个多语言困境对比实例。然后提出一种无需微调的价值向量引导方法，从隐藏状态差异中推导价值方向，并在推理过程中选择性地对价值敏感层进行干预。
AI.result: 在六种语言上的实验表明：CSV导向的偏好具有模型依赖性和语言敏感性，同一困境在不同语言下会引发不同的响应；所提出的方法能有效实现CSV价值引导，支持价值向量的跨语言迁移，并能泛化到已有的FLAMES和ValuePrism基准上。
AI.conclusion: LLM的价值偏好存在显著的语言间不一致性，文化价值对齐需要跨语言视角；提出的价值向量引导方法无需微调即可有效实现文化价值观的引导与跨语言迁移，为多元文化价值观对齐提供了可行方案。

title: MSSP: Multi-Scale Spatially-Constrained Partition for Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation of 3D Point Clouds
comment: Accepted by the International Conference on Image and Graphics (ICIG 2025), Springer LNCS
summary: 3D point cloud semantic segmentation is essential for real-world spatial understanding, yet the prohibitive cost of human annotations motivates unsupervised approaches that require no labels. Existing superpoint-based methods typically rely on spectral analysis at a fixed granularity, failing to capture the hierarchical semantic structures inherent in complex indoor scenes. To bridge this gap, we present a Multi-Scale Spatially-Constrained Partition (MSSP) framework that combines multi-scale spectral analysis with spatially-constrained clustering. Multi-scale spectral analysis constructs enriched superpoint descriptors across multiple clustering granularities; however, the resulting high-dimensional feature space calls for a structural prior to translate into cleaner segmentation. Spatially-constrained clustering supplies this prior by restricting superpoint merging to physically adjacent regions, imposing the spatial coherence needed for multi-scale features to be effective. Extensive experiments on S3DIS and ScanNet show that MSSP achieves the best mIoU among unsupervised methods on the main benchmarks, with particularly significant gains on S3DIS. Notably, our ablation reveals a regularize-then-enrich interaction: multi-scale features alone do not improve final segmentation, yet become highly effective when coupled with spatial regularization, underscoring that spatial coherence is aprerequisite for multi-scale representations in superpoint clustering.

AI.tldr: 提出MSSP框架，结合多尺度谱分析与空间约束聚类，实现无监督3D点云语义分割，在S3DIS和ScanNet上达到最优mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有基于超点的方法通常依赖固定粒度的谱分析，无法捕捉复杂室内场景中的层次化语义结构，且人工标注成本高昂。
AI.method: 采用多尺度谱分析构建跨多个聚类粒度的丰富超点描述子，并通过空间约束聚类将超点合并限制在物理相邻区域，引入空间一致性先验以提升多尺度特征的有效性。
AI.result: 在S3DIS和ScanNet上，MSSP在无监督方法中取得最优mIoU，尤其在S3DIS上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验揭示了"先正则化再丰富"的相互作用：多尺度特征单独使用无法改善分割，但与空间正则化结合后效果显著，表明空间一致性是多尺度超点聚类表示的前提条件。

title: CreaMem: A Scene-Aware Memory Architecture for Personalized Agents
summary: Long-term memory is a core capability for personalized LLM agents. To support it, existing memory systems organize information using various criteria such as topic segments or summary hierarchies. However, we identify two major limitations in these designs. First, they lack scene awareness: memories from unrelated life scenes share the same retrieval space, which inflates the search space and introduces cross-scene interference. Second, they encode each memory from a single perspective, making it difficult to retrieve complementary views of the same event. In this paper, we propose the CreaMem architecture, which enables scene-aware memory organization by partitioning memory into several Life Scene Memories to reduce cross-scene interference at retrieval. To go beyond the single perspective and achieve cross-memory synergy, entries are dual-coded from both episodic and trait-based perspectives within each memory. We further devise a permemory balanced sampling strategy at retrieval time. Extensive experiments on two long-term memory benchmarks show that CreaMem improves QA accuracy across all evaluation metrics, with particularly large gains on multi-hop reasoning performance, validating scene-aware partitioning and cross-memory synergy. To enhance reproducibility, we release our code in a public GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CreaMem架构，通过将长期记忆按生活场景分区以减少检索时的跨场景干扰，并在每个场景记忆内从情节和特质双视角编码记忆以实现跨记忆协同，同时设计了按记忆平衡的采样策略。在两个长期记忆基准上，CreaMem在所有评估指标上提升了QA准确率，尤其是在多跳推理任务上增益显著。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆系统在组织信息时存在两个主要局限：(1)缺乏场景意识，不同生活场景的记忆共享同一检索空间，导致搜索空间膨胀并引入跨场景干扰；(2)每条记忆从单一视角编码，难以检索同一事件的互补视角。
AI.method: 提出CreaMem架构，核心包括：将记忆划分为多个"生活场景记忆"以实现场景感知组织，减少检索时的跨场景干扰；在每个场景记忆内，条目从情节（episodic）和特质（trait-based）双视角进行编码，实现跨记忆协同；并在检索阶段设计按记忆平衡的采样策略。
AI.result: 在两个长期记忆基准上的大量实验表明，CreaMem在所有评估指标上均提升了QA准确率，特别是在多跳推理性能上取得了大幅提升，验证了场景感知分区和跨记忆协同的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 场景感知的记忆分区与双视角编码策略能有效提升个性化LLM代理的长期记忆检索质量，尤其是在需要综合多个记忆片段进行推理的任务上表现突出。代码已公开以支持可复现性。

title: DPSF-Net: A Dual-Prior Spatial-Frequency Network for Real-World Remote Sensing Image Dehazing
summary: Real-world remote sensing image dehazing (RSID) remains challenging because atmospheric scattering, spatially non-uniform haze and colour distortion jointly degrade structural and spectral information. Most deep learning methods rely on RGB inputs and spatial-domain feature extraction, which limits their ability to separate global background haze from local surface details. Here, we propose DPSF-Net, a dual-prior spatial-frequency network built on MCAF-Net for real-world RSID. The network uses hazy RGB images and dark channel prior (DCP) maps as joint inputs, allowing physical degradation cues to guide end-to-end feature learning. A spatial-frequency residual interaction block introduces a FourierUnit branch into multi-directional spatial interaction to model large-scale haze components. A prior-guided feature attention module adaptively fuses prior and attention features to reduce colour shift and structural distortion. A selective kernel complementary fusion module screens multi-scale skip features through bidirectional residual complementary gating and selective kernel fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DPSF-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance on the real-world RRSHID remote sensing image dehazing benchmark and remains competitive across multiple synthetic datasets. Moreover, the proposed method strikes a favourable balance among restoration quality, parameter count and computational complexity, supporting the effectiveness of dual-prior spatial-frequency modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPSF-Net，一种基于双先验（hazy RGB图像与暗通道先验DCP图）的空间-频率域联合网络，用于真实世界遥感图像去雾。该方法在RRSHID基准上达到SOTA性能，并在多个合成数据集上具有竞争力，同时兼顾了恢复质量、参数量和计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 真实世界遥感图像去雾面临大气散射、非均匀雾霾和颜色失真共同导致的退化和光谱信息损失。现有深度学习方法主要依赖RGB输入和空间域特征提取，难以将全局背景雾霾与局部地表细节有效分离，限制了去雾性能。
AI.method: DPSF-Net以MCAF-Net为基础，采用三方面创新：(1) 将hazy RGB图像与暗通道先验（DCP）图作为联合输入，利用物理退化线索引导端到端特征学习；(2) 提出空间-频率残差交互模块，在方向化空间交互中引入FourierUnit分支以建模大尺度雾霾成分；(3) 先验引导特征注意力模块自适应融合先验与注意力特征，减少色彩偏移和结构失真；(4) 选择性核互补融合模块通过双向残差互补门控和选择性核融合筛选多尺度跳跃特征。
AI.result: 在真实世界RRSHID遥感图像去雾基准上达到SOTA性能，并在多个合成数据集上保持竞争力。方法在恢复质量、参数数量和计算复杂度之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 双先验空间-频率建模策略能有效提升真实世界遥感图像去雾效果，验证了将物理先验知识与频域特征建模相结合的可行性，为遥感图像去雾提供了新的技术路线。

title: Do New Attention Mechanisms Actually Fix Attention Sinks at Million-Token Context?
comment: Experimental study of attention sinks, long-context recall, and million-token context behavior. Code and measurement protocol are available at https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window
summary: Long context language models now advertise windows of one million tokens, but two habits limit how much of that window is used. Attention heads with nothing useful to read still spend their budget on the first token, which is called the attention sink, and where a fact sits in the context changes whether the model finds it. Gated attention cut first token attention from 46.7 percent to 4.8 percent at NeurIPS 2025, and Kimi K3 pairs that idea with Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals behind a one million token window, eight times past the range where these diagnostics have been reported. This paper asks whether the fix survives that jump. We build SinkProbe, a suite that measures sink mass, massive activation, position resolved recall and the recency gap, and apply it to four small models that differ only in how they mix tokens and depth. Three results follow. The training objective produces the sink, not the architecture. Gating did not reproduce its published effect at our scale. Sink mass, activations and position bias moved independently. Code, data and the measurement protocol are released at https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window

AI.tldr: 本文构建SinkProbe评测套件，在百万token上下文中检验门控注意力等机制是否仍能抑制注意力沉没现象。结果发现训练目标而非架构产生注意力沉没，门控在本文规模下未复现发表效果，且沉没质量、激活和位置偏差是独立变动的。
AI.motivation: 长上下文语言模型宣称支持百万token窗口，但注意力沉没（注意力头花预算读取首token）和位置偏差（事实位置影响模型能否找到）两种习惯限制窗口利用率。已有工作（如门控注意力）在小范围内有效，但需检验其在百万token尺度下是否持续有效。
AI.method: 构建SinkProbe评测套件，测量沉没质量（sink mass）、大规模激活（massive activation）、位置解析召回率和最近偏差（recency gap）；并测试四个仅在token混合和深度方式上不同的小规模模型。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：训练目标（而非架构）是注意力沉没产生的根源；门控注意力在本文测试规模下未复现其已发表的效果；沉没质量、激活和位置偏差三项指标可以独立变化。
AI.conclusion: 注意力沉没等诊断指标从短上下文扩展到百万token窗口时，之前报告的修复措施不一定仍然有效，需要在新尺度上进行专门的评测验证。

title: Re-calibrated Contrastive Loss for Transformation-Aware Prompt Conditioning in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted by British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Ensuring effective transfer learning for vision-language models without compromising their generalization performance is crucial. However, many existing methods overlook data characteristics and simply reuse the training strategies adopted during pre-training. Specifically, they treat same-class samples as distinct instances and transform images independently of their paired text prompts, which makes model learning more difficult. We address these limitations through transformation-aware prompt conditioning and a re-calibrated contrastive loss. Fixed text descriptors identify the transformations applied to paired images, providing transformation-level consistency without altering class semantics. This design aligns the image and text branches at the transformation level, enabling richer representations while preserving the models' ability to generalize. In addition, our loss function mitigates positive-gradient dilution in soft-target cross-entropy when each anchor has multiple valid positives. During transfer, our approach treats same-class samples as positives rather than distinct instances, enabling the model to learn domain-specific features more effectively. Experiments across distribution shift, transfer learning, and few-shot settings demonstrate consistent improvements over existing approaches. Source code for our method is available at https://github.com/SoongE/ReCalCon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向视觉-语言模型迁移学习的改进方法，通过变换感知提示条件和重新校准的对比损失，解决了现有方法忽略数据特征、将同类样本视为独立实例以及图像变换与文本提示解耦的问题，在多个场景下取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型迁移学习方法忽视了数据特性，简单复用预训练阶段的训练策略，导致同类样本被当作不同实例处理、图像变换与配对文本提示相互独立，增加了模型学习难度，影响泛化性能。
AI.method: 该方法包含两个核心设计：(1) 变换感知提示条件——使用固定文本描述符标识应用到配对图像的变换，在不改变类别语义的前提下提供变换层级的语义一致性，使图像和文本分支在变换级别对齐；(2) 重新校准的对比损失——缓解soft-target交叉熵中当每个锚点有多个有效正样本时出现的正梯度稀释问题，将同类样本视为正样本而非独立实例，从而更有效地学习领域特定特征。
AI.result: 在分布偏移、迁移学习和少样本学习等多项实验中均取得了一致的性能提升，超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过变换感知提示条件与重新校准的对比损失，既能增强模型表征的丰富性，又能保持其泛化能力，为视觉-语言模型的迁移学习提供了有效改进方案。

title: Which Forms of Caregiver Feedback Support Grammar Learning? A Reinforcement-Learning Study of Child-Like Language Models
summary: Social interaction is central to children's language learning, but the effects of different forms of caregiver feedback are difficult to isolate in naturalistic data. We use child-like language models as controlled learners to test which forms of feedback support grammatical development. Small GPT-2-style models are pretrained on child-directed language from CHILDES, then fine-tuned with reinforcement learning using reward models trained to capture four feedback types: communicative feedback, structural alignment, semantic contingency, and affective feedback. Reward fine-tuning yields limited gains on minimal-pair evaluations, but clearer effects in free generation. Structural alignment produces the strongest improvements in grammaticality, providing a novel, plausible mechanistic account of how this feedback can support grammar learning. Communicative feedback yields more moderate gains. In contrast, semantic contingency and affective feedback do not improve grammaticality, although further analyses suggest that they may support other aspects of language learning beyond grammar. These results suggest that different forms of caregiver feedback make complementary contributions to language learning.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用类儿童语言模型作为受控学习者，通过强化学习测试四种照顾者反馈形式（交际性反馈、结构对齐、语义连贯性和情感反馈）对语法发展的影响。结果发现结构对齐对语法习得的提升最强，交际性反馈效果中等，而语义连贯性和情感反馈对语法没有直接提升作用。
AI.motivation: 社交互动对儿童语言学习至关重要，但自然语料数据中难以隔离不同照顾者反馈形式的具体影响。该研究旨在通过可控的类儿童语言模型来分离并测试不同反馈形式对语法发展的独特贡献。
AI.method: 使用小型GPT-2风格模型在CHILDES的儿童导向语言上进行预训练，然后通过强化学习使用四种反馈类型的奖励模型进行微调，并在最小对评估和自由生成两个层面评估语法表现。
AI.result: 奖励微调在最小对评估上收益有限，但在自由生成中效果更明显。结构对齐带来最强的语法性提升，交际性反馈产生中等增益，而语义连贯性和情感反馈未提升语法性，但可能支持语言学习的其他方面。
AI.conclusion: 不同类型的照顾者反馈对语言学习做出互补性贡献，结构对齐提供了一种新颖且合理的机制性解释，说明该反馈形式如何支持语法习得。语义连贯性和情感反馈可能对语法之外的语言学习维度有助益。

title: AnomalyCraft-700K: Component-Level Controllable and Verifiable Synthetic Anomalies for Fine-Grained Video Anomaly Understanding
summary: Progress in video anomaly understanding (VAU) has long been limited by inherent deficiencies of real-world anomaly videos, which are hard to collect and offer little control over their content. Synthetic anomaly approaches partially alleviate data scarcity, yet their generation remains largely controlled at the category or prompt level. They also lack component-level verification of video-text consistency and provide insufficient hard normal samples near the normal-anomaly boundary. To address this, we present AnomalyCraft-700K, a component-controllable synthetic anomaly dataset for fine-grained VAU, containing over 40K videos and over 700K task-level textual annotations. From fine-grained semantic components and a progressive three-stage pipeline, we craft anomaly events that are richly detailed, semantically controlled, and temporally structured, and additionally construct per-category hard normal samples to prompt the model to discriminate based on anomaly semantics rather than surface visual cues. Moreover, using the components as verification units, AnomalyCraft-700K further performs component-wise correction of video-text discrepancies introduced during generation, providing reliable annotations with verified cross-modal alignment for six tasks that progress from anomaly detection, through anomaly retrieval and captioning, to fine-grained anomaly reasoning. Evaluations of widely used methods under both traditional and MLLM-based protocols demonstrate that AnomalyCraft-700K serves as an effective source of supervision, from anomaly detection to fine-grained anomaly understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnomalyCraft-700K，一个组件可控的合成异常视频数据集，包含超过4万视频和70万条任务级文本标注，通过渐进式三阶段pipeline生成语义精细且时间结构化的异常事件，并提供逐类别困难正常样本及组件级视频-文本一致性验证，支持从异常检测到细粒度异常推理的六项任务。
AI.motivation: 真实异常视频存在收集困难、内容可控性差等固有缺陷；现有合成异常方法仅能在类别或提示词级别控制生成，缺乏组件级视频-文本一致性验证，且靠近正常-异常边界的困难正常样本不足，限制了细粒度视频异常理解的发展。
AI.method: 构建AnomalyCraft-700K数据集：1）从细粒度语义组件出发，采用渐进式三阶段pipeline生成语义丰富、时间结构化的异常事件；2）构造逐类别困难正常样本，迫使模型基于异常语义而非表面视觉线索进行判别；3）以组件作为验证单元，对生成过程中出现的视频-文本不一致进行组件级修正，确保跨模态对齐可靠。
AI.result: 基于传统和MLLM两种协议对广泛使用的方法进行评估，结果表明AnomalyCraft-700K能够作为有效的监督来源，涵盖从异常检测到细粒度异常理解的各项任务。
AI.conclusion: AnomalyCraft-700K通过组件级可控生成与验证机制，有效缓解真实异常视频数据稀缺问题，为细粒度视频异常理解提供了可靠的大规模合成训练数据支撑。

title: Limitations of Automated Simulatability: LLM Simulators Can Bypass Explanations
comment: Accepted to the BlackboxNLP 2026 Reproducibility Challenge (Special Track), EMNLP 2026
summary: Simulatability is an evaluation protocol for explanations that quantifies their usefulness by how well they help a user predict a task model's outputs. Since human evaluation is costly, automated simulatability replaces human explainees with LLM simulators, as proposed in ConSim (Poché et al., 2025) for large-scale experiments. We qualitatively replicate and extend ConSim's ranking of explanation methods across the tested datasets, explanation families, and simulator LLMs, and identify two limitations. First, when class names are meaningful, simulators can obtain high simulatability by solving the classification task directly, without relying on the explanations. Second, class anonymization can reward explanations for leaking the hidden label mapping, a limitation we expose with a new classes-as-concepts baseline. These results are consistent with a shortcut hypothesis: in the tested settings, simulator predictions mainly rely on task priors, while explanations produce small changes. We derive recommendations for more robust automated simulatability evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文对ConSim自动可模拟性评估框架进行了定性质性复制与扩展，发现两个关键局限：其一，当类别名称有实际含义时，LLM模拟器可直接通过解决分类任务获得高可模拟性分数，无需依赖解释；其二，类别匿名化可能反向奖励泄露隐藏标签映射的解释。研究提出"捷径假设"解释这一现象，并给出更稳健的自动化可模拟性评估建议。
AI.motivation: 人工评估解释方法的成本高昂，ConSim提出用LLM模拟器替代人类测试者进行大规模自动可模拟性评估。然而该评估框架可能存在未暴露的系统性偏差，需要对其有效性进行严谨检验，以确保基于该协议得出的解释方法排序结论可靠。
AI.method: 采用定性复制加扩展的研究策略：在ConSim原有的数据集、解释方法族和模拟器LLM配置下进行复现实验；新增"classes-as-concepts"基线来暴露类别匿名化下标签映射泄露问题；通过对比有无解释时的预测差异来检验"捷径假设"（即模拟器主要依赖任务先验而非解释）。
AI.result: 研究识别出两个核心局限：(1) 有意义的类别名称使模拟器可直接解题获得高分，解释并非必要；(2) 类别匿名化机制反而可能使泄露标签映射的解释被高估。两者均支持捷径假设——在测试条件下，模拟器预测主要基于任务先验，解释贡献微小。
AI.conclusion: 自动化可模拟性评估对解释质量的度量存在偏差，需改进评估协议以消除任务先验干扰和标签映射泄漏问题，从而获得更可靠、更具区分度的解释方法评估结果。

title: AV-SafetyBench: A Safety Benchmark for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent text-to-audio-video (T2AV) models jointly generate video, speech, sound effects, and ambience from a single text prompt. This capability poses new challenges for safety evaluation, as unsafe content may be conveyed through the audio track or arise only when the visual and audio tracks are interpreted jointly. Existing safety benchmarks largely focus on either generated video or generated audio in isolation and are therefore not designed to capture these risks. To close this gap, we introduce AV-SafetyBench, the first safety benchmark developed specifically for T2AV generation. AV-SafetyBench comprises a four-axis, 13-category taxonomy and 5,200 manually reviewed prompts that specify visual scenes, speech, and non-speech audio. Our evaluation protocol assesses each output under three views: Full-AV, Video-Only, and Audio-Only. It then uses the Video-Only and Audio-Only judgments to assign Full-AV unsafe outputs to one of four risk sources: Video-Only, Audio-Only, AV-Both, or AV-Joint. We evaluate five open-source T2AV models and validate the automated Full-AV judgments against human annotations. Across the five models, Full-AV Unsafe Rates range from 25.1% to 49.4%. Beyond these aggregate rates, risk-source analysis reveals that, for four of the five models, Audio-Only and AV-Joint cases-unsafe outputs missed by video-only evaluation-account for 41.6-48.3% of Full-AV unsafe outputs for which a risk source could be assigned. In the Cross-Modal Harm Emergence category, AV-Joint accounts for 87.5% of unsafe outputs withan assigned risk source. Together, these findings demonstrate the value of AV-SafetyBench for evaluating T2AV safety across the visual and audio modalities and their interaction.

AI.tldr: AV-SafetyBench是首个针对文生音视频（T2AV）生成模型的安全评测基准，包含四轴13类别的分类体系和5200条人工审核提示词。评测采用Full-AV、Video-Only、Audio-Only三种视角，将Full-AV不安全输出归因到Video-Only、Audio-Only、AV-Both或AV-Joint四类风险源。对五个开源模型评测发现Full-AV不安全率在25.1%-49.4%之间，且音频相关和跨模态联合风险占据重要比例。
AI.motivation: 现有的T2AV模型可同时生成视频、语音、音效和环境声，但现有安全基准仅针对视频或音频单独评测，无法捕捉音轨中的不安全内容或音视频联合解读才出现的风险。作者希望填补这一评测空白。
AI.method: 构建了四轴13类别的安全分类体系及5200条人工审核提示词；设计三视角（Full-AV、Video-Only、Audio-Only）评测协议，通过消融对比将Full-AV不安全输出归因到四类风险源；对五个开源T2AV模型进行评测并以人工标注验证自动判断。
AI.result: 五个模型的Full-AV不安全率在25.1%-49.4%之间。风险源分析显示四个模型的Audio-Only和AV-Joint不安全输出占Full-AV可归因不安全输出的41.6%-48.3%；在Cross-Modal Harm Emergence类别中，AV-Joint占可归因不安全输出的87.5%。
AI.conclusion: AV-SafetyBench能有效揭示纯视觉评测无法覆盖的音频相关及跨模态联合安全风险，凸显了T2AV安全评测需要在视觉、音频及二者交互三个层面进行综合评估的必要性。

title: Dynamics of meaning: Towards the Evaluation of Diachronic Semantic Change in Sinhala
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables, Accepted paper at the 5th Asia-Pacific Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (AACL) & the 15th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing (IJCNLP) 2026
summary: Tracking semantic change in low-resource languages across extensive historical timelines presents significant challenges due to data scarcity and the limitations of static embedding alignments. This study investigates the diachronic evolution of the Sinhala language from the 13th to the 20th century using a multi-stage computational framework. We first align century-specific Word2Vec and FastText embeddings using Similarity Matrix Based Alignment (SMA) and Orthogonal Procrustes (OP) techniques, finding that OP alignment provides more stable neighbourhood tracking for identifying temporal similarity dips. To move beyond aggregate measures, we introduce a Bidirectional Semantic Impact Pruning approach using contextualised embeddings from a fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B. By applying Leave-One-Out (LOO) diagnostics, we attempt to isolate influential sentences to distinguish between systemic semantic shifts and transient polysemic expansion. Our results show that semantic drift in the fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B is not evenly distributed across all usages. Instead, a significant part of the change is driven by a smaller set of high-impact contextual instances, rather than gradual and uniform change across all occurrences. This work provides a preliminary framework for diachronic analysis in low-resource contexts, highlighting the trade-offs between model sensitivity and data availability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多阶段计算框架，用于追踪13至20世纪僧伽罗语（Sinhala）这一低资源语言的语义演变，结合静态词嵌入对齐与基于微调Llama-3.1-8B的上下文嵌入分析，发现语义漂移主要由少数高影响力语境实例驱动，而非均匀分布。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言在跨越长时间线的语义变化追踪中面临数据稀缺和静态嵌入对齐局限的双重挑战，亟需一种能在资源贫乏条件下有效区分系统性语义变迁与短暂多义扩张的分析方法。
AI.method: 首先使用Similarity Matrix Based Alignment (SMA)和Orthogonal Procrustes (OP)对齐各世纪的Word2Vec与FastText嵌入，随后提出一种双向语义影响剪枝方法，利用微调后的Llama-3.1-8B上下文嵌入，通过Leave-One-Out（LOO）诊断来隔离影响性句子，以区分系统语义变迁与短暂多义扩张。
AI.result: OP对齐相比SMA在识别时间相似性低谷的邻域追踪方面更为稳定；语义漂移在微调Llama-3.1-8B中并非均匀分布，而是由较小的高影响力上下文实例集合驱动，而非全体用法的渐进统一变化。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为低资源语言的历时分析提供了初步框架，揭示了模型敏感性与数据可用性之间的权衡，表明少数关键语境实例即可驱动大部分语义变化。

title: CGSM: Concept-Guided Segmentation Model for Precise Pulmonary Lesion Delineation
comment: Changheng Lin and Wenjie Zhang contributed equally to this work. Xiao Jia and Wei Zhang are corresponding authors
summary: Accurate segmentation of pulmonary lesions is essential for effective clinical diagnosis and treatment strategies. Existing segmentation approaches often lack task-specific semantic guidance, as text-based annotations typically offer coarse localization of lesions, leading to inadequate delineation of lesion boundaries and poor performance on small-scale lesions. To address this, we propose CGSM, a Concept-Guided Segmentation Model that integrates LLM-generated and clinically reviewed concepts into the segmentation process. Specifically, we design a Concept-Visual Alignment Module (CVAM) to activate relevant tokens within the concepts that align with visual features, enhancing the interaction between textual and visual information. In addition, we introduce a Concept Modulated Decoder (CM-Decoder), which uses concepts from CVAM as modulation signals to facilitate the adaptive fusion of image and text features, improving the segmentation accuracy. Extensive experiments on two public datasets show that CGSM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with results of 91.59% Dice and 84.49% mIoU on the QaTa-COV19 dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness in pulmonary lesion segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CGSM（概念引导分割模型），通过集成LLM生成并经临床审核的概念来增强肺部病变分割。模型包含Concept-Visual Alignment Module（CVAM）用于激活与视觉特征对齐的概念相关token，以及Concept Modulated Decoder（CM-Decoder）利用概念作为调制信号实现图像与文本特征的适应性融合。在QaTa-COV19等公开数据集上达到SOTA性能（Dice 91.59%，mIoU 84.49%）。
AI.motivation: 现有肺部病变分割方法缺乏任务特定的语义指导，文本标注通常只能提供病变的粗略定位，导致病变边界分割不准确，且对小规模病变表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出CGSM框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) CVAM模块，用于激活与视觉特征对齐的概念中的相关token，增强文本与视觉信息交互；(2) CM-Decoder模块，将CVAM输出的概念作为调制信号，促进图像与文本特征的适应性融合，以提升分割精度。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上的大量实验表明CGSM达到最先进水平，在QaTa-COV19数据集上取得91.59% Dice和84.49% mIoU的成绩。
AI.conclusion: CGSM通过引入概念引导机制有效解决了现有方法中语义指导不足的问题，验证了LLM生成的概念与视觉特征对齐在医学图像分割中的有效性。

title: Navigating the digital spectrum: Assessing political bias, stability, and downstream fairness in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed as information intermediaries, yet measuring their political behavior remains fragile because questionnaire results mix model dispositions with measurement artifacts and response-elicitation biases. We introduce a robust Political Compass Test evaluation framework that samples 300 configurations across an eight-dimensional perturbation space varying language, framing, instructions, answer format, option order, and persona wording. We evaluate eight Gemma 3 and Qwen 3 models across 14 languages and three quantization levels, obtaining design-averaged political coordinates with quantified uncertainty. Most models lean Libertarian-Left on average, but instruction phrasing, language, and answer format significantly affect recovered coordinates. Cross-lingual differences primarily reflect coordinate drift rather than distinct cultural reasoning. Reverse-engineering the test also exposes axis-weighting imbalances and the collapse of degenerate responses toward the center, so near-origin estimates for the smallest models can reflect weak signal rather than centrism. Free-text reasoning and chat-then-classify elicitation alter recovered coordinates, and larger models show clearer persona separation, with a specific failure of the Authoritarian-Left persona to move most models in the intended social direction. In downstream tasks, persona effects are modest relative to model size and target group for hate-speech detection, while base and centrist prompts give the highest agreement for topic-level sentiment. Political role prompting therefore has measurable but task- and dataset-specific downstream effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的政治罗盘测试评估框架，在八维扰动空间中采样300种配置，对8个Gemma 3和Qwen 3模型在14种语言和3个量化级别下进行系统评估。研究发现多数模型平均偏向自由意志主义-左翼，但指令措辞、语言和答案格式会显著影响测量结果；跨语言差异主要是坐标漂移而非文化推理差异；最小模型近原点估计反映的是弱信号而非中间立场；角色提示在下游任务中产生可测量但任务和数据相关的效应。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地作为信息中介部署，但测量其政治行为仍然很脆弱，因为问卷结果混淆了模型的内在倾向与测量伪影和响应诱发偏差。现有评估方法缺乏系统性的鲁棒性检验，需要更严格的评估框架来准确量化模型的政治坐标及其不确定性。
AI.method: 构建八维扰动空间（涵盖语言、框架、指令、答案格式、选项顺序和个人措辞等），从中采样300种配置形成Political Compass Test评估框架。对8个Gemma 3和Qwen 3模型在14种语言和3个量化级别上进行系统评估，采用设计平均化的政治坐标并量化不确定性。同时反向工程设计分析轴加权失衡和退化响应折叠问题，并在仇恨言论检测和主题级情感分析等下游任务中测试角色提示效应。
AI.result: 多数模型平均呈自由意志主义-左翼倾向，但指令措辞、语言和答案格式显著影响测量坐标；跨语言差异主要体现为坐标漂移而非文化推理差异。最小模型的近原点估计源于退化响应的弱信号而非真实中间立场。自由文本推理和聊天后分类的诱发方式会改变测量坐标；更大模型显示更清晰的角色分离，但威权-左翼角色在推动模型朝预期社会方向移动方面存在特定失效。下游任务中角色提示效应相对模型大小和目标群体较弱。
AI.conclusion: 政治角色提示具有可测量但任务和数据特定的下游效应；现有的模型政治行为测量需考虑多维度扰动带来的不确定性；建议在报告模型政治坐标时纳入设计平均化和不确定性量化，并对小模型的近原点估计保持谨慎解读。

title: GIFT: Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning for Efficient Manipulation Policy Adaptation
summary: Compared with relying solely on initial observations and language instructions, predicting goal images with generative models as high-level visual guidance can significantly enhance the robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, most existing foundation models have not systematically incorporated goal image conditioning due to the high computational training cost. To this end, we propose Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a lightweight and efficient fine-tuning framework that seamlessly integrates generated goal images into multiple representative pretrained VLA models. Our approach introduces goal image features into observations via a zero-initialized convolution which progressively grows parameters from zero and prevents harmful noise from disrupting the pretrained policy during fine-tuning. As training proceeds, goal information is gradually incorporated, enabling efficient goal understanding without disrupting model stability. We further introduce a refined image editing method to generate semantically and visually consistent goal images from initial observations and task instructions. Experiments show that goal-aware VLA models achieve substantial performance gains across tasks: with only a single epoch of fine-tuning, GIFT outperforms the base model by 6.0% and 13.4% on two SIMPLER settings, and by 4.7% on LIBERO, demonstrating both efficiency and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GIFT（Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning）框架，通过零初始化卷积将生成的目标图像特征逐步注入预训练的VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型，仅需单轮微调即可显著提升模型在机器人操作任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型过度依赖初始观测和语言指令，鲁棒性不足；虽然生成目标图像作为视觉引导可以增强模型表现，但大多数预训练基础模型因高昂的计算训练成本，未能系统性地整合目标图像条件。
AI.method: 提出轻量级高效的GIFT微调框架：(1) 通过零初始化卷积将目标图像特征注入观测，参数从零逐步增长，避免有害噪声干扰预训练策略；(2) 提出精细化的图像编辑方法，从初始观测和任务指令生成语义和视觉一致的目标图像。该方法可无缝集成到多种代表性预训练VLA模型中。
AI.result: 仅单轮微调，GIFT在两个SIMPLER设置上分别比基础模型提升6.0%和13.4%，在LIBERO上提升4.7%，展示了高效性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: GIFT能够以极低的训练成本为目标感知VLA模型注入生成目标图像信息，兼顾了微调的稳定性与效果，验证了目标图像引导在增强VLA模型鲁棒性方面的实用价值。

title: Combating Instruction Conflict via Energy-Driven Latent Conflict Detection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with hierarchical instructions, yet they remain vulnerable to conflicts in which user directives override system-level constraints. Existing defense mechanisms predominantly focus on static input inspection and therefore fail to detect Response Drift, a phenomenon in which the model's final response violates system-level constraints despite seemingly compliant inputs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ELCD, a response-level latent conflict detector for post-generation, pre-delivery verification. Given the full generated output, ELCD constructs a composite hidden-state representation by concatenating the final-token embedding with the mean-pooled response embedding. It then optimizes a pairwise margin ranking objective to separate compliant and drifting responses in latent space. Extensive experiments across five mainstream LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters demonstrate that ELCD significantly outperforms competitive baselines. Notably, it improves the PR-AUC on Llama-2-7B by approximately 30 percentage points and reduces the False Positive Rate at 95% TPR (FPR95) on Mistral-7B to 2.67%. These results suggest that ELCD provides a promising approach for latent instruction-conflict detection in open-weight or self-hosted LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ELCD，一种针对大语言模型响应级别（response-level）的潜在冲突检测器，在生成后、交付前阶段验证模型输出是否违反系统级指令约束。ELCD通过拼接最终token嵌入与响应均值池化嵌入构建复合隐藏状态表示，并采用成对边际排序目标来分离合规响应与漂移响应。实验覆盖五个主流LLM（1.5B至14B参数），结果表明ELCD显著优于现有基线，在Llama-2-7B上PR-AUC提升约30个百分点，在Mistral-7B上将FPR95降至2.67%。
AI.motivation: 现有防御机制主要依赖静态输入检查，无法检测"响应漂移"（Response Drift）现象——即模型最终响应违反系统级约束，尽管输入看似合规。这一空白需要响应级别的潜在冲突检测方法来解决。
AI.method: ELCD采用两阶段架构：首先构建复合隐藏状态表示（拼接最终token嵌入与响应均值池化嵌入），然后通过成对边际排名目标（pairwise margin ranking objective）训练分类器，将合规响应与漂移响应在潜在空间中分离。
AI.result: 在五个主流LLM（1.5B至14B参数）上的广泛实验表明，ELCD显著优于竞争基线：在Llama-2-7B上PR-AUC提升约30个百分点，在Mistral-7B上FPR95降低至2.67%。
AI.conclusion: ELCD为开放权重或自托管LLM部署中的潜在指令冲突检测提供了一种有前景的解决方案，填补了响应级防御的研究空白。

title: Fine-Grained Visual Preprocessing and Dual-Stream Temporal Modeling for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis on Social Media
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis often remains text-dominant due to raw-video noise and insufficient temporal modeling. Using CH-SIMS v2.0S, this study proposes three improvements: the NAPS pipeline---a seven-stage system integrating face tracking,identity embedding, and normalized lip-motion analysis to reduce visual noise;DS-TANet, combining an EfficientNetB2 static stream, RAFT optical-flow motion stream, motion-guided attention, and Bi-GRU temporal modeling; and DS-TAFNet, fusing visual and MacBERT-Base textual representations via concatenation fusion. With NAPS, the static visual baseline achieves 80.98\% Macro F1, comparable to the text baseline of 80.55\%; DS-TANet improves visual Macro F1 to 82.58\%;and DS-TAFNet achieves 87.49\% accuracy and 87.48\% Macro F1. These results demonstrate that improving visual input quality and temporal representation is more effective than increasing fusion complexity under limited-data conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对多模态情感分析中文本主导、视频噪声和时序建模不足的问题，提出NAPS视觉噪声处理流水线、DS-TANet动态视觉网络和DS-TAFNet多模态融合模型三项改进。在CH-SIMS v2.0S数据集上，DS-TAFNet达到87.49%准确率和87.48% Macro F1，证明在有限数据条件下提升视觉输入质量和时序表征比增加融合复杂度更有效。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析中，由于原始视频存在噪声且时序建模不足，模型往往偏向依赖文本信息，导致视觉模态的潜力未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 提出三项改进：(1) NAPS流水线——七阶段系统，整合人脸跟踪、身份嵌入和归一化唇部运动分析来降低视觉噪声；(2) DS-TANet——结合EfficientNetB2静态流、RAFT光流运动流、运动引导注意力及Bi-GRU时序建模；(3) DS-TAFNet——通过拼接融合方式整合视觉特征与MacBERT-Base文本表示。
AI.result: 使用NAPS后，静态视觉基线达到80.98% Macro F1（接近文本基线的80.55%）；DS-TANet将视觉Macro F1提升至82.58%；DS-TAFNet实现87.49%的准确率和87.48%的Macro F1。
AI.conclusion: 在有限数据条件下，改善视觉输入质量和时序表征的效果优于增加融合机制的复杂度，验证了视觉模态在多模态情感分析中的可提升性。

title: When Victorian Becomes a Prompt: Literary Periodization as a Generative Constraint in 100 AI-Generated Novels
summary: Generative AI inverts the typical periodization of literary history: the periodizing tag Victorian can now come first and influence what is written. Generative periodization, defined and tested here, describes the use of literary-period designations in generating texts. I test this approach on 100 book-length novels produced under Victorian and Zero-Style conditions using GPT, Qwen, and Llama workflows. The Period Alignment Score (PAS), trained on nineteenth-century literature and benchmarked against human Zero-Style prose, assesses alignment using topic-reduced grammatical features. Victorian prompts produce consistent historical-direction shifts in GPT and Qwen, but not robustly in Llama. Victorian-only recalibration and harder comparison corpora preserve the GPT and Qwen effects. Cross-model transfer also shows a shared direction of grammatical change. The measurable target is the broader nineteenth century rather than the Victorian period per se.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生成式时期划分"概念，即文学时期标签（如"维多利亚时期"）作为生成提示词会影响AI写作风格。作者用GPT、Qwen、Llama三种模型各生成100部小说，并通过新提出的"时期对齐评分"（PAS）评估文本与19世纪文学的语法风格对齐程度，发现GPT和Qwen对维多利亚提示词有稳定响应，而Llama不显著。
AI.motivation: 传统文学史按时间顺序分期，而生成式AI颠覆了这一顺序——时代标签可以反过来先于文本存在并引导文本生成。作者旨在检验这种"逆向时期化"是否真实有效，并开发可量化评估工具。
AI.method: 使用GPT、Qwen、Llama三种LLM工作流，在"维多利亚条件"与"零风格条件"下分别生成100部书级长度小说；构建PAS评分，基于19世纪文学训练、以人类零风格散文为基准，采用主题约简的语法特征来评估时期对齐度；并进行了仅维多利亚重校准、更严格对比语料库及跨模型迁移测试。
AI.result: 维多利亚提示词在GPT和Qwen中产生一致的历史方向偏移，在Llama中不稳健；维多利亚仅重校准与更难的对照语料保留了GPT与Qwen的效果；跨模型迁移显示语法变化存在共同方向。但可测目标更接近广义的19世纪而非狭义的维多利亚时期。
AI.conclusion: 生成式时期划分在部分大模型上成立且具有跨模型一致性，但效果因模型而异；期许符号所激活的风格本质上指向更宽泛的19世纪语法特征，而非精确的维多利亚风格复现。

title: ARNAI: Artifact Removal Network based on Autoencoding and Inpainting for Robust Spinal Image Segmentation and Measurement
summary:
Purpose: This study aims to develop an AI framework applicable for postoperative imaging for automated measurement of spinopelvic parameters on radiographs with robustness to the presence of spinal implants.
  Materials and Methods: We retrospectively reviewed lateral lumbar spine radiographs from two institutions (Internal: January 2017--December 2024; External: October 2021--September 2025). We developed the Restore, Segment, and Measure (RSM) framework, incorporating a novel Artifact Removal Network based on Autoencoding and Inpainting (ARNAI) to mitigate implant-related artifacts in postoperative radiographs. Segmentation and spinopelvic parameter (PT, LL, SS, SCA) measurement performance were assessed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and intraclass correlation coefficients.
  Results: When ARNAI was added to a recent Transformer-based segmentation model, FCBFormer, the mean DSC increased to 0.870 from 0.814, with marked gains at L3--L5 and smaller improvements at L1--L2. On 91 radiographs with implants, the mean L4--L5 segmental Cobb angle error decreased to 4.7 ° from 15.6--16.2 °, an average error reduction of 70%. The ICC for L4--L5 segmental Cobb angle improved to 0.54 (Rater 1) and 0.59 (Rater 2) from 0.18, and ICCs for pelvic tilt, lumbar lordosis, and sacral slope all exceeded 0.70. The improvement in L4--L5 segmental Cobb angle error was statistically significant in the internal implant-containing cohort after correction for multiple comparisons.
  Conclusion: The proposed RSM framework improved automated spinopelvic parameter measurement in implant-containing postoperative radiographs. By mitigating implant-related artifacts, ARNAI improved segmentation and downstream measurement accuracy, with the greatest benefit observed for L4--L5 segmental Cobb angle estimation, where the mean error was reduced by approximately 70%.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种RSM（Restore, Segment, and Measure）AI框架，用于术后影像中脊柱骨盆参数的自动化测量。该框架引入了一种基于自编码和修复的新型伪影去除网络（ARNAI），有效缓解了脊柱植入物在术后X光片上产生的伪影。加入ARNAI后，分割性能（DSC从0.814提升至0.870），L4-L5节段Cobb角误差降低了约70%（从15.6-16.2°降至4.7°），且各项脊柱骨盆参数的ICC均超过0.70。
AI.motivation: 术后X光片中存在脊柱植入物，会干扰AI模型对脊柱骨盆参数的自动化测量，导致分割和测量精度下降。现有方法缺乏对植入物伪影的有效处理手段，需要开发一个对植入物具有鲁棒性的自动化测量框架。
AI.method: 从两家机构回顾性收集腰椎侧位X光片数据，开发了RSM框架，包含三个阶段：修复（Restore）、分割（Segment）和测量（Measure）。核心创新是ARNAI（基于自编码和修复的伪影去除网络），用于消除术后影像中的植入物伪影。采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验和组内相关系数（ICC）评估分割和参数测量性能。
AI.result: 加入ARNAI后，FCBFormer分割模型的平均DSC从0.814提升至0.870，L3-L5改善显著。在91张含植入物的X光片上，L4-L5节段Cobb角平均误差从15.6-16.2°降至4.7°，误差减少约70%。Cobb角的ICC从0.18提升至0.54和0.59，骨盆倾斜角、腰椎前凸角和骶骨倾斜角的ICC均超过0.70。内部含植入物队列的Cobb角误差改善在多重比较校正后具有统计学显著性。
AI.conclusion: RSM框架有效改善了含植入物术后X光片中脊柱骨盆参数的自动化测量精度。ARNAI通过缓解植入物相关伪影，显著提升了分割精度和下游测量准确性，其中对L4-L5节段Cobb角的改善最为明显，平均误差降低了约70%。

title: Global Divergence, Local Convergence: Representation Geometry in SSMs and Transformers
summary: Recent state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba achieve language modeling performance comparable to transformers despite relying on fundamentally different architectures. This raises an important question: how do these structural differences influence the geometry and functional nature of their internal representations? We study this question through a multi-scale analysis of representations in transformers, SSMs, and hybrid architecture. First, we find that SSMs distribute their representational information evenly across all dimensions, whereas transformer representations are heavily dominated by a single principal direction. By evaluating hybrid architectures, we observe that the representation space becomes increasingly skewed toward a single dominant direction after each attention layer. Next, we explore how the different geometric spread of representations impacts representational capacity through compressibility. Surprisingly, we find that despite their contrasting geometric structures, both architectures exhibit tightly matched effective capacities. We further investigate whether this skewed geometry affects how concepts are encoded. Using rank-constrained probes, we demonstrate that both architectures encode concepts in subspaces of surprisingly similar dimensionality. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the transformers' dominant principal direction does not inherently encode more conceptual information. Finally, we zoom in and examine the alignment between manifolds, either by analyzing representations of specific topics or by looking at the nearest neighborhoods of tokens, and find that they are highly aligned. Ultimately, our analysis suggests that while transformers and SSMs induce different usage of latent space, they display a striking functional convergence at the level of local semantic manifolds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多尺度分析比较了Transformer、状态空间模型（SSM）和混合架构的内部表示几何与功能特性，发现尽管三者对潜在空间的使用方式不同（SSM均匀分布信息，Transformer主导方向集中），但在有效容量、概念编码维度、局部语义流形对齐等方面表现出显著的功能趋同。
AI.motivation: Mamba等状态空间模型在语言建模性能上可与Transformer匹敌，但二者架构根本不同。这引发了一个关键问题：这些结构差异如何影响其内部表示的几何形态和功能本质？理解这一问题有助于揭示不同架构下模型表示学习的底层规律。
AI.method: 采用多尺度分析方法：1）分析表示的几何散布（SSM均匀分布vs Transformer单主导方向）；2）通过混合架构定位注意力层对几何偏斜的影响；3）通过压缩性评估表示的有效容量；4）使用秩约束探针（rank-constrained probes）评估概念编码子空间维度；5）通过主题流形和最近邻token分析局部语义流形对齐。
AI.result: 1）SSM将表示信息均匀分布在各维度，而Transformer表示由单个主方向主导，且混合架构中每个注意力层都会增加这种偏斜度；2）尽管几何结构截然不同，二者的有效容量高度匹配；3）两种架构在相似维度的子空间中编码概念；4）Transformer的主导主方向并不固有地包含更多概念信息；5）在局部语义流形（主题流形和最近邻token）层面两种架构高度对齐。
AI.conclusion: 尽管Transformer和SSM采用了不同的潜在空间使用方式，但它们在局部语义流形层面展现出惊人的功能趋同性，表明不同架构可能在语义表征层面收敛到相似的解决方案。

title: LoGAN: Multilingual Font Localization with Generative Agents
summary: Localizing a font into new languages is a highly intricate task requiring precise design adaptation of glyphs, color/texture, and spacing/kerning, from source to target languages. Most existing methods focus on single glyph generation with limited capability in handling multilingual font rendering. In this work, we propose LoGAN, a VLM-based agentic framework for few-shot multilingual font localization, which takes in a small number of individual glyphs from a font or letters from a logo and uses them to generate complete character sets in other languages. LoGAN breaks down this task into multiple components: a glyph-level diffusion model, a style finetuning module, a spacing and kerning transfer algorithm, and a texture expansion model, with a VLM agent coordinator. LoGAN achieves broad language coverage for font localization with various styles, including Chinese/Korean/Japanese (CJK). We evaluate our approach on both font and real-world logo datasets spanning more than 27 languages and compare it against both specialized font generation and state-of-the-art image editing models with strong text rendering capabilities (e.g., FLUX, Nano-Banana). Our approach yields higher glyph fidelity while maintaining better style, texture, and kerning consistency according to both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.
