AI.result: 10个开源MLLM在SAFIRE上的平均准确率为61.9%，揭示出安全关键推理方面的显著差距；仅使用7%领域特定数据适配视觉编码器，火灾场景分类准确率从20.1%大幅提升至64.5%，表明即使数据量有限，精心策划的数据也能带来显著收益。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大语言模型在火灾烟雾理解这一安全关键任务上表现不足，尤其在高阶推理维度存在明显短板；然而，通过少量领域特定数据微调视觉编码器即可获得大幅性能提升，说明构建高质量、精心策划的领域基准数据对于提升MLLMs的安全关键应用能力具有重要意义。

title: MV-STRIDE: Enabling MLLMs to Master Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Hierarchical Capability Modeling
summary: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in 2D vision-language tasks, robust multi-view spatial reasoning remains a fundamental bottleneck due to the lack of structured 3D cognitive pathways in existing datasets. To address this, we introduce MV-STRIDE, a Multi-View hierarchical SpaTial Reasoning dataset with Interdependent and DEcomposed capabilitiEs. Moving beyond flat data structures, MV-STRIDE explicitly models the dependency relationships between foundational perception, scene understanding, and complex contextual reasoning, providing a coherent learning pathway aligned with human spatial cognition. We develop a systematic QA generation pipeline leveraging diverse 3D scene sources that enforces cross-view dependency constraints to prevent single-view solvability, generating multi-level spatial reasoning tasks supported by cognitively grounded chain-of-thought supervision for complex inference. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our multi-stage training framework based on our hierarchical dataset achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks, notably the multi-view oriented MMSI-Bench. Our approach enables MLLMs to maintain robust, 3D-consistent spatial reasoning across diverse viewpoints. The code and dataset are available at https://co1dspring.github.io/MV-STRIDE/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MV-STRIDE，一个多视角分层空间推理数据集，通过显式建模基础感知、场景理解与复杂情境推理之间的依赖关系，并提供跨视角约束的QA生成管道与认知驱动的链式思维监督，实现了MLLMs在多视角下的稳健3D一致空间推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在2D视觉语言任务上进展迅速，但在多视角空间推理上仍存在根本性瓶颈，主要原因在于现有数据集缺乏结构化的3D认知通路。现有数据集的平面结构无法为模型提供与人类空间认知一致的层级学习路径。
AI.method: 1) 构建MV-STRIDE数据集，显式建模基础感知、场景理解和复杂情境推理之间的依赖关系；2) 开发系统的QA生成管道，利用多样的3D场景源，通过跨视角依赖约束防止单视角可解问题；3) 为复杂推理提供认知驱动的链式思维监督；4) 基于该层级数据集设计多阶段训练框架。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，基于MV-STRIDE层级数据集的多阶段训练框架在多个空间推理基准上取得最先进性能，尤其是在多视角导向的MMSI-Bench基准上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使MLLMs在多个不同视角下保持稳健且3D一致的空间推理能力，验证了结构化3D认知通路和层级数据集对多视角空间推理的重要性。

title: From Coordinates to Candidate Regions: Temporal Change Localization via Region Selection in Remote Sensing Multimodal LLMs
summary: Remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS-MLLMs) have advanced scene understanding and visual question answering over satellite imagery, yet localizing specific objects or changed regions remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on generating bounding box coordinates as token sequences, which is fragile for the small, densely packed objects common in remote sensing and increasingly error-prone when multiple targets must be localized simultaneously. In this work, we present an RS-specific formulation of the region selection paradigm, previously explored in natural-image MLLMs, and extend it to temporal change localization over multi-image sequences. Our framework employs a text-conditioned region proposal module, encodes each candidate as special tokens carrying per-frame visual features enriched with spatial and temporal cues, and lets the LLM localize targets by selecting region tokens in its response. We construct a multi-task training and evaluation suite spanning localization, referring expression, visual grounding, and understanding tasks across single-image and multi-temporal settings. Experiments show that our approach substantially outperforms coordinate-generation baselines on temporal change localization, while improving single-image visual grounding and maintaining competitive understanding performance. Oracle analysis decomposes the contributions of the region proposer and the LLM selector, providing diagnostic insight unique to this framework. Our code will be available at https://github.com/juwan-kr/RS-RegionSelect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向遥感多模态大语言模型（RS-MLLM）的区域选择范式，通过将候选区域编码为携带时空特征的特殊token，让LLM通过选择区域token而非生成坐标序列来完成目标定位和时序变化检测，在多项任务上超越坐标生成基线。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中的目标通常小而密集，现有RS-MLLM依赖生成边界框坐标token序列进行定位，当需要同时定位多个目标时容易出错且不稳定，亟需更鲁棒的定位范式。
AI.method: 1) 提出RS特定的区域选择范式，扩展自然图像MLLM中的方法到多时相变化定位；2) 采用文本条件区域提议模块生成候选区域；3) 将每个候选区域编码为携带逐帧视觉特征（含空间和时间线索）的特殊token；4) 让LLM通过选择区域token来定位目标；5) 构建覆盖单图和多时相的多任务训练与评估套件。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在时序变化定位上显著优于坐标生成基线，同时提升了单图视觉定位性能，并保持具有竞争力的场景理解能力。Oracle分析进一步分解了区域提议器和LLM选择器各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 区域选择范式是遥感多模态大模型中坐标生成方法的有效替代方案，尤其适合小目标稠密场景和时序变化定位任务，该框架为RS-MLLM定位任务提供了新的诊断视角和改进方向。

title: KODAMA: Multimodal Digital Twin Reconstruction for Urban RF Propagation Modelling
summary: 3D reconstruction typically strives for geometric fidelity or visual plausibility. Radio frequency digital twins (RFDT) are instead judged by whether communication channels behave in them as they do in the real world. RFDTs promise site-specific channel prediction but current practice forces a choice between coarse automated scenes and hand-built, measurement-calibrated models that take weeks to construct per-site. We present KODAMA, an automated pipeline that reconstructs ray tracing-ready RFDTs at city scale from off-the-shelf geospatial data alone: aerial imagery, LiDAR, and photogrammetry yield terrain and watertight building meshes, while exposure-weighted multi-view fusion of street-level imagery recovers façade relief, electromagnetic materials, and clutter---all without site visits or calibration. Across three sites spanning 3.6 to 28 GHz, KODAMA's uncalibrated predictions achieve single-digit RMSE, reducing point-to-point error by up to 5.35 dB over automated baselines and coming within 0.22 dB of a measurement-calibrated, hand-built RFDT.

AI.tldr: KODAMA是一种自动化管线，仅利用现成的地理空间数据（航拍影像、LiDAR、摄影测量和街景影像）即可在城市尺度重建可直接用于光线追踪的无线电频率数字孪生（RFDT），无需现场勘测或校准，在3.6至28 GHz三个场地上的未校准预测误差达到个位数RMSE，比自动化基线最多降低5.35 dB。
AI.motivation: 传统RFDT构建面临两难：全自动场景方案粗劣、精度不足，而手工构建并经测量校准的模型虽准确但需数周工期。作者希望填补这一空白，实现无需现场测绘的高保真自动RFDT重建。
AI.method: KODAMA由两条数据通路组成：一是利用航拍影像、LiDAR和摄影测量生成地形和密封的建筑网格；二是通过曝光加权多视角融合处理街景影像，恢复建筑外立面细节、电磁材料属性及杂波信息，最终输出可直接用于光线追踪的RFDT。
AI.result: 在三个覆盖3.6至28 GHz频段的测试场地上，KODAMA的未校准预测实现了个位数的RMSE误差；相比自动化基线，点对点误差最多降低5.35 dB；与经过测量校准的手工RFDT相比，误差差距仅0.22 dB。
AI.conclusion: KODAMA证明了无需现场勘测和人工校准，仅依靠现成地理空间数据即可在城市规模上自动构建接近手工校准精度的RFDT，大幅缩短了构建周期，为站点特定的通信信道预测提供了可扩展的高保真解决方案。

title: Studying Image Tokenizers as Visual Languages in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Image tokenizers define the ``visual language'' of unified multimodal models, yet are commonly studied through isolated metrics or generation-/understanding-only evaluations. These evaluations do not fully capture how visual tokens behave when modeled jointly with text. We build a controlled pure-autoregressive testbed and track task-specific validation losses during multimodal continual pretraining across text, image, text-to-image (T2I), and image-to-text (I2T) prediction. We examine how these losses scale and relate to downstream performance, then use them to study multimodal learnability---how well image and text tokens are jointly modeled---and tokenizer design. We find that (1) losses should be analyzed by task, since they exhibit distinct scaling behavior and rank tokenizers differently. (2) The loss--performance relationship depends on the predicted token space: for a fixed tokenizer, T2I and I2T losses correlate with generation quality, but across tokenizers, the T2I loss--performance relationship shifts with the image-token space, whereas I2T loss, computed over a shared text vocabulary, provides a more consistent signal. I2T loss also correlates with both generation and visual understanding performance after supervised finetuning. Using losses as a lens, we show that (3) better reconstruction does not necessarily yield lower task-specific losses or stronger downstream performance, and that (4) image tokenizer choice can affect text modeling under joint optimization. As case studies, we revisit three tokenizer design axes---the discriminator, semantic supervision, and vocabulary size---to examine their effects on joint modeling and downstream performance. Together, our testbed offers a complementary perspective on image tokenizers as visual languages, highlighting their interplay with text in joint multimodal training.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个受控的纯自回归测试平台，在多模态持续预训练中跟踪任务特定的验证损失（文本、图像、T2I、I2T），以研究图像分词器作为"视觉语言"在联合文本建模中的行为。研究发现：损失需按任务分析、损失-性能关系取决于预测词元空间、更好的重建并不必然带来更低的损失或更强的下游性能，且图像分词器的选择会影响文本建模。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像分词器评估要么使用孤立的指标（如重建质量），要么仅针对生成或理解任务单独评估，无法充分捕捉视觉词元在与文本联合建模时的真实行为。作者旨在建立一个能够同时评估图像分词器在多模态联合训练中表现的系统化框架。
AI.method: 构建纯自回归测试平台，在文本、图像、T2I和I2T四种任务上进行多模态持续预训练，跟踪任务特定的验证损失，分析其缩放行为及其与下游性能的关联。利用损失作为分析透镜，研究多模态可学习性和分词器设计，并通过判别器、语义监督和词汇量三个维度进行案例研究。
AI.result: (1) 不同任务的损失呈现不同的缩放行为，并对分词器排名不同；(2) 固定分词器时T2I和I2T损失与生成质量相关，但跨分词器比较时T2I损失-性能关系会随图像词元空间变化，而基于共享文本词汇的I2T损失提供了更一致的信号；(3) 更好的重建性能不一定意味着更低的任务损失或更强的下游性能；(4) 图像分词器的选择会影响联合优化下的文本建模。
AI.conclusion: 该测试平台提供了研究图像分词器作为视觉语言的互补视角，揭示了图像与文本在联合多模态训练中的相互作用，并为未来分词器设计提供了基于任务损失的评估依据。

title: CRISP: Corneal Confocal Microscopy Real-Time Image Stitching Pipeline
summary:
Morphology of the sub-basal nerve plexus (SNP) reflects peripheral nerve health, and corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) provides an important means for in vivo, real-time, non-invasive observation of the SNP. However, mainstream CCM devices offer a limited field of view per frame, whereas the SNP is spatially non-uniform; discrete image sampling is therefore sensitive to sampling location and frame selection, which limits the reproducibility and clinical adoption of CCM as a quantitative assessment tool. Wide-field stitching can reconstruct larger SNP mosaics by integrating sequentially acquired CCM images, but existing methods largely rely on offline post-processing, additional hardware, or specific acquisition protocols, and lack open-source real-time solutions for conventional CCM video streams.
  This paper presents CRISP (Corneal confocal microscopy Real-time Image Stitching Pipeline), an open-source real-time SNP wide-field stitching framework for conventional CCM examination video streams. CRISP excludes defocused and discontinuous segments via focus-aware gating, propagates poses through local pairwise registration, and maintains non-redundant spatial coverage with a sparse anchor map; when local temporal continuity is interrupted, the system completes relocalization and subgraph merging through global appearance retrieval followed by geometric verification. The framework prioritizes low-latency coverage feedback during examination while outputting accepted frames, poses, and anchor information to initialize offline fine stitching.
  To our knowledge, CRISP is the first open-source real-time SNP wide-field stitching framework released for conventional CCM video streams. By lowering the barrier to adoption and reproduction of wide-field stitching, CRISP may help move SNP wide-field imaging from a research tool into routine clinical examination workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRISP，一个开源、实时的角膜共聚焦显微镜（CCM）视频流亚基底神经丛（SNP）宽视野拼接框架，通过焦点感知门控、局部配对配准、稀疏锚点图及全局重定位等模块，实现在传统CCM视频流上的低延迟宽视野图像重建，打破现有方法依赖离线处理或专用硬件的局限。
AI.motivation: CCM观察SNP对评估周围神经健康至关重要，但主流CCM设备单帧视野有限且SNP空间非均匀，导致采样位置和帧选择敏感、可重复性差；现有宽视野拼接方法依赖离线后处理、额外硬件或特定采集协议，缺乏面向传统CCM视频流的开源实时解决方案。
AI.method: CRISP框架包含四个关键模块：焦点感知门控排除离焦与不连续片段；局部配对配准传播位姿；稀疏锚点图维护非冗余空间覆盖；当局部时间连续性中断时，通过全局外观检索加几何验证完成重定位与子图合并。系统在检查过程中提供低延迟覆盖反馈，同时输出已接受帧、位姿和锚点信息用于离线精细拼接初始化。
AI.result: CRISP是首个面向传统CCM视频流的开源实时SNP宽视野拼接框架，降低宽视野拼接技术的采纳和复现门槛。
AI.conclusion: CRISP有望推动SNP宽视野成像从研究工具迈向常规临床检查流程，提升CCM作为定量评估工具的可重复性和临床可用性。

title: From Explicit References to Scene Manifolds: Distributional Fidelity and Realism for Radiance Field Quality Assessment
summary: Radiance field representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enable high-quality novel view synthesis but can introduce complex, view-dependent artifacts from reconstruction, rendering, and compression. Reliable perceptual quality assessment (QA) is thus essential for evaluating rendered views and guiding the design of perceptually faithful scene representations. Existing full-reference QA metrics require an aligned reference image, while recent cross-reference metrics relax this requirement by comparing a test view with non-aligned references. However, under wide-baseline radiance field settings, selecting a reliable nearby reference can be difficult, particularly when evaluating views along arbitrary trajectories and poses. We propose SCODA, a lightweight scene-conditioned objective QA method that shifts QA from explicit image-to-image comparison to scene-manifold modeling. High-quality observations of each scene are represented as a multivariate Gaussian distribution in deep feature space, producing a semantic fidelity score that measures deviation from the scene distribution. A weakly-supervised distortion-aware patch discriminator provides a complementary realism signal, and both cues are combined through an unsupervised bounded fusion strategy. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show strong agreement with human judgments and robust generalization across GS- and NeRF-generated views and trajectories. Code is publicly available at https://gitlab.com/saeedmp/scoda.

AI.tldr: SCODA是一种轻量级的场景条件目标质量评估方法，通过将质量评估从图像间比较转变为场景流形建模，在深度特征空间中用多元高斯分布表示高质量观察，结合弱监督失真感知判别器和无监督有界融合策略，实现无需对齐参考图像的辐射场视图质量评估。
AI.motivation: 现有全参考QA指标需要对齐参考图像，而跨参考指标虽然放宽了对齐要求，但在宽基线辐射场设置下难以选择可靠近邻参考，尤其是评估任意轨迹和姿态下的视图时。因此需要一种不依赖显式参考比较的场景级QA方法。
AI.method: SCODA首先将每个场景的高质量观察表示为深度特征空间中的多元高斯分布，生成衡量偏离场景分布程度的语义保真度分数；其次使用弱监督的失真感知patch判别器提供互补的逼真度信号；最后通过无监督有界融合策略将两种线索结合为最终质量分数。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，SCODA与人类判断高度一致，并在GS和NeRF生成的视图及轨迹上展现出鲁棒的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SCODA通过在场景级别而非图像级别进行质量评估，有效避开了近邻参考选择的难题，为辐射场表示下的感知质量评估提供了新的轻量级解决方案，代码已公开。

title: DF26: We Cannot Tell Fake From Real Anymore
summary: We introduce DF26, a novel benchmark for detecting AI-generated videos containing fully synthetic clips produced by recent text-to-video and image-to-video models. The videos capture single-person public-speaking scenarios, spanning direct-to-camera recordings, official statements, and studio interviews - 271 real and 2,420 synthetic videos generated by seven modern video models. The study on DF26 shows that human performance in detecting AI-generated videos, as well as state-of-the-art deepfake detectors, is close to random chance. Our results highlight the limitations of current evaluation protocols and motivate the need for benchmarks that explicitly measure robustness to modern generative model distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DF26基准数据集，用于检测由现代文本到视频和图像到视频模型生成的完全合成视频。该基准涵盖单人公共演讲场景，包含271个真实视频和2420个由七种现代视频模型生成的合成视频。研究发现人类和SOTA深度伪造检测器在DF26上的检测性能接近随机水平，揭示了当前评估协议的局限性和现代生成模型分布偏移带来的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法在面对现代AI生成视频模型时表现不佳，当前评估协议无法有效衡量检测器对生成模型分布偏移的鲁棒性。作者希望构建一个能够真实反映现代视频生成技术挑战的基准，推动该领域的发展。
AI.method: 构建了DF26基准数据集，收集271个真实视频和2420个由七种现代视频生成模型（包括文本到视频和图像到视频模型）产生的完全合成视频，涵盖直接对镜头录制、官方声明和演播室访谈等多种单人公共演讲场景。通过在DF26上测试人类和SOTA深度伪造检测器来评估检测性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，人类检测者以及当前最先进的深度伪造检测器在DF26基准上的检测准确率接近随机猜测水平，说明现有检测方法难以有效识别现代AI生成的合成视频。
AI.conclusion: 当前评估协议无法充分应对现代生成模型带来的分布偏移，研究强调了亟需开发能够明确测量对最新生成模型鲁棒性的基准，为未来AI视频检测研究提供了新的评估方向和标准。

title: TRAIL: Trajectory-Aware Visual Place Recognition against Unordered Databases
summary: Modern Visual Place Recognition (VPR) methods excel on standard benchmarks yet remain brittle in feature-poor environments. By treating each query image in isolation, they discard the sequential context in any real trajectory. We formalize a task that exploits this context: given a query sequence, localize the final image against an unordered reference database -- which, unlike sequence-to-sequence methods, requires no sequential structure in the database. We propose TRAIL (TRajectory-Aware Image Localization), a principled framework based on Conditional Random Fields (CRF) that combines learned functions for visual similarity and for camera-motion consistency, refining a distribution over candidate references as each query arrives. A lightweight post-processing layer atop any pre-trained VPR backbone, TRAIL improves a state-of-the-art baseline by up to 8.3 percentage points on our primary benchmark, transfers to unseen datasets without retraining, and delivers its largest gains where visual cues are scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRAIL框架，利用查询序列的连续上下文来提升视觉位置识别（VPR）在特征匮乏环境中的鲁棒性。TRAIL基于条件随机场（CRF），结合视觉相似度与相机运动一致性函数，在查询图像到达时逐步细化候选参考图像的分布。该框架可轻量地叠加在任何预训练VPR骨干之上，在主要基准上将最先进基线提升最高8.3个百分点，且无需重新训练即可迁移至未见数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有VPR方法在标准基准上表现优异，但在特征匮乏的环境中仍然脆弱。根本原因在于这些方法将每张查询图像孤立处理，丢弃了真实轨迹中固有的序列上下文信息。本文旨在利用这一被忽视的上下文来增强定位能力。
AI.method: TRAIL提出了一种基于条件随机场（CRF）的框架：将轨迹中的查询图像序列建模为图结构，联合建模视觉相似度（衡量查询图像与参考库的匹配度）与相机运动一致性（约束相邻查询间的空间连贯性）。作为一种轻量级后处理层，TRAIL可部署在任何预训练VPR骨干之上，随每个查询到达逐步更新候选参考的分布。
AI.result: 在主要基准上，TRAIL将最先进的基线方法提升了最高8.3个百分点；无需重新训练即可迁移至未见数据集；且在视觉线索稀少的场景中获得了最大的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: TRAIL证明了轨迹级上下文对于VPR的重要性，其设计形式化了一个更为通用的任务——只需参考库无序存档，即可利用查询序列信息，避免了序列到序列方法对数据库顺序结构的依赖，为特征贫乏环境中的鲁棒定位提供了有效且可迁移的解决方案。

title: Social Intuition vs. Machine Reasoning: Anticipating Human-Robot Interaction from multiple modalities
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Workshop paper accepted to The 4th Workshop on Nonverbal Cues for Human-Robot Cooperative Intelligence at IROS 2026
summary: Anticipating whether a person will interact from one's own perspective is a highly intuitive task for humans, that relies on a combination of cues. We investigate how humans perform at predicting a person's intention to interact from a service robot's point of view, using pose-only or full video input, then benchmark different lightweight pose-based models and state-of-the-art vision-language models. We conducted our benchmark on the HUI360 dataset on a fixed pilot subset of 100 test tracks (25 positive, 75 negative). We found that with pose-only input, human annotators outperform lightweight trained pose models but not by large margins (+0.08 in F1-Score). But when given full egocentric video with a target bounding box, human annotators perform substantially better and largely outperform the Vision-Language Models (+0.2 in F1-Score). We also compared VLMs of different size and under different input conditions, and found that the best results do not correlate with model size. Our result confirms that predicting interactions is a challenging task for social robots and that reasoning-capable models are necessary but their actual reasoning capabilities alone do not suffice to match the social intuition of humans.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了从服务机器人视角预测人类互动意图的任务。研究发现，在仅使用姿态输入时，人类标注者仅略优于轻量级姿态模型（F1分数高0.08）；但在完整第一视角视频配合目标边界框条件下，人类显著优于视觉语言模型（F1分数高0.2）。同时发现VLM的最佳表现与模型大小无直接关联，表明预测互动对社交机器人而言是挑战性任务，仅有推理能力的模型不足以匹配人类的社交直觉。
AI.motivation: 从自身视角预测他人是否会与自己互动对人类而言是直观的任务，但对服务机器人来说却充满挑战。作者希望通过系统对比人类与不同模型在此任务上的表现，明确现有AI方法（包括轻量级姿态模型和视觉语言模型）与人类社交直觉之间的差距，从而为社交机器人的交互预测能力提供基准参考。
AI.method: 在HUI360数据集上选取100条测试轨迹（25条正样本、75条负样本）作为固定子集进行基准测试。对比了（1）人类标注者在仅姿态输入和完整视频输入下的表现；（2）多个轻量级基于姿态的模型；（3）不同规模的视觉语言模型及其在不同输入条件下的表现。
AI.result: 姿态输入条件下，人类标注者的F1分数仅比轻量级训练姿态模型高0.08；但在完整第一视角视频配合目标边界框输入下，人类表现大幅优于视觉语言模型，F1分数高出0.2。此外，不同规模的VLM表现与其模型大小无正相关关系。
AI.conclusion: 预测人类互动意图对社交机器人而言是一个具有挑战性的任务。具备推理能力的模型是必要的，但仅有推理能力并不足以匹敌人类的社交直觉，提示未来需要在推理能力之外进一步探索其他能力维度的提升。

title: Federated Binary Gating with Server-Side Vision-Language Inference for Surveillance Anomaly Classification
summary:
Privacy-sensitive surveillance systems could benefit from large vision-language models (VLMs), but such models typically require centralized access to raw video. In federated learning settings, this challenge is amplified by non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) client data, which can make direct multiclass anomaly classification unstable, especially for rare categories. We propose a hybrid two-stage architecture that combines a federated binary convolutional neural network (CNN) gate with server-side zero-shot VLM inference. The lightweight LiteCNN3D gate performs local anomaly screening and forwards only flagged videos to Qwen3-VL-8B, which assigns them to four anomaly metaclasses. We evaluate this design on UCF-Crime grouped into five coarse metaclasses and implement the federated stage in a real three-node heterogeneous deployment.
  In the studied setting, direct federated multiclass training collapses, whereas the proposed decomposition yields a better trade-off between classification quality and raw-video transmission. With fixed-threshold routing, the federated hybrid pipeline preserves nearly the same macro-averaged F1 score (F1-macro) as its centralized CNN+VLM counterpart while reducing the fraction of transmitted videos to 51.4%, although with a lower proxy macro receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC AUC) than the centralized hybrid system. A complementary sensitivity-oriented routing operating point increases macro ROC AUC from 0.673 to 0.692 and reduces the false negative rate from 29.3% to 22.9%, but decreases F1-macro from 0.503 to 0.485 while increasing transmission from 51.4% to 57.9%. These results suggest that federation is better suited to coarse local screening, while routing rules can be adjusted to trade server-side VLM usage for higher anomaly sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合两阶段架构，将联邦二分类CNN门控（LiteCNN3D）与服务器端零样本VLM（Qwen3-VL-8B）结合，用于隐私敏感的监控视频异常分类。联邦阶段仅传输被标记的视频到服务器进行四类异常分类，解决了直接联邦多分类在非独立同分布数据下的训练崩溃问题，并在真实三节点异构部署中验证了效果。
AI.motivation: 隐私敏感的监控系统希望利用大视觉语言模型（VLM），但VLM通常需要集中访问原始视频。在联邦学习场景中，非独立同分布（non-IID）客户端数据导致直接多分类异常分类不稳定，尤其是罕见类别，因此需要一种能在联邦环境下有效利用VLM能力的混合架构。
AI.method: 采用混合两阶段架构：第一阶段使用轻量级LiteCNN3D联邦二分类CNN门控进行本地异常筛选，仅将标记的视频转发到服务器端；第二阶段由服务器端的Qwen3-VL-8B零样本VLM将视频归类到四种异常元类。在UCF-Crime数据集（分为五个粗粒度元类）上评估，并以真实三节点异构部署实现联邦阶段。提出固定阈值路由和灵敏度导向路由两种操作点。
AI.result: 直接联邦多分类训练发生崩溃，而所提分解方法在分类质量和原始视频传输之间取得更好权衡。固定阈值路由下，联邦混合管道的F1-macro几乎与集中式CNN+VLM相当，同时传输视频比例降至51.4%，但代理macro ROC AUC低于集中式混合系统。灵敏度导向路由将macro ROC AUC从0.673提升至0.692，假阴性率从29.3%降至22.9%，但F1-macro从0.503降至0.485，传输比例从51.4%增至57.9%。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习更适合粗粒度本地筛选任务，而路由规则可以通过调整服务器端VLM使用量来换取更高的异常灵敏度，为隐私敏感监控系统提供了一种兼顾隐私保护与分类性能的可行方案。

title: Multi-label versus multi-class classification of blood cells and their aggregates in microfluidic channels
summary: Deformability cytometry (DC) is a type of imaging flow cytometry, which uses a camera-equipped device to measure cellular stiffness in addition to other cellular properties at high throughput. Cellular properties such as area and elongation can identify cell types, but this requires prior knowledge of distinguishing properties and cannot be applied to clinically important cell aggregates. Using DC data, we evaluated conventional multi-class (MC) classification and introduced a multi-label (ML) approach for identifying blood cells and their aggregates. In particular, an ML classifier can simultaneously assign multiple cell-type labels to a single imaged event. We show that, unlike MC classification, ML classification can identify cell aggregates not represented in the training data. It also avoids the need for exhaustive, strictly defined aggregate labels, thereby simplifying and speeding up annotation. Since automated blood analyzers do not reliably analyze cell aggregates, our approach may help address this clinical gap.

AI.tldr: 本文针对变形性细胞计数（DC）数据，引入多标签（ML）分类方法来识别血细胞及其聚集体，克服了传统多类（MC）分类需要预先知识且无法处理细胞聚集体的局限，能够识别训练数据中未出现的细胞聚集体，并简化标注流程。
AI.motivation: 传统多类分类方法需要事先知道区分细胞类型的特性，且无法应用于临床重要的细胞聚集体；自动血液分析仪无法可靠分析细胞聚集体，存在临床空白需要填补。
AI.method: 使用变形性细胞计数（DC）数据，对比传统的多类（MC）分类方法，引入多标签（ML）分类器，使其能同时对单个成像事件分配多个细胞类型标签。
AI.result: 与MC分类不同，ML分类能够识别训练数据中未出现的细胞聚集体，并且避免了需要详尽、严格定义的聚集体标签的需求，从而简化并加速了标注过程。
AI.conclusion: 多标签分类方法有望帮助解决自动血液分析仪无法可靠分析细胞聚集体的临床缺口，为临床血细胞分析提供更优方案。

title: RelightFormer: Feed-forward Generative Transformer for Multiview Object Relighting
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026. Hejun and Jinxi are co-first authors. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/vLAR-group/RelightFormer
summary: Image relighting is traditionally tackled via complex inverse rendering pipelines, which suffer from ill-posed optimization, or single-image generative models that ignore crucial multi-view cues necessary for understanding 3D geometry and material interactions. To address these limitations, we introduce a feed-forward generative Transformer for direct single- and multi-view image relighting that entirely bypasses explicit intrinsic property estimation. Adapted from a video foundation model, our architecture features a latent illumination module that dynamically injects target environment maps into spatial features via cross-attention. Furthermore, we employ permutation-invariant positional encodings to symmetrically process unordered multi-view inputs without sequential bias. To train this robust data-driven model, we construct the massive Laval Objaverse Dataset (LOD), comprising 90K objects and 39K unique illuminations. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art visual quality, photorealistic relighting quality, and strong zero-shot generalization across single-view, multi-view, and novel-view relighting tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的前馈式生成式重打光方法，直接从单视图或多视图输入生成重新打光后的图像，完全绕过显式的内在属性（材质、几何）估计。方法从视频基础模型适配而来，通过潜在光照模块实现目标环境贴图的动态注入，并使用置换不变的位置编码对称处理多视图输入。作者还构建了包含90K物体和39K种光照的大规模数据集LOD用于训练，在单视图、多视图和新视角重打光任务上均达到最先进的视觉效果和零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统图像重打光依赖复杂的逆渲染管线，存在不适定优化问题；而单图像生成模型忽略了多视图提示中蕴含的3D几何与材质交互关键信息。作者希望突破这些局限，提出一种无需显式内在属性估计的直接重打光方案。
AI.method: 1) 采用前馈式生成式Transformer架构，从视频基础模型适配而来；2) 设计潜在光照模块，通过交叉注意力将目标环境贴图动态注入空间特征；3) 使用置换不变的位置编码，以对称方式处理无序的多视图输入；4) 构建大规模数据集Laval Objaverse Dataset（LOD），包含90K物体和39K种独特光照。
AI.result: 在单视图、多视图和新视角重打光任务上均达到最先进的视觉质量和照片级真实感的重打光效果，展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了绕过显式逆渲染的基于学习的前馈式生成方法能够有效解决图像重打光问题，且将视频基础模型适配用于光照编辑任务是一种可行的技术路线。

title: Self-Supervised Multi-View 3D Gaze Target Estimation via Probabilistic Ray Marching
summary: We present a self-supervised approach, Self-MVGTE, for estimating 3D gaze targets from multiple camera views. Unlike existing methods that independently estimate 2D gaze targets per camera view, Self-MVGTE predicts gaze targets directly in 3D space for the first time. Moreover, it does not require any ground-truth annotations from the target scene and uses only the multi-view input images from a calibrated camera setup, pseudo 2D gaze target labels from a monocular gaze target estimation model, and 3D gaze vectors from a monocular 3D gaze estimation model. A key challenge is that these pseudo labels are inherently noisy and multi-view inconsistent. To address this, we propose a probabilistic ray marching framework, which models the uncertainty of these pseudo labels and exploits 3D gaze vectors as geometric priors. Specifically, these gaze vectors are first integrated into the monocular gaze target estimation model to improve its generalization to unseen scenes, producing higher-quality pseudo labels. Then, for 3D gaze target estimation, we construct a 3D gaze cone by casting a bundle of rays from the eye position around the gaze vector to strictly constrain the solution space. Within this cone, we propose a depth-guided feature sampling strategy using off-the-shelf DINOv2 and Depth-Anything-3 models, and estimate a spatial likelihood distribution of the gaze target. Finally, we convert the pseudo gaze target labels into a target distribution and softly optimize the network. Extensive experiments on the MVGT dataset show that Self-MVGTE achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing fully-supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: Self-MVGTE是一种自监督的多视角3D视线目标估计方法，首次直接在3D空间中预测视线目标，无需目标场景的任何真值标注。它采用概率射线行进框架，利用3D视线向量作为几何先验来约束解空间，结合DINOv2和Depth-Anything-3进行深度引导的特征采样，最终在MVGT数据集上超越了现有全监督基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常对每个相机视图独立估计2D视线目标，缺乏跨视图一致性，且依赖大量人工标注。作者希望首次直接在3D空间中预测视线目标，同时摆脱对目标场景真值标注的依赖。
AI.method: (1) 将单目3D视线向量集成到单目视线目标估计模型中，提升其在未见场景中的泛化能力，生成更高质量的伪标签；(2) 构建3D视线锥，从眼部位置沿视线向量发射一束射线以严格约束解空间；(3) 在锥内利用DINOv2和Depth-Anything-3模型提出深度引导的特征采样策略，估计视线目标的空间似然分布；(4) 将伪标签转换为目标分布，以软优化方式训练网络。
AI.result: 在MVGT数据集上的大量实验表明，Self-MVGTE取得了最先进的性能，超越了现有的全监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Self-MVGTE验证了通过概率射线行进框架建模伪标签不确定性并利用3D视线向量作为几何先验，可以在无真值标注的情况下实现高质量的多视角3D视线目标估计，甚至优于全监督方法。

title: Unified Vision-Centric Pedestrian Crossing Action Prediction via Adaptive Patch Projection and Proactive Spatial Rectification
summary: Vision cues are available and informative for pedestrian action prediction, but obtaining stable target-centric representations from video frames remains challenging without frame-level external perception cues. Thus, most methods rely on additional perception modules or multi-source information fusion, leaving the reliability of vision-centric setting an open question. To this end, we propose ViCross, a vision-centric pedestrian crossing action prediction framework powered by multimodal large language models, which maintains target-centric reasoning from video frames without additional perception modules beyond first-frame target initialization. While multimodal large language models exhibit strong visual understanding, applying them directly to vision-centric action prediction faces two challenges. First, accurately perceiving target pedestrians often requires high resolution inputs and dense visual tokenization, making full-frame encoding computationally prohibitive. ViCross tackles this with Variable Resolution Patch Mapping module for efficient token allocation while preserving key pedestrian details. Second, missing spatiotemporal priors hinder consistent cross frame reasoning. ViCross mitigates this with a Spatial Constraint Enhancement Strategy that captures past motion, future locations, and action semantics for training-time proactive spatial rectification. Extensive experiments show that ViCross delivers clear gains in vision-centric prediction settings and is competitive with multi-source fusion approaches in several settings. Code is available at https://github.com/2tianyao1/ViCross.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViCross，一个以视觉为中心的行人过街动作预测框架，利用多模态大语言模型实现无需额外感知模块的目标中心推理，通过可变分辨率补丁映射和空间约束增强策略解决高分辨率计算代价大和时空先验缺失两大挑战。
AI.motivation: 大多数行人动作预测方法依赖额外感知模块或多源信息融合，视觉中心设置的可靠性仍是开放问题，亟需探索仅依赖视频帧的目标中心推理方法。
AI.method: ViCross采用两个关键技术：(1)可变分辨率补丁映射模块(VRPM)，实现高效的token分配同时保留关键行人细节；(2)空间约束增强策略(SCES)，在训练时捕捉过去运动、未来位置和动作语义进行主动空间校正，弥补时空先验缺失。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ViCross在视觉中心预测设置中取得明显改进，并在多种设置下与多源融合方法具有竞争力。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.conclusion: ViCross验证了纯视觉中心设置下行人过街动作预测的可行性，证明了无需额外感知模块即可通过多模态大语言模型实现可靠的预测，为视觉中心行人预测提供了有效的解决方案。

title: AFID: A Unified Open Framework for Automated Fingermark Identification, Quality Assessment and Feature Extraction
summary: Automated fingermark identification is the foundation of forensic investigation, yet progress in the field is held back by fragmented, closed-source solutions trained on private or discontinued data. We present AFID, a unified open-source framework for friction ridge image processing that performs recognition, quality assessment, and feature extraction based on a single shared encoder, trained exclusively on publicly available data. At its core is a fixed-length representation learned for identity discrimination, trained under heavy augmentation. Despite applying essentially no preprocessing beyond resizing and padding at inference, AFID sets a new state of the art in fixed-length fingermark recognition, leading identification across NIST SD 27 (67.6% rank-1) , SD 302 (54.9% rank-1), and SD 303 (67.6% rank-1), surpassing a commercial matcher on fingermarks. From the same frozen backbone, a quality assessment module predicts recognition utility more accurately than any compared baseline and generalizes across independent matchers, while lightweight decoders recover minutiae, ridge orientation, and segmentation competitive with dedicated methods. The framework proves that a single, efficiently trained encoder can support the full fingermark processing pipeline, from recognition through quality assessment all the way to feature extraction. To accelerate research on fingermark analysis even further, we release the code, models, and annotations to the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AFID，一个统一的开放源码指纹（指印）图像处理框架，基于单一共享编码器同时完成识别、质量评估和特征提取，在多个标准数据集上刷新了固定长度指印识别的最先进水平，并开源了代码、模型和标注。
AI.motivation: 自动指印识别是法医调查的基础，但该领域因碎片化、闭源解决方案以及依赖私有或已停用数据进行训练而进展缓慢，亟需一个统一、开源且基于公开数据的框架。
AI.method: 提出AFID框架，基于一个在强数据增强下训练、用于身份区分的固定长度表示编码器。推理时仅需调整大小和填充等极简预处理，同一冻结骨干网络可支撑三个下游任务：识别、质量评估（预测识别效用）和特征提取（细节点、脊线方向、分割），轻量解码器用于恢复特征。
AI.result: AFID在NIST SD 27（67.6% rank-1）、SD 302（54.9% rank-1）和SD 303（67.6% rank-1）上刷新了指印识别最先进水平，超过商业匹配器；质量评估模块在预测识别效用方面优于所有对比基线并能跨独立匹配器泛化；特征提取与专用方法竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: 单一高效训练的编码器足以支撑完整的指印处理流水线（识别→质量评估→特征提取），证明统一框架的可行性，并通过开源加速该领域的社区研究。

title: Parser-Free VLM Verification for Federated Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
summary: How can vision-language models help video anomaly detection (VAD) when surveillance data remain distributed, weakly labeled, and resource-constrained? Most weakly supervised VAD methods assume centralized training; recent VLM-based extensions further rely on dense inference, generated explanations, or additional adaptation. We introduce a lightweight federated MIL-VLM cascade in which only a compact MIL scorer is trained across clients, while a frozen VLM verifies high-scoring suspect segments post hoc. We study two VLM feedback interfaces: parsed text-generation decisions and a logit-based interface that extracts a continuous anomaly score from next-token Yes/No probabilities. Experiments on UCF-Crime with InternVL3.5-2B and Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct show that text-generation verification can improve frame-level AUC after diagnostic temporal post-processing, but remains sensitive to prompts, parsers, model choice, and smoothing. In contrast, the logit interface provides a fixed parser-free signal that improves both frame-level AUC and frame-level AP over the MIL baseline across both VLMs, without temporal post-processing in its main configuration. Since suspect segments are updated independently once available, next-token logit feedback provides a simple segment-local alternative to text-generation verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级联邦MIL-VLM级联框架用于视频异常检测（VAD），仅在各客户端训练紧凑的MIL评分器，用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）事后验证高置信度的可疑片段。比较了两种VLM反馈接口：文本生成决策和基于logit的连续异常分数（从下一个token Yes/No概率中提取）。在UCF-Crime数据集上使用InternVL3.5-2B和Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct实验表明，logit接口提供无解析器的固定信号，能一致提升帧级AUC和AP，而文本生成验证虽可提升帧级AUC但依赖提示、解析器、模型选择和平滑处理。
AI.motivation: 大部分弱监督VAD方法假设集中式训练，而近期基于VLM的扩展依赖密集推理、生成的解释或额外适配，这在分布式、弱标注和资源受限的监控数据场景下不适用。作者旨在探索如何在这种受限条件下利用VLM辅助VAD。
AI.method: 提出联邦MIL-VLM级联框架：各客户端仅训练一个紧凑的MIL评分器，冻结的VLM事后验证高评分可疑片段。研究两种VLM反馈接口：1）解析的文本生成决策；2）logit接口——从下一个token Yes/No概率中提取连续异常分数。可疑片段可独立更新。
AI.result: 在UCF-Crime上，文本生成验证经诊断性时间后处理后能提升帧级AUC，但对提示、解析器、模型选择和平滑敏感；相比之下logit接口提供无解析器的固定信号，在两种VLM下均一致提升帧级AUC和AP，且其主配置无需时间后处理。
AI.conclusion: logit接口的next-token反馈是一种简单且无需片段全局依赖的验证方案，比文本生成验证更稳健高效，适用于资源受限的联邦VAD场景。

title: Latent-to-Latent Flow for Volumetric Stochastic Segmentation
summary: Uncertainty arising from inter-observer variability in medical image segmentation plays an important role in developing treatment plans. Research in this area is inhibited by the lack of multiple annotations for large-scale medical datasets, especially for volumetric data, which suffers from additional scaling and computational complexity challenges. Flow matching has emerged as a powerful framework for generative modelling and has also been demonstrated to maintain strong performance when working with latent representations of images. In this work, we introduce a latent-to-latent flow technique for stochastic segmentation of medical volumes via encoded representations of both the image and label space. We evaluate our method on two challenging applications covering delineation uncertainty for radiotherapy planning and multiple organ structure segmentation, improving efficiency up to 14x compared with full resolution models while maintaining clinically relevant performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于潜空间到潜空间（latent-to-latent）流匹配技术的医学体积图像随机分割方法，通过对图像和标签空间进行编码表示来建模分割中的观测者间不确定性，在放疗规划和多器官分割任务上实现了相比全分辨率模型最高14倍的计算效率提升，同时保持临床相关的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割中观测者间变异性带来的不确定性对治疗计划制定至关重要，但大规模医学数据集中缺少多标注数据，尤其是三维体积数据还面临额外的缩放和计算复杂性挑战，限制了该领域的研究进展。
AI.method: 采用流匹配（flow matching）框架，引入一种潜空间到潜空间的流技术，通过同时对图像和标签空间进行编码表示，实现对医学体积数据的随机分割，以生成式方式建模分割结果中的不确定性。
AI.result: 在两个具有挑战性的应用（放疗计划的分割不确定性刻画和多器官结构分割）上进行了评估，相比全分辨率模型计算效率最高提升14倍，同时保持临床相关的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的潜空间流匹配方法有效解决了医学体积分割中不确定性建模所面临的数据稀缺和计算复杂性问题，为临床环境下的高效随机分割提供了可行方案。

title: When Superpixels Fail on Documents: A Study of Segmentation for LIME Explanations
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 1 table, XAI Workshop @ IJCAI 2026
summary: Post-hoc explanation methods are widely used to inspect image classifiers, but their reliability depends on design choices that are often treated as implementation details. We study this issue for LIME on document image classification, focusing on the segmentation step that defines the interpretable units being perturbed. Standard image-based LIME typically relies on natural-image superpixels, which are poorly aligned with document structure such as text regions, layout blocks, and identification codes. Using RVL-CDIP, we compare Quickshift and SLIC with document-aware segmentations based on OCR bounding boxes and regular grids. Our results show that segmentation strongly affects explanation consistency, correctness, and local fidelity. Document-aware segmentations produce more stable and faithful explanations, require fewer perturbations to converge, and expose shortcut behaviour based on document identification codes, a known RVL-CDIP bias that superpixel-based LIME often obscures. These findings show that reliable post-hoc explanation requires domain-aware interpretable representations, and that segmentation should be treated as part of the explanation method rather than as neutral preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LIME在文档图像分类中的分割步骤选择问题，发现文档感知的分割方法（基于OCR边界框和规则网格）相比自然图像超像素（Quickshift和SLIC）能产生更稳定、更忠实的解释，且能暴露RVL-CDIP中基于文档识别码的捷径行为。
AI.motivation: 事后解释方法的可靠性依赖于常被视为实现细节的设计选择，特别是LIME的分割步骤。标准图像分割（自然图像超像素）与文档结构（文本区域、布局块、识别码）对齐不良，可能导致不可靠的解释。
AI.method: 在RVL-CDIP数据集上，对比Quickshift和SLIC两种自然图像分割方法与基于OCR边界框和规则网格的文档感知分割方法在LIME框架中的表现，评估解释一致性、正确性和局部保真度。
AI.result: 分割方法强烈影响解释的一致性、正确性和局部保真度。文档感知分割产生更稳定和忠实的解释，所需扰动更少即可收敛，并能暴露基于文档识别码的捷径行为（RVL-CDIP的已知偏差），而超像素LIME往往掩盖此问题。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的事后解释需要领域感知的可解释表示，分割应被视为解释方法的一部分而非中性预处理步骤。

title: CrACK: Adversarial Attacks on Cross-Model Consistency in Collaborative Vision Foundation Models
summary: Training-free collaborative pipelines that integrate Vision Foundation Models such as CLIP, SAM, and DINO achieve strong open-vocabulary dense prediction and are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications. The security of these systems is commonly assumed to follow from the robustness of their individual models. We challenge this assumption. We identify a vulnerability shared by every collaborative pipeline: each model consumes the intermediate output of another without verifying semantic consistency, an unverified premise that we term the semantic-spatial alignment dependency. Existing adversarial attacks target a single model and overlook this premise, leaving the inter-model interface entirely unguarded. We propose CrACK (Cross-model Adversarial Consistency attack), an inference-time attack that exploits this interface without modifying any input pixel, model weight, or training data. CrACK operates in two stages: Adversarial Affinity Contradiction Injection corrupts the cross-modal affinity matrix by inverting SAM encoder features under the guidance of CLIP patch-level semantics, and Semantic Interface Poisoning steers the prediction through a max-distance label permutation derived from CLIP text embeddings. Experiments on four collaborative pipelines across eight benchmarks show that CrACK causes catastrophic degradation while every individual model continues to produce its unchanged standalone output, rendering per-model defenses structurally blind. The corruption further cascades into large vision-language model reasoning, driving models such as LLaVA to produce erroneous responses from visually intact inputs. Our results show that the security of a collaborative AI system cannot be reduced to the robustness of its components, and that inter-model feature interfaces must be treated as first-class security boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrACK攻击，利用协作式视觉管道中模型间共享的"语义-空间对齐依赖"漏洞，在不修改任何输入像素、模型权重或训练数据的条件下，通过破坏跨模型特征接口实现灾难性性能退化，且单个模型自身输出完全不变，使逐模型防御机制结构性失灵。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全研究普遍假设协作管道的安全性可由其组成模型的鲁棒性推得，但这一假设存在漏洞：管道中每个模型消费另一个模型的中间输出时未验证语义一致性（即语义-空间对齐依赖）。现有对抗攻击只针对单一模型，忽视了模型间接口这一完全未设防的环节。
AI.method: CrACK攻击分为两个阶段：1）对抗亲和矛盾注入（AAI）：通过反转SAM编码器特征并在CLIP patch级语义指导下，破坏跨模态亲和矩阵；2）语义接口投毒（SIP）：利用CLIP文本嵌入推导最大距离标签置换，引导最终预测偏离正确结果。
AI.result: 在4个协作管道、8个基准上的实验显示，CrACK导致灾难性退化，而每个单模型仍产生与独立运行时完全一致的输出，使逐模型防御在结构上失效。攻击还能级联影响大视觉语言模型如LLaVA，使其在视觉输入完整无误的情况下产生错误回答。
AI.conclusion: 协作AI系统的安全性不能简化为其各组件鲁棒性的加总，模型间特征接口必须被视为第一等的安全边界加以防护。

title: Mitigating Shortcut Learning: Texture-Penalized Prototype Networks
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 22nd IEEE International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS 2026)
summary: Standard Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) exhibit severe performance degradation due to a strong inductive texture bias that prioritizes local, high-frequency patterns over global structural shapes. This dependency causes confident misclassifications during textural changes or environmental effects. To address this flaw, this study introduces the Texture-Penalized Prototype Network (TPPN), a novel architectural framework that shifts this inherent bias without depending on resource-intensive augmented datasets. Specifically, a Texture-Penalization Branch (TPB) imposes a penalty to suppress the extraction of local texture proxies, forcing the network backbone to discard high-frequency cues and extract purified, shape-biased representations. By evaluating similarities within a prototype-based hypersphere derived from the final convolutional features, the approach enforces strict geometric constraints, treating objects as compositions of essential parts to achieve robust classification. Evaluations on texture-shape cue-conflict datasets and synthetic noise benchmarks demonstrate the stronger shape bias of this structural disentanglement. The proposed framework reduces the inherent texture bias of a baseline ResNet-50 from 55.11% to 29.73%, surpassing the texture-suppression capabilities of an off-the-shelf Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16). Furthermore, the approach demonstrates robust generalization under cue-conflict conditions, resisting textural shortcut learning when encountering Out-of-Distribution (OOD) shapes. The model maintains stronger shape accuracy against elevated perturbations. On clean validation data, the architecture incurs a minimal drop in accuracy of 0.90 percentage points. This provides a structural, efficient solution to CNN texture bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出纹理惩罚原型网络（TPPN），通过在CNN中引入纹理惩罚分支，抑制高频纹理特征提取，促使网络学习形状偏置表征，并在原型超球面上施加几何约束，从而显著降低CNN的纹理偏置，提升形状识别能力。
AI.motivation: 标准CNN由于强烈的归纳式纹理偏置，倾向于依赖局部高频纹理模式而非全局结构形状进行识别，导致在纹理变化或环境干扰下产生错误分类。现有方法依赖资源密集的数据增强，不够高效。
AI.method: 提出TPPN框架，包含纹理惩罚分支（TPB）以惩罚机制抑制局部纹理代理的提取，迫使骨干网络丢弃高频线索并提取纯化的形状偏置表征；同时在基于最终卷积特征的原型超球面上评估相似性，施加严格的几何约束，将物体视为本质部件的组合以实现鲁棒分类。
AI.result: 在纹理-形状线索冲突数据集和合成噪声基准上，将ResNet-50的纹理偏置从55.11%降至29.73%，超越ViT-B/16的纹理抑制能力；在OOD形状和扰动下保持较强形状精度，在干净验证数据上仅损失0.90个百分点精度。
AI.conclusion: TPPN提供了一种结构化、高效的解决方案，在不依赖资源密集增强数据集的前提下有效缓解了CNN的纹理偏置问题。

title: PICANet: Physics-Informed Cascaded Asymmetric Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection (ISTD) is an important research direction in image processing. However, existing methods are limited by severe background noise propagation and target degradation in high-level semantic features. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a plug-and-play physics-informed cascaded asymmetric network, named PICANet. Specifically, we construct a hierarchical prior decoupling module to explicitly extract low-level and high-level physical information, thereby characterizing target features at different levels rather than relying solely on convolutional extraction. Furthermore, a dual-prior interactive fusion module is developed to dynamically refine target representations while suppressing complex background clutter. Unlike previous work, a multi-level cross-feature attention module with the cascaded asymmetric mechanism is introduced to achieve precise alignment between high-level semantics and low-level spatial details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed PICANet outperforms state-of-the-art ISTD methods, showing satisfactory detection accuracy even against complex backgrounds. Our code is available at https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/PICANet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种即插即用的物理信息级联非对称网络（PICANet），用于红外小目标检测（ISTD）。该网络通过层次先验解耦模块提取不同级别的物理信息，通过双先验交互融合模块抑制背景杂波，并引入多级跨特征注意力模块实现高级语义与低级空间细节的精确对齐。实验表明PICANet在复杂背景下超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有红外小目标检测方法受限于两个主要问题：一是严重的背景噪声传播，二是高级语义特征中的目标退化。这些问题导致检测精度在复杂背景下表现不佳，需要一种能更好地保留目标特征并抑制噪声的新型方法。
AI.method: 本文提出PICANet，包含三个关键模块：（1）层次先验解耦模块，显式提取低级和高级物理信息，用于在不同层级表征目标特征；（2）双先验交互融合模块，动态细化目标表示并抑制复杂背景杂波；（3）多级跨特征注意力模块，采用级联非对称机制，实现高级语义与低级空间细节的精确对齐。整个网络作为即插即用模块设计。
AI.result: 广泛的实验结果表明，PICANet在红外小目标检测任务上优于现有的最先进方法，在复杂背景下仍能保持令人满意的检测精度。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: PICANet通过引入物理信息先验和级联非对称机制，有效解决了背景噪声传播和目标退化问题，为红外小目标检测提供了新的解决思路，并在多种复杂场景中验证了其优越性。

title: Topologically Consistent Agricultural Parcel Vectorization with Semantic-Guided Diffusion and Topology-Aware Polygonization
summary: Agricultural parcel polygons play a fundamental role in geospatial applications such as precision agriculture, land administration, and crop monitoring. Beyond regular polygon geometry and low vertex redundancy, practical parcel maps should avoid topological conflicts and preserve common boundaries between adjacent fields. Yet this requirement remains largely unresolved: segmentation-based methods mainly produce parcel masks or raster boundary cues and rely on heuristic raster-to-vector conversion, instance- and contour-based methods reconstruct parcels independently, and recent vector-oriented methods improve polygon regularity but do not explicitly recover adjacent parcels from a shared topological structure. To address this gap, we propose a semantic-guided diffusion framework for topologically consistent agricultural parcel vectorization. It couples joint edge--vertex latent diffusion with supervised multi-cue conditioning to generate geometrically regularised parcel-boundary and vertex primitives while suppressing false-positive responses. A topology-aware parcel polygon reconstruction method then converts these primitives into regular polygons by reconstructing parcel faces from a common planar graph, enabling adjacent predicted parcels to reuse shared boundaries and avoid mutual interior intrusion. Extensive experiments on the AI4SmallFarms and iFLYTEK datasets evaluate parcel vectorization in terms of pixel-level coverage, geometric fidelity, object-level correctness, and topological consistency. The results show strong and competitive performance, with zero measured intrusion ratio and the highest shared-edge recall, demonstrating the potential of the proposed framework for accurate, regular, and topologically consistent agricultural parcel vectorization.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种语义引导的扩散框架用于农业地块矢量化，通过联合边-顶点潜扩散和拓扑感知的多边形重建，生成几何规整且拓扑一致的地块多边形。
AI.motivation: 现有农业地块矢量化方法存在不足：分割方法依赖启发式栅格转矢量且缺乏拓扑一致性；实例和轮廓方法独立重建地块不共享边界；现有矢量导向方法未显式恢复相邻地块的共享拓扑结构。
AI.method: 该框架包括：(1) 联合边-顶点潜扩散模型，结合监督多线索条件生成几何规整的地块边界和顶点基元并抑制误检；(2) 拓扑感知的地块多边形重建方法，从公共平面图重建地块面，使相邻地块复用共享边界并避免内部互相侵入。
AI.result: 在AI4SmallFarms和iFLYTEK数据集上，该方法在像素覆盖、几何保真度、目标级正确性和拓扑一致性方面表现优异，实现了零侵入率和最高的共享边召回率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在农业地块矢量化中实现了准确、规整且拓扑一致的结果，展示了其在实际应用中的潜力。

title: When Semantically Consistent Encoding Meets View-Label Heterogeneity Modeling: A Unified Framework for Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Learning
summary: Incomplete multi-view multi-label learning requires not only robust semantic aggregation from partially observed views, but also label-aware exploitation of view-specific evidence. Existing approaches usually emphasize either shared representation learning or decision-level fusion. The former improves robustness against missing views, yet tends to compress label-discriminative view-specific cues into a single latent representation. The latter preserves individual view predictions, but often relies on fixed or globally learned fusion weights, ignoring that different labels of different instances may require different views. To address these limitations, this paper presents V2L, a unified representation-decision framework for incomplete multi-view multi-label classification. On the representation side, V2L constructs semantically consistent variational posteriors from incomplete views through a perturbation-aware encoding mechanism, which provides a stable shared semantic basis. On the decision side, V2L introduces an active view-label relevance modeling strategy that estimates instance-wise and label-wise view contributions, allowing each label prediction to adaptively select useful view-specific evidence. From the perspective of model architecture, these two important strategies are integrated into a unified framework through a hybrid fusion architecture, simultaneously meeting the requirements of cross-view semantic consistency and representational complementarity. Extensive experiments under both incomplete and complete settings show that V2L achieves leading performance on five benchmarks. Code is available at: https://github.com/justsmart/V2L.

AI.tldr: 本文提出V2L框架，用于解决不完整多视图多标签分类问题，通过统一的表示-决策框架同时保证跨视图语义一致性和视图特定证据的自适应利用，在五个基准数据集上取得了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么只强调共享表示学习导致压缩视图特定判别线索，要么只做决策级融合但依赖固定或全局融合权重，忽视了不同实例的不同标签可能需要不同视图的证据。作者希望同时克服这两个局限。
AI.method: V2L框架包含三部分：1) 表示层面，通过扰动感知编码机制从不完整视图中构建语义一致的变分后验，提供稳定的共享语义基础；2) 决策层面，提出主动视图-标签相关性建模策略，估计实例级和标签级的视图贡献，使每个标签预测能自适应选择有用的视图特定证据；3) 架构层面，通过混合融合架构将表示学习和决策融合统一集成到同一框架中。
AI.result: 在不完整和完整两种设置下进行了大量实验，V2L在五个基准数据集上均取得了领先的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了将表示级语义一致性与决策级标签自适应的视图选择统一到一个框架中是解决不完整多视图多标签学习的有效途径，代码已开源。

title: TeMo: Temperature Modulation for Multimodal Contrastive Learning
summary: Contrastive learning approaches achieve strong performance by training models to bring similar samples closer while pushing dissimilar samples apart. A crucial component of contrastive learning is the temperature hyperparameter $τ$, which controls the penalty strength applied to negative samples. However, most existing methods either fix this hyperparameter or learn a global value during training. In this paper, we introduce TeMo, Temperature Modulation framework, a similarity-based modulation approach that adaptively adjusts the temperature for each positive-negative pair according to their similarity, enabling more fine-grained multimodal contrastive learning. Our approach seamlessly integrates temperature-modulated multimodal and unimodal losses with the standard multimodal contrastive loss by gradually transitioning between them. This design allows the model to capture both coarse- and fine-grained semantics at different training stages. Extensive experiments demonstrate that each component of TeMo consistently enhances performance across diverse zero-shot retrieval and classification tasks, establishing new state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TeMo（温度调制框架），通过根据正负样本对的相似度自适应地调整每个样本对的温度超参数τ，实现更细粒度的多模态对比学习，并在零样本检索和分类任务上取得了新的最先进结果。
AI.motivation: 对比学习中的温度超参数τ控制对负样本的惩罚强度，但现有方法要么固定该超参数，要么在训练中学习一个全局值，无法针对不同样本对进行细粒度的自适应调整。
AI.method: 提出TeMo框架，采用基于相似度的调制方法，为每个正负样本对根据其相似度自适应调整温度。该方法将温度调制的多模态和单模态损失与标准多模态对比损失无缝整合，通过在训练的不同阶段逐渐转换，使模型能够同时捕获粗粒度和细粒度的语义信息。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，TeMo的每个组件都能在多样化的零样本检索和分类任务中一致地提升性能，并建立了新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: TeMo通过逐样本对的自适应温度调制增强了多模态对比学习的效果，验证了细粒度温度控制相比全局温度设置的优越性。

title: Re-engineering SORT-based algorithms for low-cost small object tracking from omnidirectional footage
comment: Accepted by IEEE 28th International Workshop on Multimedia Signal Processing (MMSP)
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) has advanced rapidly in urban surveillance and autonomous driving, yet many trackers rely on ReID- and transformer-based appearance encoders and are designed for standard FoV cameras. These assumptions break down for low-cost omnidirectional deployments, where equirectangular projection introduces seam discontinuities and targets appear to be small and fast-moving. We address multi-object tracking of flying animals captured in remote environments using omnidirectional cameras. We propose a lightweight framework that re-engineers SORT-based tracking for this geometry, including (i) a Seam-Aware Motion Model that keeps the Kalman state continuous across the seam, (ii) a composite seam-aware association cost that pairs a wrapped Euclidean term with GIoU, and (iii) OmniSmall, a new benchmark of omnidirectional wildlife footage. On our new dataset, with ground-truth detections, our modifications improved over OCSORT by +8.51 HOTA, +9.41 MOTA, and +10.17 IDF1; with YOLOX detections the gain narrows to +1.95 HOTA. Our proposed methods improved tracking performance on OmniSmall and remained competitive on JRDB without adding appearance encoders while keeping the tracking stage CPU-only. Our dataset and source code are available at: https://github.com/Xin-Shu/OmniSORT.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniSORT框架，针对全向摄像头下的野生动物多目标跟踪问题，通过接缝感知运动模型、复合接缝感知关联代价和OmniSmall基准数据集，在不使用外观编码器且仅依赖CPU的情况下显著提升了跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MOT追踪器基于标准FoV摄像头设计，依赖ReID和Transformer外观编码器，无法应对低成本全向摄像头的球面投影接缝不连续、目标小而移动快等挑战。这些假设在远程环境下的飞行动物跟踪场景中完全失效。
AI.method: 重新设计基于SORT的跟踪框架：(i)接缝感知运动模型保持卡尔曼状态在接缝处连续；(ii)复合接缝感知关联代价，结合环绕欧氏距离与GIoU；(iii)提出OmniSmall全向野生动物视频基准数据集。框架不使用外观编码器，跟踪阶段仅需CPU。
AI.result: 在OmniSmall基准上，使用真值检测时相较OCSORT提升HOTA +8.51、MOTA +9.41、IDF1 +10.17；使用YOLOX检测时HOTA提升+1.95。在JRDB上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 针对全向几何的轻量级改造可以有效解决低成本全向监控下的MOT难题，无需外观编码器即可获得显著性能提升，且在标准基准上仍具竞争力，验证了方法的通用性与实用性。

title: Heat Kernel Textures: the Geodesic Gaussians That Do Not Splat
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently revolutionised novel view synthesis as well as many other 3D vision methods and applications. Drawing inspiration from this representation, we now rethink textures to overcome the main issues of UV mapping while considerably lowering their memory footprint. Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex) eliminate UV unwrapping as well as their persistent issues of wasted UV space, seams, distortions, vertex-duplication, and varying resolution. Grounded in discrete Riemannian geometry and intrinsically defined on any manifold surface discretised as a triangular mesh, HKTex uses anisotropic heat kernels as geodesic equivalents to Gaussians. Like our kernels, also the optimisation of their position and the adaptive densification strategies were redefined to operate on the surface of the object to be textureised. Our novel representation is also fully integrated with a physically based renderer and can be optimised either from existing textures or multi-view images. Our project page and code are available at circle-group.github.io/research/HeatKernelTextures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出热核纹理（HKTex），一种基于离散黎曼几何的新型三维纹理表示方法，在任意三角网格曲面上使用各向异性热核作为高斯函数的测地线等价物，消除UV展开的需求及其相关问题，同时显著降低内存占用。
AI.motivation: UV映射存在浪费UV空间、接缝、变形、顶点重复和分辨率不一致等固有问题。受3D高斯泼溅启发，作者希望重新思考纹理表示，以克服上述UV映射的主要缺陷并降低内存开销。
AI.method: HKTex在离散黎曼几何框架下定义于三角网格曲面，使用各向异性热核作为测地线高斯核。核的位置优化和自适应加密度策略都在物体表面进行操作，无需UV展开。该方法完全集成于物理基渲染器中，可从现有纹理或多视角图像进行优化。
AI.result: 该方法消除了UV展开及其相关问题（废置空间、接缝、变形、顶点重复、分辨率变化），同时降低了内存占用，并支持从现有纹理或多视图图像进行优化。
AI.conclusion: HKTex为三维纹理表示提供了一种无需UV的全新范式，将3D高斯泼溅思想推广到曲面纹理领域，兼具高效率和灵活性。

title: SphereSOD: Geometry-Structure Coupled Learning for 360 Salient Object Detection
summary: 360° salient object detection (SOD) aims to accurately segment salient regions across a full field of view. However, equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces severe spatial distortion when mapping the spherical domain onto a planar representation. Existing methods mainly focus on compensating projection distortion while overlooking the interaction between panoramic geometry and salient object structure during feature perception and prediction refinement. To this end, we propose SphereSOD, an ERP-native framework that couples panoramic geometry with evolving salient structures. Specifically, spherical geometry governs feature sampling and spatial weighting, while coarse-grained saliency and contour prediction influence context aggregation during the progressive decoding process. SphereSOD first initializes deformable sampling based on spherical projection geometry and then employs bounded, content-adaptive offsets, yielding features that are better aligned with the underlying panoramic geometry. Subsequently, the decoder performs structure-guided context aggregation and progressive refinement to recover complete salient regions and accurate boundaries. Extensive experiments on three public 360° SOD benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, supporting structurepreserving inference directly in ERP space as a promising alternative to projection-heavy panoramic pipelines.

AI.tldr: SphereSOD是一个ERP原生的360°显著目标检测框架，通过将全景几何与逐渐演化的显著结构相结合，直接在等距柱状投影空间中实现结构保持的推断，在三个公共基准上取得了最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的360°显著目标检测方法主要关注补偿ERP投影带来的空间畸变，却忽略了在特征感知和预测细化过程中全景几何与显著目标结构之间的交互作用。
AI.method: SphereSOD框架包括两部分：1) 基于球面投影几何初始化可变形采样，使用有界内容自适应偏移，使特征与全景几何对齐；2) 解码器执行结构引导的上下文聚合与渐进式细化，通过粗粒度显著性预测和轮廓预测来影响上下文聚合过程，恢复完整的显著区域和精确边界。
AI.result: 在三个公共360°SOD基准上的大量实验表明，SphereSOD取得了最先进的性能以及良好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 在ERP空间中直接进行结构保持推断可以成为投影处理类全景管线的一个有前景的替代方案。

title: Solution for UCF UrbanTwin LUMPI Track: Sim-to-Real Urban LiDAR 3D Object Detection
summary: We present our solution to the LUMPI track of the UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge at the 6th DriveX Workshop, ECCV 2026. The detector must be trained only on synthetic data and is evaluated on 50 held-out real LiDAR frames; a separate 50-frame synthetic submission is evaluated for point-cloud realism. Our method addresses the Sim2Real gap at three levels. First, we align synthetic scans to the 50k-point test density and build a 30k-record training pool using UT-LUMPI geometry, RangeLDM-based sampling diversification, rare-class copy-paste, and pedestrian-oriented augmentation. Second, complementary DSVT detectors and Car/Bus PointPillars specialists are trained under the same synthetic-only constraint. Third, predictions are integrated by class-aware routing, asymmetric agreement fusion, constrained residual-recall supplementation, class-coverage auditing, and selective box-size calibration. The realism branch is optimized independently with radial-density matching, weak affine calibration, and calibrated set mixing. The final submission obtains a Combined Score of 0.4692, a Detection Score of 0.1797, a Realism Score of 0.9035, and 3D mAP@0.5 of 0.1258.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在ECCV 2026 DriveX Workshop的LUMPI赛道中，仅使用合成数据训练并在真实LiDAR数据上评估的Sim2Real检测与点云真实性方法，最终获得Combined Score 0.4692。
AI.motivation: 解决自动驾驶LiDAR感知中合成数据训练与真实数据评估之间的域差距（Sim2Real gap），因标注成本高，需探索仅依赖合成数据训练检测器的可行方案。
AI.method: 在三个层面解决Sim2Real域差距：1）数据层面：对齐合成扫描与50k点测试密度，构建30k记录训练池，包含RangeLDM采样多样化、稀有类复制粘贴和行人增强；2）模型层面：训练互补的DSVT检测器和Car/Bus专用的PointPillars专家模型；3）集成层面：采用类别感知路由、非对称协议融合、受约束残差召回补充、类别覆盖审计和选择性框尺寸标定。真实性分支独立优化，使用径向密度匹配、弱仿射标定和校准集合混合。
AI.result: 最终提交取得Combined Score 0.4692，Detection Score 0.1797，Realism Score 0.9035，3D mAP@0.5为0.1258。
AI.conclusion: 该方案通过多层次的数据增强、多模型集成与独立优化真实性分支，在纯合成训练约束下实现了可观的Sim2Real迁移效果，证明了合成数据在LiDAR感知中的潜力。

title: BarkNet-Lite: A Lightweight Texture and Colour Network with the BarkBD Benchmark for Bark-Based Tree Species Recognition in Bangladesh
summary: Tree species recognition supports forest inventory and biodiversity monitoring but still depends on scarce taxonomic expertise. Bark is visible year-round at ground level, yet bark recognition has concentrated on temperate floras and on large ImageNet-pre-trained backbones. We address both gaps. First, we release BarkBD, a bark dataset for Bangladesh: 14,258 uncropped smartphone photographs of 20 native species across four districts and three weather conditions, with a fixed stratified split. Second, we propose BarkNet-Lite, a 2.96M-parameter network trained from random initialisation, pairing a multi-scale texture pathway with a parallel colour-aware pathway. Over five seeds it reaches 96.64+-0.66%accuracyunderstrict single-image inference, within 2.3 points of nine ImageNet-pre-trained backbones fine-tuned under an identical protocol and within one seed-level standard deviation of the smallest ofthem, andtransfers to public benchmarks (95.86% on BarkVN-50, 92.85% on BarkNet 1.0). Grad-CAM, validated by faithfulness and weight-randomisation checks, confirms its decisions rest on bark structure rather than background. The exported single-precision model classifies one photograph in 15.34ms on a commodity smartphone.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了孟加拉国树皮数据集BarkBD（含20种本土树种、14,258张手机照片），并提出轻量级网络BarkNet-Lite（仅296万参数，从随机初始化训练），在严格单图推理下达到96.64%±0.66%的准确率，与ImageNet预训练大模型仅差2.3个百分点，且在公开基准及智能手机端均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 树种识别对森林清查和生物多样性监测至关重要，但依赖稀缺的分类学专业知识。现有树皮识别研究集中于温带植物区系和大型ImageNet预训练骨干网络，缺乏热带/发展中国家（如孟加拉国）的数据集与轻量级解决方案。
AI.method: 提出BarkNet-Lite，一个2.96M参数的轻量级网络，从随机初始化训练，采用多尺度纹理通路与并行颜色感知通路相结合的双通路架构；同时构建孟加拉国树皮数据集BarkBD，包含四个地区、三种天气条件下的20个本土树种照片，并设置固定分层划分。
AI.result: 五个种子上达到96.64%±0.66%准确率，与九个ImageNet预训练骨干（相同协议）差距在2.3个百分点以内；在公开基准上转移性能优异（BarkVN-50达95.86%，BarkNet 1.0达92.85%）；Grad-CAM经忠实度和权重随机化验证，确认决策基于树皮结构而非背景；导出模型在商用手机上推理单张照片仅需15.34ms。
AI.conclusion: BarkNet-Lite以极小参数量从随机初始化训练即可接近甚至匹敌大型预训练模型的性能，并可高效部署于移动端，填补了热带树皮识别和轻量级模型的双重空白。

title: Search-to-World: Evaluation of 3D World Delivery from User Request through Web Search
summary: Agentic systems can interpret user requests, search the live web, and use external tools, but their ability to transform retrieved web content into a usable 3D world has not been systematically evaluated. No established end-to-end pipeline or benchmark exists for this capability. We introduce Search-to-World, an end-to-end evaluation task covering request understanding, web visual-content retrieval, and 3D-world delivery. We define Observed Retrieval Rate (ORR) and World Delivery Rate (WDR) to distinguish observing relevant content from successfully delivering a request-aligned, perceptually acceptable world. We also present WorldSearcher, a reuse-then-reconstruction harness that connects existing search agents to world delivery: it first retrieves reusable 3D worlds and, when none are available, reconstructs a world from video. A structured recovery controller revises temporal grounding, replaces source videos, or reformulates queries after failure. Using WorldSearcher, we benchmark representative models on Search-to-World and study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for recovery subagents. Results show that delivery depends on the underlying agentic model, and that relevant-content observation does not ensure world delivery. Jointly training recovery agents improves delivery success and action efficiency. Search-to-World makes agentic 3D-world delivery measurable, while WorldSearcher provides a practical evaluation harness with recovery capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Search-to-World，一个端到端评测任务，用于系统评估智能体系统将网络检索内容转化为可用3D世界的能力，并配套提出WorldSearcher评测框架及两个核心指标（ORR和WDR）。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体系统能够理解用户请求、搜索网络并使用外部工具，但其将检索到的网络内容转化为可用3D世界的能力尚未被系统评估，也缺乏端到端流水线和基准测试。
AI.method: 提出Search-to-World端到端评测任务，涵盖请求理解、网络视觉内容检索和3D世界交付三个环节；定义Observed Retrieval Rate（ORR）和World Delivery Rate（WDR）两个指标；构建WorldSearcher复用-重建框架，先检索可复用的3D世界，若无则从视频重建，并通过结构化恢复控制器进行时序校正、视频替换或查询改写。
AI.result: 基准测试显示3D世界交付能力取决于底层智能体模型，且观察到相关内容并不保证世界成功交付；联合训练恢复子智能体可提升交付成功率和行动效率。
AI.conclusion: Search-to-World使智能体3D世界交付能力变得可测量，WorldSearcher提供了具备恢复能力的实用评测框架。

title: Solution for UCF UrbanTwin V2X-Real Track: Sim-to-Real Urban LiDAR 3D Object Detection
summary: Bridging the simulation-to-reality gap in roadside LiDAR requires addressing several coupled discrepancies, including scene geometry, sampling density, return patterns, and pedestrian scale. This report presents a multi-source collaborative training and class-aware fusion framework for Sim2Real 3D detection. The method organizes digital-twin scans, diffusion-redrawn scans, density-stabilized scans, and pedestrian morphology-aligned samples into a unified training pool with complementary roles. Within a common DSVT detection formulation, source-specialized expert branches preserve those roles while optimizing for the same detection objective. At inference, a predefined class-aware fusion pathway integrates geometry-stable and calibration-aware branches for vehicles, sampling-complementary branches for trucks, and morphology-consistent evidence for pedestrians. A label-free point-cloud center blend then refines geometric localization. On the UrbanTwin V2X-Real hidden test set, the unified system achieves a combined score of 0.7421, with 3D mAP@0.5 of 0.4518 and a realism score of 0.8871. The results indicate that a stable, interpretable collaboration among data sources is more valuable than unconstrained aggregation of model outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多源协同训练与类别感知融合框架，用于路边LiDAR的Sim2Real 3D检测，通过组织多种互补数据源（数字孪生、扩散重绘、密度稳定、行人形态对齐样本）在统一DSVT框架下训练，并在推理时采用预定义的类别感知融合路径整合不同分支输出，最终在UrbanTwin V2X-Real测试集上实现0.7421的综合得分。
AI.motivation: 路边LiDAR的仿真到现实（Sim2Real）转换面临多种耦合的不一致性问题，包括场景几何、采样密度、回波模式和行人尺度等，需要系统性的方法来解决这些多层面差异。
AI.method: 提出多源协同训练与类别感知融合框架：(1) 将数字孪生扫描、扩散重绘扫描、密度稳定扫描和行人形态对齐样本组织为统一训练池，各数据源承担互补角色；(2) 在统一的DSVT检测框架内建立源特定的专家分支，所有分支优化同一检测目标；(3) 推理阶段采用预定义的类别感知融合路径——车辆使用几何稳定与校准感知分支，卡车使用采样互补分支，行人使用形态一致性证据；(4) 使用无标签的点云中心混合方法精炼几何定位。
AI.result: 在UrbanTwin V2X-Real隐藏测试集上，系统综合得分0.7421，3D mAP@0.5为0.4518，真实感评分为0.8871。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，数据源之间稳定且可解释的协同合作比无约束的模型输出聚合更有价值，验证了结构化融合策略在解决Sim2Real差距中的有效性。

title: Harnessing CLIP and DINO: An Uncertainty-Aware Cascaded Fusion Network for Generalizable Deepfake Image Detection
summary: The growing realism and accessibility of manipulated and generated faces threaten the trustworthiness of digital media. To detect such forgeries, deepfake detectors based on vision foundation models have shown promising performance, but they typically rely on a single pretrained representation and are prone to overfitting to particular training distributions. To improve generalization to unseen forgeries, we propose UCF-Net, an uncertainty-aware cascaded fusion network that harnesses CLIP's language-aligned semantic priors and DINO's self-supervised visual-structure priors. UCF-Net extracts hierarchical features across Transformer depths, uses layer-wise expert aggregation to adaptively combine each encoder's multi-level cues, and performs weighted fusion of the resulting representations based on entropy-derived uncertainty. We further consolidate public deepfake datasets into a unified benchmark of approximately 4M images and construct a separate cross-generator evaluation set with over 8K face images from eight recent generators. On the unified benchmark, UCF-Net achieves the best mean AUC among the evaluated methods in both in-domain and cross-domain evaluations. On the cross-generator set, it adapts effectively with limited target-domain data, although zero-shot transfer remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UCF-Net，一种基于不确定性的级联融合网络，结合CLIP的语言对齐语义先验和DINO的自监督视觉结构先验来检测深度伪造，在统一基准和跨生成器评估中均取得最佳平均AUC。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器通常依赖单一预训练表示，容易过拟合特定训练分布，难以泛化到未知伪造内容。
AI.method: UCF-Net通过跨Transformer层提取分层特征，采用逐层专家聚合自适应组合CLIP和DINO编码器的多层级线索，并基于熵导出的不确定性对所得表示进行加权融合。
AI.result: 在约400万图像的统一基准上，UCF-Net在域内和跨域评估中均取得最佳平均AUC；在包含8个近期生成器、8000余张人脸的跨生成器评估集上，有限目标域数据下可有效适应，但零样本迁移仍有挑战。
AI.conclusion: 融合多种预训练先验并利用不确定性加权可提升深度伪造检测的泛化能力，但零样本场景下的跨生成器泛化仍是待解决难题。

title: CrowdTraj: A Benchmark for Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction in Realistic Crowded Environments
summary: In real-world applications, pedestrian trajectory prediction models rely on inputs from detection and tracking systems. Prior trajectory prediction benchmarks either contain relatively sparse pedestrian interactions, assume perfect tracking inputs, or rely on overhead viewpoints that minimize occlusion and perspective distortion, limiting evaluation in realistic dense-crowd scenarios. We present CrowdTraj, a benchmark for pedestrian trajectory prediction in natural dense crowd scenes. Unlike previous datasets, CrowdTraj supports end-to-end evaluation from detection through tracking to trajectory prediction under severe occlusion in CCTV views. It also captures diverse, natural pedestrian behaviours, including abrupt directional changes rarely observed in existing benchmarks. CrowdTraj includes five diverse scenes, with an average of 1,146 unique pedestrians per scene, maximum frame-level densities ranging from 114 to 372 pedestrians, and over 3.2 million annotated head bounding boxes. CrowdTraj provides pixel and real-world coordinates via per-scene homography matrices for physically meaningful analysis. Our experimental results show that tracking accuracy (IDF1) drops to 0.68 to 0.70 in the densest scenes, compared with approximately 0.90 in less crowded scenes. Trajectory prediction training also becomes substantially more computationally expensive in dense scenes, with training times increasing by up to 8 times. These findings show that CrowdTraj exposes limitations in current trajectory prediction pipelines that remain hidden on existing sparse-crowd benchmarks, particularly in robustness to tracking noise and computational scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrowdTraj，一个针对自然密集人群场景的轨迹预测基准数据集，涵盖五个场景、平均每场景1,146个行人、超过320万个标注头部边界框，支持从检测到跟踪再到轨迹预测的端到端评估，并发现密集场景下轨迹预测管道存在鲁棒性和计算可扩展性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测基准存在两个关键缺陷：一是行人交互稀疏，与实际密集人群场景不符；二是假设完美的跟踪输入或依赖无遮挡的俯视视角，无法评估现实世界中严重遮挡、透视畸变以及跟踪噪声对预测的影响。
AI.method: CrowdTraj基准包含五个多样化密集人群场景，通过CCTV视角捕获严重遮挡下的自然行人行为，提供像素坐标和通过单应性矩阵转换的真实世界坐标，支持从检测到跟踪再到轨迹预测的完整端到端评估流程。
AI.result: 在最密集场景中跟踪准确率（IDF1）降至0.68至0.70，而较不密集场景约为0.90；密集场景下轨迹预测训练时间最多增加8倍，表明现有轨迹预测管道在密集场景中存在显著性能下降。
AI.conclusion: CrowdTraj揭示了现有稀疏人群基准所隐藏的轨迹预测管道局限性，特别是在对跟踪噪声的鲁棒性和计算可扩展性方面，为构建面向真实密集人群场景的轨迹预测方法提供了重要基准资源。

title: Better Call CineCrew: Consistent Ultra-Long Narrative-to-Film Generation
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026 Project page: https://jiabenchen.github.io/cinecrew/
summary: Long-form narrative-to-film generation requires shot-level controllability and cross-clip consistency in both visual identity and character behavior-requirements that remain difficult to satisfy with current prompt-based workflows. A core reason existing workflows remain brittle is the lack of a structured intermediate layer between scripts and video models, especially when screenplays are underspecified at key cinematic decision points. We introduce a structured orchestration layer for film-oriented script-to-video generation, implemented as a multi-agent framework that operates between scripts and off-the-shelf video generators. The layer is centered on FilmDSL, a film-oriented domain-specific language that makes cinematic constraints explicit, including shot and camera directives, asset and continuity requirements, and persona cues, so that agents coordinate through a shared structured specification for planning, generation, critique, and repair. Specifically, a generation agent constructs asset packs and storyboard keyframes that anchor composition before clip-by-clip synthesis, while a critic agent produces structured QA signals and triggers targeted refinement without retraining the base model. Experiments on TV-style segments show improved controllability and consistency over text-only and reference-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FilmDSL结构化编排层，一个介于剧本与视频生成模型之间的多智能体框架，通过领域特定语言实现镜头级控制与跨片段一致性，改善长叙事剧本到视频生成的可靠性与可控性。
AI.motivation: 当前基于提示词的剧本转视频工作流难以满足长叙事生成所需的镜头级可控性和跨片段视觉身份与角色行为一致性。核心原因在于剧本与视频模型之间缺乏结构化中间层，尤其在剧本对关键电影决策点描述不充分时，现有工作流表现脆弱。
AI.method: 提出以FilmDSL为核心的剧本到视频生成编排层，这是一个面向电影的领域特定语言，将镜头与摄影机指令、资产与连续性要求、角色线索等电影约束显式化。多智能体框架通过共享结构化规范进行协同：生成智能体构建资产包和分镜关键帧以锚定构图，再逐片段合成；评论智能体产出结构化QA信号并触发精准修正，无需重新训练基础模型。
AI.result: 在电视风格片段上的实验表明，相比纯文本基线和仅参考基线，该方法在可控性和一致性方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化编排层FilmDSL有效弥合了剧本与视频模型之间的语义鸿沟，通过显式电影约束和多智能体协作（生成-评论-修复循环），在不重新训练基础模型的前提下提升了长叙事视频生成的镜头级可控性与跨片段一致性。

title: Zero-Shot 3D Plant Organ Segmentation with SAM3 and Semantic NeRFs
comment: Submitted to CVPPA Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Accurate 3D plant organ segmentation is fundamental to automated phenotyping. Existing approaches rely on annotated training data or species-specific model configurations. We present an annotation-free pipeline for 3D plant organ segmentation, combining text-prompted SAM3 segmentation with semantic neural radiance fields (NeRFs). Given only multi-view RGB images and a list of class names, our zero-shot pipeline produces semantically labeled 3D point clouds without manual annotation, per-species fine-tuning, or domain-specific preprocessing. Multi-view NeRF fusion acts as effective implicit consensus mechanism that lifts imperfect per-frame masks into accurate 3D labels. On a controlled Begonia maculata testbed the SAM3 pipeline achieves 92.6% mIoU, reaching 95.9% of the oracle upper bound established with perfect ground-truth masks. The pipeline was further evaluated on a new dataset spanning ten diverse plant point clouds reaching an average 0.856 mIoU, with leaf and pot IoU above 0.91 and 0.90 for every species, respectively. These results demonstrate that annotation-free 3D plant organ segmentation is now feasible and approaching the range of supervised methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需标注的3D植物器官分割流程，将文本提示的SAM3分割与语义神经辐射场（NeRF）相结合，仅需多视角RGB图像和类别名称即可生成带语义标签的3D点云，在Begonia maculata测试集上达到92.6%的mIoU，在十种不同植物点云上平均mIoU为0.856，接近监督方法的性能水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D植物器官分割方法依赖标注训练数据或针对特定物种的模型配置，这限制了其在不同植物物种间的泛化能力和实际应用效率。作者旨在开发一种免标注、免微调的通用分割流程，以突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 该方法将文本提示的SAM3分割与语义神经辐射场（NeRF）相结合：首先仅使用多视角RGB图像和类别名称列表作为输入，SAM3产生逐帧分割掩码，随后通过多视角NeRF融合作为隐式的共识机制，将不完美的逐帧掩码提升为准确的3D点云语义标签，整个过程无需手动标注、物种级微调或特定领域的预处理。
AI.result: 在Begonia maculata受控测试平台上，该方法达到92.6%的mIoU，相当于使用完美真实掩码建立的Oracle上界的95.9%。在涵盖十种不同植物的新数据集上，平均mIoU达到0.856，其中所有物种的叶片IoU均超过0.91、花盆IoU均超过0.90。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，无需标注的3D植物器官分割方法已具备可行性，其性能正逐步接近甚至达到监督方法的水平，为自动化植物表型分析提供了新的实用路径。

title: TV-SGS: Gaussian Splatting with Geometric Information Propagation via Tensor Voting under sparse views
summary: Gaussian Splatting has been effective in inferring scene representations that excel in novel view synthesis. Multiple splats cooperate seamlessly to synthesize the pixels of novel views and are jointly optimized even though they only affect each other indirectly, via pixels they project to in common. We present an approach that enables direct communication among splats to enhance the geometric structures they form in 3D. This is accomplished by Tensor Voting, which was originally designed to infer structures from noisy inputs and has been adapted here to provide supervision during test-time optimization, leading to more accurate scene geometry. We introduce a new class of 3D losses that do not rely on rendering and can be combined with essentially all losses previously reported in the literature. Our 3D losses are especially effective when the input views are sparse and geometric regularization is essential due to limited supervision from the images. Our method is easy to integrate with a diverse set of backbones, and our experiments on the DTU and Tanks-and-Temples datasets demonstrate that TV-SGS improves the geometry of the outputs compared to the backbone, while maintaining or improving rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TV-SGS方法，通过张量投票（Tensor Voting）技术实现高斯溅射（Gaussian Splatting）中三维点之间的直接通信，引入了不依赖渲染的全新三维损失函数，在稀疏视角输入下显著提升场景几何精度，同时保持或改善渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的高斯溅射方法中，多个溅射点之间仅通过投影到相同像素来间接影响彼此，缺乏直接的3D通信机制，导致在稀疏视角输入下因图像监督不足而使场景几何结构不够准确。
AI.method: 将原本用于从噪声输入中推断结构的张量投票技术适配为测试时优化的监督信号，在3D空间中为高斯溅射点提供直接的几何结构监督。文中提出一类不依赖渲染的3D损失函数，可以与文献中已有的所有损失函数结合使用，且易于集成到多种骨干网络上。
AI.result: 在DTU和Tanks-and-Temples数据集上的实验表明，TV-SGS相比骨干预方法改善了输出的几何精度，同时保持或提升了渲染质量。尤其在输入视图稀疏、几何正则化至关重要的场景下效果更加显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过张量投票实现溅射点之间的直接三维通信是一种有效提升高斯溅射几何结构的途径，所提出的3D损失具有通用性，能够在不牺牲渲染质量的前提下增强场景几何精度，为稀疏视图下的神经渲染提供了新的正则化思路。

title: TFTrack: A Template-Free Framework for Efficient 3D Point Cloud Tracking
summary: LiDAR-based 3D Single Object Tracking (3D SOT) is critical for robotic perception and navigation and aims to localize dynamic objects across frames in sparse point clouds. Existing methods, rooted in the Siamese tracking paradigm from 2D vision, rely on costly dual-input designs and excessive motion modeling guided by template priors, hindering their efficiency. Our in-depth analysis reveals: (i) the template paradigm is redundant, as the previous bounding box center encodes sufficient historical context; (ii) complex motion modeling is unnecessary, as geometric alignment provides adequate motion priors. Based on the above findings, we propose the first Template-Free Tracking framework (TFTrack). The novel framework eliminates the need for template-search pairings and operates directly on the current frame guided solely by the prior bounding box center and size. We instantiate this paradigm into three variants: TFTrack-Voxel, TFTrack-Pillar, and TFTrack-Point, to explore different 3D representations under a unified framework, ensuring flexibility across sparse and dense scenes. Extensive experiments on KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks show that TFTrack is competitive with leading template-based trackers, while reducing FLOPs by approximately 50% and running at approximately 120 FPS. By simplifying overcomplicated motion-centric designs, TFTrack establishes a new minimalist paradigm for efficient 3D point cloud tracking, paving the way for real-time and resource-efficient deployment in embedded robotic systems, such as autonomous vehicles. The code is available at https://github.com/tftrack-anonymous/TFTrack/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种无模板的3D单目标跟踪框架（TFTrack），摒弃了传统Siamese范式中的模板-搜索配对输入，仅依靠上一帧边界框中心和尺寸直接跟踪当前帧目标。作者通过分析发现模板范式冗余且复杂运动建模不必要，几何对齐已足够提供运动先验。TFTrack实例化为三种变体（Voxel、Pillar、Point），在KITTI和nuScenes基准上取得与领先模板方法相当的精度，同时FLOPs减少约50%、运行速度达约120 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LiDAR的3D单目标跟踪方法沿用2D视觉中的Siamese跟踪范式，依赖双输入设计（模板对+搜索区域）和以模板先验驱动的过多运动建模，导致计算开销大、效率低下。作者希望通过深入分析揭示这些复杂设计的冗余性，从而提出更高效的跟踪框架。
AI.method: 首先进行深入分析揭示两点核心发现：(i) 模板范式冗余——前一轮边界框中心已编码了足够的历史上下文；(ii) 复杂运动建模不必要——几何对齐即可提供充分的运动先验。基于此，提出TFTrack框架，消除模板-搜索配对，仅以先前边界框中心和尺寸为引导直接处理当前帧，并实例化为Voxel、Pillar、Point三种变体以适应不同3D表示和稀疏/稠密场景。
AI.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes基准上的大量实验表明，TFTrack与领先的基于模板的跟踪器性能相当，同时计算量（FLOPs）减少约50%，运行速度达到约120 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 通过简化过度复杂的以运动为中心的设计，TFTrack建立了高效的3D点云跟踪的新极简范式，为嵌入式机器人系统（如自动驾驶车辆）中的实时和资源高效部署铺平了道路。

title: Cross-modal learning for SAR target recognition using optical vision foundation models
comment: Accepted for presentation at SPIE Sensors + Imaging 2026
summary:
Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) is an important modality in a wide range of imaging applications due to its versatile, long range and near all weather operating capabilities. However, Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) remains a challenging problem due to limited labelled data, the strong speckle in SAR images and the significant domain gap between SAR and more abundant optical imagery. In contrast, electro-optical (EO) imagery benefits from massive datasets, clearer visual structure and powerful foundation models. In this work, we investigate how vision foundation models trained on optical data can provide class level supervision for SAR classification.
  We propose a cross-modal EO to SAR prototype alignment framework in which a frozen EO encoder, based on a DINOv3 vision foundation model, is used to construct class level optical prototypes without requiring strict EO/SAR pairs. A SAR model is then trained to classify SAR images while aligning its embeddings to the corresponding EO class prototype. At inference time, the SAR model operates independently, without access to optical imagery. We evaluate our approach on the UNICORNv2 dataset, an EO and SAR dataset of civilian vehicles with heavily speckled images and severe class imbalance. EO prototype alignment improves SAR classification accuracy over frozen DINOv3, SAR only finetuning and unpaired distribution alignment baselines, and t-SNE visualizations provide qualitative evidence of clearer separation among classes in the trained SAR embedding space. These results suggest that optical vision foundation models, despite being trained on visible spectrum imagery, provide transferable information for SAR image classification, offering a practical method for using large scale pretrained vision foundation models across challenging sensing modalities.
