AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨模态EO到SAR的类原型对齐框架，利用基于DINOv3的冻结EO编码器构建光学类原型，训练SAR模型在分类的同时对齐到对应光学原型，从而在没有严格EO/SAR配对的情况下，将光学视觉基础模型的类别信息迁移到SAR图像分类任务中。
AI.motivation: SAR图像在自动目标识别中面临标注数据少、强斑噪声和与光学图像之间存在显著域差异等挑战，而光学图像拥有海量数据和强大的基础模型。作者希望利用光学视觉基础模型为SAR分类提供类别级别的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出跨模态EO到SAR原型对齐框架：使用基于DINOv3的冻结EO编码器构建类级光学原型（无需严格EO/SAR配对），然后训练SAR模型在分类的同时将其嵌入表示对齐到对应的EO类原型。推理时SAR模型独立运行，不依赖光学图像。
AI.result: 在UNICORNv2数据集（包含重斑噪声和严重类别不平衡的民用车辆EO和SAR数据）上，EO原型对齐方法的SAR分类准确率优于冻结DINOv3、仅SAR微调和无配对分布对齐等基线方法。t-SNE可视化进一步表明训练后的SAR嵌入空间中类别分离更清晰。
AI.conclusion: 光学视觉基础模型尽管在可见光谱图像上训练，但仍能为SAR图像分类提供可迁移的类别信息，为利用大规模预训练视觉基础模型跨挑战性传感模态提供了实用方法。

title: DroneGround: Open-Vocabulary Drone Payload Characterization Using Synthetic Data and Grounded Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at RVS-SE, British Machine Vision Conference, 2026
summary: Automated drone surveillance has become increasingly important for public safety, critical infrastructure protection,and restricted airspace monitoring. While existing vision-based systems achieve strong performance for drone detection and tracking, reliable payload characterization remains highly challenging under long-range imaging conditions due to limited availability of annotated real-world datasets, and substantial distribution shifts encountered during deployment. Existing approaches formulate payload characterization as a closed-set object detection problem, limiting their ability to recognize previously unseen payloads and generalize beyond the training distribution. To address these challenges, we generate a photorealistic synthetic drone-payload dataset using Unreal Engine 5 and Cosys-AirSim and propose DroneGround: Grounded Vision-Language Payload Characterization, a two-stage framework for robust open-vocabulary payload analysis. DroneGround first employs a YOLO26s detector to localize drones and extract drone-centric image crops, followed by a LoRA-fine-tuned PaliGemma vision-language model that generates seman- tic descriptions of the detected drones and their attached payloads, enabling open-vocabulary payload characterization beyond predefined categories. An occlusion-based grounding module further provides interpretable payload localization by identifying image regions responsible for the generated descriptions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world drone imagery demonstrate that DroneGround substantially improves robustness under synthetic-to-real distribution shifts, outperforming a conventional closed-set payload detector by improving the F1-score from 82.5% to 96.3%, while achieving significantly better generalization to previously unseen payload categories (80.4%versus 42.7% F1). Dataset and code will be released upon acceptance of the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DroneGround，一个基于视觉-语言模型的两阶段开放词汇无人机载荷表征框架，利用UE5和Cosys-AirSim生成逼真合成数据集，通过YOLO26s检测器定位无人机并结合LoRA微调的PaliGemma模型进行载荷语义描述，在合成到真实的分布漂移下将F1分数从82.5%提升至96.3%，对未见载荷类别的泛化能力显著优于传统闭环检测方法（80.4%对42.7%）。
AI.motivation: 无人机自动化监控对公共安全等至关重要，但现有系统在无人机检测与跟踪上表现良好，远距离成像条件下的载荷表征仍具挑战：真实标注数据稀缺、部署时存在显著分布漂移，且现有方法将载荷表征视为闭集目标检测，无法识别训练分布之外的未见载荷。
AI.method: DroneGround采用两阶段框架：首先使用YOLO26s检测器定位无人机并提取以无人机为中心的图像裁剪区域；然后通过LoRA微调的PaliGemma视觉-语言模型生成无人机及其挂载载荷的语义描述，实现开放词汇的载荷表征；最后利用基于遮挡的定位模块识别生成描述所对应的图像区域，提供可解释的载荷定位。数据集通过Unreal Engine 5和Cosys-AirSim生成。
AI.result: 在合成和真实无人机图像上的大量实验表明，DroneGround在合成到真实的分布漂移下鲁棒性显著提升，将传统闭集载荷检测器的F1分数从82.5%提高到96.3%；对于未见载荷类别，泛化性能大幅优于传统方法（80.4%对比42.7%的F1分数）。
AI.conclusion: DroneGround通过结合合成数据生成、开放词汇视觉-语言建模和可解释的遮挡基元定位，有效解决了长期困扰无人机载荷表征的标注稀缺和分布漂移问题，在闭集和开放词汇场景下均优于传统方法，为无人机载荷自动化分析提供了新的可行范式。

title: Are Image Generators Zero-Shot Perceivers? A Rigorous Evaluation
summary: Recent work, such as Vision Banana, shows that lightweight instruction tuning can enable an image generator to achieve state-of-the-art performance across multiple visual perception tasks. Motivated by this perspective, we ask how far image generators can go on public visual perception benchmarks in a zero-shot setting. We introduce ProbeGen, a benchmark for zero-shot generative perception that casts monocular depth estimation, referring/reasoning segmentation, and object counting as conditional generation tasks specified through text prompts, and compares 20 models in total---including proprietary and open-weight image generators, specialist perception models, and MLLMs---across 11 published benchmarks. We observe that pretrained image generators show measurable zero-shot perceptual competence, but with a clear trade-off: specialist models remain stronger for in-distribution accuracy and efficiency, while generative models are often more robust under distribution shift and better at compositional semantic reasoning. We hope this study helps establish zero-shot generative perception as a meaningful research direction and provides a useful foundation for future work at the intersection of visual generation and understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProbeGen基准，系统评估图像生成器在零样本条件下执行视觉感知任务（深度估计、分割、计数）的能力，并与专精感知模型和多模态大语言模型进行了20个模型的跨11个基准的全面比较，揭示了生成模型在分布外鲁棒性和组合语义推理上的优势与在分布内精度上的劣势。
AI.motivation: 受Vision Banana等技术启发，研究者希望探究图像生成器在零样本设置下能走多远，即能否仅通过轻量指令微调就承担多种视觉感知任务。现有研究缺乏对这一方向的系统性评估。
AI.method: 引入ProbeGen基准，将单目深度估计、指代/推理分割和物体计数三类视觉感知任务统一转化为基于文本提示的条件生成任务。对比了20个模型（包括专有和开源图像生成器、专精感知模型及多模态大语言模型），在11个公开基准上进行全面评估。
AI.result: 预训练图像生成器在零样本条件下展现出可测量的感知能力，但存在清晰权衡：专精模型在分布内精度和效率上仍然更优，而生成模型在分布偏移下更鲁棒且更擅长组合语义推理。
AI.conclusion: 该研究希望确立零样本生成式感知作为一个有意义的研究方向，并为视觉生成与理解交叉领域的未来工作提供基础。

title: JEDI: JEPA-to-Edge Distillation for Efficient Cropland Segmentation from Satellite Imagery
summary: Large vision models provide useful representations for remote-sensing segmentation but are often too expensive for deployment at the satellite or field edge. Existing feature-level distillation methods also tend to assume similar teacher and student architectures and often stop feature alignment when task training begins. We introduce JEDI (JEPA-to-Edge Distillation), a two-stage framework that transfers representations from a large I-JEPA Vision Transformer teacher to a compact SegFormer student. First, JEDI aligns the student's terminal representation with the teacher's token space using cross-architecture projection and spatial alignment. It then jointly optimizes supervised segmentation, temperature-scaled response distillation, and persistent feature alignment throughout task adaptation. On CalCROP21, JEDI-B0 achieves 68.0 mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) with 4.04M parameters, improving over the standalone student by 16.0 points and coming within 2.0 points of the 70.0 mIoU achieved by the 639M-parameter teacher. We evaluate SegFormer B0, B1, and B2 students with 4.04M, 14.33M, and 28M parameters, respectively. Across all three variants, JEDI consistently outperforms response-, structure-, channel-, and relational-distillation baselines under the same teacher-student setting. These results show that persistent representation alignment is especially valuable under aggressive compression, substantially reducing model size and computation while preserving segmentation performance.

AI.tldr: JEDI是一种两阶段知识蒸馏框架，将大型I-JEPA视觉Transformer的表示迁移到紧凑的SegFormer学生模型中，通过跨架构投影、空间对齐和持续特征对齐，在CalCROP21数据集上以4.04M参数达到68.0 mIoU，比独立学生模型提升16.0个点。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉模型在遥感分割中表现优异，但模型规模过大难以部署在卫星或边缘设备上。现有的特征级蒸馏方法假设师生架构相似，且通常在任务训练开始后停止特征对齐，限制了压缩效果。
AI.method: JEDI采用两阶段框架：(1)第一阶段通过跨架构投影和空间对齐，将学生终端表示与教师token空间对齐；(2)第二阶段联合优化监督分割损失、温度缩放的响应蒸馏以及整个任务适应过程中的持续特征对齐。
AI.result: 在CalCROP21上，JEDI-B0以4.04M参数达到68.0 mIoU，比独立学生提升16.0个点，仅比639M参数的教师模型低2.0个点。在SegFormer B0/B1/B2三种学生变体上，JEDI均优于响应、结构、通道和关系蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: 持续特征对齐在激进压缩场景下尤为有价值，能够大幅减小模型规模和计算量，同时保持分割性能，验证了JEDI框架在边缘部署场景中的有效性。

title: Poisson Image Denoising Using Minimax Concave and Reweighted $\ell_1$ Penalties: Nonblind and Blind Approaches
summary: Images are important tools in various sciences. Despite the development of photo-taking tools, creating clear and image without noise remains challenging in practice. In particular, Poisson noise has an effect on medical and astronomical images, and reduces their quality. Additionally, blur is another factor that has an effect on image quality. The problem of image restoration becomes very complicated when we have no information about the Point Spread Function (PSF). These types of problems are known as blind case. However, in some images, such as some astronomical images, the type of PSF can be specified, and these types of problems are known as nonblind problems. Total Variation (TV) is a widely used method for solving such inverse problems, where the selection of the penalty function is the most critical factor that affects the method's performance. In this paper, to improve edge preservation, we employ a reweighted $\ell_1$-regularization of the fractional order derivative. Furthermore, we propose a nonblind and blind image deblurring approach under Poisson noise using the Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP), which is a continuous, sparsity promoting, and nearly unbiased regularizer. This formulation leads to a nonconvex optimization model. To solve the proposed model, we introduce an efficient numerical algorithm based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) and provide an analysis of its convergence. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are demonstrated through extensive experiments on various images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于MCP惩罚函数和分数阶导数重加权ℓ1正则化的图像去模糊方法，用于解决泊松噪声下的盲和非盲图像恢复问题，并通过ADMM算法高效求解非凸优化模型。
AI.motivation: 图像在医学和天文等领域中常受泊松噪声和模糊的影响而质量下降。当无PSF信息时（盲情况）图像恢复问题尤为复杂。传统的TV方法在惩罚函数选择上存在局限，需要更好的边缘保持正则化方法。
AI.method: 采用分数阶导数的重加权ℓ1正则化以改进边缘保持；提出基于Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP)的非凸优化模型，MCP是一种连续、促进稀疏且近乎无偏的正则化器；针对非凸模型设计基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的高效数值算法，并给出收敛性分析。
AI.result: 通过在多种图像上的大量实验，验证了所提出算法在泊松噪声下的盲和非盲图像去模糊任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MCP结合分数阶重加权ℓ1正则化的方法能有效改善图像去模糊中的边缘保持效果，ADMM算法在非凸模型下具备收敛性保证，整体方案在泊松噪声场景下表现良好。

title: TDDN: Text-aligned Diffused DINO Network for Puzzle Understanding
summary: Structured visual reasoning, such as image puzzles, demands fine-grained visual perception, an ability current Vision Language Models (VLMs) lack. VLMs built on CLIP-based ViT backbones trade fine-grained detail for high-level semantics, and we show this loss propagates downstream. To recover it, we fuse DINOv3 and CleanDIFT representations into a perception encoder (DiffusedDINO) and align it with RoBERTa-L, yielding a text-aligned model TDDN that preserves this perceptual advantage: with frozen backbones and only $\sim$590K alignment pairs, TDDN matches CLIP on image-text retrieval, surpassing it on three of four settings. It does so while more than tripling CLIP's dense-prediction accuracy (ADE20K 5.20 $\to$ 18.11 mIoU, COCO-Stuff 7.35 $\to$ 24.44), despite CLIP's massive training corpus. TDDN leads on segmentation benchmarks among general-purpose contrastive encoders, including SigLIP$\,$2. We further introduce Puzzle Perception, a segmentation and visual question answering dataset that probes fine-grained spatial understanding, on which TDDN doubles CLIP's segmentation accuracy (11.04 $\to$ 22.51 mIoU).

AI.tldr: 本文提出TDDN模型，通过融合DINOv3和CleanDIFT表示构建DiffusedDINO感知编码器，并与RoBERTa-L对齐，在冻结骨干和仅约59万对齐对的条件下，使视觉语言模型在图像文本检索上匹配CLIP、在三个设置中超越CLIP，同时在密集预测和图像拼图等细粒度感知任务上大幅超越CLIP，并引入了新的Puzzle Perception基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP-ViT的视觉语言模型（VLM）牺牲了细粒度视觉细节以换取高层语义信息，导致在图像拼图等结构化视觉推理任务中表现不足，且这种感知损失会向下游传播。
AI.method: 将DINOv3和CleanDIFT表示融合到感知编码器DiffusedDINO中，再与RoBERTa-L文本表示进行对齐，构建文本对齐模型TDDN。在推理时冻结骨干网络，只需约59万对齐样本进行训练。
AI.result: TDDN在图像文本检索上匹配并部分超越CLIP（四个设置中三个优于CLIP）；在ADE20K上mIoU从5.20提升到18.11，COCO-Stuff从7.35提升到24.44，密集预测精度是CLIP的三倍以上；在通用对比编码器中分割基准领先，包括SigLIP 2；在Puzzle Perception上分割精度较CLIP翻倍（11.04至22.51 mIoU）。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合自监督密集特征与语言对齐，可以在不牺牲高水平语义能力的前提下恢复细粒度视觉感知，为VLM在结构化视觉推理任务上提供更优的感知基础。

title: Bottom-up Modeling of Repeated Elements via Single Image Analysis-by-Synthesis
summary: We address the problem of discovering repeated elements from a single image. In contrast to existing approaches that depend on large annotated datasets, curated multi-image collections, or object segmentation masks, we show that a single image can suffice to learn a meaningful object model in a completely bottom-up fashion, without any prior knowledge beyond a coarse scale prior. Our method learns a tunable image-space prototype of the repeated elements through a reconstruction objective, enabling the model to identify and synthesize consistent object instances within the same image. Experiments on 116 real images from the FSC-147 dataset demonstrate that our method successfully learns coherent element models and captures intra-category variation on challenging images. Qualitative results reveal superior reconstructions and interpretable decompositions compared to classical decomposition, joint alignment, and 3D object modeling methods, while maintaining a simple 2D formulation. These results suggest that meaningful object discovery can emerge from single image learning alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从单张图像中自底向上发现重复元素的方法，无需大型标注数据集或多图像集合，仅通过重建目标学习可调图像空间原型，即可识别并合成图像内的一致对象实例。在FSC-147数据集116张真实图像上的实验证明了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有重复元素发现方法通常依赖大规模标注数据集、精心策划的多图像集合或对象分割掩码。作者旨在挑战这一假设，探究仅凭单张图像能否以完全自底向上的方式学习有意义的对象模型，从而降低数据依赖并简化任务设置。
AI.method: 方法通过学习一个可调（tunable）的图像空间原型来表征重复元素，并通过重建目标（reconstruction objective）进行优化，使模型能够同时识别和合成同一图像中的一致对象实例。整个过程仅需一个粗略的尺度先验，无需任何额外先验知识。
AI.result: 在FSC-147数据集的116张真实图像上进行实验，方法成功学习了连贯的元素模型并捕捉了类内变化。定性结果显示，与经典分解、联合对齐和3D对象建模方法相比，本方法在重建质量和可解释分解方面表现更优，同时保持了简单的2D形式。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，有意义的目标发现可以从单图像学习中涌现，无需外部数据或先验知识（除粗略尺度外），为重复元素检测任务提供了一种更简洁且数据高效的解决方案。

title: ReactVAU: A Slow-Fast Decoupled Framework for Streaming Video Anomaly Understanding
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://huiyuiui.github.io/React_VAU/
summary: In this paper, we propose ReactVAU, a Slow-Fast Decoupled Framework for real-time streaming Video Anomaly Understanding (VAU). Existing VAU methods rely on offline inference with global temporal sampling, which violates causality and prevents deployment in live surveillance streams. Conversely, general streaming video models satisfy causal access but dilute rare transient anomalies during memory compression and often invoke heavyweight MLLMs uniformly over long normal intervals. React VAU addresses this gap with three synergistic components: a lightweight Fast Detection Module based on Spatial Grid Folding (SGF) for continuous anomaly filtering; an Anomaly-Aware Persistent Memory (AAPM) that protects critical visual cues from temporal decay; and a heavyweight Slow Reasoning Module that remains dormant during normal streams and is awakened only by suspicious events for semantic verification and causal description. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ReactVAU operates under strict streaming constraints while simultaneously achieving competitive performance in both anomaly detection and causal reasoning, alongside significantly enhanced computational efficiency by minimizing heavyweight MLLM invocations. Project page is available at https://huiyuiui.github.io/React_VAU/

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReactVAU，一个用于实时流式视频异常理解（VAU）的慢-快解耦框架。它通过轻量级快速检测模块（SGF）、异常感知持久记忆（AAPM）和仅在异常事件时唤醒的重型慢速推理模块，在严格流式约束下实现异常检测与因果推理，同时大幅提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有VAU方法依赖离线推理和全局时序采样，违反因果性且无法部署于实时监控流；而通用流式视频模型会稀释罕见瞬时异常，并且会均匀地调用重型MLLM导致巨大计算开销。
AI.method: 提出三个协同组件：1) 基于空间网格折叠（SGF）的轻量快速检测模块，用于连续异常过滤；2) 异常感知持久记忆（AAPM）保护关键视觉线索免受时间衰减；3) 重型慢速推理模块在正常流期间保持休眠，仅在可疑事件时被唤醒用于语义验证和因果描述。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，ReactVAU在严格流式约束下运行，同时在异常检测和因果推理上取得有竞争力的性能，并通过最小化重型MLLM调用显著提升计算效率。
AI.conclusion: ReactVAU有效弥合了流式视频理解与异常理解之间的差距，证明了在实时监控场景中既能保持因果性又能实现高效准确的异常检测与推理是可行的。

title: TaskGuard: Task-Conditioned Restoration Utility for Risk-Aware Object Detection
comment: 15 pages total: 9-page main paper with 4 figures and 4 tables; 6-page supplementary material with 2 figures and 8 tables
summary: Image restoration is commonly applied before object detection under adverse conditions, yet a visually improved image need not improve the downstream task. We study this mismatch as restoration utility prediction: given a degraded image and its candidate restoration, should the restoration be used or should the original observation be preserved? We introduce TaskGuard, a post-hoc controller for frozen restoration and detection pipelines. TaskGuard characterizes the realized restoration residual through its interaction with detector sensitivity and predicts whether the intervention is task-beneficial. Exact regional counterfactuals reveal substantial within-image utility heterogeneity, while a deployable pseudo-gradient preserves statistically reliable directional information. Feature-group ablation further shows that task-conditioned evidence contributes information beyond detector-response and residual statistics. The TaskGuard utility predictor is trained only on Gaussian degradation and frozen before final evaluation, then transferred to unseen motion blur, rain, and defocus. Across these unseen families, TaskGuard reduces lossnegative interventions by 54.2% (family macro) and practical per-image detection deteriorations by 37.0% (pooled), while preserving 98.8% of the Always-Restore COCO AP. On natural-rain DAWN, it reduces loss-negative interventions by 97.9% while retaining 77.8% of the AP improvement obtained by deraining. These results support restoration utility as a task-conditioned property of the specific intervention rather than image appearance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TaskGuard，一种用于冻结的复原-检测流水线的后置控制器，通过预测图像复原操作是否对下游检测任务有益，来决定是否采用该复原结果，而非盲目使用。TaskGuard仅需在高斯退化数据上训练，即可泛化到运动模糊、雨雾和散焦等未见退化类型，显著减少"损失性干预"并保留大部分原有性能。
AI.motivation: 图像复原通常在下游目标检测之前执行，但视觉上更优的图像未必能提升检测性能。现有工作忽视了这一复原效用与下游任务之间的错配问题，需要一种能判断给定复原是否对检测任务有益的机制。
AI.method: TaskGuard作为后置控制器，不修改已有的复原和检测模型。它通过表征复原残差与检测器敏感性的交互来预测干预是否有益。精确的区域级反事实分析揭示了图像内部的效用异质性，同时采用可部署的伪梯度保留可靠的统计方向信息。特征组消融表明任务条件化证据超越单纯的检测器响应和残差统计。模型仅在高斯退化上训练后冻结，然后迁移到未见退化类型。
AI.result: 在未见退化类型（运动模糊、雨、散焦）上，TaskGuard减少了54.2%（类别宏平均）的损失性干预，实际逐图像检测退化减少37.0%（合并），同时保留了Always-Restore COCO AP的98.8%。在自然雨DAWN数据集上，损失性干预减少97.9%，同时保留了去雨所得AP改进的77.8%。
AI.conclusion: 复原效用是特定干预的任务条件化属性，而非仅取决于图像外观。TaskGuard证明了可以在不重新训练下游模型的情况下，做出可靠的复原采用决策，并具有良好的跨退化类型泛化能力。

title: A Black-Box Adversarial Attack on Human Pose Estimation and Keypoint-Based Action Recognition Models
summary: Human pose estimation and keypoint-based action recognition models are increasingly deployed as components of video understanding pipelines, yet their vulnerability to adversarial attacks remains insufficiently studied. Temporally coherent black-box attacks have been previously studied in visual object tracking, where the attack feedback can be defined using bounding-box overlap measures such as Intersection over Union (IoU). However, human pose estimation produces keypoint configurations rather than enclosing boxes, making box-level similarity poorly suited for measuring pose degradation. We propose OKS Attack, a decision-based black-box attack that uses Object Keypoint Similarity (OKS) as the attack feedback signal, directly targeting the spatial structure of human poses rather than their enclosing boxes. Experiments on the Penn Action dataset show that OKS Attack consistently reduces pose quality across evaluated pose estimators, with mean OKS decreases ranging from 0.0802 to 0.1494. In a downstream cross-dataset action-recognition evaluation, the attack reduces accuracy by 6.18 to 13.86 percentage points and outperforms query-matched random-noise perturbations. The attack is effective across both top-down and single-stage pose estimation models. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/KacperM33/OKS_attack

AI.tldr: 本文提出OKS Attack，一种基于决策的黑盒攻击方法，利用OKS（对象关键点相似度）作为攻击反馈信号，直接针对人体姿态估计的关键点空间结构进行攻击，而非包围框级别。实验表明该方法能有效降低姿态质量并在下游动作识别任务中显著降低精度。
AI.motivation: 人体姿态估计和基于关键点的动作识别模型越来越广泛部署于视频理解流程中，但其对抗攻击脆弱性研究不足。已有时间一致的攻击方法主要用于视觉目标跟踪（基于IoU边框重叠度量），而人体姿态估计输出关键点配置而非包围框，使用框级相似度难以有效衡量姿态退化，因此需要设计专门针对姿态估计的黑盒攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出OKS Attack，一种基于决策的黑盒攻击方法。使用对象关键点相似度（OKS）作为攻击反馈信号，替代传统的IoU或其他框级相似度度量。该方法不依赖模型的内部梯度信息，仅通过查询决策输出来生成时间连贯的攻击扰动，直接针对人类姿态的空间结构而非包围盒进行干扰。
AI.result: 在Penn Action数据集上的实验表明，OKS Attack在多个姿态估计模型上持续降低姿态质量，平均OKS下降范围在0.0802到0.1494之间。在下游跨数据集动作识别评估中，攻击使准确率降低6.18至13.86个百分点，并优于查询匹配的随机噪声扰动。该方法对自上而下（top-down）和单阶段姿态估计模型均有效。
AI.conclusion: OKS Attack首次系统地利用OKS作为姿态估计黑盒攻击的反馈信号，验证了将攻击目标从包围框层面提升到关键点结构层面的有效性。该攻击在跨模型和跨任务场景下均表现出强大的攻击力，为姿态估计模型的安全评估提供了新的攻击范式。源代码将公开供社区使用。

title: Flexible Motion Generation from Language and Style References
summary: We introduce FlexMoGen, a novel framework for flexible human motion synthesis conditioned on both natural language descriptions and motion style references. Text prompts are effective at defining semantic content, but they are often limited in capturing fine-grained style details such as timing, limb articulation, and expressive dynamics. A style example clip supplements the text by conveying these nuanced motion characteristics directly, enabling the model to preserve high-level intent while reproducing the desired stylistic traits. Given a text prompt and a style example clip, FlexMoGen generates high-quality motions that preserve semantic content while faithfully reflecting the target style, offering users greater control over the animation generation process. Unlike prior methods that rely on discrete style labels and do not generalize to long or multi-style generation, FlexMoGen learns a variational style encoder without style supervision and supports long, time-varying, multi-style synthesis. Our framework jointly pre-trains the style encoder and a text-to-motion latent diffusion model within a unified architecture, modulating motion style through a lightweight adaptation module. It integrates an efficient relative positional encoding scheme and is trained on both stylized and non-stylized datasets, enabling strong generalization to unseen text-style combinations. Experiments show that FlexMoGen achieves the best balance between content fidelity and style reflection.

AI.tldr: FlexMoGen是一个新颖的框架，用于基于自然语言描述和动作风格参考进行灵活的人体运动合成。它通过变分风格编码器（无需风格监督）与文本到运动的潜在扩散模型联合预训练，支持长时间、时变、多风格的合成，在内容保真度和风格反映之间达到最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 文本提示虽然在定义语义内容方面有效，但在捕捉细粒度的风格细节（如时间节奏、肢体关节表达和表现力动态）方面存在局限。此外，现有方法依赖离散的风格标签，且无法泛化到长时间或多风格生成场景。
AI.method: FlexMoGen在统一架构中联合预训练变分风格编码器和文本到运动的潜在扩散模型，通过轻量级适应模块来调制运动风格，并集成了高效相对位置编码方案，同时在风格化和非风格化数据集上进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明FlexMoGen在内容保真度和风格反映之间实现了最佳平衡，并且对未见过的文本-风格组合具有很强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FlexMoGen通过引入风格示例片段补充文本提示，能够在不牺牲语义内容的前提下忠实反映目标风格，为用户提供对动画生成过程更强的控制能力，克服了以往方法在风格监督依赖和长时间/多风格生成方面的局限。

title: SAFER-Activities: A Dataset for Smart Assessment of Fall Events and Routine Activities
summary: Smart healthcare monitoring systems require precise action recognition to ensure well-being and timely intervention in critical situations such as falls, particularly for mobility-challenged individuals. Existing datasets are often clip-based, lacking the frame-level detail needed to recognize actions online, as they unfold. To address this, we introduce SAFER-Activities, a dataset for fall detection and physical activity monitoring, with a dedicated subset for wheelchair use scenarios. It comprises over 66 hours of video data captured by multiple cameras, with 85,310 action instances and frame-level annotations for 30 action classes. We benchmark action recognition on SAFER-Activities with 2D and 3D skeleton models, RGB models with frozen backbones, and multimodal fusion strategies, and evaluate on in-lab, out-of-distribution, and cross-dataset test sets. Skeleton-based models generalize best under domain shift; fusing frozen RGB features with the skeleton stream improves in-domain recognition over the baseline CNN1D, most clearly on the wheelchair subset, but degrades out of distribution. Cross-dataset and qualitative evaluations confirm that models trained on SAFER-Activities transfer well to unseen environments and external fall data. To support research on robust fall detection and activity monitoring, we release the dataset and code at https://safer-activities.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SAFER-Activities 数据集，包含超过66小时的带帧级标注的多摄像头视频数据，覆盖30个动作类别（含85,310个实例），专门设有轮椅使用场景子集，用于跌倒检测和体力活动监测。作者通过2D/3D骨架模型、RGB冻结骨干模型及多模态融合策略进行基准测试，发现骨架模型在域偏移下泛化最佳，且融合冻结RGB特征能提升域内识别但降低分布外性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动作识别数据集多为基于片段的标注，缺乏识别在线（实时进行中）动作所需的帧级细节；且面向跌倒检测和活动监测的公开数据集不足，尤其是缺少轮椅使用者的场景，难以支撑智能医疗保健监测系统在紧急情况下（如跌倒）的精准动作识别需求。
AI.method: 构建SAFER-Activities数据集（66小时+、多摄像头、85,310个动作实例、30类别、帧级标注）；使用2D和3D骨架模型、冻结骨干RGB模型、以及多模态融合（冻结RGB特征+骨架流）等方法进行基准测试；在实验室内、分布外、跨数据集三种测试集上评估。
AI.result: 骨架模型在域偏移下泛化最佳；融合冻结RGB特征与骨架流在域内识别上优于基线CNN1D（在轮椅子集上最明显），但分布外性能下降；跨数据集与定性评估表明SAFER-Activities上训练的模型能很好地迁移到未见环境及外部跌倒数据。
AI.conclusion: SAFER-Activities数据集及代码已公开，为鲁棒的跌倒检测与活动监测研究提供支撑，验证了帧级标注数据集对在线动作识别和跨域泛化的重要性。

title: MamMA: A Mamba-Based Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction Algorithm Considering Occupancy Map and Pedestrian Awareness States
comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026). 7 pages, 5 figures
summary: Many pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms have been proposed to improve the safety of navigation for mobile robots working in human-robot coexistence environments. Some pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms extract information about obstacles near pedestrians from top-down view images to improve the accuracy of trajectory prediction. However, mobile robots typically create local occupancy maps using LiDAR, rather than top-down view images. Meanwhile, the vision sensors on board robots provide egocentric view images, which contain fine-grained behavioral information about the pedestrians near the robot. To better use the information collected by LiDAR and on-board vision sensors, we propose MamMA, a Mamba-based pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithm considering occupancy maps and pedestrian awareness states. MamMA divides the occupancy map by patches and extracts obstacle features from each patch to create map features. Pedestrian awareness states are divided and considered, as some studies show that awareness states affect the perception and speed of pedestrians. Furthermore, a Mamba-based model is proposed to predict the future trajectories of pedestrians based on different types of features. Experiments on the STCrowd, SiT, JRDB, ETH, and UCY datasets show that MamMA achieves better average displacement error and final displacement error than the state-of-the-art algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MamMA，一种基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法，结合LiDAR局部占用图和机器人视觉传感器采集的自我中心视角图像，考虑占用图特征与行人感知状态，在多个公开数据集上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测算法多依赖俯视图获取行人附近障碍物信息，但移动机器人实际使用LiDAR生成局部占用图，且机器人视觉传感器提供的是含有行人细粒度行为信息的自我中心视角图像。如何更好地利用LiDAR和视觉传感器采集的信息来提高行人轨迹预测精度是核心动机。
AI.method: MamMA将占用图按补丁（patch）划分，从每个patch中提取障碍物特征以构建地图特征；同时划分并考虑行人感知状态（awareness states），因为已有研究表明感知状态会影响行人的感知和速度；最后提出基于Mamba的模型，基于不同类型特征预测行人未来轨迹。
AI.result: 在STCrowd、SiT、JRDB、ETH和UCY数据集上的实验表明，MamMA在平均位移误差（ADE）和最终位移误差（FDE）上均优于现有最先进的算法。
AI.conclusion: MamMA通过融合LiDAR占用图特征与行人感知状态，并利用Mamba模型进行轨迹预测，有效提升了在人机共存环境中行人轨迹预测的准确性，为移动机器人导航安全提供了更可靠的方案。

title: A Quantitative Evaluation Framework for Temporal Explainability in Echocardiographic Video Segmentation
summary: Deep learning has achieved state-of-the-art performance in echocardiographic video segmentation, with an increasing number of models incorporating temporal information. However, quantitative evaluation of temporal explainability remains largely unexplored. We propose a quantitative framework for evaluating Grad-CAM explanations using four complementary metrics measuring temporal consistency, saliency motion, anatomical overlap, and temporal overlap. Using EchoNet-Dynamic, we compare a baseline 2D U-Net with ConvLSTM U-Net models trained across multiple temporal strides. While segmentation performance remained comparable across all models, intermediate ConvLSTM explanations exhibited substantially lower saliency consistency and greater centroid motion than final prediction explanations. Temporal Bottleneck explanations were significantly more stable than Encoder Bottleneck explanations across all strides, while final ConvLSTM Decoder3 explanations were broadly comparable to those of the 2D U-Net. Importantly, conventional frame-wise explanation metrics cannot determine whether variation in intermediate explanations reflects meaningful temporal feature evolution or explanation instability. These findings establish a preliminary quantitative framework for temporal explainability and motivate temporal-aware XAI methods that explicitly account for evolving representations in medical video models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于评估超声心动图视频分割模型中Grad-CAM时间可解释性的定量框架，包含四种互补指标（时间一致性、显著性运动、解剖重叠和时间重叠），并通过EchoNet-Dynamic数据集对2D U-Net与ConvLSTM U-Net模型进行了比较分析。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在超声心动图视频分割中已取得先进性能，越来越多的模型引入了时间信息，但时间可解释性的定量评估仍基本空白，现有逐帧解释指标无法区分中间层解释变化反映的是有意义的时序特征演化还是解释不稳定。
AI.method: 提出包含四种互补度量的定量框架：时间一致性（temporal consistency）、显著性运动（saliency motion）、解剖重叠（anatomical overlap）和时间重叠（temporal overlap）。使用EchoNet-Dynamic数据集，比较基线2D U-Net与在多种时间步长下训练的ConvLSTM U-Net模型。
AI.result: 所有模型的分割性能相当，但中间层ConvLSTM解释的显著一致性显著更低、质心运动更大。Temporal Bottleneck解释在所有步长下显著比Encoder Bottleneck更稳定，而最终ConvLSTM Decoder3解释与2D U-Net大体相当。
AI.conclusion: 建立了时间可解释性的初步定量评估框架，并强调了医学视频模型中需要显式考虑表示演化的时间感知XAI方法。

title: RFS-UNet: Decoder-Conditioned High-Resolution Skip Recalibration for Bone-Selective DRR Synthesis
summary: Bone-selective digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) synthesis depends on high-resolution encoder detail, yet static skips cannot condition reuse on the evolving decoder representation. We ask whether decoder state adds useful information beyond encoder-only self-recalibration for high-resolution skip reuse. RFS-UNet uses pooled encoder and aligned decoder statistics for bounded residual channel recalibration at the 512^2 and 256^2 skips, leaving the backbone unchanged. In the matched seed-2026 comparison isolating decoder conditioning, RFS raises validation PSNR by 0.254 dB over Self-RFS. Across three seeds, locked-test PSNR rises from 33.225+/-0.048 to 33.537+/-0.128 dB; RFS lowers MAE in 179/200 held-out CT cases and reduces mean MAE by 3.91%. It adds 0.117% parameters and 1.169% counted Conv2d operations. These results support decoder state as a useful conditioning signal for high-resolution feature reuse in controlled paired projection synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RFS-UNet，在UNet的高分辨率跳跃连接中引入基于池化编码器和对齐解码器统计量的残差通道重校准机制，使特征重用能根据解码器状态动态调整。在骨骼选择性DRR合成任务中，与仅依赖编码器自校准的Self-RFS相比，RFS在验证PSNR上提升0.254 dB，锁定测试PSNR从33.225±0.048提升至33.537±0.128 dB，并在179/200个CT案例中降低MAE（平均降低3.91%），参数仅增加0.117%、计算量增加1.169%。
AI.motivation: 传统的静态跳跃连接无法根据不断演化的解码器表示来条件化复用高分辨率特征，作者质疑解码器状态是否能为高分辨率跳跃复用提供超越编码器自校准的额外有用信息。
AI.method: RFS-UNet在512²和256²的跳跃连接处，利用池化的编码器特征和对齐的解码器统计量进行有界残差通道重校准，同时保持骨干网络结构不变，以隔离评估解码器条件化的效果。
AI.result: 匹配seed-2026对比中，RFS比Self-RFS提升验证PSNR 0.254 dB；三种子锁定测试PSNR从33.225±0.048提升至33.537±0.128 dB；179/200个CT案例MAE降低，平均MAE减少3.91%；仅增加0.117%参数和1.169%的Conv2d计算量。
AI.conclusion: 解码器状态是高分辨率特征复用的有效条件信号，RFS在受控配对投影合成中实现了稳健且参数高效的性能提升。

title: BrachistoneLR: A Brachistochrone-Inspired Learning-Rate Schedule and a Controlled Benchmark of Scheduling Policies
summary: The learning-rate schedule is a consequential choice in training deep networks, yet the policies in common use are heuristic, and published comparisons are hard to read, because architecture, dataset, and budget tend to vary alongside the schedule. We study BrachistoneLR, a schedule built by mapping the vertical coordinate of the brachistochrone, the curve of fastest descent under gravity, onto the range between a peak and a floor rate. Expanding the definition shows it to be cosine annealing with the half-period set to E - 1 instead of E, the configuration a standard implementation gives when its period argument is one less than the number of epochs. The rate therefore reaches its floor at the last epoch trained rather than one epoch later, and we show this difference decays as E^-2, making it a short-horizon effect. We then benchmark six schedules over 72 runs on three image classification datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10) and four architecture families (fully connected, convolutional, recurrent, residual), fixing the optimizer, data pipeline, and evaluation protocol so that only the schedule varies. Schedules that fall smoothly from peak to floor beat the constant rate and calendar-based decay by margins that grow with task difficulty, reaching 2.5 points of dataset mean on CIFAR-10. Within that leading group, BrachistoneLR, cosine annealing, and warmup-cosine lie within 0.06 accuracy points and 0.17 of a mean rank, which one seed per configuration cannot separate. BrachistoneLR is best on both residual networks and has the highest CIFAR-10 mean, and it sets no milestones, decay factor, warmup length, or restart period. We conclude that the shape of a schedule matters more than its parameterization, that the choice of whether to use a smooth schedule matters more than the choice among them, and that the terminal-rate distinction is worth attention only over short horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种名为BrachistoneLR的学习率调度策略，它本质上是周期参数设为E-1（而非E）的余弦退火。作者在三个图像分类数据集和四种架构族上进行了72次实验，发现平滑下降的调度策略优于恒定学习率和基于日历的衰减，任务越难优势越大（CIFAR-10上最高提升2.5个百分点）。BrachistoneLR、余弦退火和warmup-cosine之间差异极小（0.06精度点以内），无法用单种子区分。
AI.motivation: 学习率调度策略是训练深度网络的重要选择，但现有策略多为启发式，且已有比较研究因架构、数据集和预算同时变化而难以解读。作者希望在一个严格控制变量的条件下，公平比较不同调度策略。
AI.method: 将最速下降曲线的纵向坐标映射到峰值与下限学习率之间，构建BrachistoneLR；通过数学推导证明其等价于周期参数为E-1的余弦退火。然后在三个数据集（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10）和四种架构（全连接、卷积、循环、残差）上固定优化器、数据管道和评估协议，仅改变调度策略进行72次基准测试。
AI.result: 平滑下降的调度策略显著优于恒定学习率和基于日历的衰减，优势随任务难度增加而增长，在CIFAR-10上最高达2.5个百分点。BrachistoneLR、余弦退火和warmup-cosine彼此差异在0.06精度点内，无法用单种子区分。BrachistoneLR在残差网络上表现最优且CIFAR-10均值最高。与标准余弦退火的差异以E^-2衰减，属于短周期效应。
AI.conclusion: 调度策略的形状比参数化更重要；是否使用平滑调度比在多种平滑调度之间做选择更重要；末端学习率的差异只在短训练周期中值得关注。

title: VI-Bench: Benchmarking Prompt Inversion from AIGC Videos
summary: Recent advances in video generation have made prompt-based control increasingly central to AIGC video generation. Prompts specify what a video should depict and how it should be represented, controlling factors such as visual style or camera behavior. Understanding this recoverability is important both for creative reuse and editing, and for assessing prompt leakage risks. However, existing video understanding benchmarks do not measure this capability: a caption may describe what is visible, but a replayable prompt must recover the generation-relevant controls needed to reproduce the video. To address this gap, we introduce VI-Bench, a benchmark built from 16.1 million real-user prompts and 900 human-verified AIGC videos. VI-Bench spans three progressively harder settings, namely single-shot semantic grounding, control over style and camera behavior, and multi-shot compositional inversion, and evaluates five generation-critical dimensions: subject, action, scene, style, and camera. We evaluate 18 representative VLMs, including 2 proprietary and 16 open-source models on VI-Bench, using an Inversion Score that measures prompt-level alignment with the original prompt and video-level fidelity of the regenerated video. The results reveal substantial limitations: even the strongest model achieves only 0.632 on Inversion Score, performance degrades sharply as samples require richer control and multi-shot reasoning, and models often produce plausible prompts whose regenerated videos deviate from the reference. These findings show that video prompt inversion is a distinct and under-evaluated capability requiring models to transform visual understanding into replay-stable generative control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VI-Bench基准，基于1610万真实用户提示和900个经过人工验证的AIGC视频构建，用于评估视频提示反演能力（将视频恢复为可重放生成的控制参数），跨越语义接地、风格/相机控制、多镜头组合反演三个递进难度的设置，并评测了18个代表性视觉语言模型，发现即使最强模型也仅达到0.632的反演分数，揭示了视频提示反演是一个独特且未被充分评估的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准无法衡量提示反演能力：一个说明性标题只能描述视频中可见的内容，但可重放的提示必须恢复生成相关的控制参数（如视觉风格、相机行为）以复现视频。这一能力对创意复用、编辑以及评估提示泄露风险都至关重要。
AI.method: 从1610万真实用户提示和900个人工验证的AIGC视频构建VI-Bench基准，涵盖三个递进难度的设置（单次语义接地、风格与相机控制、多镜头组合反演），评测五个生成关键维度（主体、动作、场景、风格、相机），采用反演分数（Inversion Score）同时评估提示级对齐与视频级保真度，对18个代表性VLM（2个专有、16个开源）进行了系统评估。
AI.result: 最强模型在反演分数上仅达到0.632；随着样本需要更丰富的控制环节和多镜头推理，性能急剧下降；模型经常生成看似合理的提示但重生成的视频与参考视频存在明显偏差。18个VLM在该任务上的整体表现显著不足。
AI.conclusion: 视频提示反演是一种独特且未被充分评估的能力，要求模型将视觉理解转化为可重放稳定的生成控制，VI-Bench为此提供了首个系统化评测基准。现有VLM在该任务上的局限表明需要将可重放生成控制能力纳入模型训练与评估体系。

title: Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Monocular depth estimation is a ubiquitous yet highly ill-posed computer vision task, with downstream applications in scene reconstruction, computational photography, and robotics, among others. Despite the field's maturity, recent models still struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution inputs and to produce sharp and detailed depth maps. In this paper, we revisit Marigold, a set of techniques for repurposing modern image generation and editing models, powered by the diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture, into state-of-the-art monocular depth estimators. Our recipes target single-step inference from pretrained multi-step flow-matching models, with quantization where needed, preserving model capacity while remaining cheap to run. We analyze the artifacts of naive training and identify two effective remedies: aligning the model's internal representations with semantic features extracted from ground-truth, and adopting a 2-stage fine-tuning protocol built around a novel Sinkhorn-based loss. The results are crisper, cleaner depth maps that generalize well out-of-distribution, with 16-26% improvement in AbsRel over the previous best on KITTI and ETH3D. Qualitatively, our model resolves fur, foliage, and hair-thin edges that have eluded prior models. Furthermore, Marigold V2 achieves state-of-the-art results when applied to other dense regression tasks, such as surface normals estimation and intrinsic image decomposition. Project website: https://hf.co/spaces/huawei-bayerlab/marigold-v2-web

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Marigold V2，一套利用扩散变换器（DiT）架构的图像生成模型改造成单目深度估计器的技术方案，通过单步推理、量化、语义特征对齐和基于Sinkhorn损失的两阶段微调，在KITTI和ETH3D上将AbsRel提升了16-26%，并拓展到表面法线估计等稠密回归任务。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计虽已成熟，但现有模型在分布外输入上泛化能力差，且生成的深度图不够锐利和精细，无法处理毛发、树叶等细节边缘。
AI.method: 1) 从预训练的多步流匹配模型中蒸馏出单步推理能力，并采用必要的量化策略降低计算成本；2) 将模型的内部表示与从真实深度标签中提取的语义特征进行对齐；3) 提出基于Sinkhorn损失的两阶段微调协议，并在训练中分析并修复了朴素训练产生的伪影。
AI.result: 在KITTI和ETH3D上较先前最优方法提升了16-26%的AbsRel；深度图更锐利清晰，能解析毛发、树叶等纤细边缘；在表面法线估计和本征图像分解等其他稠密回归任务上也达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: Marigold V2证明通过精心设计的训练策略（语义对齐、两阶段微调、Sinkhorn损失），可以高效地将扩散生成模型转化为高质量、强泛化能力的稠密预测工具。

title: SynthGait-19K: A Physically Grounded Synthetic Video Dataset for Gait Parameter Estimation
summary: Accurate estimation of clinically meaningful gait parameters from monocular video is important for scalable mobility assessment, yet progress is limited by the small scale, restricted viewpoints, and limited visual diversity of existing datasets. We introduce SynthGait-19k, a physically grounded synthetic video dataset containing 19,272 walking videos derived from 6,427 MoCap sequences across 437 subjects, with paired SMPL motion and annotations for six gait parameters. To construct the dataset, we develop Gait2Vid, which unifies heterogeneous MoCap recordings through SMPL and synthesizes diverse RGB walking videos under controllable viewpoints and scene appearances. We assess the generated videos for consistency with their conditioning gait kinematics and validate extracted gait events against force-platform measurements. Using SynthGait-19K, we benchmark direct RGB, pose-based, biomechanical, and human-mesh-recovery approaches and analyze viewpoint, training-data scale, and synthetic-to-real domain shift. We also introduce GaitXFormer as a direct RGB reference model for estimating gait parameters. Synthetic supervision transfers effectively to real videos across both GaitXFormer and a pose-based architecture, demonstrating utility across different representations. We further find that spatial gait parameters are more sensitive to visual domain shift and that improved HMR reconstruction alone does not necessarily translate to improved downstream gait estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SynthGait-19k，一个包含19,272个步行视频的物理约束合成数据集，并开发了Gait2Vid框架从MoCap数据合成多样化RGB视频。通过基准测试和提出的GaitXFormer模型，验证了合成数据监督可有效迁移到真实视频的步态参数估计任务。
AI.motivation: 从单目视频准确估计临床步态参数对可扩展的移动能力评估至关重要，但现有数据集存在规模小、视角受限、视觉多样性不足等限制，阻碍了该领域进展。
AI.method: 构建Gait2Vid框架，通过SMPL统一异构MoCap记录并合成多样化RGB步行视频；生成SynthGait-19k数据集（19,272个视频、6,427个MoCap序列、437个受试者，配对SMPL运动和六个步态参数标注）；提出GaitXFormer作为直接RGB参考模型。
AI.result: 合成监督在GaitXFormer和基于姿态的架构上均有效迁移到真实视频；发现空间步态参数对视觉域迁移更敏感；改进的HMR重建不必然转化为更好的下游步态估计。
AI.conclusion: SynthGait-19k和Gait2Vid提供了可扩展的步态估计训练数据方案，合成数据的迁移能力在不同表征上得到验证，为临床步态评估提供了有价值的基准和方法参考。

title: DriveMotion: A Large-Scale Multi-Source Benchmark for Driver Motion Sequence Modeling and Forecasting
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 18 tables. Dataset and benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/HenryYHW/DriveMotion; project page: https://wangyuhang-cmd.github.io/drivemotion/
summary: Driver motion can provide cues to ongoing behavior, attention, and near-term driving intent. However, most existing driver-centric datasets focus on recognizing predefined driver behaviors from short video clips, while human motion forecasting benchmarks largely target motion outside the vehicle. We introduce DriveMotion, a multi-source benchmark for continuous driver motion forecasting. DriveMotion contains 393 hours of 133-keypoint motion sequences at 10 Hz from 360 drivers, integrating naturalistic driving data, curated public in-cabin videos, and the AIDE dataset into a unified representation with per-joint validity masks and synchronized driving context. Naturalistic driving contains long periods of limited body movement, making uniformly sampled evaluation dominated by persistence and less sensitive to brief but behaviorally meaningful motion. To address this, we use dynamics-anchored evaluation, placing forecasting windows around vehicle maneuvers identified offline from CAN signals without providing CAN to the model at inference. Arm motion in pre-maneuver windows is 3.4x greater than in route-matched stable-driving controls. On these anchored windows, learned models reduce forecasting error over persistence by up to 15%, while maneuver-enriched training improves forecast-derived Part-State F1 by 44% over the zero-motion reference. Training on the full multi-source corpus further reduces forecasting error on held-out web drivers by 38% compared with BATON-only training. DriveMotion provides identity-disjoint splits, fixed evaluation subsets, and reference implementations for reproducible evaluation of continuous driver motion forecasting. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/HenryYHW/DriveMotion

AI.tldr: DriveMotion是一个多源、连续驾驶者运动预测基准，包含393小时、360名驾驶者的133关键点运动序列数据。该基准提出了动力学锚定评估方法（dynamics-anchored evaluation），在车辆机动操作前的窗口内评估运动预测，解决了自然驾驶数据中运动稀疏导致评估不敏感的问题。实验表明该方法在机动窗口上比持久性基线提升最高15%的预测误差，机动增强训练使Part-State F1提升44%，多源训练比单源训练降低38%的预测误差。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶者中心数据集主要关注从短视频片段中识别预定义驾驶行为，而人体运动预测基准大多针对车外运动场景，缺乏面向连续驾驶者运动预测的综合基准。同时自然驾驶数据中长时间的身体运动有限，均匀采样评估会被持续性预测主导，难以捕捉短暂但具有行为意义的运动。
AI.method: 构建DriveMotion基准，融合自然驾驶数据、公开车内视频和AIDE数据集为统一表示（含133关键点、10Hz、逐关节有效掩码和同步驾驶上下文）。提出动力学锚定评估策略，基于CAN信号离线识别车辆机动操作，将预测窗口放置在机动操作前进行评估，推理时不向模型提供CAN信号。采用Part-State F1等指标，并设计身份不重叠划分、固定评估子集和参考实现。
AI.result: 机动前窗口的手臂运动幅度是路线匹配的可控稳定驾驶状态的3.4倍。在锚定窗口上，学习模型相比持久性基线最多降低15%的预测误差；机动增强训练使Part-State F1相对零运动参考提升44%；基于完整多源语料库训练相比仅用BATON训练，在未见的网页驾驶者上的预测误差降低38%。
AI.conclusion: DriveMotion为连续驾驶者运动预测提供了首个多源综合基准，其动力学锚定评估范式能有效聚焦于行为有意义的运动窗口，多源数据融合策略验证了跨域泛化的可行性和价值，为未来驾驶者行为建模研究提供了可复现的评估基础设施。

title: Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection via Group Sparse Low-Rank Tensor Factorization With Automatic Anomaly Grouping
summary: Low-rank tensor modeling has become an effective tool for hyperspectral anomaly detection. However, existing methods still suffer from high computational cost and limited flexibility in characterizing spatially structured anomalies. To address these issues, this paper proposes a hyperspectral anomaly detection method based on group sparse low-rank tensor factorization with automatic anomaly grouping (GSAA). Specifically, the low tubal rank background is characterized by imposing group sparsity on tensor factors, which provides an efficient alternative to direct tensor rank regularization. For anomaly modeling, a latent grouping map is introduced to build an automatic anomaly grouping penalty, allowing anomaly groups to be adaptively inferred from the data rather than predefined at the pixel level. To further exploit complementary spectral and spatial information, GSAA is applied in both domains, and the resulting detection maps are fused to form a spectral--spatial version of GSAA, termed GSAA-SS. An efficient linearized alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm with convergence guarantee is developed to solve the resulting model. Experimental results on five real hyperspectral datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior detection performance and competitive computational efficiency compared with several state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于组稀疏低秩张量分解与自动异常分组的高光谱异常检测方法（GSAA），通过在张量因子上施加组稀疏约束来高效刻画低秩背景，并引入潜在分组图实现异常的自适应分组；进一步提出谱-空联合版本GSAA-SS，并开发了具有收敛保证的线性化ADMM算法。在五个真实高光谱数据集上验证了方法的优越性能与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩张量高光谱异常检测方法存在计算成本高、难以灵活刻画空间结构异常的问题，需要一种更高效且能自适应建模异常空间结构的检测方法。
AI.method: 1）在张量因子上施加组稀疏约束以刻画低管秩背景，替代直接张量秩正则化，降低计算成本；2）引入潜在分组图构建自动异常分组惩罚项，使异常组从数据中自适应推断，而非在像素级预先定义；3）分别在光谱域和空间域应用该方法（GSAA），融合检测图得到谱空联合版本GSAA-SS；4）设计带收敛保证的线性化交替方向乘子法（LADMM）求解模型。
AI.result: 在五个真实高光谱数据集上的实验表明，所提方法相比多种最先进方法取得了更优的检测性能，同时具有有竞争力的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提GSAA/GSAA-SS方法能有效解决现有低秩张量异常检测方法计算效率低和异常空间结构刻画灵活性不足的问题，为高光谱异常检测提供了新的高效解决方案。

title: Observe Before You Alert: Adaptive Driver Alerting with Vision-Language Models
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
summary: Driver alerting from dashcam video requires sequential decision-making under partial observability: a system must decide not only whether a scene is risky, but also when the evidence is sufficient to warn. Most existing accident anticipation models output a binary risk score, leaving ambiguous scenes to be handled by thresholding. We propose VLAlert, a vision-language alerting framework that casts warning generation as a tri-action policy over SILENT, OBSERVE, and ALERT. The OBSERVE action acts as an internal evidence-gathering decision that delays uncertain warnings and changes the next observation window, creating a lightweight perception-action loop for adaptive alerting. VLAlert uses Qwen3-VL-4B as a safety-evidence generator and pools hidden states from structured belief spans to form compact representations for danger estimation and policy prediction. We evaluate VLAlert on VLAlert-Bench, a unified per-tick benchmark from four real-world dashcam alert datasets, and further test transfer to held-out naturalistic ADAS takeover clips. On VLAlert-Bench validation, VLAlert achieves the highest deployment-oriented utility among tested baselines, with DAUS 0.4878 compared with 0.4752 for Open-BADAS, and improves AUROC, AP_tick, F1_t, and balanced accuracy from 0.610, 0.176, 0.276, and 0.581 to 0.689, 0.195, 0.297, and 0.648, respectively. On 221 held-out ADAS-TO-Critic clips, VLAlert improves R@5s from 74.2% to 88.7% and F1 from 0.585 to 0.686. These results indicate that adaptive observation and safety-focused VLM representations provide measurable gains for driver-facing alert decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLAlert，一个视觉语言告警框架，将行车记录仪视频中的驾驶员告警问题建模为三动作策略（SILENT/OBSERVE/ALERT），通过OBSERVE动作实现自适应证据收集。基于Qwen3-VL-4B生成安全证据并池化隐藏状态用于危险估计和策略预测。在VLAlert-Bench基准上，VLAlert在部署导向效用DAUS达到0.4878，优于基线Open-BADAS的0.4752；在221个ADAS接管片段上R@5s从74.2%提升至88.7%，验证了自适应观察和VLM安全表征的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的事故预测模型仅输出二值风险分数，通过简单阈值处理模糊场景，无法有效解决"何时警告"的时序决策问题。行车记录仪告警本质上需要在部分可观测条件下进行序贯决策，而现有方法缺乏这种自适应证据收集能力。
AI.method: VLAlert将告警生成建模为三动作策略：SILENT、OBSERVE和ALERT。其中OBSERVE作为内部证据收集决策，延迟不确定的警告并改变下一观察窗口，形成轻量级感知-行动循环。模型使用Qwen3-VL-4B作为安全证据生成器，对结构化信念跨度的隐藏状态进行池化，形成紧凑的危险估计和策略预测表征。
AI.result: 在VLAlert-Bench验证集上，DAUS达0.4878（对比Open-BADAS的0.4752）；AUROC从0.610提升至0.689，AP_tick从0.176到0.195，F1_t从0.276到0.297，平衡准确率从0.581到0.648。在221个ADAS-TO-Critic片段上，R@5s从74.2%提升至88.7%，F1从0.585提升至0.686。
AI.conclusion: 自适应观察机制和安全导向的VLM表征能够显著提升面向驾驶员的告警决策质量，说明了在告警任务中引入显式证据收集决策而非简单阈值化的价值。

title: MRI-Guided Reslice-Refined Cross-Slice SDF Reconstruction of the Left Ventricle from Cardiac MRI with Sparse Axial Supervision
summary: Reconstructing a three-dimensional left-ventricular (LV) endocardial surface from cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) data is challenging when supervision is available on only a small number of axial slices. Through-plane geometry is weakly constrained, and automatically generated two-dimensional masks can propagate segmentation errors into the recovered shape. We present MR-RS-SDFR, a per-case implicit signed distance field (SDF) framework that reconstructs a continuous LV surface from a CMR volume and sparse axial weak masks. The method first builds a cross-slice SDF initialization from axial and longitudinal geometric cues and then refines the field using two complementary signals: MRI edge-field normal alignment, which provides an image-derived boundary cue independent of the weak masks, and differentiable reslice Dice and contour consistency, which preserve agreement with the observed planes. We evaluate three weak-mask generators -- LOO TransUNet, LOO nnU-Net, and an off-the-shelf Medical SAM3 model used without MM-WHS-specific training or fine-tuning -- and five sparsity levels from 4 to 64 axial planes. In the sparse-16 setting, final MR-RS-SDFR reconstruction reaches 0.928 Dice and 3.80mm HD95 with Medical SAM3 masks. The upstream generators do not exhibit a single common ranking across 2D and dense 3D segmentation, and nnU-Net- and Medical-SAM3-driven sparse reconstruction achieve the same mean final Dice despite different upstream error profiles. Across all three sparse-16 mask sources, MR-RS-SDFR is numerically better than protocol-matched full GHD+DVS in both Dice and HD95. Final Dice improves markedly from sparse-4 to sparse-16 and then saturates at the reported precision through sparse-64. These results support MRI-guided per-case SDF refinement as a reconstruction strategy that remains effective across weak-mask generators and supervision densities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MR-RS-SDFR，一个基于隐式符号距离场（SDF）的逐病例框架，用于从心脏磁共振（CMR）数据和稀疏轴向弱掩膜中重建连续的三维左心室心内膜表面。该方法通过跨切片SDF初始化和MRI边缘场法向对齐、可微重切片Dice与轮廓一致性两种互补信号进行细化。在稀疏16层设置下，结合Medical SAM3掩膜达到0.928 Dice和3.80mm HD95，且在所有弱掩膜生成器和监督密度下均优于基准方法。
AI.motivation: 从CMR数据重建三维左心室心内膜表面面临挑战：仅少量轴向切片有监督标注时，穿切片几何约束极弱；自动生成的二维掩膜会将分割错误传播到三维重建中，影响形状的准确性。
AI.method: 提出MR-RS-SDFR逐病例隐式SDF框架。首先利用轴向和纵向几何线索构建跨切片SDF初始化；然后通过两种互补信号细化场：一是MRI边缘场法向对齐（提供独立于弱掩膜的图像边界线索），二是可微重切片的Dice和轮廓一致性（保持与观测平面的对齐）。评估了三种弱掩膜生成器（LOO TransUNet、LOO nnU-Net、Medical SAM3）和五种从4到64个轴向平面的稀疏度水平。
AI.result: 稀疏16设置下，MR-RS-SDFR结合Medical SAM3掩膜达到0.928 Dice和3.80mm HD95。上游生成器在二维和稠密三维分割间无单一共同排序；nnU-Net和Medical SAM3驱动的稀疏重建达到相同平均最终Dice。在所有三种稀疏16掩膜源下，MR-RS-SDFR在Dice和HD95上均优于协议匹配的完整GHD+DVS。最终Dice从稀疏4到稀疏16显著提升，随后在稀疏64处趋于饱和。
AI.conclusion: MRI引导的逐病例SDF细化是一种有效的重建策略，在多种弱掩膜生成器和监督密度下均保持稳健有效，证明了该框架的泛化能力与实用性。

title: SciFigure2Code: An AI-Reconstructed Benchmark for Scientific Figure-to-Code
summary: Scientific figures are the interface through which research claims are inspected and reused, but final published panels rarely expose the data or plotting code that produced them. Recovering this hidden provenance from pixels is therefore underdetermined. We introduce SciFigure2Code, an AI-reconstructed benchmark that instead evaluates presentation recovery: generating editable Python programs that preserve how a scientific panel is arranged and read. Role-specialized Codex agents generate, execute, visually refine, and audit silver-standard presentation programs that capture geometry, visual hierarchy, encodings, annotations, and typography without claiming to recover original measurements or author source code. This reconstruction-and-audit protocol turns final published panels into auditable reference packages; the resulting resource contains 6,740 reviewed panels and SciFigureBench, a balanced 337-panel test set across 31 chart subtypes, five domains, and three complexity levels. Across 14 zero-shot models in image-only and caption-assisted settings, execution, multi-component layouts, axes, legends, and scientific labels remain weak. Claude Opus 4.7 achieves the highest image-only Overall score, Claude Opus 4.6 leads caption-assisted reconstruction, and two-stage plan-then-code prompting improves Overall for all four tested models. SciFigure2Code provides an auditable testbed for agents that construct editable, visually faithful scientific figure presentations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciFigure2Code基准，用AI重建科学图表的可编辑Python展示代码（而非原始数据/源码），包含6,740个已审查面板和337个测试面板，跨31种子图类型，并评估14个零样本模型，发现多组件布局、坐标轴、图例和科学标注仍是薄弱点。
AI.motivation: 科学图表是研究声明被检查和复用的接口，但最终发表的图表面板很少暴露生成它们的数据或绘图代码。从像素中恢复这些隐藏的来源是欠定（underdetermined）问题，因此需要一种替代性评估方式——评估"展示恢复"（presentation recovery），即生成保留图表布局和阅读方式的可编辑程序。
AI.method: 采用角色专精的Codex代理（Role-specialized Codex agents）来生成、执行、视觉精炼并审计银标准（silver-standard）展示程序，捕获几何结构、视觉层级、编码方式、标注和排版。通过重建与审计协议将已发表的图表面板转化为可审计的参考包。
AI.result: 构建了包含6,740个已审查面板的资源和SciFigureBench测试集（337个平衡面板，覆盖31种子图类型、5个领域和3个复杂度级别）。评估14个零样本模型后发现：执行、多组件布局、坐标轴、图例和科学标签仍然薄弱。Claude Opus 4.7在纯图像模式下取得最高Overall分数，Claude Opus 4.6在带标题辅助的重建中领先，两阶段"先规划后编码"提示方法对所有四个测试模型的Overall均有提升。
AI.conclusion: SciFigure2Code为构建可编辑、视觉忠实的科学图表展示的代理提供了一个可审计的测试平台（auditable testbed），能够推动科学图表可视化代码生成领域的进展。

title: Boundary Voting Network for Ambiguity-Aware Timestamp-Supervised Action Segmentation
summary: Timestamp-supervised action segmentation aims to segment and classify actions in untrimmed videos with a random frame annotated per action. Precisely localizing action boundaries from timestamp annotations is crucial for this setting, as it enables generating framewise pseudo-labels and applying the well-explored fully-supervised training. However, prevailing methods struggle with intrinsic uncertainty in boundary localization due to less discriminative features in action-transiting regions. This imprecise boundary estimation significantly reduces the stability and reliability of the generated pseudo-labels in ambiguous action-transiting regions, consequently resulting in performance deterioration of the trained segmentation models. In our paper, we introduce the boundary voting network that mitigates feature ambiguity by hierarchically propagating video-level global prior knowledge into local action-transiting regions. By generating key action representations as votes throughout the video and targeting action-transiting regions, all votes collaboratively contribute to action-transiting feature enhancement and boundary localization refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种边界投票网络（Boundary Voting Network），通过将视频级别的全局先验知识分层传播到局部动作过渡区域，缓解特征模糊性，从而提升时间戳监督动作分割中动作边界定位的精度。
AI.motivation: 时间戳监督的动作分割任务中，动作边界定位存在固有不确定性，因为动作过渡区域的特征区分度较低。现有方法生成的伪标签在模糊的动作过渡区域不够稳定可靠，导致分割模型性能下降。
AI.method: 提出边界投票网络，利用分层传播机制将视频级别的全局先验知识引入局部动作过渡区域；通过生成关键动作表示作为投票，并定向作用于动作过渡区域，所有投票协同增强动作过渡特征并细化边界定位。
AI.result: 在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast三个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过全局-局部信息的层级传播和投票机制，可以有效缓解动作过渡区域的特征模糊性，提升时间戳监督下动作边界定位的准确性和伪标签的可靠性，从而改善最终分割性能。

title: WSPolypNet: Weakly Supervised Polyp Localization in Colonoscopy Videos
summary: Because dense frame-level annotation of colonoscopy videos is costly, we propose WSPolypNet, a weakly supervised framework for polyp localization using only video-level labels. WSPolypNet employs a 3D convolutional neural network trained with video-level supervision to generate class activation maps (CAMs), which identify candidate polyp regions without requiring frame-level spatial annotations. The CAM-derived localization cues are further enhanced using a multi-view strategy and provided to MedSAM2 as point prompts. MedSAM2 then propagates segmentation masks across the video, refining the coarse localization cues according to polyp boundaries. WSPolypNet achieved CorLoc scores of 47.80%, 43.68%, and 35.01% at IoU thresholds of 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7, respectively, compared with 36.87%, 33.72%, and 27.94% in the single-view setting. For small polyps, the multi-view strategy improved CorLoc@0.5 from 16.01% to 30.97%. The framework also achieved a recall of 94.51%. These results demonstrate the potential of weakly supervised spatiotemporal learning to substantially reduce spatial annotation requirements for polyp localization in colonoscopy videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WSPolypNet，一种仅需视频级标签的弱监督息肉定位框架，利用3D CNN生成CAM并结合多视图策略增强定位线索，再引导MedSAM2完成跨视频分割掩膜传播，显著提升息肉定位性能。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜视频的密集帧级标注成本高昂，现有方法依赖昂贵的空间级标注，需要一种仅使用视频级标签即可实现息肉定位的弱监督方案，以大幅降低标注需求。
AI.method: 采用3D卷积神经网络在视频级监督下训练生成类激活图（CAMs），识别候选息肉区域；通过多视图策略增强CAM导出的定位线索；将增强后的线索作为点提示输入MedSAM2，由其跨视频传播分割掩膜，并根据息肉边界细化粗糙的定位线索。
AI.result: 在IoU阈值0.3、0.5和0.7下分别取得47.80%、43.68%和35.01%的CorLoc分数，均优于单视图设置的36.87%、33.72%和27.94%；小息肉场景下多视图策略将CorLoc@0.5从16.01%提升至30.97%，召回率达94.51%。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督时空学习能大幅减少结肠镜视频中息肉定位的空间标注需求，多视图策略与MedSAM2的结合有效提升了定位精度，尤其对小息肉检测具有显著优势。

title: PhysFlow: Physics-Aware Optical Flow for Motion Controllable Video Generation
summary: Video generation models have recently attracted substantial attention for their ability to generate visually compelling videos, yet ensuring physically consistent and plausible dynamics still remains a fundamental challenge, driving a growing line of research on physical realism in video generation. To address this challenge, motivated by the fact that physical regularities are primarily encoded in motion patterns, we propose PhysFlow, a novel two-stage framework for improving the physical plausibility of generated videos by decomposing video generation into motion-aware optical flow generation followed by motion-conditioned appearance synthesis. Specifically, PhysFlow consists of a physics-aware optical-flow video generator called PA-Flow and a flow-guided video generator called FlowRender. During the first stage, PA-Flow employs a physics-aware attention module to model how motion attributes and material properties influence global motion and local deformation, respectively, and generates an optical flow video as an explicit representation of motion. In the second stage, FlowRender leverages the decoupled motion representation as guidance to synthesize realistic textures and appearances, ultimately producing the final physically plausible video. To further support model training with explicit physical supervision, we construct PhysVideo, a physics-based video dataset generated with a physics engine and 3D-GS rendering, containing 10K foreground objects and 50K realistic video sequences with annotations of motion and material properties. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed PhysFlow generates videos with superior physical plausibility while maintaining high visual fidelity compared with existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysFlow，一个两阶段的视频生成框架，通过将视频生成分解为运动感知的光流生成和运动条件的外观合成两个阶段，来提升生成视频的物理合理性与视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型虽然能生成视觉上吸引人的视频，但在保证物理一致性和动态合理性方面仍面临根本性挑战，亟需提升生成视频的物理真实感。
AI.method: PhysFlow采用两阶段框架：第一阶段使用PA-Flow（物理感知光流视频生成器），通过物理感知注意力模块建模运动属性与材料属性对全局运动和局部形变的影响，生成光流视频作为运动的显式表征；第二阶段使用FlowRender（光流引导的视频生成器），利用解耦的运动表征指导逼真纹理和外观的合成。此外构建了基于物理引擎和3D-GS渲染的PhysVideo数据集，包含10K前景物体和50K带运动与材料属性标注的视频序列，用于显式物理监督训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，PhysFlow生成的视频在物理合理性上表现更优，同时保持了较高的视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将物理规则显式注入到运动表征（光流）生成中，并进一步利用运动引导外观合成，PhysFlow有效解决了视频生成中的物理合理性难题，为提升视频生成的物理真实感提供了新范式。

title: Drive by Hindsight and Foresight: Tool-Grounded Synergistic Reasoning over Hierarchical Memory for Autonomous Driving
summary: VLMs have shown promise for autonomous driving, yet still suffer from hallucination, weak spatio-temporal perception, and limited generalization. Recent methods improve reasoning and decision-making through CoT explanations, retrieval-augmented generation or the static injection of tool outputs. Although these mechanisms enrich the context, the model neither proactively perceives scene information nor accumulates experience after answering. To overcome these limitations, we present, to our knowledge, the first synergistic framework that tightly couples hierarchical memory with proactive tool invocation in a closed reasoning loop. Our contributions are threefold. (i) Hierarchical Driving Memory: a scene-level short-term memory maintains the dynamic scene state, and an evolving long-term memory retrieves reusable experience and tool strategies. (ii) Memory-Tool Synergistic Reasoning Framework: guided by the scene state and retrieved experience, the model adaptively invokes tools to refine its reasoning at inference time and consolidates reusable experience into a long-term memory pool offline. (iii) Data Generation and Two-stage Training Pipeline: verified memory-tool trajectories built by multi-step teacher rollout are used to train with SFT and GRPO. Our 7B model reaches an overall reasoning score of 80.03 and MCQ accuracy of 79.09% on DriveLMM-o1, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.74 MCQ points and generalizes strongly across benchmarks. Notably, ablation and analysis studies validate the effectiveness of each component and further reveal the complementary roles of hierarchical memory. Short-term memory strengthens spatio-temporal understanding, improving STSBench accuracy by 24.2 points, while offline long-term memory consolidation yields an additional 3.57-point MCQ gain with all parameters frozen, demonstrating continual self-evolution through accumulated driving experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个将层级驾驶记忆与主动工具调用紧密耦合于闭环推理框架中的方法，通过场景级短期记忆维护动态场景状态、演化长期记忆检索可重用经验与工具策略，结合两阶段训练（SFT+GRPO），使7B模型在DriveLMM-o1上达到80.03推理分和79.09% MCQ准确率，超越最强基线7.74个MCQ点。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM自动驾驶方法虽通过CoT解释、检索增强生成或静态工具输出注入来丰富上下文，但模型既不主动感知场景信息，也无法在作答后积累经验，导致幻觉、时空感知弱和泛化受限等问题。
AI.method: 提出三部分贡献：(i) 层级驾驶记忆系统（场景短期记忆+演化长期记忆）；(ii) 记忆-工具协同推理框架（推理时自适应调用工具精炼推理，离线时将可重用经验固化为长期记忆）；(iii) 数据生成与两阶段训练流水线（多步教师轨迹构建验证后的记忆-工具轨迹，使用SFT和GRPO训练）。
AI.result: 7B模型在DriveLMM-o1上达到80.03推理分和79.09% MCQ准确率，超越最强基线7.74个MCQ点。消融实验显示短期记忆使STSBench准确率提升24.2点，离线长期记忆固化在参数冻结情况下额外带来3.57个MCQ提升。
AI.conclusion: 层级记忆的两个组成部分具有互补作用：短期记忆增强时空理解能力，长期记忆固化实现参数冻结下的持续自我演化，整体框架展现强泛化能力，验证了各组件有效性与记忆-工具协同推理范式的可行性。

title: SoftRerank: Hierarchical Soft Fusion with Candidate-Label Reranking for Long-Tailed Micro-Action Recognition
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26). Ranked 1st in the 3rd Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge at ACM MM 2026
summary: Micro-actions are subtle, low-intensity non-verbal behaviors that provide cues to fine-grained human states, including emotions and intentions. Recognizing them remains difficult because they are brief, contain weak visual changes, and often exhibit similar motion patterns across categories. This paper addresses these challenges with a fine-grained micro-action recognition method that combines full fine-tuning of InternVideo2.5, hierarchical soft fusion, and a lightweight candidate-label reranker. For the long-tailed label distribution in MA-52, we use class-balanced sampling and inverse-frequency reweighting to reduce the effect of frequent classes during training. We fine-tune InternVideo2.5 end to end and attach coarse and group-conditional fine-grained classification heads to the shared video representation, improving the consistency between coarse and fine predictions. For ambiguous samples, the candidate-label reranker uses hard samples and video-label matching to focus on easily confused fine-grained actions. Experiments validate the proposed method, which achieves a 79.99% F1-mean on MA-52 and ranks first in the 3rd Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种细粒度微动作识别方法，结合InternVideo2.5的全参数微调、层级软融合和轻量级候选标签重排序器，在MA-52数据集上取得79.99%的F1-mean分数，并在ACM Multimedia 2026第三届微动作分析挑战赛中排名第一。
AI.motivation: 微动作是细微、低强度的非语言行为，能提供人类情绪和意图的细粒度线索，但因其持续时间短、视觉变化弱且类别间运动模式相似，识别难度大。
AI.method: 该方法包括：(1) 对InternVideo2.5进行端到端全参数微调；(2) 采用层级软融合策略，在共享视频表示上附加粗粒度分类头和组条件细粒度分类头，提升粗/细预测一致性；(3) 引入轻量级候选标签重排序器，利用困难和视频-标签匹配样本来处理易混淆的细粒度动作；(4) 针对MA-52的长尾标签分布，采用类别平衡采样和逆频率重加权减少高频类别影响。
AI.result: 在MA-52数据集上取得了79.99%的F1-mean，并在ACM Multimedia 2026第三届微动作分析挑战赛中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过结合大型视频基础模型的端到端微调、层级分类结构设计和候选标签重排序机制，有效解决了微动作识别中细粒度区分和长尾分布等核心难题，验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: ActionSplice: In-Flight Action Editing for Interactive World Models
summary: Chunk-autoregressive video world models typically condition each generated chunk on one action. An action received during sampling must therefore wait for the next chunk, condition future solver evaluations on a state produced under the previous action, or trigger rollback that repeats completed evaluations. We introduce ActionSplice, an inference framework that formulates this problem as Counterfactual State Transport (CST). A lightweight corrector transports the interrupted backbone-native representation toward the matched state induced by the revised action at the same solver step. The world model and sampler remain frozen, and sampling resumes without replaying completed evaluations. The retargeting variant $\mathrm{CST}*{R}$ updates the entire active chunk, while the temporal-splicing variant $\mathrm{CST}*{T}$ preserves a temporal prefix and updates only the suffix. Across minWM-Wan Action2V and HY-WM1.5, $\mathrm{CST}*{R}$ reduces rollback-relative LPIPS by 61.5% and 75.9% relative to direct condition swapping. $\mathrm{CST}*{T}$ reduces suffix LPIPS by 56.1% and 77.5%, respectively, while providing $2.73\times$ and $1.69\times$ pixel-ready speedups over waiting. Under the HY-WorldPlay protocol, $\mathrm{CST}_{R}$ obtains a PSNR of 25.66 dB, an SSIM of 0.6902, and an LPIPS of 0.1337 against the original rollout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ActionSplice推理框架，将分块自回归视频世界模型中的动作切换问题形式化为反事实状态传输（CST），通过轻量级校正器将骨干网络表征传输到修订动作对应的匹配状态，无需整体回滚即可恢复采样。
AI.motivation: 在分块自回归视频世界模型中，每一块通常只对应一个动作。当采样过程中收到新动作时，要么需等待下一块生成，要么需要在旧动作状态上继续求解，要么触发回滚重放已完成的计算，这些方式均造成延迟或计算浪费。
AI.method: 提出ActionSplice框架，将动作修订问题建模为反事实状态传输（CST）。CST_R变体更新整个活动块，CST_T变体保留时间前缀仅更新后缀。世界模型和采样器保持冻结，采样过程无需重放已完成的计算。
AI.result: 在minWM-Wan Action2V上，CST_R相对直接条件交换将LPIPS降低61.5%；在HY-WM1.5上降低75.9%。CST_T在后缀LPIPS上分别降低56.1%和77.5%，同时相比等待方案提供2.73倍和1.69倍的像素就绪加速。在HY-WorldPlay协议下CST_R达到PSNR 25.66 dB、SSIM 0.6902、LPIPS 0.1337。
AI.conclusion: ActionSplice以轻量且高效的推理框架解决了分块自回归视频世界模型中动作切换带来的延滞问题，在减少视觉失真和加速采样方面效果显著，且无需修改或重新训练底层世界模型。

title: CS-CLIP: Compositional Scene Graph-guided CLIP for Robust Compositional Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate strong performance across compositional reasoning benchmarks, which require reasoning over semantic perturbations of objects, attributes, relations, and their interactions. However, our controlled analysis reveals that existing compositionality-aware VLMs exhibit element-specific biases, often underperforming vanilla CLIP on certain compositional elements. To address this, we propose Compositional Scene Graph-guided CLIP (CS-CLIP), which uses scene graphs to identify compositional elements and construct structured negatives via selective masking. We further retain negatives that are most contradictory to the original caption, forcing the model to rely on compositional structure rather than surface cues. CS-CLIP achieves state-of-the-art compositional reasoning with robust performance across compositional elements. It also preserves general vision-language capabilities such as cross-modal retrieval and downstream visual reasoning, while requiring fewer training samples than prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出CS-CLIP模型，利用场景图识别组合元素并构建结构化负样本，通过选择性掩蔽和保留与原始描述最矛盾的负样本，使模型依赖组合结构而非表面线索，在组合推理基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有组合感知的视觉语言模型在不同组合元素上表现出元素特定偏差，某些情况下甚至不如vanilla CLIP。需要通过受控分析揭示这一问题并提出针对性解决方案。
AI.method: 使用场景图识别组合元素，通过选择性掩蔽构造结构化负样本，并保留与原始标题最矛盾的负样本，迫使模型依赖组合结构而非表面线索进行推理。
AI.result: 在组合推理任务上达到最先进水平，各组合元素上表现稳健；同时保持跨模态检索和下游视觉推理等通用视觉语言能力，且所需训练样本少于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CS-CLIP通过场景图引导的结构化负样本策略，在提升组合推理能力的同时有效避免了元素特定偏差，且以更少训练样本保持通用能力。

title: Tracking-by-detection in Multi-object Tracking: Survey and Experiments
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) is an essential computer vision task that simultaneously tracks multiple objects in video sequences, with various applications in surveillance, autonomous navigation, and human-computer interaction. The tracking-by-detection (TBD) paradigm, which combines object detection with temporal association, has emerged as a leading approach, driven by innovative algorithms. Despite recent progress, fair evaluation of TBD-based methods remains a challenge. Many studies introduce modules such as similarity metrics, data association strategies, or motion models, but they are often evaluated under inconsistent protocols, with different baseline trackers, hyperparameters, and datasets. Such inconsistencies obscure the genuine contribution of each module and hinder objective comparison. This survey systematically reviews TBD-based MOT techniques, including similarity measurements, data association, camera motion compensation, and interpolation strategies. Starting from a minimal baseline tracker, we fairly evaluate the contributions of each method across diverse datasets and accumulate well-balanced methods. Our findings establish a strong baseline tracker and provide a foundation for the principled design of robust and versatile MOT systems suitable for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了基于检测跟踪（TBD）范式的多目标跟踪技术，指出现有研究因评估协议不一致而难以公平比较各模块贡献，并从最小基线跟踪器出发，在多样数据集上公平评估相似度度量、数据关联、相机运动补偿和插值策略等模块，最终建立了强基线跟踪器，为鲁棒MOT系统设计提供基础。
AI.motivation: TBD方法的评估存在严重的不一致性问题——不同研究采用不同的基线跟踪器、超参数和数据集，导致各模块（如相似度度量、数据关联策略、运动模型）的真实贡献被掩盖，难以进行客观比较，需要系统性公平评估来揭示每种技术的实际价值。
AI.method: 本文采用系统综述方法，首先回顾TBD框架下的关键技术模块（相似度度量、数据关联、相机运动补偿、插值策略），然后从最小基线跟踪器出发，在多个数据集上对每个模块逐一进行公平的增量评估，并累积验证平衡组合的有效性。
AI.result: 研究确立了多个模块各自的实际贡献水平，识别出有效的模块组合，最终建立了一个强基线跟踪器，其性能在多样数据集上具有良好平衡性和鲁棒性，为后续MOT研究提供了可复现的公平比较基准。
AI.conclusion: 公平且可复现的评估是推动MOT领域发展的关键；本文提供的高质量基线跟踪器和系统评估框架，可作为未来MOT方法设计与改进的参照基准，有助于构建适用于真实场景的鲁棒多目标跟踪系统。

title: SAM3-O2D2: Zero-Shot Object Out-of-Distribution Detection by Object Class Prompting of the SAM3-Image Model
summary: Object detectors have shown remarkable performance in various fields, among these medical imaging, surveillance, and autonomous driving. However, they are prone to overconfidence when encountering unseen objects in real-world deployments, causing potential safety issues. To address this, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) objects is essential for reliable object detection. Modern approaches leverage the broad semantic knowledge of foundation models such as CLIP for post-hoc few- and zero-shot OOD detection. However, these methods typically perform OOD assessment in feature space, which can be sensitive to object detector localization errors and variations in object appearance. Moreover, the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot method performs computationally costly diffusion in inference. In this work, for our proposed zero-shot object OOD detection method SAM3-O2D2, we employ the SAM3-image foundation model in an efficient manner. Specifically, we prompt SAM3 only with the object detector's predicted classes and compare the predictions of the object detector and SAM3. An object is in-distribution (ID), if SAM3 also detects an object at the corresponding location. If SAM3 does not detect the prompted object, this indicates a mismatch between the detector's prediction and the image content, suggesting that the object is OOD. Experimental results show that our method significantly surpasses the so-far zero-shot SOTA method. Specifically, we achieve new SOTA AuROC and FPR95 metrics over both ID datasets Pascal-VOC and BDD100K and both OOD datasets MS-COCO and OpenImages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SAM3图像基础模型的零样本目标级OOD检测方法SAM3-O2D2，通过提示SAM3检测物体检测器预测的类别，并比较两者预测结果来判断目标是否为分布内或分布外。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD目标检测方法存在两个问题：一是基于CLIP等基础模型的特征空间评估对定位误差和外观变化敏感；二是当前零样本SOTA方法推理时需要昂贵的扩散计算。因此需要一种高效且鲁棒的零样本OOD目标检测方法。
AI.method: 利用SAM3图像基础模型进行高效推理。仅将物体检测器预测的类别作为提示输入给SAM3，然后比较物体检测器与SAM3的预测结果。若SAM3在对应位置也检测到物体则视为分布内；若SAM3未检测到被提示的物体，则表明检测器预测与图像内容不匹配，判为OOD。在推理时进行零样本OOD检测，避免昂贵扩散过程。
AI.result: 在Pascal-VOC和BDD100K两个分布内数据集以及MS-COCO和OpenImages两个分布外数据集上，方法显著超越现有零样本SOTA方法，取得了新的SOTA AuROC和FPR95指标。
AI.conclusion: 基于SAM3的预测一致性比较策略能够高效且有效地实现零样本OOD目标检测，解决了现有方法在推理成本和特征空间敏感性方面的局限。

title: Dreaming in Flow: Generative Grounding Feedback for Self-Evolving Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models integrate visual understanding and generation within a single network, yet the two capabilities are commonly optimized as separate tasks. We introduce Generative Grounding Feedback(GGF), a self-evolving post-training framework that uses only text prompts and the model's own visual experience. Given a prompt, the model first generates a visual ``dream.'' Flow-level feedback compares text-, image-, and repair-conditioned predictions at the same noisy latent state, transferring image-grounded generation directions to the prompt condition. Dream replay grounding replays this dream through captioning and re-imagination, training claim-level evidence to remain consistent across the replay while separating unrelated visual experiences. Jointly optimized, these two directions let generation provide visual grounding for understanding and understanding refine subsequent generation without paired image--text supervision. Experiments across unified models with different understanding--generation integration designs show consistent improvements in text-to-image generation together with modest gains in visual understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出Generative Grounding Feedback (GGF)，一种自进化后训练框架，仅使用文本提示和模型自身视觉经验，通过"梦境"生成、流级反馈和梦境回放来联合优化多模态模型的视觉理解和生成能力，无需配对图文监督。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型虽将视觉理解与生成集成于单一网络，但两者通常被当作独立任务优化，缺乏相互促进的协同训练机制，尤其缺乏无需配对图文数据即可实现理解和生成能力互相增强的方法。
AI.method: 包含两个核心方向：(1) Flow-level feedback——在相同噪声隐状态下比较文本、图像和修复条件预测的流级反馈，将图像接地生成方向迁移到提示条件；(2) Dream replay grounding——将生成的"梦境"通过描述和重新想象进行回放，训练声明级证据在回放中保持一致并与无关视觉经验分离。两者联合优化实现生成指导理解、理解反哺生成。
AI.result: 在多种具有不同理解-生成集成设计的统一多模态模型上进行了实验，文本到图像生成性能一致提升，同时视觉理解能力也有适度提升。
AI.conclusion: 生成过程可以为理解提供视觉接地，理解能力又能精炼后续生成，二者通过自演化后训练框架实现良性循环，且无需配对图像-文本监督。

title: MARS-CLIP: Multi-Resolution and Attention Refined Zero-Shot Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has demonstrated impressive capabilities in zero-shot transfer but often struggles with dense prediction tasks due to low spatial resolution and the loss of structural information. To address these limitations, we propose MARS-CLIP (Multi-resolution and Attention Refined Segmentation for CLIP), a novel framework for zero-shot semantic segmentation. Our approach introduces two key strategies: (i) a multi-resolution feature extraction module that fuses local fine-grained features with global context to overcome input resolution constraints, and (ii) an attention refinement mechanism that injects spatial and color biases from intermediate layers into the final self-attention block to accurately restore object boundaries. A set of experiments on six public datasets demonstrates that MARS-CLIP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出MARS-CLIP框架，通过多分辨率特征提取与注意力精炼机制，解决CLIP在零样本语义分割中空间分辨率低和结构信息丢失的问题，在六个公开数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: CLIP在零样本迁移任务中表现出色，但在密集预测任务（如语义分割）中表现不佳，主要原因是输入分辨率较低以及结构信息在特征提取过程中丢失。现有方法未能有效解决这两个核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出两个关键策略：(i) 多分辨率特征提取模块，融合局部细粒度特征与全局上下文以突破输入分辨率限制；(ii) 注意力精炼机制，将中间层的空间与颜色偏置注入最终自注意力块中，从而准确恢复目标边界。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集上的实验表明，MARS-CLIP显著优于当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: MARS-CLIP通过多分辨率融合与注意力精炼两大策略，有效克服了CLIP在零样本语义分割中分辨率不足和结构信息丢失的局限，验证了该框架的有效性与通用性。

title: Human-Centric Image Captioning with Subject-Centered Spatial Understanding
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve remarkable performance on generic image captioning, they frequently suffer from structural hallucinations in human-centric scenarios. Accurately modeling human subjects is foundational for critical downstream applications, such as accurate avatar/video/image generation and fine-grained human action understanding. However, these tasks require highly precise subject-centered spatial grounding, such as distinguishing egocentric left/right laterality and maintaining correct anatomical-object bindings. Although catastrophic for structural integrity, these localized spatial inversions are often overshadowed by overall descriptive metrics in existing benchmarks. To systematically expose and quantify this bottleneck, we introduce SPACE (Subject-centric Poses, Appearance, and Characteristics Evaluation), a benchmark designed to evaluate subject-centered spatial understanding. On SPACE, we reveal that despite strong generic perception, current MLLMs consistently fail to ground descriptions in the subject's intrinsic frame of reference. To bridge this gap, we propose a specialized data construction and alignment pipeline. We first extract structured spatial hints from fine-grained body-part localization to guide a two-stage caption rewriting process, yielding highly spatially-faithful training data. Furthermore, we design a rubric-based reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that explicitly penalizes structurally critical spatial errors during alignment. Extensive experiments on SPACE demonstrate our framework significantly improves human-centric caption quality, particularly in subject-centered spatial reasoning, achieving performance competitive with strong closed-source models. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/JHang2020/SPACE-Eval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPACE基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在以主体为中心的空间理解能力（如自我左右侧区分、解剖部位绑定），并配套提出数据构建和对齐流程，通过空间提示引导的两阶段描述重写和基于规则的GRPO奖励，显著提升人类为中心图像描述的空间保真度。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在通用图像描述上表现优异，但在以人为中心的场景中常出现结构性幻觉，尤其是需要精确主体空间定位的任务（如自我左右侧、解剖-物体绑定）。现有基准的整体描述指标掩盖了这些局部的空间反转错误，缺乏对此瓶颈的系统性评估。
AI.method: 1) 提出SPACE基准评估主体中心的空间理解能力；2) 从细粒度身体部位定位提取结构化空间提示，指导两阶段描述重写流程生成高空间保真训练数据；3) 设计基于规则的奖励用于GRPO对齐，显式惩罚结构关键的空间错误。
AI.result: 实验表明尽管现有MLLMs具有强大的通用感知能力，但在主体的固有参考系中进行空间描述时一致失败；所提框架显著改善了以人为中心的描述质量，尤其在主体中心空间推理方面，达到了与强闭源模型竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: 主体中心的空间理解是MLLMs的重要瓶颈，通过专门的基准评估、空间保真的数据构建和针对空间错误的奖励对齐，可以有效弥合这一差距，推动以人为中心的细粒度应用发展。

title: TRIUNE-Net: Harmonizing Scale, Shape, and Efficiency in Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation
summary: Pancreatic tumor segmentation in 3D CT volumes is challenged by extreme scale variability across both the pancreas and tumor, and highly irregular tumor morphology. While recent advances have pushed segmentation performance, existing methods do not explicitly address these challenges and come at the cost of excessive computational complexity, limiting their practicality in resource-constrained clinical environments. We propose TRIUNE-Net, a lightweight unified architecture that harmonizes scale, shape, and efficiency through three synergistic innovations. A multi-scale context aggregation module with stage-adaptive dilated convolutions enables the model to reason across the broad range of anatomical scales present in both organs. A serial linear-deformable attention mechanism combines large effective receptive fields with shapeadaptive deformable convolutions to capture irregular, non-convex tumor morphologies. Finally, an information-preserving downsampling module replaces conventional max pooling entirely, retaining all spatial information while adding negligible parameters, preventing small tumors from being discarded before they can be recognized. On both the MSD Pancreas and NVD Pancreas datasets, TRIUNE-Net achieves state-of-theart results with only 5.86 M parameters and no external pre-training, outperforming all baselines across all key tumor metrics. Specifically, it surpasses the next-best model by 0.45% in tumor Dice, 6.0 points in F1 score, 6.6 points in sensitivity, and 3.4 points in precision, simultaneously reflecting its ability to suppress both missed tumors and false alarms in clinically realistic conditions. Our code is available at: https://github.com/abdora-ai/TRIUNE-Net

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRIUNE-Net，一个轻量级统一架构用于3D CT胰腺肿瘤分割，通过多尺度上下文聚合、串行线性可变形注意力机制和信息保持的下采样三个模块协同解决尺度变异性、不规则肿瘤形态和计算效率问题。在MSD Pancreas和NVD Pancreas数据集上达到最先进水平，仅需5.86M参数且无需外部预训练。
AI.motivation: 胰腺肿瘤分割面临两大挑战：胰腺与肿瘤的极端尺度变异性以及高度不规则的肿瘤形态。现有方法未明确针对这些挑战，且计算复杂度过高，限制了其在资源受限临床环境中的实用性。
